tei:titleStmt.tei:title: bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las/ /chos sde yongs rdzogs kyi them byang bzhugs so/oṃ swa sti/sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa
bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las/ /chos sde yongs rdzogs kyi them byang bzhugs so/oṃ swa sti/sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa

tei:div.tei:p: bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las/ /chos sde yongs rdzogs kyi them byang bzhugs so/ oṃ swa sti/ sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa yi/ /bka' gsang zab gter bdun cu'i cha shas las/ /bsam yas mchims phu'i gter byon thugs sgrub rmad/ /bde gshegs bka' 'dus chos sde'i them byang 'god/ de yang o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i zab gter rtsa gsum rab 'byams kyi sgrub thabs sna tshogs pa las/ 'di ni bka' phur thugs gsum gyi ya gyal thugs sgrub yin pa ma zad rtsa gsum bka' 'dus chos kyi mtsho zhes rtsa gsum dgongs pa 'dus pa'i zab chos bla na med pa 'di nyid thog mar mnga' bdag btsan po sogs rje 'bangs snying gi bu dgu la bder 'dus gsum gyi smin grol phog pa dang*/ bar du bsam yas dbu rtse rim gsum du ma 'ongs lung bstan zhus len rgyas par bstsal ba/ tha ma khra 'brug tu lha sras mu khri btsan po sogs las can 'dus pa'i 'khor rnams la/ bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho zhal phyes shing zhus len zhal gdams le'u bdun ma bka' stsal zhing snga phyi de thams cad kyi rgyab chos su bsam pa lhun 'grub ma man ngag bcu gsum bcas gung thang la thog tu skyel len tshul du bstsal bar lung bstan pa bzhin phyi mor gung thang la ru bod kyi rje 'bangs la zhal chems su gdams pa ste/ de ltar thog mtha' bar gsum chos 'khor rim pa gsum dang zhus len man ngag zhal chems dang bcas pa phyogs gcig tu dril ba'i chos sde chen po 'di nyid gu ru'i shin tu gces par mdzad de jo mo mtsho rgyal la ma 'ongs pa'i don du zab mo'i gter du bsdams par gnyer kha gtad cing gter gyi gnas kyang gangs can rdo rje gdan dpal bsam yas gtsug lag khang dang 'brel ba'i mchims phu brag dmar ke'u tshang zhes sngar bder 'dus gsum gyi chos 'khor dang po zhal phyes pa'i gnas de nyid du sbas par mdzad pas/ zugs pa rtsa ba lta bu'i dbus gter gyi khongs su gtogs pa bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen sogs lam gyi nyams len ma tshang ba med cing zab khyad rmad du byung ba'i chos sde yongs rdzogs kyi them byang 'god pa la/

thugs sgrub smad cha wam̐ rtags can la'ang rtsa ba gter gzhung gi skor/ yan lag kha skong gi skor/ chog khrigs sna tshogs kyi skor bcas gsum las/ dang po rtsa ba gter gzhung gi skor la/ thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus dang*/ bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'i zhal gdams le'u bdun ma sogs snga phyir bka' stsal zhing de thams cad kyi rgyab chos su bsam pa lhun 'grub ma man ngag bcu gsum zhes bya ba la'ang*/ stod las byang chub sgrub pa'i zhal gdams lnga dang*/ smad las gang 'dul der ston gyi zhal gdams lnga dang*/ phrin las bye brag gi zhal gdams bzhi bcas bzhugs pa las/ dang po stod las byang chub sgrub pa'i zhal gdams dang 'brel le'u lnga las/ ka) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: bde chen zhing sgrub ye shes gsang lam ngo mtshar rin po che'i phreng ba/ kha) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: bde chen rgyal po rig 'dzin rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs in+d+ra nī la'i khang bu/ ga) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: thod phreng rigs lnga'i sgrub pa 'khrul snang rang grol/ nga) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: o rgyan dpa' bo gyad kyi sgrub thabs ka dag snying po/ ca) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: mkha' spyod sgrub pa ye shes zang thal/

gnyis pa smad las gang 'dul der ston gyi zhal gdams la'ang lnga/ cha) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: o rgyan nor lha dbyer med sgrub thabs rat+na'i rgyal mtshan/ ja) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: o rgyan sman lha dbyer med sgrub pa 'chi med bcud dril/ nya) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: o rgyan rdo rje gur gyi sgrub thabs 'jigs med gnam lcags ri bo/ ta) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: dregs pa zil gnon gyi dmod pa'i spu gri bdud dpung mthar byed/ tha) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: g.yul bzlog dregs pa'i dmag 'gyed shan pa spu gri/ gsum pa phrin las so sor sgrub pa'i le tshan la/ da) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: sbas gnas sgo 'byed bar chad lam sel ye shes drwa ba/ na) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: rin chen gter sgo 'byed pa mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs bde chen dpa' mo'i rol rtsed/ pa) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: sbas yul sgo 'byed o rgyan dpa' bo ging sgrub rin chen lde mig / bcas le tshan bcu gsum dang*/ pha) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: ma rgyud 'pho ba ka dag ye grol ngo sprod/ ba) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: bde chen zhing gi smon lam sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/ ma) ye shes mkha' 'gro khro gnyer can ma las: gdong lnga'i gsang sgrub gnam lcags ur mo/ tsa) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: lha mo khro gnyer can gyi byad khrol gser gyi lde mig tsha) 'phags ma khro gnyer can ma las: sreg pa zangs kyi sgrom bu sog le dmar chung*/ dza) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bar chad kun sel las: bum gter ri khrus kyi bkram bkod ye shes me long*/ wa) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las:

ri khrus bag chags stobs 'joms/ zha) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: bstan skyong yul gyi cho ga bde legs kun 'byung*/ za) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: rgya gar chos kyi rgyal po in+d+ra bo dhi dang bod kyi rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sku ring la sku tshab bzhengs pa'i dkar chag bsdus pa rin chen mgul rgyan/ 'a) sku tshab mthong grol gyi dkar chag ya) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: dbang chen in+ḍa nī la'i mchod sdong rin po che'i phreng ba/ ra) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: bum dbang ye shes 'od kyi drwa ba/ la) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: rtsa ba gcig dril gyi lha tshom ye shes drwa ba/ sha) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: gsang dbang bde chen 'khor lo zab lam ye shes drwa ba/ sa) chos skyong sde lnga'i bskul gab pa don phyungs kyi sdeb/ khol du phyung ba bka' rgya ma/ ha) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: ma rgyud 'pho ba ka dag ye grol bcas chos tshan nyer dgu bzhugs so// slar smad pa/ bde gshegs kun 'dus thugs sgrub rgya mtsho'i phul/ /rtsa gsum bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho zhes/ /gcig chog kun 'dus zab chos rgya mtsho 'di/ /tshogs gnyis yongs 'dus chos sbyin rgya mtshor spel/ /de slad dpal mgon bla ma yi/ /thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs pa dang*/ gang la me tog phog pa yi/ /lhag pa'i lha dang gang de'i chos/ /rgyun dkon gsung rab bsdu skrun dang*/ chad nye'i smin grol rgyun spel slad/ /'di yang bka' gter sri zhu ru/ /e waṃ dpe skrun khang nas bsgrubs/ /des kyang snying po'i ring lugs 'di/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa dar zhing rgyas/ /snyigs ma'i rgud pa yongs su zhi/ /rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod par shog / zhes pa'ang sgo chen sprul ming gsang sngags bstan 'dzin pas gsol ba btab pa bzhin 'grub par gyur cig/

// ka) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: bde chen zhing sgrub ye shes gsang lam ngo mtshar rin po che'i phreng ba bzhugs so: thugs sgrub yang snying bde gshegs kun 'dus las: bde chen zhing gi sgrub pa nyams su len pa'i gang zag: mos blo chos la 'gro ba: tshe 'di'i bya byed yid dpyod thams cad rmi lam dang glog gi rol rtsed ltar: 'khrul pa bdag tu bzung ba don med yin pas mtshan nyid ngo 'phrod pa: sangs rgyas lag 'chang sgrub pa'i dam bca' gdeng ldan dang : rang blo mi zhum pa'i spobs pas lhur len pa la 'bebs par bya ba'i gdams pa ma ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal gyi zhal lung thog ma'o: sa ma ya: e ma hoḥ gdams pa'i zhal lung rgyud kyi man ngag las: rgyal sras grogs la nges 'byung tshigs su bcad: blo yi rab ma chos kyi mdun bsu la: skye gnas 'jig dang tha ma'i bar do gsum: nges par da lan lus 'dir 'byung ba la: rnam g.yeng bdud kyi blo sna mi mdzin par: mi rtag 'chi ba nges shes rang rgyud bskul: tshe la long med snum zad dkar me 'dra: chu tshod yud tsam 'chi ba nye ru ldang : tshe 'dir bsags pa'i nor rdzas sbrang rtsi bzhin: bsags pa'i dbang yod za ba'i go skabs med: dmangs po'i zas nor btsan pos 'phrog pa bzhin: gzhon lus mi rtag nam langs ba mo ltar: 'chi bdag nyi mas dal 'byor zil pa skam: snying ring dred po'i zas skal gshin rjes 'phrog: tshogs ma bsags rnams gtan brgyag lam la zad: zhim lto 'jam gos sprin dkar 'dab ma bzhin: rtsol sgrub tha ma ston nam g.yer ba 'dra: blo gtad rtswa shing 'bras bu thal ba 'byung : gtong bsam chen po byed don gnad la 'gags: yengs ma lam la mi tshe stong log mkhan: rten 'brel bcu gnyis lus kyi sgrom bu 'di: dur khrod rus pa'i khra khrol ya re nga : mi gtsang 'dam rdzab 'khor ba'i phyi thag 'di: 'di phyi gnyis phung yin pas kye re hud:

zob po'i dge bshes 'jig rten dkor nag rngam: skye srid kun la mi phan zhe re pham: ser gzugs a 'thas 'gong po mi chos mkhas: zog pos chos brgyad sgrub pa bdud kyi grogs: 'phral bzang 'phro med g.yo can sbyin pa bzhin: de mthong skal ldan rnams kyis chos sgrub tshe: sngon chad shi ba rnams la skyo bas bskul: da lta yad yud 'di la mi rtag sgom: phyis 'byung tshe rabs gtan gyi 'dun ma la: gnas lugs ngo bo chos sku'i nyams len skyongs: zhing khams dag pa longs sku'i rtsal snang sbyongs: 'bras bu dag pa sprul sku'i 'dun ma sgrubs: lha sras dam 'dzin rje 'bangs grogs rnams kun: ma 'ongs dus su snying nas chos byed dkon: khyad par snyigs ma lnga brgya'i yang mtha' la: mi rnams dug lnga rang phung spyod pa yis: 'bras bu rnam smin dus ngan gnyis tshogs 'khor: de dus sgrub la long med glo bur 'chi: nyams len skyong ba nyin mo'i skar ma tsam: dge bcu'i srol bstod nam phyed me dmar mtshungs: de 'dra'i skabs su sems can a tsa ma: nges par ngan gol lam la snyogs pa'i tshe: da lta'i grogs rnams skye ba rim brgyud nas: phan sems bla na med pas rgyud bskul mthus: nga yi snying byang don tshan 'byed par 'gyur: de dus zhal gdams 'di dang gang 'phrad rnams: o rgyan bde chen zhing la bgrod par 'gyur: 'di la sgrub pa phyi nang gsang gsum ste: phyi ltar tshogs bsags cho ga'i phyag len dang : nang ltar nyams len bskyed rdzogs skyong thabs dang : zung 'jug bdag lus zhing khams ltar sbyangs nas: dran rig mngon sum chos sku sgrub pa'i thabs: spros bcas spros med shin tu spros med ste: 'di nyid 'od lus chos skur grol ba'i thabs: don rdzogs sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor bstan pa'i phyir: sgrub pa'i go rim bde chen gsang lam bzhag: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal brda yi yi ger gzugs: ma 'ongs yang mtha' dus kyi snyigs ma'i tshe:

skal ldan thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: de'ang lam zab mo bde chen zhing gi sgrub pa la 'jug pa ni: thog mar bdag dang nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la dgod pa'i ched du sgrub pa zab mo lhur len par bya'o/ snyam pa'i 'dun pa bya: de yang rnal 'byor bzhi rim ltar las tho rangs rig pa gsal gdab pa'i rnal 'byor ni: phyogs dus zhing khams thams cad kyi sangs rgyas byang sems gsal btab nas mi rtag rgyud kyis bskul: nyin mo snang ba rgyas btab pa'i rnal 'byor ni: 'dir snang deng sang skabs sems can thams cad ci bya don med 'khor ba'i las la yengs nas g.yeng ba'i bdud dang 'grogs pas rang phung mi rtag pa'i las la rtag chags 'khrul gzugs su a 'thas nas lhan skyes kyi bdud lto gos grogs dang zung du 'jug pa ngo mi shes pa a re 'khrul bsam zhing : nying 'khrul thams cad bden med du rgyas gdab bo: dgong mo'i rig pa gzhi la sdud pa'i rnal 'byor ni: nyin snang thams cad rmi lam dang sgyu ma'i ngo bo ltar gyur: thams cad mi rtag pa'i ngang tshul snang ba'i nyi ma nub pas sa rub: rigs drug nyin snang la brten pa thams cad glo bur du 'dus: 'dir snang gi gzugs kyi zhen pa nub: ltas kyang mi mthong : mtshan snang lha srin dang mtshan gyi rigs drug lus thob thams cad kyang longs spyod zas 'tshol du 'gro: nyin gyi snang ba gnyid kyi ngal dub pas nyin snang gi byed las phal cher 'gag ste mi rtag myur du sleb: mig phyed btsums nas 'jig rten gyi snang ba nub ces pa dang dpe mtshungs: de yi tshe nyams len rlung la 'bad: rlung khug nyi shu rtsa gcig la mnyam par bzhag: phung po gzan du skyur ltar snang ba bshig: nam phyed shes bya bum par 'jug pa'i rnal 'byor ni: nyal ba'i tshe rang gi snying khar pad+ma dmar po la 'dab ma bzhi'i ze'u 'bru'i steng du hrīḥdamar po 'od zer dang ldan pa nyi ma 'bum gyi mdangs phyung ba zhig mos te:

de la 'dun pa gtad: shar du om̐: lho ru trām̐: nub tu āḥ byang du hūm̐: de ltar yi ge de nyid la 'dun pa gtad de mnyam par bzhag: thim rim gyi tshe cung zad gnyid 'thib pa dang shar gyi om̐ yig trām̐ la thim par sgom: had hob tsam la trām̐ āḥ rmi lam 'byung la khad āḥhūm̐ de gnyid za zi tsam thig le dkar dmar 'phrad skabs gzugs 'dun pa mi 'gul bar hūm̐ hrīḥdri med 'od gsal ngang la bzhag rmi lam gang shar thams cad nyin snang bden med: de yi nying 'khrul rmi lam bden med: de yi tshe stong 'khrul mi bden bzhin du 'gyu ba rmi lam gnyis mched gsum 'brel thod rgal lug gu rgyud 'gyu rkyen pa ltar 'byung ba de stong pa'i rang mdangs dngos med stong gzugs yin pas sa la gol 'chug med par sbyangs: rgyu ni dbang po kun tshang thogs med rgyu: sha gzugs bag chags 'brel ba'i lus: 'dzin chags bar do'i nang tshan mthong : tshe 'di'i snang ba nyin snang 'dra: bag chags ma gtogs nub par gyur: ci phyir tshogs drug don la 'khrul: snang ba bden par ma grub pas: kun tu bzang po bsten ma thub: de bas 'khor 'das mnyam par bzhag: 'jug sgo rim gnyis don du gnas: zhes pa ltar: rnal 'byor bzhi rim rtogs pa myur lam bya ba nges don bsdus par 'jug pa'o: sa ma ya: de'ang phyi bskyed rim sgyu lus dag pa lha sku'i stong ra bsgoms nas bsdus bya phung khams zhing lha ru bkod pa'i gdams pa ste: bde chen zhing sgrub 'di ltar 'jug par bya'o: na mo hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings dag pa'i pho brang du: chos sku 'od dpag med la gsol ba 'debs: phung po 'ja' lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: bde chen longs spyod rdzogs pa'i pho brang nas: spyan gzigs dbyings phyug yum la gsol ba 'debs: phung po 'ja' lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams su: rdor sems spyan ma'i yum la gsol ba 'debs:

phung po 'ja' lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: lho phyogs dpal dang ldan pa'i zhing khams su: rin 'byung mā kī yum la gsol ba 'debs: phung po 'ja' lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams su: snang mtha' gos dkar yum la gsol ba 'debs: phung po 'ja' lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: byang phyogs las rab rdzogs pa'i zhing khams su: don grub sgrol ma yum la gsol ba 'debs: phung po 'ja' lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: rnga yab pad+ma 'od kyi zhing khams su: pad 'byung mtsho rgyal yum la gsol ba 'debs: phung po 'ja' lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: bsam yas mchims phu'i dge'u gong gnas mchog tu: rtsa gsum bka' 'dus chos la gsol ba 'debs: phung po 'ja' lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: spyi gtsug dung khang bde chen pho brang nas: drin can rtsa ba'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs: phung po 'ja' lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: rang lus rtsa gsum 'khor lo'i pho brang nas: rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gror gsol ba 'debs: phung po 'ja' lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: 'di nas tshe 'phos bde ba can gyi zhing : bde gshegs 'od dpag med pas rjes bzung nas: phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la 'god pa yis: tshe rabs ngan 'gro'i skye sgo chod par shog: om̐ badz+ra pad+ma dha ra hrīḥ gnyis pa'o: om̐: snang srid yongs gang dkon mchog mchod pa'i sprin: āḥzhing khams phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba mdzes pa'i sku: hūm̐: kun bzang bla med mdzod kyi rang bzhin gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥha hoḥ phaiṃ phaiṃ badz+ra pū dza hoḥ gsum pa: hrīḥ bdag lus phung po gdod nas gzhal yas khang : dbyings dang bdag mdun dbyer med dran rdzogs su: phyogs bcu'i zhing khams tshom gcig bkod pa yi: dbus su glang chen pad+ma nyi zla'i steng : hrīḥlas chos sku sangs rgyas 'od mi 'gyur: mnyam bzhag skyil krung gsal stong lham mer bzhugs:

thugs rje'i spyan gyis phyogs bcu'i dbyings la gzigs: mdun du 'jig rten dbang phyug sku mdog dkar: phyag 'tshal phyag rgya 'khor lo rtsibs stong bsnams: dbyings phyug dkar sngon bde stong yab la 'khril: chos dbyings ye shes ngo bor gsal rdzogs bsgom: hūm̐: de'i mdun seng khri zhe sdang rnam dag steng : rdau rje sems dpa' dung mdog rdor dril bsnams: spyan ma dkar mo bde stong yab la 'khril: me long ye shes snang stong ngo bor bsgom: hūm̐: g.yas su rta mchog nga rgyal rnam dag steng : rin chen 'byung ldan chos 'chad mnyam bzhag can: rin chen zhags 'dzin mā kī ser mo 'khril: mnyam nyid ye shes bde stong ngo bor bsgom: hūm̐: rgyab tu rma bya 'dod chags rnam dag steng : snang mtha' dmar po thugs rje'i phyag rgya can: pad+ma lcags sgrog gos dkar bde stong 'khril: sor rtog ye shes grags stong ngo bor bsgom: hūm̐: g.yon du shang shang phrag dog rnam dag steng : don yod grub pa skyabs sbyin mchog sbyin can: rgya gram dril bu sgrol ljang sku la 'khril: bya grub ye shes ka dag don rdzogs bsgom: hūm̐: ye shes lnga las grub pa'i zhing khams su: rigs kyi bdag po snang mtha' 'od mi 'gyur: longs sku spyan gzigs sprul sku rigs bzhi la: bde gshegs rgyal ba kun gyi bkod pa rdzogs: 'khor du bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas dang : sems dpa' sems ma grangs med 'khor gyis bskor: khyad par dag pa rig 'dzin gtso 'khor dang : mkha' spyod zhing gi lha dang lha mo'i tshogs: bar med 'khor ba bsam brjod blo las 'das: khyad par mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing khams kyi: mngon par 'phags pa'i lha dang lha mo yi: de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la: bdud rtsi khrus gsol mdzes pa'i rgyan cha 'dogs: dbu la theg chen chos kyi bsil gdugs 'bubs: zhabs la bcu drug rdo rje'i khri gdan brtsegs:

sku la sna tshogs 'dzin med na bza' bklubs: thugs la gsal stong 'gags med dbyangs kyis bstod: de bzhin lha yi 'od khyim gur ras dang : 'ja' 'od zer dang nyi zla'i phreng ba sogs: lha yi me tog rgyan 'phyang yug gos phreng : gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya'i mchod sprin gtibs: 'khor ra yug dag khor yug mar me'i phreng : lha yi gzhal med khang dang dpag bsam shing : 'dod 'jo rdzing dang ma rmos lo 'bras dbyung : lha yi bdud rtsi chu mig sil ma bkram: sa gzhi thams cad mig mang drwa ba ris: 'phags pa'i zhing khams me tog bkod pa'i rgyan: pad+ma'i ze'u 'brur sangs rgyas re re la: byang chub sems pa sems ma grangs med bcas: mchod pa'i lha mo de bzhin grangs dang mnyam: mkha' spyod 'gro ba'i don du dgongs pa dang : mkha' la spyod pa'i byams sems grangs med sogs: nyi zer char babs 'ja' dang me tog bzhin: grangs med bye ba'i rlung bzhin snang stong gshegs: zhing khams de yi mdun gyi nam mkha' ru: 'ja' 'od zlum po brtsegs pa'i pho brang dbus: rnga yab dag zhing mkha' spyod pad+ma 'od: zhing khams lta na sdug pa bkod pa'i dbus: dri med mdangs ldan rgya mtsho 'khyil ba'i dbus: ma chags pad+ma 'bar ba'i rgyan gyis spras: phyag gnyis rdo rje bhan+dha snang stong tshul: phyed skyil zung 'jug lha lcam gsang ye 'khril: mda' dar tshom bu yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: thugs kar 'od zer phyogs bzhir 'phros pa las: dag pa rig 'dzin rnam bzhi phyogs kyi mdog: gtso bo'i cha mthun rigs bzhi ḍāk+ki 'khril: gtso 'khor rnams kyi phyogs dang phyogs mtshams su: mkha' spyod rig 'dzin pho mo sprin ltar 'khrigs: de yi 'khor du rig 'dzin drang srong rnams: pad sdong dbus dmar skyes pa'i 'dab chung steng : mnyam bzhag thor tshugs rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras: de yi mkha' dbyings khor yug thams cad du: lha klu rig 'dzin khye'u pho mo yis:

gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan bla bre dang : phye ma phur ma me tog phreng ba'i sprin: kun kyang mchod sprin sna tshogs thogs nas su: mkha' lam 'geng ba phyogs bcu'i zhing dang mnyam: lha yi 'dod yon bkod pa blo las 'das: zhing mchog gtsang ma'i gnas mchog dam pa der: skal ldan mos pa'i 'dun pas blos blangs tshogs: bdag dang yid can 'brel bcas sems can tshogs: dag pa rig 'dzin rnams kyis mdun bsu zhing : lha yi spos dang rol mo'i bye brag phreng : zhing khams dpa' bo rnams kyis g.yas nas skyol: mkha' spyod mkha' 'gro rnams kyis g.yon nas brten: sems dpa' sems ma rnams kyis rgyab nas phul: grangs med sangs rgyas rnams kyis mdun nas bsus: skyon bral pad+ma'i steng du skyes nas kyang : sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyi zhal mthong ste: pad 'byung yab yum rnams kyis lung bstan nas: grangs med sangs rgyas rnams kyis smon lam mdzad: ging dang dpa' bos sa lam bar chad bskrad: byang sems 'phags tshogs rnams kyis bkra shis brjod: lha dang lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa 'bul: mngon brjod rab tu gnas pa'i bsod nams kyis: lha las lhag pa'i lus thob sangs rgyas rnyed: sangs rgyas spyan dang sangs rgyas snyan dang ni: sangs rgyas shangs dang sangs rgyas ljags dang ni: sangs rgyas thugs dang sangs rgyas mngon shes bcas: lha dang mi yi tshogs drug mi re zhing : drug ldan rdo rje sgra dang yan lag bcu: mtshan bzang so gnyis dpe byad brgyad cu sogs: mngon par 'phags pa'i dpe byad ldan pa yis: zhing du dmigs pa'i thugs rje'i rang gzugs kyis: bdag lus sgyu ma'i phung po g.ya' bral nas: zag med 'ja' lus phung po 'od skur grol: rtsa khams 'khor lo zhing khams lnga ru shar: ka dag bdag mdun mi dmigs gsal stong ngang : ma bcos snang srid zhing khams lha ru gsal: mnyam bzhag de yi rol rtsal 'phro 'du yis: grangs med phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams na:

bde gshegs kun gyi byin rlabs thugs rje rnams: ye shes gsal rdzogs spyan drangs dbyer med thim: nus pa'i gzi byin rtsol med 'bar bar bsgom: om̐ dharma dhā tu dz+nyā na pradz+nyā badz+ra hrī dha ya sarba pa ri mi ta ga ga na āt+ma ko3 haṃ:

bzhi pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas spyan drangs shing dbang bskur byin rlabs thugs rje'i nus pas bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro kun skyabs kyis rjes su bzung bar bsam: hoḥ phyogs bcu'i ga la'i zhing du bzhugs pa yi: sangs rgyas byang sems rig 'dzin ji snyed dang : de snyed bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas rnams: byams brtse'i thugs dam dbang gis 'dir gshegs la: bdag gzhan mkha' mnyam 'gro kun skyob pa'i slad: nye bar dgongs shig byin rlabs dbang bskur stsol: om̐ dz+nyā na pañtsa ā li kā li mūm̐ shrī bha ga wan: ma hā ka ru ṇi ka sa ma ya e h+ya hi badz+ra bud+dha rat+na pad+ma karma badz+ra bhi dh+wa dhā ra ya tad+ya thā om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ dza gu ru ha ri ni sa pad+ma badz+ra ak+ṣo bh+ya badz+ra sa twa k+ṣaṃ shrī yaṃ ku ru hūm̐ āḥ om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tiṣ+ṭha satwaṃ: lnga pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad sprin gtibs pa ltar byon nas dbang bskur byin rlabs nos te shes bya'i sgrib pa dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa las kyi sgrib pa kun nas bslangs pa bag chags kyi sgrib pa ste sgrib bzhi byang : bya ba'i rgyud spyod pa'i rgyud rnal 'byor gyi rgyud rnal 'byor chen po a ti bla na med pa'i rgyud ste: rgyud bzhi smin: chos kyi sku longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku sprul pa'i sku ngo bo nyid kyi sku ste: sku bzhi 'grub: tshogs kyi lam sbyor ba'i lam mthong ba'i lam sgom pa'i lam ste: lam bzhi sbyangs: bum dbang gsang dbang shes rab dbang ye shes dbang tshe dbang ngo sprod de: dbang bzhi thob: brdzus te skyes pa mngal las skyes pa drod gsher las skyes pa sgo nga las skyes pa ste: skye sgo bzhi khegs: bskyed rim phung po 'od skur grol: bzlas brjod gsung dbyangs drug cu'i rdo rje'i rang sgrar grol: rdzogs rim gsal stong ting nge 'dzin du grol:

ngo bo rang bzhin stong la ma 'gags gsal la 'dzin pa med par grol te: grol bzhi mthar phyin: sa lam thams cad cig car du rdzogs pa a ti bsgom med kyi rgyal sa zin: bcom ldan 'das gdod ma'i mgon po ngo bo nyid sku'i rang zhal mjal: chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid kyi dgongs pa mngon du gyur: bsam gtan bsam bya med pa'i yul las 'das: shes rab kun shes rgyal po dgongs pa len: bden pas dor mi gtub 'khrul pas bslu mi gtub: las dang rnam smin gyis bsgyur mi nus: dge sdig gi byed po yid dpyod kyi blo las 'das pa'i dpal he ru'i dgongs pa mi rgod gcig rgyug glang chen smyo rgyug: nyi zla gcig bgrod: g.yu 'brug gcig ngar: seṅge gcig khyu: rgya stag gcig mchong : dug sbrul gcig 'gyu: gnas lugs gcig shes: sangs rgyas sku gcig: dben ri gcig bzung : dmag dpon gcig thub ste: dpal dang po'i chos sku snang ba mtha' yas mu mtha' gra khyu'i ris su ma bcad pa'i 'byams klas pa mu med pa'i khor yug don gcig gis khyab pa'i sku rang 'od rang gsal: nyi zla'i rang bzhin ltar kun la ye shes 'phags pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med ces su grags pa'o: gdod nas nyon mongs pa dang nye ba'i nyon mongs med cing kun rtog gis 'gog gzhi'i duḥkha las grol ba'i mtshan nyid kyis: sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral bde 'gro yang dag pa'i sar 'god: bde ba can gyi zhing khams su mtshan gsol bas thos pa tsam gyis kun gyis gya noms med pa'i gdung ba skyes te: de yi mtshan ci ltar don rtogs shing don dang ldan pa'i skyes bu sems dpa' 'am ni: bdag sangs rgyas pa'i dge ba la dge ba'i 'dun ma'am: chos lugs su 'byung ba'i 'khor ba'i zhen pa ldog: ldog pa'i lugs ldog sangs rgyas 'khor lo ltar bskor ba'am: mngon pa'i mkha' spyod pa'i rig 'dzin sems dpa' 'am: sa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' 'am mkha' spyod dang sa spyod kyi rnam pa nges pa'i don la spyod pa skyong ba:

sa lam theg rim skyong ba'i rgyal po chen por gdaud mar gnas so: sa skyong mi mchog ston pa pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes pa bzhin du mngon par 'phags pa'i go 'phang thob pa'o: ci bzhin de yi byed po lam du skyong bar mos pa'i gang zag gam: skal ldan nam: skyes chen nam: dad ldan nam: so so'i skye bo sogs: ci ltar gdams pa zab mo bde chen gsang lam bgrod par mos pa'i yid mi phyed pa'i lhag bsam 'dun pas sor rtse spyi bor thal mo sbyar la dkon mchog mchod sprin la 'bad 'bung bgyis so: na mo hūm̐: phyogs dus bde gshegs ma lus 'dus pa'i tshogs: snang srid zhing khams lhar gsal bzhugs pa la: bdag sogs 'gro ba ma gyur sems can gyis: phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul gus pas gsol ba 'debs: om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: na mo hūm̐: phyogs bcu dus bzhir bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang : byang sems rig 'dzin 'phags tshogs 'dus sde la: bdag cag gus pas skyabs mchis phyag 'tshal lo: na mo hūm̐: chos sku skye ba med pa'i ngang nyid las: sangs rgyas thams cad thugs las skyes pa'i yab: snang mtha' 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo: chos kyi sku yis byams pa'i spyan gyis gzigs: snying rje thugs kyis 'gro drug gnas nas 'dren: 'phags mchog nam mkha'i rgyal por phyag 'tshal lo: snang stong sku la ye shes rgyun chad med: chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong 'byung ba'i yum: dbyings phyug pha rol phyin mar phyag 'tshal lo: shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams su: rdo rje sems dpa' longs spyod rdzogs pa'i chas: zhi ba'i rig 'dzin rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: byang chub sems ma sa khams rnam par dag: me long ye shes sangs rgyas byang sems yum: sangs rgyas spyan ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: lho phyogs dpal dang ldan pa'i zhing khams su: rin chen 'byung ldan longs spyod rdzogs pa'i chas: rgyas pa'i rig 'dzin rnams la phyag 'tshal lo:

byang chub sems ma chu khams rnam par dag: mnyam nyid ye shes sangs rgyas byang sems yum: mā ma kī yi sku la phyag 'tshal lo: nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams su: rnam par snang mdzad longs spyod rdzogs pa'i chas: dbang gi rig 'dzin rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: byang chub sems ma me khams rnam par dag: sor rtog ye shes sangs rgyas byang sems yum: gos dkar mo y-i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: byang phyogs las rab rdzogs pa'i zhing khams su: don yod grub pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i chas: drag po'i rig 'dzin rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: byang chub sems ma rlung khams rnam par dag: bya grub ye shes sangs rgyas byang sems yum: dam tshig sgrol ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: 'phags pa'i zhing khams 'og min 'thug po bkod: sangs rgyas byang sems rig 'dzin 'dus sde la: lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: om̐ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐: om̐ rat+na sa twa hūm̐: om̐ pad+ma sa twa hūm̐: om̐ karma sa twa hūm̐: oṃ gu ru sa twa hūm̐: om̐ dhe wa sa twa hūm̐: om̐ ḍāk+ki sa twa hūm̐: de nas rig 'dzin phyag rabs ni: na mo hūm̐: kun gzhi ma bcos sangs rgyas 'byung ba'i gnas: 'ja' lus dpal 'bar rkang gnyis sangs rgyas gtso: pad 'byung tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo: mkha' spyod rnga yab dag pa rig 'dzin gnas: rnga yab pad+ma 'od kyi zhing khams su: o rgyan rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: bde stong ye shes zab rgya theg chen mdzod: bde gshegs rig 'dzin rnams kyi yum chen mo: man+da ra ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: shar phyogs lta na sdug pa'i zhing khams su: rdo rje thod phreng sprul sku'i cha lugs 'chang : rnam sman rig 'dzin sku la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: byams pa'i 'od zer 'gro la 'gyed pa yi: bde gshegs rig 'dzin rgyal yum rdo rje'i rigs: ye shes mtsho rgyal sku la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: lho phyogs 'thug po bkod pa'i zhing khams su:

rat+na thod phreng sprul sku'i cha lugs 'chang : phyag rgya rig 'dzin sku la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: snying rje lcags kyus rigs drug gnas nas 'dren: bde gshegs rig 'dzin rgyal yum rin chen rigs: ka la sid+dhi'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: nub phyogs mkha' dbyings brtsegs pa'i zhing khams su: pad+ma thod phreng sprul sku'i cha lugs 'chang : tshe dbang rig 'dzin sku la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: dga' ba'i shugs 'chang skye gnas sgo bzhi khegs: bde gshegs rig 'dzin yum chen pad+ma'i rigs: shākya dhe ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: byang phyogs lcang lo 'khyil ba'i zhing khams su: karma thod phreng sprul sku'i cha lugs 'chang : lhun grub rig 'dzin sku la phyag 'tshal lo: hūm̐: btang snyoms dgongs pas sku bzhi'i sa bon rnyed: bde gshegs rig 'dzin rgyal yum las kyi rigs: bkra shis khye'u 'dren sku la phyag 'tshal lo: sa spyod dag pa mkha' spyod rnam dag zhing : ji snyed bzhugs pa'i rig 'dzin brgyud bcas la: mi phyed yid kyi gdung bas phyag 'tshal lo: om̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma dha ra dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī sa ma ya a ti pu hoḥ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ drug pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni: phyi nang gsang ba kho na nyid dang spyan gzigs zhing bkod bkram pa'i mdun du bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags maṇ+ḍal sogs dngos 'byor la brgya mchod stong mchod grangs med kyi mchod pa yid las sprul pa'i gling 'di dang gling gzhan sogs: grangs med bkod pa blo yis blangs te bdag lus longs spyod dge rtsa bcas phangs med phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams la mchod pa phul ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba la brten nas: rgyu bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags 'bras bu ye shes kyi tshogs smin: tshe rabs dang da lta'i sgrib gnyis byang : smon lam bzang po de'i dge bas mtshams sbyor bas bde chen dag pa'i zhing yid la yang yang bkod pas: nam zhig tshe yi 'phen pa zad dus mos pa'i stobs kyis ngo shes kyi mi dang 'phrad pa lta bu 'byung 'gyur de phyir dam bca' gsum 'dun pa gsum gdams pa thabs kyis 'dzin pa'i man ngag yin:

lam ni thabs yin: 'bras bu ni shes rab yin: thabs lam 'bras bu rim gnyis kyi sa lam bgrod tshul thag chod: tshogs zhing dang dag zhing la blo sbyang ba gal che'o: na mo hūm̐: phyogs dus rgyal ba bde gshegs 'dus pa'i mchog: sku gsum zhing khams rab 'byams la gnas pa'i: bde chen dag pa'i zhing du gang bzhugs dang : gang dag 'das dang ma byon da lta yi: dus gsum dus bzhi dus med rtogs rnams la: bdag gzhan 'gro ba sems can ma lus kyis: grangs med bsags pa'i bag chags g.ya' bral phyir: bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa 'bul: bkra shis mdzes pa'i lha mo grangs med kyis: stong gsum 'di'am rab 'byams 'jig rten na: grangs med skyes pa'i me tog ci mchis pa: gcig tu bsdus nas blo yis bzung ba'i tshogs: bde chen dag pa'i sangs rgyas zhing la 'bul: bzhes nas tshe rabs mkha' spyod bgrod par shog: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe pū dza me gha s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: bkra shis mdzes pa'i lha mo grangs med kyis: stong gsum 'di'am rab 'byams 'jig rten na: grangs med gtams pa'i spos dri ci mchis pa: gcig tu bsdus nas blo yis bzung ba'i tshogs: bde chen dag pa'i sangs rgyas zhing la 'bul: bzhes nas tshe rabs mkha' spyod bgrod par shog: om̐ badz+ra dhū pe pū dza me gha s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: bkra shis mdzes pa'i lha mo grangs med kyis: stong gsum 'di'am rab 'byams 'jig rten na: grangs med gtams pa'i mar me ci mchis pa: gcig tu bsdus nas blo yis bzung ba'i tshogs: bde chen dag pa'i sangs rgyas zhing la 'bul: bzhes nas tshe rabs mkha' spyod bgrod par shog: om̐ badz+ra ā lo ke pū dza me gha s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: bkra shis mdzes pa'i lha mo grangs med kyis: stong gsum 'di'am rab 'byams 'jig rten na: grangs med gtams pa'i dri chab ci mchis pa: gcig tu bsdus nas blo yis bzung ba'i tshogs:

bde chen dag pa'i sangs rgyas zhing du 'bul: bzhes nas tshe rabs mkha' spyod bgrod par shog: om̐ badz+ra gan+dhe pū dza me gha s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: bkra shis mdzes pa'i lha mo grangs med kyis: stong gsum 'di'am rab 'byams 'jig rten na: grangs med bcud ldan zhal zas ci mchis pa: gcig tu bsdus nas blo yis bzung ba'i tshogs: bde chen dag pa'i sangs rgyas zhing la 'bul: bzhes nas tshe rabs mkha' spyod bgrod par shog: om̐ badz+ra nai wi d+ye pū dza me gha s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: bkra shis mdzes pa'i lha mo grangs med kyis: stong gsum 'di'am rab 'byams 'jig rten na: grangs med sgra snyan rol mo ci mchis pa: gcig tu bsdus nas blo yis bzung ba'i tshogs: bde chen dag pa'i sangs rgyas zhing du 'bul: bzhes nas tshe rabs mkha' spyod bgrod par shog: om̐ badz+ra shab+da pū dza me gha s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: bkra shis mdzes pa'i lha mo grangs med kyis: stong gsum 'di'am rab 'byams 'jig rten na: grangs med spyan gzigs gzugs mdzes ci mchis pa: gcig tu bsdus nas blo yis bzung ba'i tshogs: bde chen dag pa'i sangs rgyas zhing la 'bul: bzhes nas tshe rabs mkha' spyod bgrod par shog: om̐ badz+ra rū pa pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: bkra shis mdzes pa'i lha mo grangs med kyis: stong gsum 'di'am rab 'byams 'jig rten na: grangs med glu dbyangs sgra snyan ci mchis pa: gcig tu bsdus nas blo yis bzung ba'i tshogs: bde chen dag pa'i sangs rgyas zhing la 'bul: bzhes nas tshe rabs mkha' spyod bgrod par shog: om̐ shab+da pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: bkra shis mdzes pa'i lha mo grangs med kyis: stong gsum 'di'am rab 'byams 'jig rten na: grangs med bcud g.yo rdzas gtams ci mchis pa: gcig tu bsdus nas blo yis bzung ba'i tshogs:

bde chen dag pa'i sangs rgyas zhing la 'bul: bzhes nas tshe rabs mkha' spyod bgrod par shog: om̐ badz+ra gan+dhe ho pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: bkra shis mdzes pa'i lha mo grangs med kyis: stong gsum 'di'am rab 'byams 'jig rten na: grangs med ro brgya'i khyaun ltar ci mchis pa: gcig tu bsdus nas blo yis bzung ba'i tshogs: bde chen dag pa'i sangs rgyas zhing la 'bul: bzhes nas tshe rabs mkha' spyod bgrod par shog: om̐ badz+ra rā sa pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: bkra shis mdzes pa'i lha mo grangs med kyis: stong gsum 'di'am rab 'byams 'jig rten na: grangs med reg 'jam rgyan bzang ci mchis pa: gcig tu bsdus nas blo yis bzung ba'i tshogs: bde chen dag pa'i sangs rgyas zhing la 'bul: bzhes nas tshe rabs mkha' spyod bgrod par shog: om̐ badz+ra spar+she pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: nang mchod bdud rtsi dza gad sman phud chang : mkha' dbyings rak+ta rgyan bzang bha ling+ta: bde stong sbyor ba zung 'jug dga' ba bzhi: mkha' dbyings klong las nyon mongs mtshan ma bsgral: bla med kho na nyid kyi mchod pa bzhes: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta dharma pū dza me gha s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: rin chen gdugs mchog gser gyi yu ba can: bla bre 'phan gdugs ba dan dar dpyangs bskyod: phye ma phur ma la sogs me tog phreng : lha yi 'dod yon mi yi longs spyod dang : ri rab gling bzhi gling phran gser ri bdun: rol mtsho bcud g.yo dpag bsam ljon pa'i shing : ma rmos lo tog lha yi skyed mos tshal: 'ja' tshon khri gdugs gur khyim 'od kyi dkyil: ma tshang med pa'i mchod sprin sna tshogs 'di: blo yis blangs te yid kyis 'bul lags na: bde chen dag zhing bgrod par byin gyis rlobs: om̐ badz+ra sarba swa bhā āt+ma ko3 haṃ:
pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐:

skabs 'dir maṇ+ḍal rgyas pa 'bul: de nas bdun pa bstod pa ni: hūm̐: bde gshegs kun gyi zhing bkod bde ba can: de ru bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med: mnyam bzhag skyil krung gzi brjid 'bum du 'khyil: thugs rje'i spyan gyis mkha' mnyam 'gro la gzigs: mtshan thos tsam gyis ngan 'gro'i 'jigs pa skyob: chos sku 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal bstod: mdun du rgyal ba longs sku spyan ras gzigs: 'jig rten dbang phyug rigs drug skye sgo gcod: byang chub sems ma 'gro kun snying rjes 'dren: nam mkha'i rgyal po yab yum phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: shar phyogs zhing khams rdor sems yab yum la: sku yi rigs mchog bde gshegs tshogs kyis bskor: mngon dga'i zhing khams lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: lho phyogs zhing khams rin 'byung yab yum la: yon tan rigs mchog bde gshegs tshogs kyis bskor: dpal ldan zhing khams lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: nub phyogs zhing khams snang mtha' yab yum la: gsung gi rigs mchog bde gshegs tshogs kyis bskor: bde chen zhing khams lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: byang phyogs zhing khams don grub yab yum la: phrin las rigs mchog bde gshegs tshogs kyis bskor: las rab zhing khams lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: sangs rgyas byang sems grangs med zhing gi lha: rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed bzhugs pa la: lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: mkha' dbyings zhing gi dbang phyug tshe dpag med: 'ja' lus skye 'chi gnyis spangs pad+ma 'byung : bde gshegs rgyal po lhun grub 'dus ma byas: sku lnga mtshan brgyad 'gro ba yongs kyi mgon: long med sems can thugs rjes skyob mdzad lha: thugs rje rgyun mi 'chad pa'i yum chen mo: grangs med sprul pas rig 'dzin gsang lam ster: 'ja' lus bgres rgud bral ba'i lha lcam 'khril: pad 'byung yab yum sku la phyag 'tshal bstod:

hūm̐: zhi ba'i las mdzad rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: lha yi rig 'dzin tshom bu grangs med bskor: lta na bkod zhing lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: rgyas pa'i las mdzad rat+na thod phreng rtsal: mi yi rig 'dzin tshom bu grangs med bskor: 'thug po bkod zhing lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: dbang gi las mdzad pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: tshe yi rig 'dzin tshom bu grangs med bskor: mkha' dbyings bkod zhing lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: drag po'i las mdzad karma thod phreng rtsal: klu yi rig 'dzin tshom bu grangs med bskor: lcang lo bkod zhing lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i gtso 'khor grangs med pa: bdag lus blo yis blangs nas gus pa yis: phyag 'tshal bde chen zh-ing khams bgrod par shog: (1) om̐ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ (2) om̐ pad+ma dha ra hrīḥ (3) om̐ a mi dhe wa ā yur sid+dhi hūm̐: (4) om̐ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: (5) om̐ dz+nyā na ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa hūm̐: (6) om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.a mām̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ dza hūm̐: (7) om̐ ā li kā li dz+nyā na pañtsa sa twa kro ta mu ne ye swā hā: (8) om̐ āḥhūm̐ hrī swā hā: zhes pa dang po sangs rgyas lag 'chang gi gzungs: gnyis pa sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi gzungs: gsum pa sangs rgyas rnga sgra'i gzungs: bzhi pa rig 'dzin bla ma'i gzungs: lnga pa zhing khams lha mo'i gzungs: drug pa bde gshegs rtsa ba'i gzungs: bdun pa bde gshegs rigs lnga'i gzungs: brgyad pa sangs rgyas rtse mo mnyam sbyor gyi gzungs: gzungs sngags rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs rnams rim par phye na: sangs rgyas lag 'chang gis dpal dang po'i sa thob: sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyis bskyed rdzogs kyi sa thob: sangs rgyas rnga sgras 'chi ba med pa'i sa thob: rig 'dzin bla mas tshe gcig la lus ma bor bar mkha' spyod bgrod: zh-ing khams lha mos bde chen rgyal po mchog gi dngos grub thob:

bde gshegs rtsa ba'i gzungs kyis rigs lnga'i sa thob: bde gshegs rigs lngas zhing khams lnga gang mos 'grub: sangs rgyas rtse mos phyir mi ldog gi sa thob nas rigs dang po sangs rgyas dngos kyi go 'phang 'grub bo: des na theg pa rim bgrod mi dgos pa'i sangs rgyas dang po ni ci yang ma ltos: bskyed rim la goms 'dris dgos tshun zhing sgrub 'di nyid rang gtso che: ci phyir rnam rtog ngan goms dge ba bzang goms: de yang zhing chos sku sbyong ba longs sku ru sbyong ba sprul sku ru sbyong ba gsum sogs phyogs gc-ig dril du sgrub pa yin te: chos sku ni mnyam nyid: longs sku ni zhal phyag rdzogs pa: sprul sku mtshan nyid kun rdzogs ces pas: chos sku rgyal ba 'od dpag med: longs sku spyan gzigs dang rigs lnga: sprul sku 'chi med pad+ma 'byung gnas: de phyogs gcig tu sgrub pa'o: tshogs bsags thams cad kyi cha lag rdzogs nas sgrib sbyong phyag dang bshags pa yin te: phyag ni sngon du song ba las: rjes kyang bshags pa so so dang 'brel kyang rung : brgyad pa: na mo phyogs bcu'i zhing du bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang : byang sems 'phags tshogs bdag la dgongs su gsol: bdag sogs skye ba 'di dang tshe rabs su: rnam smin 'khor ba'i rgyu bsags ci mchis pa: bde gshegs rgyal ba'i mdun du mthol lo bshags: de bzhin mtshams med lnga yi las la ni: ma byin blangs dang rku 'phrog bcom pa dang : gzhan la 'phrog tu bcug dang bka' stsal pa: dkon mchog mchod pa phri dang bcom pa dang : lha khang dkar me bcom dang snyan dar bregs: de bzhin gsung rab klog pa'i glud zos dang : mchod rten gang zhig sāts+tsha'i dkor la 'bag: zhal zas bcom dang me tog yon chab bcad: dri spos ngar bsad 'bog pa'i thal ba spur: 'og rlung ra sun dri dang tha dud btang : bris sku thang rten no g.yol chu shar bgoms: gtsug lag 'bag pa'i gshang lci 'dor ba dang :

rgyal ba'i khri gdan rnams la 'gom pa dang : de bzhin phyogs bcu'i dge 'dun bcom pa dang : pha dang ma yi don du slong ba dang : rang gi lto gos don du slong ba dang : ma sbyin pa la yang yang slong ba dang : ma mthong ba la 'phrog dang rku ba dang : gzhan gyis 'phrog pa'i las kyis bskul ba dang : ma 'os pa yi phyag sna len pa dang : mi zhu ba yi 'bul tshogs sdud pa dang : bdun zhag bzhi bcu'i dkor la 'bag pa dang : chos gos bla gos skye bos reg pa dang : bud med rnams kyis sbags pa'i zas la sogs: dkon mchog gsum la gnod pa'i las bsags pa: mtshams med dang po bgyis pa mthol lo bshags: de nas mi gtsang mtshams med bsags pa'i rgyu: dkon mchog rnam pa gsum gyi glud zos dang : dge 'dun nor brnag can gyi dkor zas dang : mtshan nyid grub mtha' pa yi kha 'phro zas: rigs drug kha chings bgyis pa'i yas rdzas dang : sdig spyod rgyal pos phrogs pa'i bcom zas dang : sde brgyad kha chings ser ba srung ba'i yon: dmangs po'i lan chags sri'u gso ba'i gla: tshong 'dus la sogs shan pa'i lag zas dang : lho tshong byang la 'dren sogs mtha' zas dang : smon lam log pas 'brel ba'i mna' zas dang : nyams pa'i zas dang nyams pa'i gos la 'bag: dam nyams grogs dang 'grogs pa la sogs pa: mi gtsang pa la 'bag pa'i las bsags pa: mtshams med gnyis pa bgyis pa mthol lo bshags: khyad par mi mthun sbyor ba rtsub pa'i las: phyogs bcur 'khrug pa'i dmag chen g.yul ngo bskul: 'byung ba 'khrug pa'i rdzas ngan bsregs pa dang : zur za bgyis pas dgon sde dkrugs pa dang : byang sems dge 'dun mthun gnyis phye ba dang : ma mthong tshun gyis rgyus chen bshad pa dang : pha ma spun zla gnyen 'khor dkrugs pa dang : yul gru mtha' 'khob 'khrug pa'i gzhi bzhag dang : don med rnams la lam gol bslab pa dang : dus ma yin par gtam ngan bshad pa dang : nyes med sems can ku dir sgrogs pa dang :

nyam chung rnams la sngangs skrag bgyis pa sogs: phra ma bcug dang rdzun smra dbyen bgyid pa: mtshams med gsum pa bsags pa mthol lo bshags: de bzhin lus ngag yid kyi sgo nas ni: pha ni dang po sgyu lus sbyin pa'i gnyen: tshig rtsub 'thab dang sbyor ba ngan pa dang : de bzhin ma ni sgyu lus bskyed pa ste: khengs sems che bas drin lan bcag pa'i rigs: lus dang sems kyi pha ma bsad pa dang : de bzhin las kyi pha mar gyur pa yi: drin can sgo nor bzang po bsad pa dang : zhon rta bkal khal bu lon dmyal ba ster: rmo rko tshong 'dus dmyal ba dngos bsags dang : sems can ma bu phral nas bsad pa dang : dus gcig grangs med srog bcad nya 'phrang byas: phag dang gcan gzan sdig pa'i ring bsrel zos: sngon gyi lan chags srog lan bsad pa dang : zhe sdang mi dang gdug pa'i khyi dang ni: nga rgyal rta dang 'dod chags bya dang ni: gti mug phag dang shin tu khro ba sbrul: nyes med btson du bcug dang ri dwags bsad: drin chen lus kyis bskyangs pa'i gnag lug bsad: tshe gcig sangs rgyas ster ba'i bla ma la: lus kyis ltung ba bsags pas dam tshig bsad: ngag gis skur ba btab pas dam chos bsad: yid kyis log lta bgyid pas sangs rgyas bsad: bsnyen bkur mos pa ma bgyis dge 'dun bsad: dbang bskur dam tshig ma srung sdom pa bsad: ltung ba bzhi dang bcas pas nyes bslab bsad: khyad par kha bcug bsad dang yid sems bsad: srog yod srog med thabs kyis bsad pa dang : dug dang mtshon dang me chur bsad pa dang : lus kyi srin bu la sogs bsad pa dang : rkang 'gro lag 'don ched du bsad pa dang : shin tu mtshams med dge bcur bsngos nas bsad: srog bcad las kyis bsad pa'i rnam smin dang : mtshams med bzhi pa bsags pa mthol lo bshags: dkon mchog gsum la smad pa byed pa dang : dam pa'i chos ni spangs par bya ba dang : sems can rnams la 'tshe bar byed pa dang :

gsang sngags chos la log lta'i ru tra dang : mtshan ldan bla ma snying nas smad pa dang : rig 'dzin gdung gi dbu 'phang smad pa dang : dkon mchog rnam gsum dbu 'phang smad pa dang : dge ba'i bshes gnyen thabs kyis smad pa dang : g.yo can rnams kyis gang zag smad pa'i las: rang ni thabs kyis bstod pa byed pa dang : gzhan ni shugs kyis smad pa byed pa ste: ngos lkog bgyis nas sems kyi khrag byug dang : bzang rkyen ngan rkyen dge ba'i bar chad dang : gzhan snang bslu phyir sangs rgyas smad pa dang : rdo rje slob dpon sku dgra bgyis pa dang : byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dgongs pa dkrugs: bsam gtan sgom pa rnams kyi dben ri phrogs: bsnyen sgrub dge ba rnams la bar chad brtsams: ku re bzhad gad tshul du bla ma smad: dam nyams sdom nyams ma bshags mchod pa 'gom: khrus ma bgyis pas bla ma'i sku la reg: 'bag pa rnam bzhir 'bags shing bla ma mchod: bla ma'i sku yi grib ma bgoms pa dang : bla ma'i khri gdan sgab sham bskyod pa dang : dam tshig bum par dug chu blugs pa dang : dam tshig g.yel ba'i dbyen du 'bud pa sogs: bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos dang ni: bla ma dge 'dun bla ma rig 'dzin pa: gzugs sku bla ma bsod nams tshogs las 'khrungs: don dam bla ma chos sku sangs rgyas la: ngan sems sna tshogs bgyis pa'i khrag byugs pa: mtshams med lnga yi las bsags mthol lo bshags: de bzhin nye ba lnga dang ltung ba lnga: mi dge bcu po bgyid pa mthol lo bshags: so sor thar pa rnams kyi sdom pa dang : byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bslab pa dang : rdo rje sngags kyi dam tshig nyams pa dang : dbang bskur dkyil 'khor dam tshig nyams pa sogs: ngan song sgo bzhi bsags pa mthol lo bshags: bag med las kyis mnar med rgyu bsags dang : phyi nang dam tshig 'gal ba ci mchis pa: zhing khams lha la mthol bshags bzod par gsol: mi sgrib bde chen zhing khams bgrod par shog:

ces pas 'gyod tshangs phul bas las sgrib thams cad byang zhing rnam mkhyen thar pa chen po'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur ro: tha ma rjes shes bsngo smon ci rigs bya: 'di nyid bde chen zhing sgrub bya ba smon lam gyi chos zhes pa spros bcas spros med ci bder bya: sa ma ya: e ma zab pa'i theg chen yang rtse lha: bde chen zhing sgrub sku gsum mnyam sbyor nyid: gu ru rje yi bka' bzhin legs par bkod: ma 'ongs skal ldan blo gros snying po can: las can skyes bu de yis 'byin pa'i tshe: smon lam tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i snod la sprod: zhing sgrub 'di la 'bad pa'i skal ldan rnams: dag pa mkha' spyod bgrod par byin gyis rlobs: o rgyan bde chen rgyal po'i dgongs pa yin: 'di nyid nyin re tshar rer ma chag na: skye ba bdun la ngan 'gro ltung mi 'gyur: sangs rgyas rab bdun go 'phang rnyed de mchi: zhal gdams bcu gsum man ngag sgrub khog bcas: grogs lngar gdams pa mi brjed gzungs brten nas: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal kho mo bdag gis bkod: snying byang 'di ka rje yi bka' drin nyid: dregs pa sde lngas rgya 'di legs par srungs: mchims phu'i brag dmar mi nub a thaṃ rgya: btsan dang rgyal pos bstan pa'i bya ra mdzod: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: mi nub rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtsho yis sa khyi lor bsam yas mchims phu'i brag mar ke'u tshang nas gdan drangs shing lcags mo phag gi lor/ sprul sku pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis thugs sgrub dkyil 'khor gyi dbang chen skabs bkas bskul ngor nang chen rgyal po'i e waṃ sgar du shog ser nas bod yig tu zhal bshus so/ maṅga laṃ// // kha) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: bde chen rgyal po rig 'dzin rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs in+d+ra nī la'i khang bu bzhugs so: bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las:

rig 'dzin rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs las rim bstan: rgyud smin dbang rdzogs go rim bgyis pa la: bde chen rgyal po khyab bdag sgrub pa bzhag: sa ma ya: ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga brgya'i tha ma ru: sems can thams cad nyon mongs dug lnga spyod: dge las ldog pa'i sdig spyod sna tshogs kyis: gti mug rgyud nyal rigs drug duḥkha myong : de tshe sems can skyabs med a tsa ma: las kyi gzhung 'di chu bo'i gnyer ma 'dra: rnam smin rdzing 'di dmyal ba'i me 'obs 'dra: mthong zhing 'khor ba bsha' lug mgo 'khor 'dra: de phyir skyabs med las kyi sems can tshogs: rig 'dzin dag pa'i zhing du sgrol ba'i thabs: lnga ldan lha khrid tshom bu 'di lta bu: rang bzhin ma bcos stong pa'i rol rtsal las: mkha' dbyings rnam dag rnga yab pad+ma 'od: 'ja' 'od gur dang lug gu rgyud kyi phreng : sna tshogs snang ba'i dbus su tshom bu'i lha: dbus su gu ru bde chen rgyal po bzhugs: steng du rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin bzhugs: shar du sa la gnas pa'i rig 'dzin bzhugs: lho ru phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin bzhugs: nub tu tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin bzhugs: byang du lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin bzhugs: de la rig 'dzin rgyal ba rgya mtsho dang : dpa' bo mkha' 'gro nam mkha'i sprin ltar gtibs: 'ja' tshon zer thag nyi zer rdul ltar 'khrigs: snang stong sgyu ma'i snang ngor dmigs nas su: bdag sogs 'gro ba pha ma skye gnas bzhi: gsol btab ma rig rigs drug sgo bkag nas: sdug bsngal snang ba'i 'khrul rgyun chad par sgoms: sar gnas rig 'dzin dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal skyob: phyag rgya rig 'dzin yi dwags sdug bsngal skyob: tshe dbang rig 'dzin byol song sdug bsngal skyob: lhun grub rig 'dzin mi yi sdug bsngal skyob: bde chen rig 'dzin lha min sdug bsngal skyob: smin pa'i rig 'dzin lha yi sdug bsngal skyob:

rigs drug 'khrul snang sdug bsngal ci shar yang : rig 'dzin so sor 'dun pa bskyed pa'i tshe: 'khrul snang sdug bsngal rtsad nas gcod pa dang : rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i sras su skye bar shog: khyad par nam zhig bar dor 'pho ba'i tshe: dag pa rig 'dzin rnams kyi zhing khams nas: 'od zer mi bzod dpag yas 'ja' ltar du: rang gi snying khar zug pa'i tshul du 'char: rig 'dzin bsu ba yin par nges shes bskyed: de dang mnyam por nyams pa'i 'od drug ni: rang gi lte bar zug pa'i tshul du 'char: rigs drug bsu ma yin pas rjes ma 'brang : de bzhin thim rim rdzogs nas ro rkyang du: rlung rnams zhugs nas bar do'i snang ba 'char: de tshe rang nyid rig pa bag gyis klod: sngangs skrag la sogs snang ba ci shar yang : thams cad stong pa'i rang gzugs shes par gyis: dgra la sdang ba'i rnam pa mi bgyi zhing : gnyen la byams pa'i brod kha spang bar bya: dge sdig la sogs rnam smin mthong ba'i tshe: gshed ma rnams la byams sems snying nas bskyed: de tshe dge ba'i rtsi kha zin par 'gyur: gzhan yang las dang rkyen gyi dbang gyur te: zhe sdang dmyal ba'i snang ba shar ba'i tshe: sa la gnas pa'i rig 'dzin gsal btab nas: mngon dga'i zhing du skye ba'i 'dun pa bskyed: shar phyogs zhing khams lha tshom dran pas zungs: kun snang pre ta'i snang ba shar ba'i tshe: phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin gsal btab nas: dpal ldan zhing du skye ba'i 'dun pa bskyed: lho phyogs zhing khams lha tshom dran pas zungs: gti mug dud 'gro'i snang ba shar ba'i tshe: tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin gsal btab nas: bde chen zhing du skye ba'i 'dun pa bskyed: nub phyogs zhing khams lha tshom dran pas zungs: 'dod chags mi yi snang ba shar ba'i tshe: lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin gsal btab nas: las rab zhing du skye ba'i 'dun pa bskyed: byang phyogs zhing khams lha tshom dran pas zungs: phrag dog lha min snang ba shar ba'i tshe:

bde ba chen po'i rig 'dzin gsal btab nas: lnga yab zhing du skye ba'i 'dun pa bskyed: dbus phyogs zhing khams lha tshom dran pas zungs: nga rgyal lha yi snang ba shar ba'i tshe: rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin gsal btab nas: mkha' spyod zhing du skye ba'i 'dun pa bskyed: steng phyogs zhing khams lha tshom dran pas zungs: de ltar 'dzin rtog 'jigs skrag snang ba rnams: ma yengs gtan du dran pa'i lcags kyus zungs: gang shar thams cad chos nyid rol par skyongs:

sa ma ya: de yang rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor rtsa ba'i gsang sgrub las: thog mar lha tshom dkyil 'khor ras bris sam 'bru tshom pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa bya: de'i phyi rol rdo rje pad phreng 'ja' tshon 'od zer phreng ba me ri bcas: bum pa mtshan ldan me long bgrang phreng rigs lnga: gtor ma rig 'dzin 'dus pa bsdus pa ltar mdzes par bya: gzhan yang bla rten sku 'bag sogs mchod pa spyi 'gro: spyan drangs tshogs kyi mchod pa bcas 'byor tshad bsgrigs: rang nyid kyang dag pa rig 'dzin gsal ba'i ting 'dzin ngang : dkyil 'khor la 'jug par bya: sa ma ya: de nas sngon du 'gro ba skyabs sems ni: na mo: phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams ji snyed du: bzhugs pa'i rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i lha tshogs la: sgau gsum dad pa mi phyed drag po yis: gsol ba 'debs so ye shes 'od kyi skur: dag pa rig 'dzin dkyil 'khor bsgrubs nas ni: gang la gang 'dul thugs rje phrin las kyis: 'grau drug 'khrul snang sgrol bar dam bca'o: mchod pa byin rlob ni: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: om̐ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: gling bzhi'i snod mchog khor yug khyab pa yi: phyi mchod lha mo bcu drug sprin ltar gtibs: bhan+dha'i snod du nang mchod mtsho ltar bskyil: ga ṇa tshogs dang gtor ma ri ltar spungs: dbang po sna lnga'i me tog tshar du dngar: dri zhim phyur zhing spyan gzigs sprin ltar gtibs: kun bzang dgyes pa rab skyed 'dod yon tshogs: bla med bde ba chen por dgyes par bskyed: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke a mṛ ta ga ṇa tsakra badz+ra shab+da gan+dhe spar+she pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐: de nas dkyil 'khor bkod pa ni: om̐ e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bh+rūm̐: bhi shwa bi shud+dhe: ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍa la: a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la: pam̐ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la: hrīḥ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa hūm̐ ā: hūm̐: e las nam mkha' mtha' dbus bral: yam̐ las rlung gi rgya gram btegs:

ram̐ las bskal pa'i me chen 'bar: kham̐ las rgya mtsho rba rlabs 'khrugs: sum̐ las dbang chen sa gzhi brdal: keṃ las rus pa'i ri rab brjid: bh+rūm̐ las pho brang gzhal yas khang : gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan dang ldan: phyi dang nang gsal sgo rdzogs mdzes: mtshan nyid thams cad tshang ba'i dbus: pad+ma nyi zla'i steng du hūm̐: de nyid gnas 'gyur dran rdzogs su: gu ru bde chen rgyal po'i sku: longs spyod rdzogs pa'i cha lugs can: zhal gcig phyag gnyis khro 'dzum mdzes: dmar smug dbang gi phrin las rdzogs: dbu la rin chen prog zhu gsol: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum 'gying bag can: rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras: rus rgyan g.yer kha'i sgra dang bcas: dar dpyangs cod pan du ma 'phur: phyag gnyis rdor dril thugs kar bsnol: mtsho rgyal dkar mo zung 'jug 'khril: rdo rje bhan+dha mgul nas 'khyud: rin chen dang ni rus pas brgyan: zung 'jug bde chen ldan par bsgom: hūm̐: steng phyogs mkha' spyod rnam dag dbus: rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin ni: 'od lnga'i mdangs ldan gzi brjid 'bar: phyag gnyis gri gug thod khrag bsnams: gsang ba ḍāk+ki yum dang sbyor: phyag gnyis rdo rje dung dmar 'dzin: gtso bo'i cha lugs lta bur bskyed: gtso bo'i phyogs bzhir rim pa bzhin: shar du sar gnas rig 'dzin dkar: lho ru phyag rgya rig 'dzin ser: nub tu tshe dbang rig 'dzin dmar: byang du lhun grub rig 'dzin ljang : thams cad gri gug bhan+dha bsnams: sku la 'khril ba'i yum chen bzhi: nyi zla dngos grub bde chen dkar: mthing 'od 'bar ma gsal stong sngo: rdo rje rnal 'byor rā ga'i mdangs: las kyi dbang mo sngo ljang dgyes: yum rnams ḍā ru bhan+dha bsnams: thams cad gtso bo'i cha lugs can: gsal stong nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor ltar: snang la ma 'dres 'ja' ltar shar: rang bzhin stong pa'i dbyings su bsgom: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum nas:

sa bon yig 'bru 'phros pa yis: dag pa rig 'dzin lha tshogs rnams: skad cig nyid la spyan drangs gyur: om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya phaiṃ phaiṃ a be sha ya a āḥ de nas spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: mkha' spyod o rgyan dag pa'i pho brang nas: thog ma'i rig 'dzin gtso bo gshegs su gsol: bde chen longs spyod rdzogs sku'i zhing khams nas: rig 'dzin rol pa ye shes gshegs su gsol: zhing khams phrin las rnam bzhi'i pho brang nas: dag pa rig 'dzin rnam bzhi gshegs su gsol: bde stong mkha' la rol pa'i pho brang nas: gsang ba dbyings kyi yum drug gshegs su gsol: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dza hūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ bzhugs gsol dang phyag bgyid pa ni: hūm̐: rig 'dzin rol pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams: chags med pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs: rtog med thugs rjes 'gro la dgongs slad du: stong nyid snying rje ye shes stsol ba'i phyir: rnal 'byor gdung ba drag po'i nges 'byung gis: lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag bgyid do: zab ber chos gos ldan pas phyi phyag 'tshal: phod kha sngags chas ldan pas nang phyag 'tshal: rgyan drug stag sham ldan pas gsang phyag 'tshal: gcer bu 'phur zhing ldan pas brkyang phyag 'tshal: sgo gsum tha mal gzhom pas dam phyag bgyid: om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: na mo badz+ra a ti pu hoḥ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor la: phyi yi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: me tog cod pan dbu la 'bul: dri zhim sman spos shangs la 'bul: nyi zla snang gsal spyan la 'bul: dza gad tshogs mchod ljags la 'bul: dbyangs dang rol mo snyan la 'bul: reg bya rgyan mdzes sku la 'bul: phyi yi mchod pa sna tshogs kyis: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i thugs dam bskang : om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke a mṛ ta ga ṇa tsakra badz+ra shab+da gan+dhe spar+she pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐: de nas nang gi mchod pa 'bul ba ni:

hūm̐: bhan+dha dum gcig rang byung snod kyi nang : sha lnga bdud rtsi pañtsa a mṛ ta: rigs lnga sku lnga sbyor ba'i byang chub sems: pad+ma mu la añdza rak+ta sogs: mkha' dbyings dbang mo'i bde ba nyi zla'i rgyun: khā kha mu kha rdo rje rlung gis bskul: gzhan yang bha ling gtor ma ri ltar spungs: dbang po'i me tog phung por brtsegs pa dang : spyan gzigs la sogs yid la 'thad pa'i tshogs: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: bzhes nas thugs dam bskangs shing g.yar dam stsol: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta khā hi: ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na keṃ ni ri ti bha su ta khā hi: de nas gsang ba bde ba chen po'i mchod pa ni: hūm̐: rig 'dzin bde chen rgyal po la: ye shes mtsho rgyal yum dang sbyor: zag med bde ba'i 'khrul 'khor gyis: phyag rgya dga' bzhi'i mchod pa 'bul: sku lus dgyes phyir bzhes su gsol: om̐ gu ru ak+ṣo bh+ya rā ga ya hoḥ hūm̐: rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin la: gsang ba ye shes yum dang sbyor: zag med bde ba'i 'khrul 'khor gyis: phyag rgya dga' bzhi'i mchod pa 'bul: sku lus dgyes phyir bzhes su gsol: om̐ bi dho dhā ra ak+ṣo bh+ya rā ga ya hoḥ hūm̐: sa la gnas pa'i rig 'dzin la: nyi zla 'od zer yum dang sbyor: zag med bde ba'i 'khrul 'khor gyis: phyag rgya dga' bzhi'i mchod pa 'bul: sku lus dgyes phyir bzhes su gsol: om̐ bi dho dhā ra ak+ṣo bh+ya rā ga ya hoḥ hūm̐: phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin la: mthing 'od 'bar ma yum dang sbyor: zag med bde ba'i 'khrul 'khor gyis: phyag rgya dga' bzhi'i mchod pa 'bul: sku lus dgyes phyir bzhes su gsol: om̐ bhi dho dhā ra ak+ṣo bh+ya rā ga ya hoḥ hūm̐: tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin la: rdo rje rnal 'byor yum dang sbyor: zag med bde ba'i 'khrul 'khor gyis: phyag rgya dga' bzhi'i mchod pa 'bul:

sku lus dgyes phyir bzhes su gsol: om̐ bhi dho dhā ra ak+ṣo bh+ya rā ga ya hoḥ hūm̐: lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin la: las kyi dbang mo yum dang sbyor: zag med bde ba'i 'khrul 'khor gyis: phyag rgya dga' bzhi'i mchod pa 'bul: sku lus dgyes phyir bzhes su gsol: om̐ bhi dho dhā ra ak+ṣo bh+ya rā ga ya hoḥ om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐: rā ga ya hoḥ rā ga ya mi: sa ma ya ho: sa ma ya satwaṃ: su khaṃ sid+dhi pha la dz+nyā na hoḥ zhes bde ba chen po'i mchog gi dngos grub thob par bsam: dmigs pa ni lha yab yum sbyor ba mdzad pa'i sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi babs pas dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang dbyer med du gyur: mchog thun thams cad kyi rtsa ba byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi yin pa don rtogs par bya zhing sku gsung thugs kyi dbang bzhi thob par bsams la bdud rtsi lce ru myong zhing gnas gsum du thig le bya: bdud rtsi la yang byang sems dkar dmar bsre ba'am: yang na sin+dhu ra: cu gang ka la ma bsres: khyad par tsan+dan dkar dmar: yang na cong zhi dang rgya mtshal: yang na tsha dang : rgya skag ste: thabs shes spel ba'i rdzas so: yang na bdud rtsi sman sgrub kyis thams cad 'thu'o: sa ma ya: de nas bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: phyogs bcu rgyal ba ma lus bzhugs pa'i yul: zhing gi mchog gyur o rgyan mkha' spyod gnas: pho brang mchog gyur rnga yab pad+ma 'od: dpal ri mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas mchog tu: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gzi byin mched: mkha' la spyod pa'i don du dgongs pa mdzad: rig 'dzin rol pa'i dpa' bo he ru kaḥ bde ba'i zung 'jug zag med rig ma 'khril: 'gro ba'i don du sgyu ma'i sprul bsgyur pa: mkha' spyod zhing gi lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: chos dbyings skye med khyab brdal rol pa las: rigs drug thar lam mchog tu smin pa'i phyir: bde chen rgyal po rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung :

sku mdog dmar smug zhi zhing khro ba'i nyams: dbu la rigs lnga'i rtse phran prog zhu gsol: sku lnga ye shes gsal stong 'du 'bral med: sna tshogs rin chen drwa ba sku la spras: thugs rje'i 'od zer 'khor 'das phyogs ris bral: lha rdzas mdzes pa'i cod pan du mas brgyan: byams dang snying rje'i thabs kyis 'gro drug 'dren: rus rgyan zar bu g.yer kha'i phreng bas spras: skye gnas rnam bzhi'i 'khrul rgyun rtsad nas gcod: rdo rje dril bu thabs shes bsnol ba sil: 'khor 'das chos rnams sgyu ma'i rol par rtogs: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum nyams kyi gar dang ldan: skye 'chi gnyis spangs ngan 'gro'i gdung ba sel: zung 'jug bde chen mtsho rgyal pang du 'khril: dga' bzhi bde stong grol lam mtha' ru phyin: zag med sku la yon tan rdzogs pa'i yum: ma sring rgya mtsho 'dus pa'i dbang mo che: rig 'dzin yab yum sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: gti mug rnam dag chos dbyings ye shes ngang : dbus phyogs mkha' spyod zh-ing khams lha yi gtso: rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin 'od lnga'i mdangs: bde chen dbyings phyug gsang ba ye shes 'khril: smin pa'i rig 'dzin yab yum sku la bstod: hūm̐: zhe sdang rnam dag me long ye shes ngang : shar phyogs mngon dga'i zhing khams lha yi gtso: sa la gnas pa'i rig 'dzin snang stong sku: bde chen dbyings phyug nyi zla'i 'od zer 'khril: sar gnas rig 'dzin yab yum sku la bstod: hūm̐: nga rgyal rnam dag mnyam nyid ye shes ngang : lho phyogs dpal ldan zhing khams lha yi gtso: phyag rgya chen po'i bde stong rig 'dzin sku: bde chen dbyings phyug mthing 'od 'bar ma 'khril: phyag rgya rig 'dzin yab yum sku la bstod: hūm̐: 'dod chags rnam dag sor rtog ye shes ngang : nub phyogs bde chen zh-ing khams lha yi gtso: tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin grags stong sku: bde chen dbyings phyug rdo rje rnal 'byor 'khril:

tshe dbang rig 'dzin yab yum sku la bstod: hūm̐: phrag dog rnam dag bya grub ye shes sku: byang phyogs las rab zhing khams lha yi gtso: lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin gsal stong ngang : bde chen dbyings phyug las kyi dbang mo 'khril: lhun grub rig 'dzin yab yum sku la bstod: hūm̐: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: bdag gis rab bskul dwang bas bstod lags na: byin rlabs thugs rje'i smon lam shugs mtshon te: tshe rabs kun tu 'bral med rjes 'dzin cing : rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i sras su dbang bskur te: rnga yab dag zhing bgrod par byin gyis rlobs: rtsa sngags ni: om̐ ma hā gu ru bhi dho dhā ra pad+ma yo gi ni sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ las sngags ni: om̐ gu ru ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa hūm̐ phaṭḥ phrin las sngags: om̐ gu ru yo gi ni ḍāk+ki ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yoḥ zhes pa'i sngags rnams sgra gtsang la dag pa ring thung snyoms pa la gcong rong 'bring po'i chu ltar si li li bzlas so: dmigs pa ni rigs 'dus mkha' spyod kyi zhing khams lha tshogs dngos su gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'bru gsum gyi rnam par 'phros pa rang gi gnas gsum du thim: rang gis snying po bgrang ba'i tshe: lus thams cad 'od zer sngags phreng gis khengs: sngags phreng de las spros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo grangs med phyogs bcu rgyal ba'i zhing du 'phros: phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs thams cad la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul: de rnams kyi thugs rje byin rlabs thams cad tshur 'dus mdun bskyed la thim: mdun bskyed kyi lha rnams kyi thugs ka nas byin rlabs 'dus pa'i ngo bo hūm̐ mthing ka'i rnam par 'phros: rang gi snying kha la thim pas mi rtog ye shes chen po'i bde ba nyams su myong ste rang rig gdod ma'i mgon po gsal stong ye shes skye ba med pa'i shes pa rgyud la smin par bsam:

sa ma ya: de nas sgrub pa mthar phyin nas: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor las dbang bzhi blang ba ni: mchod rdzas rim par thogs la: hūm̐: rig 'dzin rgyal ba kun gyi spyi mes po: khyab bdag dpal ldan rje btsun pad+ma 'byung : nus pa'i thugs rje gzi byin 'od stong g.yo: phrin las sna tshogs thabs kyis 'gro ba sgrol: sa mkhan bde chen zhing gi dbang phyug che: rgyal ba ma lus 'dus pa'i byin rlabs gter: nam mkha'i khyon yang 'gengs pa'i dpal yon gyi: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las ma lus pa: dngos grub thams cad deng 'dir bdag la stsol: om̐ gu ru ḍāk+ki bhi dho dhā ra ha ri ni sa kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta gu h+ya sa ma ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sid+dhi pha la hoḥ zhes pas byin rlabs dbang bzhi blangs te mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thob nas: tshe 'di nyid la rig 'dzin mchog gi go 'phang grub par bsam: sa ma ya: de nas dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni: hoḥ ka dag rang rig snang stong la: rigs 'dus dkyil 'khor mi dmigs ngang : rang bzhin gsal stong a ru ldang : a a āḥ de nas bsngo smon ni: hoḥ bsngo ba rjes shes stong nyid 'dus ma byas: rtsol bral mtha' yas sangs rgyas 'thob phyir bsngo: zhes pas bsngo smon bkra shis sogs rgyas pa spyi gzhung nas blang : rjes shes mi dmigs chos dbyings ngo bor ldang : rtsol med shes pa gzhi thog mnyam par bzhag:

sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: them rgya: mi nub rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos sa khyi lor bod yul bsam yas mchims phu'i dge'u gong ke'u tshang nas gdan drangs shing chu glang lor shog ser nas bod yig tu zhal bshus so// // ga) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: thod phreng rigs lnga'i sgrub pa 'khrul snang rang grol bzhugs so: bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: sku lnga mtshan brgyad rnam thar dpag yas kyang : chig dril sgrub pa thugs kyi thig le nyid: yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po ltar 'phags pa: zab lam snyan brgyud man ngag rgya mtsho'i rdzing : de la rnam par dbye ba'i don tshan nyid: gang zhig sems can sgyu lus 'jigs pa'i tshe: 'khrul snang nying 'khrul bag chags sna tshogs 'thab: 'dod khams lha rnams gnyid log ci bzhin du: rtag mi thub ste lug rgyud mched pa ltar: gcig snang gnyis 'phel rgyu 'bras so so'i gzugs: gang la chags pa'i rnam pa mthong bar gyur: de tshe rang nyid rjes shes so ma'i steng : nyin snang thams cad sgyu mar sbyangs pa'i tshe: rdo rje thod phreng me long ye shes ngang : rnam rtog bzang ngan phra rags ci shar yang : snang yang bdag 'dzin bral ba'i ngang la zhog: gzung 'dzin dag pa gsal stong lha skur grol: de nas mtshan mo rmi lam sbyangs pa'i tshe: rat+na thod phreng mnyam nyid ye shes ngang : nyin snang mtshan mo'i bag chags bying ba la: rna ba'i sgra sogs snyan dang mi snyan rigs: brag cha dang ni rmi lam lha mo bzhin: dbyangs dang rngam skad gcan gzan 'tshe ba sogs: gnyan la dgra sdang gang gis smra ba rnams: stong pa'i 'brug skad rlung sgra ci bzhin du: pi waṃ gdangs ltar rang bzhin stong par 'gro: de nas bar do'i kun rtog sbyangs pa'i tshe: pad+ma thod phreng sor rtog ye shes ngang : nang tshan bar do'i las mkhan rngam tshul dang :

yid kyis rtag bskyed so sor gol ba'i dus: snang ba dgrar langs rtog pa ngos mi thogs: de tshe gnas pa gzhi la 'gyu ba lam: brtag dpyad gzhig bral cir yang 'char ba'i tshe: sngon bsu rjes gcod blo yis bcos mi gzhug: gang shar 'dzin med chos sku'i ngang du grol: de nas skye gnas rnam bzhi sbyangs pa'i tshe: karma thod phreng bya grub ye shes ngang : byed spyod thams cad sgyu mar shes par bya: las kyis shugs la srid par 'jug pa'i tshe: gang du skye ba'i yul de rtag tu mthong : srid pa rigs drug pho mo 'khrig pa sogs: reg bya'i yul la rtag mi thub par 'char: de tshe rang rig bla ma yi dam dang : rgyu 'bras bskul ba'i chos rnams la sogs pa: dag snang gus 'dun sbyang ba'i dus gcig go: bden pas bsu ba smon lam mtha' btsan pas: rigs ldan bram ze mtshan bzang rnyed par 'gyur: srid par gnas tshe mya ngan snang ba skye: ci snang dag pa longs sku zhing du sgoms: nam zhig las kyi rlung gis rab bskul bas: 'jig rten mi yul mthong nas bag tsha zhing : reg bya rtsub sogs sdug bsngal sdang ba'i tshe: snang stong grags stong gsal stong tshor stong dang : mi rtog ye shes gnas lugs ngang du zhog: 'di phyi'i byed spyod sgyu ma'i ngang du grol: de nas bskyed rdzogs lam la sbyangs pa'i tshe: bud+dha thod phreng chos dbyings ye shes ngang : pad 'byung dus gsum mkhyen pa dus med rtogs: 'das pa'i rtog pa ye grol gdod nas dag: da lta'i rtog pa dran rig chos skur grol: ma 'ongs rtog pa glo bur byar med ngang : gnas skabs rtog pa shar grol mnyam rjes bral: dus bzhi dus kyi dus dang gnas skabs bral: dus gsum mkhyen pas phyi nang bral ba'i phyir: sngar 'das da lta phyis 'byung stong pa nyid: chos rnams ji snyed mi dmigs stong pa nyid: ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje stong pa nyid: mthar 'das 'dor len med pa stong pa nyid:

de bzhin rgyu dang mtshan ma stong pa nyid: de bzhin sgyu lus 'byung lnga stong pa nyid: ma skyes mi 'gags nam mkha'i 'khor lo can: bskyed rim snang stong lha sku sgyu ma'i bar: rdzogs rim gang shar ka dag gdod nas grol: 'byung 'jug sngags rnams rlung gi rang bzhin gdangs: kun kyang nam mkha' che la sems kyang che: sems kyi rang bzhin gdod nas skye 'gag bral: med bzhin snang yang dam tshig dmigs su med: 'gyu ba'i snang ba gnyis snang 'gyu zhing stong : staung zhing gsal ba gsal stong skye ba med: rnam rtog skye bas chos sku 'gags mi 'gyur: rnam rtog gnyis snang chos sku'i dbyings su yal: yang rtog blang dor ma rig 'thib pa'i tshogs: gdod nas dag pa chos sku'i dbyings la ltos: lta ba klong yangs nam mkha'i mtha' dang bral: nam mkha'i mtha' la rgya dpangs ris su med: de bzhin bcad cing dum bur btub tu med: dgag cing bsgrub pa med pa'i rdzogs pa che: gu ru dus gsum mkhyen pa'i zhal gdams nyid: kho mo mtsho rgyal bdag gis yi ger btab: rin chen za ma tog gi nang du bskyil: gsang rgya zab pa'i snying thig ti la ka: skal ldan las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: de yang sku lnga bla ma sgrub pa'i thabs o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pa'i dgongs pa yang zhun gyi dkyil 'khor rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs la: thog mar dkyil 'khor thugs sgrub ltar gang 'grigs skabs dang bstun: dbus su pad+ma 'dab bzhi mu khyud lnga ldan bcas: phyi rol rdau rje pad phreng me ri bcas bkod: gu ru rtsa ba'i sgrub gtor bla ma rig 'dzin rgyan mdzes bcas: bum pa bhan+dha me long sngags phreng dang rten rdzas bshams: nyer spyod sogs spyi 'gro bshams: gnas kyang brag dkar skyid rdzong lho nub tu kha bstan pa'i sgrub phug gam gsang phug yang na rje yis byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas sogs yid 'thad sar grogs gtsang ma dang bcas sgrub pa'i dal du 'jug pa'o:

sa ma ya: dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni: na mo: bde gshegs kun 'dus thod phreng rigs kyi gtso: ma sring mkha' 'gro gsang ba dbyings kyi lha: rtsa gsum bka' 'dus dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: bdag yid rab tu gdung bas skyabs su mchi: sku lnga thugs rje'i ye shes rgyud bskul nas: srid zhir chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang : myang 'das go 'phang 'thob phyir sems bskyed do: gnyis pa mchod pa byin rlob ni: om̐ āḥhūm̐: om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐: dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ hūm̐: rlung me thod sgyed steng du ka pā la: yangs shing rgya che phyogs bzhi dbus lnga ru: lha mo bcu drug gsang ba'i lha mo bzhi: phyi mchod nang mchod gsang mchod sbyor ba'i mchod: so so'i thugs kar sa bon 'phros pa las: bhan+dha'i nang du ye shes lnga ldan gyi: dam tshig bdud rtsi sprin phung dbyings su bsnyegs: ye shes rigs lngas byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshe: rang rang thogs pa'i mchod sprin ci bzhin spel: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gen+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she pū dza āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ om̐ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ om̐ ma hā bha ling+ta te dz+wa bha ling+ta bha la bha te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ om̐ ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na kiṃ ni ri ti ba su ta āḥhūm̐: bum rdzas byin rlob ni: hūm̐: dam tshig gzhal yas dbang gi bum pa ru: bdud rtsi bka' 'dus lha tshogs 'ja' ltar shar: mchu yi sgo srung khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil: phyi nang bar gcod gdon rnams rab tu mthar: om̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kro ti hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ ga lak+sha kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bum bskyed dang mchod pas gzi byin bskyed: de nas gzhal yas khang lha bskyed pa ni: om̐ badz+ra bh+rūm̐ hūm̐:

e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ bh+rūm̐: pad+ma sūr+ya tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la tiṣ+ṭha satwaṃ: hūm̐: rlung me sa chu dbang chen gzhi: rdo rje bh+rūm̐ gyur gzhal yas khang : phyi nang bar khyams khor yug bcas: kun tshang pho brang yon tan ldan: rang bzhin dbyings su 'ja' ltar shar: hūm̐ bh+rūm̐: badz+ra āt+ma ko3 haṃ: hūm̐: de dbus pad+ma nyi zla'i steng : hūm̐ las bud+dha thod phreng rtsal: pad+ma 'byung gnas sku mdog mthing : he ru ka pa'i cha lugs can: phyag gnyis rdo rje bhan+dha bsnams: rnal 'byor spyod pa'i lugs su bsgom: de bzhin rol stabs bzhugs pa yi: pang du 'khyud pa'i gsang ye ni: lha lcam dmar mo zung 'jug 'khril: gcer bu rin chen rgyan gyis spras: phyag na mda' dar tshe bum bsnams: zung 'jug gzi brjid ldan par bsgom: hūm̐: shar du badz+ra thod phreng rtsal: lho ru rat+na thod phreng rtsal: nub tu pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: byang du karma thod phreng rtsal: g.yas rnams phyogs kyi phyag mtshan bsnams: g.yon rnams bhan+dha bdud rtsis gtams: gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan drug can: rol stabs bde chen ldan par bsgom: rig ma dkar ser dmar ljang bzhi: gcer mo rin chen rgyan gyis spras: g.yas g.yon rdo rje dung dmar bsnams: zung 'jug 'khril zhing mgul nas 'khyud: yab yum bde chen rgyas par bsgom: hūm̐: gzhan yang rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro dang : dkyil 'khor skyong ba la sogs pa: nyi ma dang ni zer bzhin du: snang la rang bzhin bral bar bsgom: gu ru bka' 'dus lha tshogs rnams: skad cig nyid la spyan drangs gyur: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ de nas spyan 'dren bya ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ rnga yab dpal ri pad+ma 'od: o rgyan rang byung zhing khams nas: rje btsun bud+dha thod phreng rtsal: ḍāk+ki rgya mtsho'i 'khor gyis bskor: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: phyogs bzhi phrin las zhing khams nas: thod phreng sde bzhi gshegs su gsol: mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing khams nas:

rigs lnga mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol: rang bzhin dag pa'i zhing khams nas: dpa' bo dpa' mo gshegs su gsol: gshegs nas byin phob dbang chen bskur: om̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī bud+dha badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma ha ri ni sa badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: dbyings la gshegs bzhugs mi mnga' yang : nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan gyi steng : gu ru bka' 'dus lha tshogs rnams: 'gro ba'i don la dgongs te bzhugs: bdag cag sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin gyis: phyi dang nang dang gsang ba yi: gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo: om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: om̐ na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ a ti pu hoḥ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: gu ru bud+dha thod phreng rtsal: rigs bzhi dpa' bo'i tshogs dang bcas: ma sring ḍāk+ki rgya mtsho sogs: bka' 'dus dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: phyi mchod me tog bdug spos dang : mar me dri chab zhal zas sogs: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'bul: nang mchod sman gtor rak+ta dang : dbang po rnam lnga'i me tog sogs: sbyor sgrol gsang ba kho na nyid: tshogs mchod dza gad chang la sogs: gzhan yang spyan gzigs du mar bcas: rtsa gsum bka' 'dus lha la 'bul: thod phreng sde lnga yab yum gyi: thugs dam bskangs shing bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: om̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī ha ri ni sa badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pū dza hoḥ rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she pū dza hoḥ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta gu h+ya sa ma ye āḥhūm̐: om̐ ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na king ni ri ti bha ling+ta pū dza hoḥ de nas bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ ma chags skyon bral pad+ma rigs kyi lha: dus gsum sangs rgyas sprul sku'i cha lugs 'chang : longs sku'i rang bzhin rin chen rgyan gyis spras: chos sku mi 'gyur sku mdog mthing 'od 'bar:

sku gcig sku gnyis sku lnga lhun gyis grub: 'gro ba'i don du rang byung pad+ma 'byung : he ru ka pa bde gshegs rigs kyi gtso: bde stong zung 'jug lha lcam gsang ye 'khril: 'khor lo rgyas 'debs mchog gi rol rtsal can: zag med dga' bzhi'i ye shes rgyas pa'i sku: ma rig gti mug dbyings su dag pa'i phyir: chos dbyings ye shes skye ba med pa'i thugs: bud+dha thod phreng yab yum sku la bstod: hūm̐: zhi ba'i las mdzad dkar gsal mdangs dang ldan: he ru ka pa sku yi bkod pa rdzogs: zung 'jug ḍāk+ki mtsho rgyal sku la 'khril: nyon mongs zhe sdang 'khrul snang dag pa'i gsung : me long ye shes skye ba med pa'i sku: rdo rje thod phreng yab yum sku la bstod: hūm̐: rgyas pa'i las mdzad ser bzhad mdangs dang ldan: he ru ka pa yon tan bkod pa rdzogs: zung 'jug ḍāk+ki kā la sid+dhi 'khril: nyon mongs nga rgyal 'khrul snang dag pa'i phyir: mnyam nyid ye shes skye med yon tan rdzogs: rat+na thod phreng yab yum sku la bstod: hūm̐: dbang gi las mdzad dri med rā ga'i mdangs: he ru ka pa gsung gi bkod pa mdzad: zung 'jug ḍāk+ki shākya dhe ma 'khril: nyon mongs 'dod chags 'khrul snang dag pa'i phyir: sor rtog ye shes skye ba med pa'i phyir: pad+ma thod phreng yab yum sku la bstod: hūm̐: drag po'i las mdzad ljang nag dgyes pa'i mdangs: he ru ka pa phrin las bkod pa rdzogs: zung 'jug ḍāk+ki bkra shis khye'u 'dren 'khril: nyon mongs phrag dog 'khrul snang dag pa'i phyir: bya grub ye shes skye med phrin las rdzogs: karma thod phreng yab yum sku la bstod: thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐: nyon mongs zhi mdzad 'khrul snang rang sar grol: dus gsum mkhyen pa ye shes gu ru rje: ma sring mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa la: bdag gi gus pas gdung zhing bstod lags na: ma gyur sems can rigs drug sdug bsngal bcas:

'khor ba'i rgya mtsho thar med bying ba rnams: thugs rje'i 'od kyi lcags kyus rjes bzung nas: rnga yab dag zhing bgrod par byin gyis rlobs: rtsa sngags ni: om̐ āḥhūm̐:badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: hrīḥm ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrī ya tsit+ta hring hring dza: sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: las sngags ni: oṃ badz+ra gu ru he ru ka ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa hūm̐ phaṭḥ gcig dril las sbyor ni: om̐ gu ru ḍāk+ki bud+dha dz+nyā na badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma ha ri ni sa thod phreng rtsal sa mā ya dzaḥ sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: zhes pa'i sngags rnams gang 'grub bya zhing : dmigs pa ni mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su thod phreng sde lnga'i lha tshogs mngon sum ltar bzhugs pa'i sku las 'od zer lnga ldan yig 'bru'i rnam par 'phros pa rang gi gnas lngar thim pas lus thams cad 'od zer gyi phung por snang zhing stong pa'i rang bzhin bdag med pa gcig tu gyur par mos: khyad par bskyed rdzogs sngags la brten pa'i dge ba'i bsod nams kyi thugs rjes shugs phyung ste: skye ba tshe rabs thams cad du bsags pa'i las kyi sgrib pa: nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa: shes bya'i sgrib pa: bag chags kyi sgrib pa: kun nas bslangs pa'i sgrib pa bcas byang zhing dag: rang rig dri med rjen pa rtogs lus 'od kyi sku ru grol: lam gyi 'khrul pa byang 'khrul snang ye shes su 'char ye shes la rgyun chad med par 'dun no: sa ma ya: de ltar o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pa he ru ka ltar sgrub pa 'di dag kho mo mtsho rgyal bdag gis shog ser logs su btab pa'o: 'di'i gzhung chen po bla ma bka' 'dus kyi skor ro: sa ma ya: de nas sgrub pa grol ba'i tshe dbang dang dngos grub zhu ba ni:

hūm̐ hrīḥ sku lnga mtshan brgyad bla ma o rgyan rje: bde chen dbang phyug ḍāk+ki rgya mtshos bskor: deng 'dir sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor bdag cag la: tshe chos zas nor gos kyi dngos grub stsol: dbang bzhi'i phrin las yongs rdzogs bskur du gsol: kā ya sid+dhi om̐: wāk+ka sid+dhi āḥ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ṇa sid+dhi trām̐: gu h+ya sid+dhi hrīḥ zhes pas dbang blang : de nas dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni: om̐: skye med rang byung zhi ba dbyings kyi lha: āḥ ma 'gags gsal stong chu zla 'ja' tshon bzhin: hūm̐: gnyis med rol pa'i rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha: hrīḥ mi dmigs ka dag rang byung e ma hoḥ a a āḥ zhes pas rang rig 'od skur bsdus: mnyam rjes bral ba chos sku'i ngang du bzhag: de nas rjes shes ni: hoḥ rang rig skye med gsal stong lhar gyur pas: thugs rje thabs mkhas dam pa'i byin rlabs kyis: mar gyur skye dgu tshogs gnyis lam bkod nas: lhun grub dbyings rig dgongs pa der rdzogs shog: ces bsngo smon sogs gang rigs bya'o: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: mi nub rgya: kho bo sngags 'chang rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtsho yis sa khyi lor bsam yas mchims phu'i dge'u gong nas gdan drangs shing chu glang lor shog ser nas bod yig tu zhal bshus so// // nga) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: o rgyan dpa' bo gyad kyi sgrub thabs ka dag snying po bzhugs so: bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: dal 'byor rnyed dka' rdo rje lus kyi sgrom: phung po lnga dang khams lnga dbang po lnga: snang ba tshogs drug rnam shes tshogs chen brgyad: rten 'brel srid pa skye mched bcu gnyis te: rlung lnga srog 'dzin las rlung ye shes rlung : brgyad khri bzhi stong rtsa khams 'khor lo drug: yas brtan ro ma dbu ma rkyang ma gsum: mas brtan khrag rlung rtsa srin rtsa ba gsum:
