rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa rnam pa bzhi: a haṃ tsha grang gnyis dang 'pho ba brgyad: kun rgyu nges par rgyu dang shin tu rgyu: bcu drug lus kyi cha shas rdzogs pa la: don lnga snod drug khams dang dbang po'i tshogs: de la brten pas skye 'chi zhes bya ste: sa chu me rlung 'byung ba'i bar chod kyis: sgyu lus nyams shing ngal ba'i nad byung na: o rgyan dpa' bo gyad kyi sgrub par brtson: sa ma ya: dpa' bo gyad kyi mtshan nyid ci zhe na: sku la skye 'chi'i bgres rgud bral ba'i phyir: 'byung bzhi tshe yi bar chod glags mi rnyed: gsung la grags stong ma 'gags sgra ldan pas: 'byung 'jug rlung gis 'phro 'du ya mi nga : thugs nyid nam mkha'i gsal stong mtha' bral bas: nyon mongs dug lnga'i khu sprin bag mi tsha: snang stong mtshan ma'i gzhom gzhig bral ba'i phyir: rgyu 'bras bden pa gang gis dor mi nus: de bzhin ka dag dbyings kyi gyad dang mtshungs: ka dag la'ang rnam pa gsum 'dod de: ngo bo ka dag rang bzhin gdod nas dag: dbyings kyi ka dag mtha' dbus ka nas dag: snang ba ka dag tshogs drug 'dzin pa bral: rgyu yis ma byas rkyen gyis mi 'jig pa'i: 'ja' lus skye 'chi gnyis med pad+ma 'byung : 'ja' lus de yi mtshan nyid ci zhe na: bsdus bya sgyu ma'i tshul la ma brten pas: snang stong tshogs drug mi re rang bzhin gsal: sa khams ma mchis sangs rgyas spyan mar grol: chu khams ma mchis mā ma kī ru grol: me khams ma mchis gos dkar ma ru grol: rlung khams ma mchis dam tshig sgrol mar grol: snang bar mi gol dbyings phyug ma ru grol: de bzhin 'byung bzhi dag kyang rang sar grol: grol ba'i gdams ngag 'dogs par bya ba la: 'byung lnga sbyangs shing bsgyur te sprul ba tsam: dang po rnam snang chos bdun ldan pa'i ngang : stong ra rtsa gsum 'khor lo zung 'jug brten: skabs su dud 'gro'i 'gyur bzhis 'dren pa dang : gsal gtab rlung ro bsal zhing rngubs nas bsgom:

gzhil zhing 'khrul 'khor lnga yis legs par bcun: 'bebs te gnas su shin tu phebs par bya: bkram pa bzhi yis laigs par dgram par bya: sprugs pa drug gis rtag tu sprug par bya: skabs su rlung sems lte ba'i 'phrul 'khor gyis: mnyam bzhag dang ni dbu ma legs par sbyangs: 'byongs tshe khams lnga rang bzhin gnas su dag: sa rlung dag pas ri brag zang thal 'gro: chu rlung dag pas rgya mtshor nya ltar 'phyo: me rlung dag pas me dang gnyis med ldog: rlung sems gnyis med mkha' la lding zhing gshegs: de tshe lus la grib ma mi 'byung zhing : ngang pa'i rgyal po bzhin ltar shin tu gsal: snang srid skye gnas bud+dha'i zhing du 'gro: 'phral gyi yon tan dag kyang 'di 'dra ste: mdangs ni rma bya rtsal ni khyung chen 'dra: tshul ni seṅge shugs ni gyad mi 'dra: dbyangs ni tshangs pa bzhin ni kun tu bzang : de phyir khams gang lha rnams sgyu mar rig: 'dzam gling 'di la ma ltos grangs med kyang : 'jig rten gnas rnams ye shes zang thal mthong : de nas rlung sems lte ba'i 'khrul 'khor gyis: tshe 'di 'byung bzhi'i gnad gcod ma ltos par: 'chi 'pho ltung ba 'di tsam ya mtshan med: o rgyan 'byung ba bzhi yi lha mo'i don: phyi nang bskyed rdzogs 'di la mi g.yel ba: gcig tu dril na rang rig pad+ma 'byung : bla mar 'dus te rje yi sgrub par brtson: gdeng dang ldan pas pad 'byung gyad kyi sku: mi 'jigs gdeng bzhi rdzu 'phrul rkang pa brgyad: dbang phyug yan lag bdun ldan 'phags pa'i lam: byang chub sems lnga tshad med rnam pa bzhi: snyoms par 'jug dang stong nyid bcu drug bcas: de sogs yon tan spyi yi bye brag rgyu: theg dgu bcu gsum sku la rdzogs pa'i phyir: o rgyan dpa' bo gyad kyi mtshan nyid de: rig 'dzin bla ma'i sgrub pa 'di kho na: yang snying bla ma mkha' 'gro dbyer med nyid: nyams len bla ma'i sgrub pa zhal gdams 'di:

dam pa rje yi bka' stsal bslad med du: kho mo dbyangs can bdag gis yi ger btab: gsang rgya shwa na ma yis brda bgyis te: bla ma bde gshegs bka' 'dus cha rkyen du: brag dmar mchims phu'i ke'u tshang rgya ru btab: da lta'i gnubs ban sangs rgyas ye shes khyod: ma 'ongs rin chen gter la spyod pa'i tshe: rtsa gsum bka' 'dus 'di dang 'phrad par shog: rgya 'di sngags bdag lha mos rtag tu skyongs: sa ma ya: de nas sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor la 'jug pa ni: 'bru tshom mam ni ras bris ci ltar yang : thog mar pad+ma bzhi tshom lte ba ljang gu bya: phyi rol pad+ma'i phreng ba rdo rwa dang : g.yung drung phreng ba pa tra me ris bskor: spyi mthun bum pa bhan+dha gtor ma phyi mchod bcas: me long sin+dhu ra yi dkyil 'khor la: om̐ badz+ra ra ti: dharma ra ti: rā ga ra ti: ta ti ra ti: su khaṃ ra ti: sarba dza dzaḥ zhes rtsibs drug rim par bkod par bya: 'di rnams rten 'brel spyi yi rdzas yin phyir: mchod tshogs bla med 'byor ldan bsham par bya: dam par mtshams bcad grib kyis ma gos par: khrus bstsal sgrub pa'i las rim sngags la bskyal: sngags rnams cung zad bzla ba bsgrubs rjes su: rlung sems dbyer med sgrub pa'i 'khrul 'khor sbyang : sa ma ya: de nas sngon du 'gro ba ni: na mo: ka dag bde chen lhun grub 'dus ma byas: kun bzang 'gyur med gsal stong ye shes che: sna tshogs ma 'gags khyab brdal lhun gyis grub: mkha' ltar rnam dag 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku: skye 'chi gnyis spangs gu ru pad+ma 'byung : phung khams rnam dag mkha' 'gro rig ma'i tshogs: 'byung bzhi gdos bral dri med rab gsal sku: dam pa'i dkyil 'khor lha la gsol ba 'debs: phung khams 'ja' lus 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: de nas mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ rang byung skye ba med pa'i snod mchog tu: tshogs drug yid la dgyes pa'i mchod sprin gtibs:

khams lnga dbang po'i sman raka gtor mchod bcas: bla med mchog gi bde ba rgyas phyir spel: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta māṃ sa tsit+ta go ro tsa na ba su ta āḥhūm̐: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: de nas gzhal yas khang lha bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: dang po ci yang dmigs su med: blo 'das de yi ngang nyid du: brtse ba'i snying rje chen por shar: de la 'khor 'das sgyu mar brten: lugs su 'byung ba'i snying rje la: e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bh+rūm̐: hūm̐ hrīḥmūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐: pad nyi zla gdan steng du shar: pho brang lha dang zhal phyag rdzogs: om̐ rat+na pad+ma sūr+ya tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ dzaḥ hūm̐: rin chen zur brgyad pad+ma nyi zla'i steng : hrī las ma chags mtsho skyes rdo rje'i sku: rgya gar rig 'dzin sprul sku'i cha lugs can: sku mdog dkar dmar gzi brjid dpal du 'bar: spyan lnga ldan zhing thugs rjes 'gro la gzigs: dbu la pad+ma'i sam zhu cod pan can: phyag g.yas rdo rje sa gnon sdug bsngal skyabs: g.yon pas mnyam bzhag bhan+dha tshe bum bsnams: sku la chos gos rnam gsum mdzes pas brgyan: zhabs gnyis bde chen rdo rje'i stabs kyis bzhugs: rig ma kha ṭ+wāṃ be'u bum rnam par gsal: rang bzhin ye shes rol pa'i ngang du bsgom: hūm̐: phyogs bzhi pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i gdan gyi steng : spyan ma mā kī gos dkar sgrol ma bzhi: dkar ser dmar ljang phyed pa'i skyil mo krung : 'khor lo rin chen pad+ma rgya gram g.yas: g.yon rnams thams cad dril bu dkur brten pa: rigs lnga dar dpyangs la sogs zhi ba'i chas: 'byung lnga'i rang bzhin gsal la ma 'gags bsgom: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas lnga'i 'od zer gyis: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren thugs rje'i byin rlabs bskul: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gnas mchog nas:

paṇa chen pad+ma kā ra la: rigs bzhi 'byung lnga'i lha mos bskor: phung khams skye mched gnas dag pa'i: zang thal chos sku'i dkyil 'khor du: spyan 'dren byin 'bebs gshegs su gsol: 'ja' lus rdo rje'i go 'phang la: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin bdag gyur stsol: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya a be sha ya a āḥ de nas bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul ni: hūm̐: rin chen pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng : 'ja' lus sku brnyes bla ma mtsho skyes rje: rgya gar paṇa chen bde chen yum dang bcas: brtan par bzhugs shig sarba tiṣ+ṭha satwaṃ: phyi yul tshogs drug nang rig stong pa'i ngang : ma 'gags gsal stong yid kyis phyag 'tshal nas: thugs rje'i byin rlabs dbang bskur deng 'dir stsol: gu ru ḍāk+ki pu ru sha ya hoḥ dbang bzhi stsol cig dz+nyā na badz+ra om̐: sku bzhi lhun grub pradz+nyā ha ra āḥ ka dag bde chen dharma ga ga hūm̐: sna tshogs ma 'gags ghu ya sid+dhi trām̐: dga' bzhi dbang sdud pad+ma rā ga hrīḥ byin rlabs mchog thun gu h+ya sid+dhi hoḥ gsal stong ma 'gags bai ro tsa na satwaṃ: kun bzhi ye grol skye med a la la: om̐ a dhiṣ+ṭha na maṅga laṃ shrī ye sarba ta thā bh+ya a be sha ya phaiṃ phaiṃ: hoḥ mchog gi dwangs ma dgyes pa'i phyir: mdzes pa'i lha mo puṣ+pe hoḥ dri zhim zhen pa tshor stong phyir: rgyun bzang ngad ldan dhū pe hoḥ gzugs kyi 'dzin pa rnam dag phyir: snang stong 'dzin pa ā lo ke: 'ja' lus sku la sgrib bral phyir: sman mchog gtams pa gan+dhe hoḥ ro yi srid pa rnam dag phyir: bcud ldan nai d+ye wi ti hoḥ grags stong skye med rtogs pa'i phyir: sna tshogs sgra snyan shab+da hoḥ sgyu ma 'od skur grol ba'i phyir: mdzes pa'i reg bya spar+she hoḥ om̐ sarba pū dza dz+nyā na hoḥ mchog gi yon tan lnga dang ldan: ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta hoḥ 'dod yon longs spyod rgyan gyis phyug: bha ling+ta pū dza māṃ sa hoḥ

chags med 'khor ba stong pa'i phyir: rā ga rak+ta pū dza hoḥ rgyud drug dbyings su bsgral ba'i phyir: ma traṃ ru tra mā ra hoḥ zag med bde ba rgyas pa'i phyir: sa khams pra mo ti ri hoḥ mchog gi dang po kho na nyid: dharma kau ri su khaṃ hoḥ sarba ma hā me gha pū dza hoḥ de nas bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ phyogs bcu'i zhing nas thugs rje byin rlabs bskul: bde gshegs rgyal ba kun gyi 'od dkar 'dzin: phrin las rab 'byams sa bon 'phros pa las: hrīḥyig ma chags 'o mtsho'i pad sdong rtser: skyon bral yon tan kun rdzogs pad+ma 'byung : 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku brnyes bgres rgud bral: thugs rje thabs mkhas rgya che rol pa'i sku: mtshan dpe'i sku la 'od dkyil gzi brjid 'bar: mtshan thos dran pas ngan 'gro'i gdung ba sel: byin rlabs dpal 'bar 'byung bzhi'i bar chad zhi: rig 'dzin gtso bo mtsho skyes rdo rje'i sku: mtshungs med 'gro mgon pad 'byung sku la bstod: hūm̐: dbu la mdzes pa'i pad zhwa gsol ba ni: mu stegs rgol ba'i bdud dpung 'joms par byed: chos gos rnam gsum rgyan gyis phyug pa yis: mdo sngags rgyud sde'i bstan pa spel bar byed: phyag g.yas rdo rje sa gnon mdzad pa yis: bdud bzhi nyon mongs zil gyis gnon par byed: phyag g.yon mnyam bzhag bhan+dha tshe bum gyis: 'ja' lus sku brnyes dbyings rig sbyor bar byed: kha ṭ+wāṃ gsang ba'i shes rab ni dhī las: bde stong ye shes gnyis med ston par byed: zhabs gnyis rdo rje thabs shes bzhugs stangs kyis: nam mkha'i rang bzhin mi g.yo gyad kyi sku: rgya gar paṇa chen sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: sa khams rnam dag rdo rje rigs kyi yum: bad kan nad rnams ma lus zhi mdzad pa: 'khor lo dril 'dzin phyed pa'i skyil krung bzhugs: yum chen spyan ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: chu khams rnam dag rin chen rigs kyi yum:

mkhris pa'i nad rnams ma lus zhi mdzad pa: rin chen dril 'dzin phyed pa'i skyil krung bzhugs: yum chen mā kī'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: me khams rnam dag pad+ma rigs kyi yum: 'dus pa'i nad rnams ma lus zhi mdzad pa: pad+ma dril 'dzin phyed pa'i skyil krung bzhugs: yum chen gos dkar mo la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: rlung khams rnam dag las kyi rigs kyi yum: rlung gi nad rnams ma lus zhi mdzad pa: rgya gram dril 'dzin phyed pa'i skyil krung bzhugs: yum chen dam tshig sgrol mar phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ hrīḥ ma bcos lhun grub bde chen ngang nyid las: thugs rje'i phrin las 'dzam bu gling du shar: mkhyen brtse nus pas skye dgu'i gdung ba sel: 'gran gyis zla bral o rgyan chos kyi rje: byin rlabs ka dag klong nas rgyud bskul la: bsnyen sgrub sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol: dam pa rje btsun nyid ltar bdag gyur cig: rtsa sngags ni: om̐ badz+ra gu ru dz+nyā na sid+dhi hrīḥ om̐ dz+nyā na ḍāk+ki mūm̐ shrī hūm̐: zhes pa rig 'dzin rtsa sngags rnams bzla zhing : rgyun du rlung gi las dang gnas lugs kyi ngo bo skyong : nam zhig lus la nad kyis btab pa'i tshe yang rlung rig bsre ba'i 'khrul 'khor kho na gtso che: dus rtag tu yang rje btsun gu ru la blo khyed shes kyis bkal te: gnad gcod sdug bsngal mi 'byung ba'i smon lam drag po yang yang du nyin re bzhin brgya phrag las mi nyung ba gdab par bya'o: de'i thugs rje'i shugs kyis dus min gyi bar chad mi 'byung zhing na tsha dkon par 'gyur ro: sa ma ya: de nas dbang bzhi blang ba ni:

hūm̐: rgya gar sku 'khrungs bod yul 'gro don mdzad: rgyud sde rgya mtsho nam mkha'i mdzod klong rdol: thugs rjes rgyud smin rje 'bangs nyer lngar gdams: gdong dmar srin po gdug pa'i dpung tshogs brtul: byin rlabs gter mdzod o rgyan sprul pa'i sku: paṇa chen dam pas rjes su bzung ba'i phyir: deng 'dir sku gsung thugs kyi dbang bskur stsol: om̐ gu ru dz+nyā na ḍāk+ki nī sarba sid+dhi kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sa ma ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes dbang blangs shing mos pa'i gdung ba bskyed: tshe 'di nyid la rig 'dzin mchog gi dngos grub thob cing : phyi ma phyag rgya chen po byang chub bla na med pa'i a ti ka dag zang thal gyi go 'phang thob par bsam: sa ma ya: rjes shes la sogs skye med ka dag la gnas par bya: sa ma ya: mtsho rgyal gyi zhal nas: stong pa'i rtsal dang snang ba'i gar gnyis zung du 'phro yang : phyi yi snang ba nang du mi len: nang gi rig pa phyi la mi 'brang : da lta'i rig pa mi bzo mi bcos mi dgag mi sgrub rgya yan skyongs: rang yan la mi btang lta thog la klod: klod thog la rjes 'dzin: 'dzin thog la gang shar bzo med shar grol dus mnyam mnyam rjes 'dres pa'i ngang la zhog: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: them rgya: kho bo rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos sa khyi lor bod yul bsam yas mchims phu'i dge'u gong sgam po ri dung seng gnam mchong 'dra ba'i rgyab rir nye ba nas gdan drangs shing chu glang lor shog ser nas bod yig tu zhal bsgyur ba'o// // ca) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: mkha' spyod sgrub pa ye shes zang thal bzhugs so: bde gshegs kun 'dus yang snying 'dus pa las: zab lam 'pho ba rnal 'byor sgrub thabs nyid: tshe gcig sangs rgyas lag 'chang gdams pa ste: da lta spel ba'i dus min sba ba'i dus: ma 'ongs yang mtha' nyi shu la nye dus:

mi rnams skye 'chi mi rtag lcag gis bskul: tshe 'di'i snang ba rlung nang mar me bzhin: drag tu bskyod pas rnam shes myu gu yal: dkar nag las kyis nam yang mi bslu phyir: rang byas rnam smin bag chags 'thib pa'i tshe: sdug bsngal bzod dka' me 'obs dong 'drar lhung : skyabs med las kyi rjes su 'jug pa'i phyir: bya byed thams cad don med kye re hud: legs par bsams na snying rlung mi ldang ngam: de phyir don med 'khor bar mi brtson par: ma rgyud mkha' 'gro'i gsang lam nyams su longs: legs par gdams so lha sras bod kyi rje: rje 'bangs grogs rnams ma brjed yid la 'chang : sa ma ya: de yang zab lam gsang ba ḍāk+ki'i sgrub la brtson pa la: thog mar dbang gi dkyil 'khor dmar po lte ba zla gam sgo gcig: de'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab bzhi bya: zla gam gyi phyi rol pad+ma'i phreng ba dang me ri bya: stegs bu'i steng du mchod pa'i bye brag dang : sgrub pa'i rdzas: bum pa dar dmar gyi mgul chings yod pa: bhan+dha bdud rtsis gtams pa: me long sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor sa bon bcas bris: srog yig gzhung gi shog dril bcas zung du 'jug par bya'o: gzhan yang nyer spyod la sogs spyi mthun bkram mo: de yang dngos gzhi la 'jug pa ni: na mo: dbyings rig ye shes skye ba med pa'i sku: zag med mchog dga' ye shes rab bskul ba: ma sring mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: om̐ āḥhūm̐: phyi nang gsang ba'i de bzhin kho na nyid: yid sprul blo yis blangs te sprul pa'i tshogs: gsang ba ḍāk+ki mnyes pa'i rdzas su gyur: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta pū dza āḥhūm̐: zhes pas byin gyis brlabs: de nas gzhal yas khang lha bskyed pa ni: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ bh+rūm̐: pho brang gzhal yas zla gam sgo gcig pa:

phyi nang mtshan tshang yon tan ldan pa'i lhun: chos 'byung mthing ga 'bar ba e yi klong : de dbus pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i lte ba ru: nyi zla ti ra dbugs bral snying kha ru: hūm̐ las bskyed pa'i rje btsun rnal 'byor ma: sku mdog dmar gsal pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs: zhal gcig phyag gnyis cung zad khros pa'i nyams: phag zhal dbu rgyan skra grol dbyings la gzigs: phyag g.yas zangs gri g.yon pas bhan+dha thogs: rus pa'i rgyan drug zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum can: gru mor brten pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ he ru kaḥ gar gyi nyams ldan 'od lnga'i klong du bzhugs: ral pa'i khrod na rigs bdag dang bcas gsal: phyogs bzhi dkar ser dmar ljang mkha' 'grau bzhi: gtso mthun nyams gyur ma nges gar stabs ldan: 'khor du 'bum phrag mkha' spyod ḍāk+ki gtibs: snang stong 'ja' tshon chu zla'i rnam par gsal: de ltar thugs ka'i sa bon 'od zer gyis: ma rgyud mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs spyan drangs gyur: om̐ badz+ra ḍāk+ki baṃ bha ra hi sa ma ya ha ri ni sa dza dzaḥ de nas spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal ni: hūm̐ ma: mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing khams nas: rje btsun rdo rje phag mo la: rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor: dbu skra thor tshugs ldems se ldem: glu len gar bsgyur shigs se shig: mkha' 'gro'i brda skad di ri ri: ḍāk+ki sprin ltar thibs se thib: byin rlabs thugs rje sha ra ra: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur phyir: pad nyi bam gyi gdan la bzhugs: mos pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal bstod: dam tshig g.yel ba mthol lo bshags: ma khyed brtse bas bsgrubs lags na: 'ja' lus mkha' spyod bgrod pa yi: ye shes 'pho ba'i dngos grub stsol: om̐ badz+ra bai ro tsa na ha ri ni sa ḍāk+ki nī badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ phaiṃ phaiṃ a be sha ya a āḥ om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ badz+ra shud+dhe hoḥ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ

de nas phyi yi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: phyi mchod lha mo spyan gzigs nam mkha'i khyon: yid la bkod pa'i sna tshogs dpag yas gtibs: rab 'byams zhing dang zhing rdul gtams pa'i tshogs: yum chen dbyings phyug ḍāk+ki'i tshogs la 'bul: bzhes nas 'ja' lus rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pū dza hoḥ rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she pū dza hoḥ de nas nang gi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: bhan+dha lcang lo yangs pa'i snod mchog tu: sha lnga bdud rtsi pañtsa a mṛ ta: rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar ngo bo'i mchog: khyad par mchog chen ma hā rak+ta dang : bha ling la sogs dbang po rnam lnga'i rgyan: spyan gzigs mda' dar bla rten du mar bcas: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin sna tshogs 'di: ma rgyud gsang ba ḍāk+ki'i tshogs la 'bul: bzhes nas mkha' spyod 'ja' lus 'grub par mdzod: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na keṃ ni ri ta bha su ta pū dza āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba ḍāk+ki nī i daṃ bha ling+ta pū dza me gha ga ṇa tsakra āḥhūm̐: a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: om̐ badz+ra bha ra hi ḍāk+ki nī ha ri ni sa sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: om̐ badz+ra ḍāk+ki nī sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: om̐ rat+na ḍāk+ki nī sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: om̐ pad+ma ḍāk+ki nī sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: om̐ karma ḍāk+ki nī sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: om̐ sa ma ya ḍāk+ki nī sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: om̐ bhi shwa ḍāk+ki nī sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: om̐ sarba ḍāk+ki nī sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes pas bdud rtsi 'bul: de nas bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐ ma: dbyings rig skye ba med pa'i pho brang nas: ye shes rol pa'i cho 'phrul skur snang ba:

chags med pad+ma rā ga'i gzi byin 'phro: thugs rje'i 'phrul gyis 'dzin pa'i dbang mo che: gzugs mdzes lta na yid sdug tshul bzang ma: dga' ba'i mdangs 'phro bzhin gyis yid rab g.yo: lang tsho dkri ba'i mnyen lcug 'khril legs kyud: yid la 'khu ba'i mtshan dpes bde ba ster: rjes chags dgyes pas gzhan snang dbang sdud phyir: rab g.yo rnal 'byor ma khyod rtag tu bstod: hūm̐: sku mdog dbang lhun dgyes pa'i rab dga' mo: khro 'dzum spyi bor phag zhal ngur sgra 'byin: thod skam dang ni dar dmar cod pan 'phur: rin chen snyan cha gdub bu se mo do: phyag g.yas zangs gris skye 'chi rtsad nas gcod: g.yon pa'i bhan+dha nyon mongs klad khrag rol: kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum dug gsum gnas nas spar: rus pa'i rgyan drug phar phyin don dang ldan: brkyang bskum gar bsgyur snying rjes 'gro drug 'dren: 'od lnga'i klong bzhugs sku lnga lhun gyis grub: mkha' spyod zhing khams sgo 'gyed mkha' 'gro ma: bde chen rnal 'byor yum la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: zhe sdang zhi mdzad me long ye shes sku: mngon dga' zhing khams sgo 'byed mkha' 'gro ma: zhi ba dkar mdzes brdzus skyes sdug bsngal skyob: mkha' spyod rdo rje ḍāk+kir phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: nga rgyal zhi mdzad mnyam nyid ye shes sku: dpal ldan zhing khams sgo 'byed mkha' 'gro ma: ser mo dgyes mdzad mngal skyes sdug bsngal skyob: sa spyod rin chen ḍāk+kir phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: 'dod chags zhi mdzad sor rtog ye shes sku: bde chen zhing khams sgo 'byed mkha' 'gro ma: dmar mo rjes chags drod gsher sdug bsngal skyob: bde spyod pad+ma ḍāk+kir phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: phrag dog zhi mdzad bya grub ye shes sku: las rab zhing khams sgo 'byed mkha' 'gro ma: ljang mo rab g.yos sgong skyes sdug bsngal skyob: gsang spyod las kyi ḍāk+kir phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐:

phung khams rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du: rtsa gsum 'khor lo mkha' 'gro'i rang bzhin la: bde chen thig le dpa' bo lhan cig skyes: a haṃ thabs shes zag med bde stong dang : myur lam mchog gi nā da rab g.yo ma: 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: gsang ba dbyings kyi dbang phyug ḍāk+ki'i tshogs: ye shes thugs dam 'dzab kyis rgyud bskul nas: zung 'jug bde chen 'ja' lus bsgrub pa'i phyir: ma sring khyed rnams srog ltar bzung lags na: zab lam dpa' mos rtag tu grogs gyis shig: phung po 'od lus chos skur 'grub pa yi: ma khyed bdag gi dpung dang gnyen mchis phyir: bzlas pa sngags kyis thugs dam gnad nas bskul: rtsa sngags ni: om̐ baṃ badz+ra bha ra hi kro ti rā ga ha ri ni sa kau ri ma dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ las sngags ni: om̐ badz+ra bai ro tsa na ha ri ni sa hūm̐ phaṭḥ ye shes 'ja' lus sgrub pa'i snying po: om̐ badz+ra ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa dharma dhā tu dz+nyā na hrīḥ 'pho ba rnam thar sgo 'byed kyi sngags 'di srung skud la phu btab ste: rdzas ni rgya tshwa: mgron bu bsregs thal: rdo khab len rnams zung du tshe 'das kyi spyi bor cung zhig 'phur la bzhag pas 'pho ba'i rtags skra byi ba skrang pa rlangs pa 'thul ba sogs 'byung ngo : de'i sngags ni: om̐ dz+nyā na ḍāk+ki yo gi ni baṃ pra be sha ya phaṭḥ ces pas tshe 'das kyi phung po phyogs ring bar yod na srung skud spyi bor sleb tshod tsam la phaṭḥ drag po bya: dmigs pa ni srung skud de hūm̐ sngon po zhig tu bsgoms: rnam shes āḥyig gi rnam par 'og min mkha' spyod zhing du rnal 'byor ma'i thugs kar spar bar bsam: de yang sgrub sngags las sngags sogs rim pa bzhin du thun skabs dang bstun: de yang sgrub pa grol tshe: ḍāk+ki'i dbang dang dngos grub blang ba ni: hūm̐: ka dag rtog med nam mkha'i snying po can: sgyu ma'i gar gyis gzugs sku'i rnam rol ston:

bde chen dbyings rig ngo bo lam gyi mchog: zag med dga' bzhis ngoms med dgyes pa'i yum: zab lam bde chen mchog gi dngos grub tshogs: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la stsal du gsol: hūm̐: bum gsang shes rab ye shes chen po'i dbang : rig pa'i rtsal dbang lug 'byung lug ldog sogs: yas dbab mas 'dzin bde ba chen po'i gnad: nyi ma zla ba bzhus pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun: nor bu pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru'i cha shas kyis: bcu drug lhan skyes dga' ma'i brda skad 'byin: rlabs chen spyod pa'i pho nya lam du bzlog: nam mkha' g.ya' bral sangs rgyas 'khor lo yis: grong 'jug dbu ma'i chos sgo gyen du phyes: mi dmigs 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub pa yi: dbang bzhi grol lam thob par byin gyis rlobs: om̐ badz+ra ḍāk+ki nī ha ri ni sa kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes pas dkyil 'khor gyi rdzas rnams byin rlabs zhus: dga' ston tshogs la rol: om̐ badz+ra ḍāk+ki sa twa hūm̐: zhes pas lhag chad bkang : rdzogs rim ni: hūm̐: dran rig ngo bo dbyings phyug yum chen mo: mi dmigs gsal stong ka dag bde ba che: sna tshogs ma 'gags rang rtsal ye shes rol: sgyu ma chu zla'i ngo bo ci bzhin ldang : a a āḥ bsngo smon bgyid pa ni: ho: bsngo bya stong nyid sgyu ma'i gar bsgyur nas: bsngo byed dmigs yul tshogs drug skye 'gag bral: 'khor gsum dag pas bden gnyis byang chub mchog: dge des ma gyur 'ja' lus lam 'god shog: ces dmigs med bde ba chen pos 'khor gsum dag pa'i dbyings rig la mnyam par bzhag: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: mi nub rgya: spel rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtsho yis bod yul bsam yas mchims phu nas sa khyi lor gdan drangs shing shog ser nas zhal bshus so// // cha) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: o rgyan nor lha dbyer med sgrub thabs rat+na'i rgyal mtshan bzhugs so:

bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: bsod nams phun tshogs dge 'bras smin pa'i phyir: tshogs gnyis 'bras bu'i dpal la longs spyod pa: sngon bsags pre ta'i 'ching ba gcod mdzad lha: snang srid g.yo ba'i rlung rnams rab brtan cing : lha 'khrug sde brgyad 'khu ldog rkyen dbang zhi: gang phyir 'dod sred zhags pa'i me 'od kyi: tsha gdung la brten sems can bsod nams rgud: 'byung ba dgra langs sa bcud nyams pa'i tshe: sems can mu ge'i nad kyis gzer ba na: yid gnyis the tshom med par gsol ba thob: o rgyan nor lha mkha' 'gro'i 'khor gyis bskor: bkres skom dbul phongs sel bar the tshom med: nges par gdams so lha sras rje 'bangs rnams: gsang rgya 'di nyid kun las gces pa yin: 'ching bu zang zing dngos po mang lags kyang : yid bzhin nor bu 'di 'dra shin tu dkon: bsod nams 'phel byed rnam sras la sogs kyang : mtha' 'khob rgyal po'i bsod nams gnas skabs tsam: 'di phyi kun tu bla ma'i nor sgrub gtso: mchog thun zung gcig 'tshogs 'gyur the tshom med: bsod nams gzugs skus bla mar 'ching ba ste: sems nyid yid bzhin nor bu nor gyi mchog: chog shes longs la 'di phyi'i don gnyis 'grub: de phyir yang snying 'di nyid rtag tu sgrubs: gsol ba gang btab bdag gis bslu ba med: sa ma ya: de yang o rgyan nor lha dbyer med sgrub pa la: thog mar bkra shis yar tshes dge ba'i nyin: dkyil 'khor stegs bu bya'am ras bris la: mkho ba'i yo byad g.yang rdzas sna tshogs bsham: khyad par bhan+dha'i snod du sku 'khor dang : rin chen 'bru sman dar zab bcas pa bsham: gtor ma nor bus mtshan pa g.yang zhags bcas: mchod pa spyi mthun dag gis mtha' nas bskor: tshogs mchod dang bcas 'byor tshogs gang 'os bsham: rang nyid ma hā de wa'i chas su zhugs: mchod rdzas bsang sbyangs byin rlabs bgyid nas su: rten bskyed dran rdzogs ma bcos 'di ltar ro:
sa ma ya: dang po:

ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: gsum: om̐ āḥhūm̐: gsum: brgyud 'debs skyabs yul ni: na mo hūm̐: bde gshegs kun 'dus rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i lha: yid bzhin nor bu dbang gi rgyal po la: bsod nams spel zhing bsgrub phyir skyabs su mchi: mchod pa dang lha bskyed ni: hūm̐: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin nam mkha'i mdzod: bsod nams tshogs zhing bsgrub phyir bla med rdzas: kun 'dus rgyal ba mnyes pa'i yo byad 'dis: pad 'byung nor lha'i dkyil 'khor dgyes gyur cig: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: om̐ a hūm̐: ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: hūm̐ bh+rūm̐: rin chen las grub rnam rgyal gzhal yas khang : sgo gru rta babs rtsig rim nor bu'i tog: phyi nang bkod pa rgyan rdzogs gzhal yas khang : de dbus rin chen pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan: hrīḥm hūm̐ las bskyed pa'i mgon po ni: pad+ma 'byung gnas dbyer med dran rdzogs su: pad+ma rgyal po dbang lhun gzi brjid 'bar: sgeg pa'i cha byad khro 'dzum dgyes pa'i gar: rin chen sna tshogs mdzes pas sku lus brgyan: g.yas su rdo rje rgyal mtshan lcags kyu bsnams: g.yon du bhan+dha ne'u le pad+ma thogs: lha rdzas stod g.yogs smad dkris ang rag bklubs: phyed skyil pang du dbang mo zung 'jug 'khril: lcags kyu pad+ma yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: g.yas su lha lcam g.yon du mtsho rgyal ma: gnyis ka gcer mo rin chen du mas brgyan: lha rdzas mdzes pa'i rgyan ldan cod pan 'phur: g.yas g.yon phyag na rdo rje pad+ma bsnams: dal 'gying nyams ldan gtso la chags pa'i tshul: phyogs bzhir 'gugs pa'i las byed pho nya mo: dkar ser dmar ljang lcags kyu ne'u le thogs: snang srid skye 'gro kun gyi tshe bsod sdud: 'dod rgu mchog sbyin stsol ba'i sku ru gsal: bskyed pa'i bdag mdun mi dmigs thugs ka nas:

'od 'phros skad cig gnas 'dir spyan drangs gyur: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha satwaṃ: badz+ra pu ru sha ya hoḥ hūm̐: gter 'byung rang bzhin dbang gi pho brang nas: rtsa gsum kun 'dus gu ru pad+ma 'byung : yid bzhin nor mchog bla ma dzam+bha la: dbang sdud ḍāk+ki rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la mchog thun stsol ba'i slad: gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor rten la 'bral med bzhugs: bdag gi tshe rabs kun tu nyid bsgrub phyir: dam tshig dbyer med gus pas phyag bgyid do: gling bzhi gling phran bkod pa'i tshom bu la: lha mi'i nor rdzas yo byad rgyan gyis phyug: snang srid 'di ru ci srid 'tshogs pa yi: phyi nang mnyes mchod dgyes pa'i 'dod rgu'i tshogs: pad 'byung nor lha dgyes phyir mchod pa 'bul: sgrub la tshe chos zas nor mnga' thang srid: yid la smod pa'i blos blang stsal du gsol: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: om̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī pad+ma rā dza ha ri ni sa pā shaṃ sa ma ya sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta pū dza hoḥ bstod pa ni: hrīḥ ma chags skyon bral dbang gi longs spyod rdzogs: 'dod rgu'i srid rje pad+ma rgyal po rtsal: dbyings phyug tshangs pa'i cha shas rnam par rol: yid 'phrog dbang sdud ma hā dhe wa'i dpyid: 'gugs pa'i rnam rol khyab 'jug zhags pa'i rlung : dbyangs can mi mo 'phrog byed dza na mo: seṅge gnas dang mo ma'i sor rtse nyul: 'dar ma'i rlung gis bde chen g.yo ba bzhin: snang srid dbang bsgyur chags pa'i mdangs ngar can: gzi 'od 'bum bzhin pho nya 'gugs byed 'phro: yab yum dkyil 'khor tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: de ltar bstod cing bskul nas bsgrub pa'i lha: pad+ma 'byung gnas yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal:

gsang ba ḍāk+ki bde chen skyed pa'i yum: 'du 'bral med par gsol btab bsgrubs lags na: thugs rje'i 'od dkar dus las mi 'da' bar: zhal mthong lung ston dngos grub sna tshogs stsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: om̐ ma hā gu ru pad+ma rā dza ma ṇi dha ra rat+na mu ṭa pad+ma rā ga he sha sarba ak+ṣo bh+ya pra mo ti sarba wi ṭa ha ri ni sa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ dza dza pā shaṃ ma ma 'dus 'dus swā hā: oṃ ka ye ku ye ku ru le pā shaṃ she pha k+ṣa dza dza swā hā: zhes nor sgrub kyi rtsa sngags dang : dbang sdud zhags dmar gyi sngags zung du 'brel ba 'di nyid rin chen sna lnga la sngags nas lus la 'chang na: rgyal po btsun mo blon po 'bangs bcas dbang du 'du bar 'gyur ro: mthing shog la gser gyis bris li khri gi waṃ rgya mtshal gsum gyis byugs nas stong skud dmar pos dkris pa 'chang na phyogs kyi bla chen dang ser mo ba'i rigs dbang du 'du bar 'gyur ro: yang dung dkar srin med la sngags nas nyi ma shar phyogs su nyi shar skabs yang 'bud rtag tu sgrom bur bcug la dar snas dril nas mdzod du gter sgrom du bzhag pas lha'i khye'u srid kyi dngos grub 'byung bar 'gyur ro: yang mda' dar lcags kyus brgyan pa la sngags tho rangs skar ma ma yol dgong mo'i skar ma tshang skabs phyogs bcur g.yugs pas phywa g.yang gi rigs thams cad dbang du 'du bar 'gyur ro: yang gzi chu mig gsum yod pa dang shel byi ru rdo khab len la sngags nas dar dmar pos dril nas tho rangs srod 'khor la phyogs bcur 'gugs pa'i phyag rgya bya: rgya sgo'i gong du zhag dgu la bzhag: rgyal mtshan nang du zhag dgu la bzhag: ri bo chen po'i rtse la zhag dgu la bzhag: chu'am mtsho chen po'i gong du zhag dgu la bzhag: rig ldan gyi bu mo dgu'i skra dang lhan cig 'chang bas: dri za'i sras mo dbyangs can mgrin bzang gi gtsos pa'i lha klu mi'i bud med thams cad dbang du 'du bar 'gyur ro:

yang tsan+dan gyi shing la ri rab kyi gzugs bgyid nas gser dngul mtshal gsum gyis bris par sngags: gter bum nang du bum rdzas sna tshogs kyi 'bru sman dar zab sogs bkra shis pa'i rdzas dang lhan cig tu bsdus nas rgyas btab ste gtsug lag khang ngam mchod rten dang sku gsung thugs rten yul lha'i lha mkhar bcas la sbas pas bsod nams dbang du 'du bar 'gyur ro: ri mthon pa'i rtse la sbas pas lha srin dbang du 'du bar 'gyur ro: yang za 'og la li shi gur gum byugs nas mtshal gyis bris pa la sngags te 'chang na gos rgyan phyug par 'gyur ro: yang g.yu drug dkar la sngags nas rta nor srog chags la btags na sgab 'phel bar 'gyur ro: yang gro khre swa ba til yungs dkar dang glang chen smyon pa la sngags nas dar dmar pos dril te chang tshang ngam chang bum la btags pas chang zhim par 'gyur ro: yang khrab byang mig dgu dang rdo mdung rtse ma pha bang long bu'i chos can dum bu bud med bu bdun ma'i gos dreg can nam rin chen rigs la sngags nas dar dkar pos dril zangs kyi gwa'u la bzhag zho zo'am 'o ma dkrug snod la btags pas dkar gzhon 'phel bar 'gyur ro: yang 'bru sna tshogs sman bzang drug bcas sga'i shing byang la sngags nas sgrom bur gzhug ste zhing khang dang yur kha ru bzhag pas 'bru 'phel zhing mi nyams par 'gyur ro: yang 'bru sna tshogs bsngags nas yul kun tu gtor na gang du bskyed pa'i sa phyogs bkra shis par 'gyur ro: yang nyi ma shar phyogs la gyu ba'i chu mig nas bud med rig ldan gyis blangs pa'i chur sngags shing bkra shis pa'i tshes la ri mthon po nyams mtshar skyed mos gling du phyin la gos dkar gyon rgyan bzang btags dngul dkar gyi me long shel rdo'am nor bu'i rigs byad la gzugs brnyan 'char ba'i ngogs la slob dpon gyis sku tshab la khrus bstsal khrus chu de zangs gzhong du blugs:

slar yang sman spos sbyar la yul ris lha srung la khrus bgyid pas yul lha 'khrugs pa'i kha rlangs sde brgyad kyi phog thug khyad par mi 'khon lha la phog pa'am: lha 'khon mi la phog pa rnams zhi bar 'gyur ro: yang chu gtsang klu sman la sbyar ba la sngags nas yul gru la khrus chu gtor bas zhing sel khang sel mtsher sri ngan pa thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro/ yang ḍā ma ru'i nang du sngags bris shing rtag tu sngags pa de rang nyid 'gro ba'i phyogs su dkrol zhing 'cham pas yul gang du 'gro ba thams cad dbang du 'du bar 'gyur ro: yang sngags 'di dar dmar po la bris nas smad 'tshong ma'i skra dang lhan cig tu rkang dung la btags sam dung la btags par sngags kyi nus pa yang bstims nas 'bud pas lha 'dre mi gsum dung gi skad thos pa'am: dmigs pas rgyas thebs tshad dbang du 'du bar 'gyur ro: yang bgrang phreng la sngags nas phyogs bcur g.yugs pas: skye 'gro kun gyi bzlas brjod kyi nus pa thim par 'gyur ro: yang rnga shing la bris nas sngags kyis rlan rdzas dung pho'i kha dang zung gcig rnga la btags nas rdung bas yi dam chos skyong thams cad bran bzhin gtibs par 'gyur ro: yang dung sho la sngags pas lus la 'chang na sho dang rgyal bar 'gyur ro: yang rmog phod kyi dar 'phru la bris nas tsan+dan gur gum gyis chus rlan par sngags nas rtsal 'gran pa'i tshe rgyal kha thams cad rang gis thob par 'gyur ro: yang mthing shog la bris nas bla ma dgu'i na bza' dpon po dgu'i lcag tshan sman pa dgu'i sman sgro dum bur dal sngags yang bskyar bgyis pa sgo chen gong du bzhag pas 'og tu 'dzul ba'i skye 'gro 'byung lnga bcas dbang du 'du bar 'gyur ro: sa ma ya: de yang sgrub sngags rnams mthar phyin pa'i skabs su dbang bzhi dkyil 'khor gzhan ltar spyi mthun len pa ni: gtor ma dang bhan+dha sogs rdzas rnams thogs nas: hūm̐: bde chen lhun grub dbang gi pho brang nas:

dbang sdud mgon po ma hā gu ru rje: ḍāk+ki rgya mtsho dngos grub gter gyi bdag: rig 'dzin yab yum thugs rje'i byin rlabs kyis: lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du 'du ba'i phyir: gsol 'debs bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub pa dang : tshe chos zas nor gos kyi dngos grub stsol: om̐ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: sarba sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ hrīḥm ha ri ni sa sarba pā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes dbang dang dngos grub blang : sgrub rdzas 'chang 'os rnams lus la 'chang : 'di la rgyas dgos na sgrub gzhung chen mo pad+ma rgyal po dang bstun: sngags ring mos na de bzhin bya: med kyang 'di nyid gcig chog mgul khug zhu ba de yin: des na skal ldan las can rnams kyis nyams su longs shig: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: them rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos sa khyi lor bod yul bsam yas mchims phu'i dge'u gong nas gdan drangs shing lcags phag lor mdo khams dpal gyi lung pa mi dbang nang chen khri dmar gdung gi gdan sa ur 'gos su shog ser nas zhal bshus so// // ja) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: o rgyan sman lha dbyer med sgrub pa 'chi med bcud dril bzhugs so: bde gshegs kun 'dus bla ma'i thugs sgrub las: 'byung 'dus sgyu ma'i g.yar khang bsdus bya la: 'dus byas smig rgyu'i rnam rtog 'thibs pa bzhin: rab rib ngang la thim rim phung po rdzogs: 'ga' zhig mi 'dod khur gyi duḥkha myong : la la rnam smin 'khor tshe rkyen dbang che: spyir ni dbyar mjug ston kha'i me tog bzhin: skye 'chi mi rtag rlung nang mar me 'dra: phra rags rnam rtog rlung gi rtar bskyon te: rags pa 'chi ltas phog ste rang gis mthong : phra ba tshe 'phrang yin pas sgrol thabs 'bungs: nges par sgyu lus 'jig pa'i nad byung nas:

mi bzod sdug bsngal nad kyis gzir ba na: yid gnyis the tshom med par gsol ba thob: nga nyid sman gyi lha dang dbyer med pas: tshe zad yin kyang nges par re zhig bshol: bar chad phra mo tsam la lta ci smos: de bas gu ru nga la gsol ba thob: rtsa rlung 'byung ba rkyen gyis 'khrugs pa ni: nga nyid dbyer med mtsho rgyal zab lam sbyong : tshe rabs las sgrib gcong nad grum po la: nga nyid zhi ba sman lha ji bzhin sgrubs: bar chad bdud kyis 'phral du sdang srid na: nga nyid bdud dang mu stegs 'dul byed pa: zil gnon seṅge sgra sgrogs sku ru sgrubs: khyad par ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga bdo la: sngon las bas kyang 'phral rkyen shin tu hrag: dam sri bdud dang 'gong po kha dar bas: chos byed pa dang chos rgyal gdung dag la: 'dre rgod 'byung pos glags blta shin tu mang : khyad par dge ba sgrub la bdud mi dad: mu stegs rnams kyis sangs rgyas mi shes shing : dam chos sgrub pos bdud la blo mi 'gro: sangs rgyas rnams kyis mu stegs las mi spyod: des na snyigs ma lnga bdo'i sems can rnams: dge sdig gnyis kyi blo sna mi mthun nas: rkyen ngan phal cher de yi rgyu las byung : dus ngan tha ma'i sems can ngan dbang che: dper na ma dag mi dge pa la mos: mi gtsang ba la sbrang bu 'khor ba bzhin: dbyar 'bu gtibs bzhin sems can a tsa ma: dge phyogs chos sgrub nyin mo'i skar ma tsam: dus bzang skabs su 'phags pa ma gtogs pa: ci bder 'char ba'i nges pa mi rig pas: rang tshod zin na nyi zlar 'gran ma btsal: sngar byas da res smin cing phyi ma'i las: blo yis zhib dpyad 'phral du 'dun ma sgrubs: chos rgyal ma rig blo la a 'thas na: 'tshang can rkun ma thang dkyil nam langs 'dra: rje 'bangs khyed rnams 'di phyi'i gtan chos sgrubs: sems can nyon mongs nad kyis zin pa na: dug lnga lam 'khyer sman gyi gdams ngag dgos: khyad par khro mo rdo rje tsaṇ+ḍa lī:

phyi yi gtum mo me 'dra 'bar ba'i shugs: bskyed rim khro nyams bdud kyi rgol ba 'joms: nang gi gtum mo sman 'dra'i nus pa bskyed: 'byung bzhi'i nad rnams tsha grang snyoms pas 'dul: gsang ba'i gtum mo dpa' bo seng sgrogs dang : ye shes rlung gis nyon mongs zil gyis gnon: seṅge'i sgra skad wa spyang 'gran zla bral: des na sangs rgyas seṅge'i nga ro yis: bar chad mu stegs wa spyang klad pa 'gems: de bzhin rgya gar maṅga dha yi gnas: bdud 'joms seṅge sgra sgrogs zhes grags pas: bdag la gsol ba gang btab bdud las rgyal: phyi yi sman mchog nus ldan bzang drug gtso: nang gi sman mchog tshogs drug lhug par gtso: gsang ba'i sman mchog sgo drug rlung la sbyang : gso ba'i sman mchog rdzas dang lag len sbyor: bskyed rim sman mchog lha sku'i stong ra sgoms: rdzogs rim sman mchog rang rig gtan la phob: 'di nyid rtogs pas nga nyid sman lha dngos: rten 'brel man ngag sman rnams so sor gsal: sa ma ya: de yang o rgyan sman gyi lha dang dbyer med sgrub thabs ni: sman lha la brten nas tshe sgrub dang sman sgrub: seng sgrogs la brten nas bar chad zhi ba: yum la brten nas rlung las sgrub pa ste: sgrub thabs gcig la rtsa gsum dril sgrub bya ba ni: thog mar bkra shis shing dge ba'i nyi ma 'char snga 'grib phyi ba la shar phyogs rgya yangs pa sman rgyud kyi mdzod kha phye ba lta bu: lho phyogs a ru ra rnam rgyal gyi sgrom bu 'dra ba: nub phyogs spyad pa las rtsis kyi gab rtse bkod pa 'dra ba: byang phyogs glang chen yang rgyu ba'i mgyogs lam byang ba 'dra ba: mtshams thams cad sman gzhong dang sman khyem gyi nang du nus pa 'khyil ba 'dra ba: gza' skar shar lugs kyang sman khyem gyi skar ma 'dra ba'i ri yod sa na mdun gtad: de yang sa dpyad nad pa 'dra ba'i ri la sgrub pa mi bya: sman pa 'dra ba 'grub pa dka':

sman khyem dang sman phor 'dra na 'grub thag nye: rgyab ri khro bo 'dra na tshe 'phrang sgrol: sman lha 'dra na sman gyi nus pa thengs: sman gyi lha mo 'dra na rtsa rlung tshe dpal bskyed: spyir ni nor bu 'brang rgyas 'dra ba dang : lhung bzed 'bras sam a ru ras bkang ba 'dra bar sman sgrub bya: bhan+dha 'dra ba yang bzang : 'og tu chu mig yod pa zhabs rdol yin pas spang : spyir sa kha shor ba dang mtha' zad pa rnams su sgrub pa bya mi lo bar shes par bya'o: sman ljongs skyed tshal klu yi gdengs ka rnams: tshe dang bsod nams dpal bskyed gnas yin no: de ltar rten 'brel ldan pa'i sa dag la: bkra shis dge ba'i nyin la dal brtsams te: mtshan ldan rig mas bde chen thig sna 'dzin: tshangs skud yo 'khyog med par cha mnyam btab: thams cad grub nas bhan+dha mtshan ldan du: bgegs bskrad gu gul bdug nas sa bon bkod: rin po che'i mañdzi dang bcas tshags: sman ni dzā ti a ru ra li shi gur gum ga pur ka ko la: sug sme tsan+dan dkar dmar gi waṃ cu gang dang : li shi rgya mtshal ka ra sbrang bu ram: lan tshwa pho ba ris sngo tsha ba gsum: gzhi ni a ru bzhi brgya nyer bzhi bzhag: de 'og skyu ru ra dang ba ru bcas: de yang slad du nus pa bstan pa'i phyir: khrom bu tsam du bya: nus pa mi nyams par gur gum dang tsan+dan rnams phon gang che: ras sam shog bu'i nang du btums pa bzhag: zhib par sgrub na dbang lag khu bas sbos: a rag btab bam phabs kyis non par bya: tshad kyang zan sbrus gar sla tsam du bya: stegs bur ye shes lnga yi dkar me sbar: sman sgrub nus pa 'byin tshe sgrub pa grol: gzhan yang rgyan bkod bhan+dha'i bca' gzhi ni: sman sgrub rgyud sde gong 'og rnams dang mtshungs: sman gyi rnam grangs ji snyed mang na yang : nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i gnyen po mchog: gsang sman gzhung sman phyogs gcig bsgrigs pa'o: 'di nas ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga bdo la:

nag po sum bsgril phyogs gcig tshang ba 'byung : ru rta bong nga sman chen rnam pa gsum: shu dag spru nag thar nu ma gi ta: dngul chu shing kun shrī khan+ḍa bcas: 'di rnams sman skabs dag dang sbyar nas btang : khyad par 'go ba'i nad rigs la sogs la: thams cad zhib btags phyogs gcig ril bu bsgril: sngags kyi nus pa bstims pas mgo nad thub: khyad par dus ma yin pa'i bar chad la: sman dang sngags rnams lus la 'chang ba yis: tshe 'phrang bdud kyi g.yul las rab tu rgyal: de bas dkyil 'khor 'di la 'bad par gyis: mchod pa spyi mthun thams cad tshang ba'i rjes: stong gsal mi dmigs dran rdzogs 'di ltar sgoms:

sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: dang po ni: na mo: sku lnga mtshan brgyad o rgyan rin po che: bdag sogs tshe la bar chad sdang lags na: 'gro mgon sman lha'i dkyil 'khor dal bzung nas: 'gro kun nyon mongs nad las grol bar mdzod: 'gro don smin grol chos 'khor bskor du gsol: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: om̐ āḥhūm̐: om̐ bh+rūm̐ hūm̐: om̐ hūm̐ trām̐: om̐ hrīḥ.āḥ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ hoḥ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ nyid zhu ba las: bhan+dha yangs pa rin chen gzhal yas khang : gru chad zlum skor phrin las rnam bzhi ldan: de dbus rdo rje rgya gram lte bar hūm̐: dran rdzogs gnas 'gyur seṅge sgra sgrogs sku: mthing nag khro tshul spyi bor seng zhal gdangs: seng ldeng gaṇ+ḍi sgrogs pas stong gsum g.yo: 'bar ba'i dbu skra thod skam phreng bas brgyan: sku la seṅge'i g.yang gzhi lhab tu gsol: rin po che dang rus pa'i phreng bas brgyan: phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas dril bu bsnams: brkyang bskum gar ldan zung 'jug yum la 'khril: lha mchog de la 'khril ba'i rnal 'byor ma: rdo rje phag mo gri thod mgul nas 'khyud: rus pa'i rgyan ldan zung 'jug yab la 'khril: yab yum ye shes rab 'bar klong du gsal: de yi spyi bor gu ru dug lnga sel: sman lha mthing ga zhi 'dzum thor tshugs can: phyag g.yas rnam par rgyal ba'i a ru ra: 'gro la sman sbyin phyag rgya mchog sbyin can: phyag g.yon 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bum pa thogs: mnyam bzhag dgongs pas tshe yi bar chad sel: zhabs gnyis phyed skyil bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'bebs bsgom: bhan+dha'i phyogs bzhir 'gugs pa'i lha mo bzhi: rang rtags phyag rgyas 'byung lnga'i bcud bsdus nas: yab yum sku la gnyis med thim par bsgom: slar yang rang gi thugs kar hūm̐ gsal ba'i: 'od dang mdun bskyed dam tshig sa bon gyis: ye shes lha tshogs skad cig spyan drangs gyur: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: yul gyi ming ni ma ga dha yi yul: mu stegs 'dul mdzad gnam lcags zor mda' 'phen: bdud dang 'byung po bgegs srin tshar gcod pa: rje btsun drag po gtum chen gshegs su gsol: drag mo rnal 'byor phag gdong gshegs su gsol: rigs bdag sman lha 'tsho mdzad gshegs su gsol: deng 'dir gso ba sman gyi dkyil 'khor du: dam ye dbyer med brtan par bzhugs nas su: byin chen phob la dbang chen bskur du gsol: om̐ badz+ra bhai ṣa dz+yai rā dza ya ā yur ṣe badz+ra sengha gan+ḍa bai ro tsa na bha ra hi dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya satwaṃ: badz+ra rā ga ya hoḥ rā ga ya mi: a we sha ya badz+ra a mṛ ta tsaṇ+ḍa mu tra ak+ṣo bhai swā hā: zhes spyan drangs shing dam tshig ye shes dbyer med du gyur: sgo ma rnams kyi phyag rgyas bskul bas yab yum gyis sbyor ba mdzad: sbyor mtshams nas sman gyi lha mo 'tsho byed gzhon nu ma grangs med byon: sman gyi lha mo'i bha ga nas 'chi med bdud rtsi bcud dril gyi bde ba babs pas sman gyi nus pa cher 'bar: de yi tshe nus pa'i zer 'og rlung ri rgya gram la phog: rlung g.yos ye shes kyi me 'bar sman gyi ngo bo bdud rtsir gyur te khol: bdud rtsi'i rlangs pa las byung ba'i sman gyi lha mo rnams kyis mchod sprin sna tshogs dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo la phul bas mnyes shing tshim: byin rlabs yig 'bru tshur 'phros sman gyi dal dang lha yi ngo bo dbyer med du gyur: lhar dri bzang zhing bcud g.yo ba phyogs bcur 'phros: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs rje byin rlabs tshur 'dus 'chi med sman lha'i dkyil 'khor la thim: 'chi ba med pa rig 'dzin tshe yi bcud du gyur: slar 'phros snang srid 'byung ba lnga yi bcud skye 'gro srid pa dang srid par mi gnas pa rnams kyi bcud dang :

dwangs ma bsdus te bdag dang sman lha'i dkyil 'khor la thim: tshe nyi zla dang mnyam: rtsal seṅge dang mnyam: mdangs rma bya dang mnyam: nus pa khyung dang mnyam: shed gyad dang mnyam: snyan grags 'brug dang mnyam: dpal stobs mchong rtsal stag dang mnyam: bden pa nus pas 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par bskyed: rtsa sngags ni: om̐ gu ru bhai ṣa dz+ye ya ma hā bhai ṣa dz+ye ya rā dza ya ta thā ga ta ya ar+ha te saṃ myak+saṃ bud+dha ya: tad+ya thā: bhai ṣa dz+ye ya ma hā rā dza ya swā hā: las sngags: auṇ+ya ya sengha gan+ḍa badz+ra na hi ā yur+dz+nyā na sarba pañtsa hrīḥṭha dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sham bur: om̐ badz+ra gu ru bir+ya pā ṇi sarba a dhiṣ+ṭha na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ swā hā: 'di nyid so sor ci nus bzlas: skabs su mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: 'chi med dbang po sman gyi dkyil 'khor lha: 'ja' lus sgrub mchog tshe yi rig 'dzin la: phyi nang gsang ba'i bla med mchod pas mchod: dgyes par bzhes nas 'chi med rig 'dzin stsol: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta pū dza āḥhūm̐: bstod pa ni: hūm̐: 'chi med ngo bo pad 'byung sman gyi lha: tshe bdud tshar gcod drag po seṅge'i sgra: rtsa rlung dpal bskyed rdo rje rnal 'byor yum: snod kyi bcud 'gugs pho nya mgyogs ma bzhi: dus min 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa 'joms mdzad lha: dug gsum nad sel dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: sgo gsum dwang ba'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal bstod: rlung mkhris bad kan khrag dang 'dus pa yi: nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zhi ba dang : bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: om̐ gu ru bhai ṣa dz+ye ā yur+dz+nyā na ma hā ghan+ḍa badz+ra bha ra hi dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ de nas sgrub pa grol skabs sman gyi zhal kha phye zhing tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen bde gshegs kun 'dus ltar bskor:

khyad par sgrub pa'i ring la rgyun chags kyis tshogs bskang bya: de nas dngos grub zhu ba ni: hūm̐: bcom ldan mgon po 'chi med lha yi bla: lha yi bla ma pad 'byung sman gyi bla: bdud bzhi tshar gcod drag po seṅge'i sgra: bde chen dbang mo zag med ye shes rgyas: rigs bzhi sgo mas dga' bzhi thabs kyis bskul: zag med sku la ye shes rgyas pa'i thugs: gu ru yid bzhin nor bur gsol ba 'debs: mi mthun tshe yi bar chad zhi ba dang : dug gsum nad sel 'chi med sman mchog gis: dbang bskur byin rlabs deng 'dir stsal du gsol: khyad par rlung mkhris bad kan 'du ba bzhi: snyoms shing 'byung bzhi'i rgud pa bsal du gsol: om̐ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta ghu ya gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes dbang bzhi blang ngo : sman sgrub kyi dngos grub zhu: bkra shis ni: hrīḥ baiḍūr+ya'i mdangs ldan 'chi med lha: dug gsum nad sel pad 'byung sman pa'i mchog: rnam rgyal phyag mtshan skye 'gro'i tsha gdung sel: o rgyan sman lha'i dkyil 'khor bkra shis shog: ces pas me tog 'thor: sman mchog bsgrubs pa'i yul gru bkra shis shing : nad mug 'khrug rtsod 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi: dus min 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa mi 'byung zhing : bkra shis yar zla'i ngo bzhin 'phel bar 'gyur: skal ldan las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: them rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtsho yis sa khyi lor bsam yas mchims phu'i dge'u gong nas gdan drangs shing*/ lcags phag lor mdo khams srin mo'i me btsa' zangs btsan rdo rje 'bar ba'i nye char dge bsnyen rin chen 'od 'bar dang rdzong sman nā ga dhe wi dhā ra'i gnas mchog nang chen mang bkur ba'i rgyal rabs khri dmar sgar chen ur 'gos su mkha' 'gro pañtsa'i yi ge 'dug pa las bod yig tu bsgyur ba'o// // nya)

bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: o rgyan rdo rje gur gyi sgrub thabs 'jigs med gnam lcags ri bo bzhugs so: bde gshegs kun 'dus bla ma'i thugs sgrub las: byin rlabs nus pa rgyun 'bebs ti la kaḥ 'di la rnam pa gsum gyis ston pa ni: bla ma sku bzhi sku lnga rdo rje'i sku: rdo rje'i sku la gzhom zhig mi mnga' phyir: pad 'byung nga ni rdo rje'i gur dang ldan: rdo rje'i gur la mtshan nyid gang ldan na: sra ba brtan pa mi chod mi shigs pa: mi 'jigs mi g.yo mi 'gyur mi 'gul ba: gur dang bla re drwa ba rwa ba dang : rgya gram bzhi la ur mo 'bub pa'i rdzong : rtsibs dang drwa mig tog dang srung 'khor bcas: bco brgyad po 'di nga nyid rdo rje'i gur: sgom sgrub nyams len po rnams rdzong chen thob: ma 'ongs sems can nga rgyal spyod pa yis: zhe sdang phrag dog dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar: de yi rkyen gyis mtha' 'khrugs bod khams rtsod: chos rgyal gdan khri bdud blon dmangs kyis 'bebs: de yi rkyen gyi pha mtshun dgra lha 'khrugs: skyes lha yul lha yid 'gyur dgra la phyogs: mtha' bzhi ral nas dbus su mi gad rdib: dbus pa'i pha tshan lcang kha'i byis chung 'dra: glo ba'i grogs pos snying gi khrag rtsa gcod: mchin pa'i bran 'khor mkhris pa'i nang tshan rul: pha tsho nye 'khor seṅge'i khog dang mtshungs: phung shig 'gong po'i sprul pas yul gru dkrugs: dam nyams dge bshes dmag las sna thag 'dren: 'dzam gling bde skyid sde dgon ban+des dkrugs: pha sde bzang po phung shig nag mos byed: yul gru'i dam rgya gnyan pa rkun mas gtor: gos su mi sdug lcags kyi slog pa gyon: zas su dug dang nye ba'i lci ba za: rgyan du rang srog phung ba'i mtshon cha thogs: grogs su dam nyams sdig to mkhan la dga': dgos dus rang srog mi kheb btsan rdzong bzo: sems can nyam chung thams cad sdug la gtad:

ma byin ka cha 'phrog nas chos brgyad bzhengs: smon lam log par 'brel ba'i dmag dpon bstod: phyag dang zhe sa sdig spyod rgyal por 'bul: gsang sngags gnyan gyi dkyil 'khor khyad du gsod: bsod nams zad pas rang nor gzhan gyis spyod: ri klung med pa dgra dang chom pos gang : gom gsum 'gro yang skyel ma dgos pa'i dus: phyug po rnams kyi srog rtsa nor gyis gcod: med po rnams kyi lto rin srog gis 'jal: yod med gnyis po sdug gis bslu ba'i dus: ma nyes cog ger 'dug kyang khrims la bcug: sems can thams cad mtshon cha'i rwa bar btsud: phal cher thams cad mda' mdung gri khar 'chi: smon lam log pa sdug 'dre'i yul du skye: de tshe sems can bde skyid zad pa ste: lto med gos dbul bse rag grong khyer 'dra: phyug po phal cher yi dwags gter srung bzhin: sbrang bus bsags pa'i sbrang rtsi gzhan spyod bzhin: bdag bsags gzhan gyis spyod par mi mthong ngam: skyes pa'i pha yul 'brog pa'i bskyas shul 'dra: gtan gyi mkhar rdzong bzo ba blo re 'khrul: phyi ches sgrub pa'i gnyen 'dun phal mo che: dri za'i rnam shes bar do 'phrad dang mtshungs: phyi ma mi sgrub da lta'i gtan don gnyer: brag la skas btsug kha la thal 'debs 'dra: snga bsags rdzogs 'jug da lta'i 'dod yon rnams: 'bab chu chad pa'i rdzing chu skam pa 'dra: kha dkar gting nag g.yo sgyu'i chos byed de: gso sman dug par nang du 'chang dang mtshungs: g.yang khar rdog pa 'chal ba'i gsol 'debs dang : rab khar skyabs 'gro byed pa'i 'bras bu dang : dgra dod mkhar rdzong 'dod pa'i bsam pa dang : shi 'tsher bla mar 'phral du dad pa bzhin: shing rul bye mar btsugs pa'i lo 'dab 'dra: de bas byang chub snying po sgrub 'dod na: sngon sbyangs snga bsags da lta'i 'phro mtha' mthud: phyi ma'i las kyang da lta'i 'bras bu yin: lha sras rje 'bangs thugs la de ltar bcag:

gnas skabs 'di yang nga nyid dran par gyis: da lta dus dang bskal pa yar ldan yang : ma 'ongs bdud sprul sa steng g.yo ba 'byung : de dus kho bo dus drug dran par gyis: gang zhig las dang rkyen dbang drag po yis: srog gcod shan pa'i dmag gis mtha' bskor nas: mtshon cha rnon pos 'debs shing nyen pa na: yid gnyis the tshom med par gsol ba thob: nga nyid rdo rje'i gur dang ldan pa yin: gshed ma bred cing mtshon cha 'thor bar 'gyur: legs par gdams so lha sras bod kyi rje: dam tshig rnam gsum snying gi khrag ltar srungs: sa ma ya: de yang gu ru rdo rje'i gur ltar sgrub pa la: spros bcas dang spros med do: spros bcas ltar na rin chen sna lnga phyogs gcig tu bsgril ba la: phyi zlum po gur gyi rnam pa rmog gi dbyibs can la rdo rje'i rgya gram gdugs kyi rtsibs ma bshibs pa ltar drwa mig nas rdo rje gnon po'i rtse mo lte ba phan chod phyogs su bstan pa rdo rje rwa gdeng ba'i tog bcas yod pa: de'i dbus kyi lte ba srog shing gi rnam pa de la rdo rje gnam lcags 'khor lo rgya che ba gdugs ltar phub pa: de'i rtsibs kyi bar rnams su gnam lcags kyi phur pa rdo rje'i yu ba can bsnol thabs su byas pa: nang gi chos 'byung gi rtsibs la hūm̐ gi yi ges mtshan pa: srog shing rdo rje rgya gram sum tshom gyi rnam pa de'i nang du gsang bdag rdo rje gu ru'i sku yod pa: sa gzhi rgya gram khor yug can rdo rje'i rwa dbus ma phur bus mtshan pa 'og tu rdo rje phyed pa dbal ldan de la mtshon cha'i 'khor lo bar du dgra bo'i liṅga 'og na spu gri'i 'khor lo yod pa bar thams cad rdo rje rtsang ltar nang du gzengs te rdo rje'i gur sgom pa'i bzo dbyibs kyi dpe'o: phyogs kyi rwa yi rtse ru rdo rje rin po che langs pa rdo rje khro bo bzhi yis mtshan pa'i lte ba ru khro bo re re ste zhal kha phyi la gyu ba'o:

gtum po gnod sbyin bzhi yang zer: de'i bar rdo rje'i drwa ba dang rwa bas yongs su bskor ba: phyi rol ye shes kyi me mched pa'i rang bzhin can no: spros bcas yod na rdo rje'i gur steng du bshams: sa gzhi 'og tu bshams: sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor rdo rje rgya gram phyi rol du rdo rje'i gur dang rwa ba me ri bcas bris pa'i lte bar mañdzu'i kha ru phyag na rdo rje'i sku bzhag: phyogs bzhir rdo rje bzhi bzhag: gnas khang kyi steng du rdo rje lnga bzhag: khang pa yin na'ang bri bar yang bshad: logs bzhir mda' dar bzhi: phur pa bzhi: me long bzhi: ral gri bzhi: lcags kyi mda' gzhu bzhi: sāts+tsha bzhiḥ zor bzhir thun rdzas bzhi bcas bkram: nang gi rdo rje'i rtse mo bzhi sgrub gtor bum pa bhan+dha me long dkyil 'khor cod pan gyis mtshan pa bcas bkram: gzhan yang thugs sgrub kyi mchod pa cha tshang mtha' nas bshams: ci tsam bsgrubs kyang thugs sgrub tshar re dgos: bka' srung yang dgos: de ltar go rim bskyed pa'i dkyil 'khor cha ru 'gro ba'i lag len no: spros med rdo rje'i gur khang nang du rdo rje'i lte bar phyag rdor rang bskyed pa gur thabs ci bzhin: spros bcas spros med gang zag blo la dpag sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: dang po mchod pa byin rlabs spyi mthun ltar ro:

na mo: rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin la: rdo rje skye 'chi 'jigs dang bral: rdo rje bgres rgud gzhom gzhig med: bla ma o rgyan rdo rje'i sku: rdo rje 'dzin la skyabs su mchi: gnyis pa: oṃ hūm̐ badz+ra tsit+ta hūm̐: hūm̐: rdo rje bh+rūm̐ nyid yongs su gyur pa las: rlung ri mi shigs srid pa rdo rje ni: rgya gram bsnol ba mi 'gul sra brtan gsal: de steng 'bar ba spu gri'i 'khor lo ni: gyen du kha phyogs bar du dgra bgegs gsal: steng na chu gri'i 'khor lo mthur du sbub: lte ba'i dbal so dgra bgegs snying khar bsnun: de steng sa gzhi rdo rje rgya gram brdal: de dbus rdo rje sum tshom gzhal yas khang : lte ba'i dbus su pad 'byung gnas gyur pa'i: gsang bdag mthing nag rdo rje gtum po'i sku: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril spyan rtsa glog ltar 'khyugs: dbu skra sma ra dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar: thod skam dbu rgyan spyi bor khyung chen lding : sku la mi shigs rdo rje'i go khrab gsol: dur khrod chas rdzogs bdud dpung zil gyis gnon: phyag g.yas gnam lcags rdo rje'i rgya gram thogs: g.yon pas sdigs mdzub rtse nas thog rgod 'bebs: brkyang bskum zhabs kyis srid gsum zil gyis gnon: thugs kar gser gyi rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐: ting 'dzin sems dpa' nā da'i nang du gsal: drag sngags tshwa tshwa dang bcas g.yas su 'khor: phyi nang ba spu'i bu gar khro chung gtams: rtsibs la rang 'dra'i khro tshogs skar ltar 'khrugs: rang srung sngags rnams bung ba'i dbyangs ltar sgrog: rab 'jigs me dpung mched pa'i klong du gsal: shar phyogs rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ dkar las: gtum po rnam par rgyal ba sku mdog dkar: phyag g.yas ral gri g.yon pas lcags kyu thogs: lho phyogs rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ ser las: gtum po mi g.yo mgon po sku mdog ser: phyag g.yas be con g.yon pas bhan+dha thogs:

nub phyogs rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ dmar las: gtum po dbang phyug stobs chen sku mdog dmar: phyag g.yas lcags kyu g.yon pas zhags dmar thogs: byang phyogs rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ sngon las: gtum po dbyug pa thogs pa sku mdog sngo: phyag g.yas rdor dbyug g.yon pas dril bu thogs: thams cad gtso bo'i cha lugs rngam tshul can: mtshon cha'i 'khor lo thogs pa grangs med 'phros: thugs kar srog yig tha mar sngags kyis bskor: dam tshig sems dpa' rang mdog dang bcas gsal: ba spu'i bu gar rang 'dra'i khro bo ni: mtshon cha'i 'khor lo thogs pa grangs med 'phros: pha rol byad ma'i g.yul ngo rdul du brlag: phyi rol mtshon cha'i dbal kha dgra la 'debs: nang du rdo rje'i gur khang me dpung 'khrigs: cis kyang mi shigs sra mkhregs rdo rje'i gur: bskal pa'i me ri 'tshubs pa'i klong du gsal: de ltar pho brang lha bcas bskyed pa yis: bdag mdun thugs rje'i 'od kyis 'phro 'du yis: pad 'byung dregs pa 'dul mdzad spyan drangs gyur: hūm̐: sku gsum rdo rje gsum gyi dkyil 'khor lha: gsang bdag g.yul las rgyal byed khro bo'i 'khor: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la thugs rje'i nus pas skyobs: bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥ gsum pa: hūm̐: mi shigs sra brtan pho brang rdo rje'i gur: mi 'gyur gnam lcags ur mo'i gzer gyis bsdams: rdo rje bsnol thabs lte dbus gdan gyi steng : gtum chen rdo rje'i go cha bzhugs su gsol: bdag gis gsol 'debs mos pas gus phyag bgyid: 'gro mgon bdud bzhi bcom pa'i gar thabs can: lhag pa'i lha mchog snang srid 'dul la bstod: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ mchod pa ni: hūm̐: sku la dgyes pa rdo rje'i go khrab 'bul: gsung la dgyes pa rdo rje'i glu dbyangs 'bul:

thugs la dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i rdzong chen 'bul: yon tan dgyes pa rdo rje'i pho nya 'bul: phrin las dgyes pa rdo rje'i mtshon cha 'bul: drug cu rtsa bzhi'i drwa mig skyong ba'i phyir: phyi mchod nang mchod gsang mchod lha mo 'bul: khyad par gdug pa'i g.yul ngo gzhom pa'i phyir: dgra sha khrag mchod 'bar bas thugs dam bskang : gsang bdag rdo rje'i go khrab thugs dam bskang : shar phyogs khro bo rnam rgyal thugs dam bskang : lho phyogs khro bo mi g.yo'i thugs dam bskang : nub phyogs khro bo stobs chen thugs dam bskang : byang phyogs khro bo dbyug sngon thugs dam bskang : drwa mig skyong mdzad rdo rje'i pho nya mo: drug cu rtsa bzhi'i 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : gnam lcags gdugs kyi rtsibs la 'gyu ba yi: gdugs dkar lha mo nyer gcig thugs dam bskang : 'khor lo mtshon cha'i rtse la 'gyu ba yi: gzhan gyis mi thub khro mo gdugs dkar mo: ma mo g.yul bzlog ma yi thugs dam bskang : gyad bzhir gnyis 'phros brgyad dang steng 'og bcu: gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i thugs dam bskang : dbal la 'phro ba gnod mdzes bgegs mthar byed: gtum po las byed sprul pa'i thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs nas mi shigs rdo rje yi: mkha' dang srid pa rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra lo ha par+she badz+ra shang ha badz+ra ko ṭi badz+ra dha ra bha la badz+ra ā yur dha badz+ra ma tri ma tri ya tri ya me gha pū dza hoḥ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: bstod pa ni: hūm̐: gnam lcags 'khor lo'i dbus 'gyings gar gyi dbang : gsang bdag tshul 'dzin ma rungs 'joms mdzad pa: gtum chen khro bo gdug pa'i g.yul las rgyal: dpal chen sde bzhir gling bzhis 'gran zla bral: 'bar ma pho nya ma mo srid pa'i 'khor: ye shes ngang las las kyi cho 'phrul du: 'khor 'das gnyis med dbang bsgyur rdo rje'i sku:

'gyur med 'gags med 'khrul med mnyam pa nyid: ngo bo ye shes rang bzhin lhun gyis grub: pad 'byung gtum po'i skur bzhengs bdud 'joms pa: khro bo 'khor dang las kyi pho nya mo: rdo rje gur gyi lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: rdo rje rtsa ba'i sngags ni: oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐: rdo rje thugs kyi sngags ni: hūm̐ badz+ra phaṭḥ rdo rje rol pa'i snying po ni: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa na hūm̐ phaṭaḥ rdo rje 'gyed pa'i snying po ni: oṃ badz+ra ghar+bha tsaṇ+ḍa khroṃ raṃ ga ru ṭa phe laṃ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ rdo rje gur gyi snying po: oṃ badz+ra ṇi bh+rūm̐ tsakra rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐: rdo rje mtshon thogs kyi sngags ni: oṃ badz+ra tik+ṇa dz+wa la raṃ ts+tshi ka tshan+dha pre sha duṣatsa ṭi te a mu ka ma ra ṇa na kharga badz+ra kī la ya ru tra sha truṃ tshin+dha tshin+dha bhan+dha bhan+dha ha na ha na da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa ma tha ma tha dhu na dhu na krak+ko sha ya rbad hu ra hu ra nan nan tsit+ta sha ma sha ni mā ra mā ra rbad rbad bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: ces gong 'og gi sngags rnams sgrub rdzas so so la bzlas shing 'chang : dus dang rnam pa kun tu mkho ba'i rigs dang 'phral du mkho ba rnams dgos rigs dang bstun: rdo rje rtse lnga la thugs rdo rje'i sngags bgyis pa gur dang khang pa la rdzas gu gul sbyar nas 'chang nas srung ba'i mchog go: rdo rje rtsa ba'i sngags rdo rje bzhi bsgrubs te thog lcags zung du phyogs bzhir bzhag pas lha 'dre 'bum thub bo: rdo rje rol pa'i sngags phur pa bzhi la bzla zhing dug shing gsum dang lhan cig ser lam du bzhag pas ser ba thub bo: rdo rje 'gyed pa'i snying po mda' gzhu la bzlas nas zangs lcags kyi phye ma glang chen smyon pa lhan cig rdzong gi sgo la bzhag pas snang srid kyi byad kha zor kha gang gis kyang mi tshugs so: ral gri la sngags nas rma bya'i mdangs gri lcags phye ma gri snying dang zung du dgra yul la kha bstan pas dgra la klu bdud kyi gtad khram phog par 'gyur ro:

mda' dar sngags nas rin chen sna lnga dug khrag thang phrom dang zung du khang pa'i thog tu bzhag pas klu dang sa bdag gi byad gtad las grol lo: rdo rje gur gyi snying po me long la sngags nas sin+dhu ra dang rdo rje pha lam khrab byang mig dgu gnas chen dgu yi sa rnams bcas khyim du 'chang bas gzugs can gzugs med gang gis mi tshugs pa'i srung ba'i mchog go: sāts+tsha la sngags te bla ma dgu'i dam rdzas dkyil 'khor dgu'i rdul mtshon ri chen dgu'i rtse nas blangs pa'i rdo bcas sgrub khang gi phyogs bzhir bzhag pas sgrub la bar chad mi 'byung ngo : rdo rje mtshon thogs kyi sngags zor la bzlas: khyad par phung shul dgu nas blangs pa'i sa rdo lung pa dgu mdo nas lam sa ri sna dgu'i rdo nag dang gzhung gi thun rdzas bcas dgra bo'i phyogs su yang yang 'phangs pas dgra bo rtsad nas brlag pa 'byung zhing dgra bo phung ste mtshon cha dang sgyogs rkang 'thor bar 'gyur ro: khyad par lam du zhugs skabs tho rangs dgong mo lam phyogs la gtor bas dgra mi 'byung ngo : khyad par mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi mde'u la sngags pas gang la btab kyang bzlog med 'byung bar 'gyur ro: yang phur pa dang thong so la sngags nas sa rko rdo bshig gi las gang byas rung phog thug med kyang sa sri 'dul bar 'gyur ro: yang sman nag po dgu sbyor dang zung du skyer pa'i shing la phur pa bzhogs te sngags bris pas chu rgyud sa rgyud gangs rgyud sogs la bzhag pas chu bzlog par 'gyur ro: yang rdo rje gur gyi dpe'u ris bris la lha bkod bgyis pa sngags bcas pa yul gru la bzhugs pa'i yul de ru pha rol gyi dmag mi 'byung ngo : gal srid chas kyang zor thun gyis bzlog par 'gyur ro: de bas 'di nyid gud du sbas te gar thod sa ru bkram par mi bya'o: sa ma ya: de nas rdo rje gur gyi sgrub pa thon nas dngos grub zhu ba ni: rdo rje'i gur khang dbang rdzas rim pa bzhin tshar re zhu'o:

hūm̐: mtsho skyes rdo rje mi shigs gnam lcags gur: pad+ma 'byung gnas skye 'chi bgres rgud bral: thugs mchog gsang bdag pha rol g.yul las rgyal: khro bzhi gnas nyul phyi nang bar chad srungs: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam dus la bab: 'gyur med rdo rje sku yi dngos grub stsol: 'gags med rdo rje gsung gi dngos grub stsol: 'khrul med rdo rje thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: yon tan rdo rje drag sngags dngos grub stsol: rdo rje phrin las bdud dpung 'joms par stsol: gu ru gsang bdag gtum por gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru tsit+ta badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭaḥ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta badz+ra sa ma ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes dbang blangs: sgrub rten rnams yig chung ltar bgyid: rjes shes rdo rje gsum la mnyam par bzhag: las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: bka' yi rgya 'di gnod sbyin gsum gyis srungs: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: mi nub rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos sa pho khyi'i lor bod yul rdo rje gnas mchog bsam yas mi 'gyur chos kyi pho brang chen po'i yang dben dam pa'i rgya mkhar rtse dgu'i gong had po ri dung seng gnam mchong 'dra ba'i rgyab ri la nye ba mchims phu'i dge'u gong gi ke'u tshang nas gdan drangs shing slar lcags mo phag gi lo la bar khams su rak+ṣa ru ni ko ṭa'i nye 'dabs gter bdag klu rgyal gtsug na nor bu 'bar ba'i la thod dkar po'i pho brang dang zung du 'brel pa nang chen bar khams kyi rgyal po tshangs sme can gyi gdan sa ru thi'u ji rin po che dang chos blon a shag dkon mchog tshe 'phel bcas dpon g.yog dgu mdzad nas rten 'brel dang bkra shis pa'i maṇ+ḍal du ma phul nas bsam pa lhun grub ma'i sgrub skor shog dril gtan la 'bebs pa'i smon lam gyi bskul ma bcas spre'u zla ba'i yar tshes dge bar mkha' 'gro brda'i ri mo nyi shu rtsa gcig ma nas bod yig sum cu'i ka sder bsgyur te gtan la phab pa'o//

// ta) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: dregs pa zil gnon gyi dmod pa'i spu gri bdud dpung mthar byed bzhugs so: bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: bar gcod bdud bcom g.yul las rab tu rgyal: dregs pa zil gnon las gzhi'i phyag mtshan 'chang : ma rungs bdud sde'i tshogs rnams mthar byed pa: snang srid dbang bsgyur che mchog 'dus pa'i gtso: dpal chen phyag rgya zil gnon he ru kaḥ snang srid dbang bsgyur gtso la gus pas 'dud: sa ma ya: ma 'ongs yang mtha' dus kyi snyigs ma ru: dam sri bdud kyi sprul pa rlung ltar 'tshub: mtha' bzhi'i so kha dbus su rim par 'jug: bod kyi 'dun ma rgyal khrims 'chol zhing g.yeng : gtsug lag chos 'khor dben gnas rim par gud: gsang sngags bstan la bdud sprul 'tshe bas rgol: bod kyi gnas gzhi sgom khang shin tu gog: mi rnams nyon mongs dug lnga dpung chen hrag: slob dpon bka' la slob mas mi nyan zhing : rje zer 'bangs kyis mi nyan gyen du log: pha zer bu yis mi nyan blo mi mthun: chos khrims rgyal khrims thang khrims sngar bas stong : yi dam lha bor the'u rang phugs su mchod: mkha' 'gro'i gsang rgya bral nas sman mo sgrub: bstan pa'i chos skyong bor nas yul lha 'bod: srid pa'i lha rabs bskyur nas shi 'dre brngan: de yi rkyen gyis rang bzhin 'byung ba 'khrugs: yi dam lha zhal ri rab ngos la gzigs: mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad ma rgyud bdud du 'bebs: chos skyong 'khu bas bstan sel phugs su gzhug: dgra lha 'khu bas rang mgo mi 'og 'chor: brtan ma 'khrugs pas 'bru bcud phyug g.yang nyams: yul lha 'khrugs pas gre bo rlung ltar 'tshubs: sa bdag 'khrugs pas dmar yams lhog rgod 'bebs: ma mo 'khrugs pas nad mug mtshon bskal dar: gza' dang rgyal po ma mo klu rnams 'khrugs: de tshe sngar nas med pa'i nad rims dang : mtshon gyi bskal pa dar zhing snang srid 'khrugs:

steng 'khrugs 'og 'khrugs yul gru kun kyang 'khrugs: de yi rkyen gyis sems can bde skyid zad: sbas yul dben gnas rong bzhi ma gtogs pa: sdod pa'i gnas med bros sa'i yul yang dkon: dper na dar tshon sbur mas g.yogs pa 'dra: lo re bzhin du dpyid kha'i rlan bzhin du: bdud sprul dmag rnams dbyar gtsang lta bur 'brub: ma 'ongs bod 'bangs sbal yul rong bzhi ru: blo gtad bgyis pas gnas skabs rkyen las grol: phyi 'byung bde sdug de yang rten 'brel gnad: ma yol 'grigs na chos srid bstan gnyis dar: rim par pad 'byung nga la gsol ba thob: yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong dpang du tshugs: gzhi bdag sde brgyad rnams la bka' bsgo 'bog: rigs ldan grogs bcas rten 'brel ma 'chol gnad: dus tshod lung bstan gong 'og rnam gsum bstun: nges par dgos phyir the tshom bor la sgrubs: de yi cha rkyen gnas chen bgrod pa dang : lha srin gzhi bdag 'khu sogs bar chod rigs: zil gnon phyag brgya bzhi yis mthar byed pa: o rgyan dregs pa zil gnon sgrub thabs te: kho mo mtsho rgyal bdag gis yi ger btab: ma 'ongs las can 'phrang las bgrod pa'i tshe: tsau ra rgol ba 'joms pa'i gnyen po ru: gsang rgya rin chen 'bar ba'i sgrom du sbas: skal ldan thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog:

sa ma ya: de yang lam 'phrang 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' ba'i gnas dang yul: khyad par sbas yul 'grims pa: lha 'dre drag po gnas sa'i sa ru bgrod dgos pa: gang zhig pha rol g.yul ngo jag chom sogs mi mthun pa'i rgol ba rtsom pa'i rigs thams cad zil gyis gnon cing phrin las bzhi yi sgo nas tshar gcod par bya ba'i gdams pa'i thabs la brten nas dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i las rim man ngag le'u'i don tshan las: khrigs chags kyi go rim ni: thog mar phrin las byang bu'i rnam par 'jug pa ste: brag ri gnam lcags gzengs pa lta bu'i gnas: phug pa byang du kha bstan pa: mdun du chu gru gsum bsnol mar 'bab pa: srin po gral du bsgrigs pa 'dra ba'i gnas su: stegs bu mthing nag chos 'byung bsnol ma: phyi rol phyag mtshan drwa bas bskor ba: bar du gang dgos pa'i gzugs 'gros mi sogs liṅga'i rnam par bkod: de yi phyi rol rdo rwa me ri bcas ras bris la 'khod par bya: de nas rten pa'i phyag mtshan mkhar phur rtse gsum: sgrub pa'i phyag mtshan gnam lcags phur pa: srung skyob phyag mtshan seng ldeng phur pa ste: lcags kyi phur pa lnga: seng ldeng gi phur pa bcu: khro bo bzhi yi phyag mtshan bcas sgrub pa'i rten du bzhag: phur pa de rnams kyi khong seng du khro bcu'i sngags dang las bzhi yi sngags rnams gzhug: sgrub thabs thams cad kyi nang du drag po'i bla 'khor dar mthing nag gis dril bar bzhag: slar sgrub pa grol pa'i skabs gri lcags kyi gwa'u'i nang du 'chang : sgrub rdzas rnams rtsa sngags kyis bsnyen cing rab gnas bya: gzhan yang bum pa bhan+dha me long sogs dang : mchod pa'i rdzas thams cad spyi mthun bya'o: sa ma ya: bla 'khor ni: dang po lte bar chos 'byung bsnol ma bya: lte bar rtsibs steng ma gsum la: : rtsibs 'og ma gsum la: mu khyud la: om̐ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ a hūm̐:

badz+ra hūm̐: rak+sha hūm̐: yak+sha hūm̐: bdag 'chang ba po la pha rol gyi dgra dang jag chom mi rgod stag gzig dom dred dug sbrul gcan spyang dur phag sogs dang lha 'dre mi gsum gang gis kyang mi tshugs par srungs shig: om̐ ka ṭa ka ṭa tsakra rak+ṣa: phyi rol rtsibs bzhi ru: om̐ badz+ra bi dza ya tsaṇ+ḍa kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ badz+ra ya mān+ta ka kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ badz+ra kro ta h+ya ghṛ wa kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ badz+ra nī la daṇ+ḍa kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ rtsibs mchan la: om̐ badz+ra h+ya ghṛ wa dār pa a bhi bhu ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ rat+na ghṛ wa dār pa a bhi bhu ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ pad+ma ghṛ wa dār pa a bhi bhu ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ karma ghṛ wa dār pa a bhi bhu ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ phyi rol mu khyud la: om̐ badz+ra shrī he ru ka kro ti tsaṇ+ḍa tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā bha le badz+ra kī li kī la yā sarba bigh+nān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ bdag 'chang ba po la lha srin sde brgyad lha 'dre mi gsum sogs srid pa gsum du gnas pa'i 'byung po mi dang mi ma yin pa 'dab chags sder chags lto 'gro rkang mang rkang bzhi rkang gcig sogs gang gis kyang 'tshe ba dang gnod pa rgol ba'i rigs rnams dang khyad par gri mtshon mda' mdung du ru rdzas sbyor rang bzhin sbyor ba'i dbal kha sogs gang gis kyang mi tshugs par srungs shig badz+ra rak+ṣa: yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ lam̐ 'byung ba rlung me chu sa bzhi yi dgra sogs 'byung ba tsha grang 'thab pa gnam lcags thog dang 'khyug sogs gang gis kyang mi tshugs par srungs shig badz+ra ṭa ṭa ṭa ṭa ka ṭa hūm̐ ka ṭa rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: de'i phyi rol mu khyud la rdo rje'i phreng ba: de yi phyi rol ral gri'i so phyi ru bsnol ba'i drwa ba: de yi phyi rol me ris bskor: rdzas ni gser dngul zangs lcags phye ma: rin po che sna tshogs kyi phye ma: gri lcags kyi phye ma: pha bang long bu: rdo rje pha lam:

rdo rje mdung rtse gtsang chen gyi bye ma: mchod rten dgu yi sa sna: gnam lcags thog gi phye ma: seng ldeng skyer pa tsher nag kan+tsa sogs tsher ma can dgu yi phye ma: nag po dgu sbyor: khyung lnga: gcan gzan mche can dgu yi mche sder gyi phye ma: bya sha gzan dgu yi sder mchu'i phye ma: sbrul gyi snying sdig pa'i rwa co: rus sbal gyi rus pa bcas phyogs gcig tu 'thag pa'i rdzas kyis byug dgos: de yang dar tshon sna lnga'i rgya chings spras la mi lpags nang du btums te sked par mi yis mi mthong bar 'chang : mi lag mi 'grim: khyi dang bud med zhum bu rnams kyis mi reg mi 'gom: dus tshes dge bar brtsam: sa ma ya: de nas sngon du 'gro ba ni: na mo: dbang drag rol pa'i cho 'phrul dgyes pa'i gar: dpal chen khro rgyal rdo rje gro bo lod: lha srin gdug pa 'dul phyir skur bzhengs pa: bcom ldan dregs pa zil gnon he ru kaḥ sde brgyad lha srin 'dul ba'i drag rtsal can: mngon spyod chen po'i dus las mi 'da' phyir: pha rol gdug pa'i g.yul ngo zhi ba dang : gcan 'phrang la sogs ma rungs 'dul ba'i phyir: phyag rgya zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: rab gus gdung bas gsol ba btab pa'i mod: lam 'phrang 'jigs pa'i nyer 'tshe mi 'byung zhing : 'gro kun gnas chen bgrod par sems bskyed do: lam log lam gol 'jigs pa bskyab tu gsol: de nas mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni: om̐ āḥhūm̐: dpag med nam mkha'i khyon ltar las: bla med kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin: phyi mchod sna tshogs 'dod yon gter: nang mchod sman gtor rak+ta dang : gsang mchod sbyor sgrol dbang po lnga: blo yis blangs te dmigs pa'i tshogs: rgyal ba mnyes pa'i rdzas su gyur: badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta māṃ sa tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta om̐ āḥhūm̐:

de nas lha bskyed pa ni: hūm̐ e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bh+rūm̐: hūm̐: e las gnam lcags gzhal yas khang : gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan dang ldan: rdo rwa dur khrod me ris bskor: phyi nang dmar chen rlabs su 'khyil: de dbus pad nyi ro yi steng : hūm̐ las dpal chen he ru kaḥ dmar nag gtum chen g.yul las rgyal: dregs pa kun 'dul he ru kaḥ am gtsigs khro gnyer spyan rtsa 'khrugs: dbu la bdud 'dul sngags zhwa gsol: phyag g.yas rtse gsum klad la bskor: g.yon pas seng ldeng phur pa bsgril: sku la dar nag ber chen gsol: dug sbrul nag po'i sku rags bcings: sked par gnam lcags phur bu 'chang : zung 'jug dur khrod chas dang ldan: zhabs gnyis zil gnon gar stabs can: khrag 'thung mngon spyod tshul du gsal: hūm̐: shar du 'gugs byed khro bo dkar: rnam rgyal bing dang lcags kyu thogs: lho ru 'ching byed khro bo ser: gshin rje kha ṭ+wāṃ zhags pa 'dzin: nub tu sdom byed khro bo dmar: rta mgrin dbyug pa lcags sgrog bsnams: byang du myos byed khro bo mthing : dbyug sngon dgra satwa dril bu thogs: kun kyang dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs: gtum rngam bzhad gshe khro gar bsgyur: khams gsum dbang sdud srid gsum sgrol: dregs pa kun 'dul lha tshogs rnams: ye shes me dpung klong du gsal: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas dpal chen phyag rgya zil gnon gyi lha tshogs rnams skad cig gis snang srid thams cad drag po'i rlung 'jigs pa'i 'brug sgra gnam lcags kyi thog dang tshwa tshwa khol ba'i shugs las byon te snang srid thams cad dngangs shing 'jigs pa'i rang bzhin can du bsgom: om̐ ram̐ ram̐ badz+ra he ru ka kro ta tsa tur he phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ spyan 'dren ni: hūm̐: dbyings las ma g.yos dpal chen khro bo'i rgyal: dregs pa zil gnon 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya ldan:

gtum gshe rngam dang rgod pa'i khro bos bskor: snang srid dbang du bsdus phyir gshegs su gsol: srid gsum zil gyis gnon phyir gshegs su gsol: sde brgyad bran du bkol phyir gshegs su gsol: ma mo las la mngag phyir gshegs su gsol: dam sri 'dre rgod 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: bstan dgra cham la dbab phyir gshegs su gsol: sgos dgra thal bar brlag phyir gshegs su gsol: gcan 'phrang gdug pa gzhom phyir gshegs su gsol: gzugs can gzugs med 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: gdug pa'i g.yul ngo bzlog phyir gshegs su gsol: dam can pho nya 'gyed phyir gshegs su gsol: chos skyong dgra la rbad phyir gshegs su gsol: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ a be sha ya āḥ phaiṃ phaiṃ sa ma ya satwaṃ: de nas bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: nyi zla pad+ma bam ro'i steng : dpal chen dregs pa zil gnon gyi: dkyil 'khor bskyed pa'i khro tshogs rnams: mi g.yo dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs: gdug pa'i g.yul ngo gzhom pa'i phyir: phrin las drag po'i skur bstan nas: brkyang bskum srin po'i gar stabs kyis: rab tu dwang bas phyag bgyid do: om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: om̐ na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ de nas mchod pa ni: hūm̐: dbang drag rdo rje srin po khro bo'i rgyal: 'jigs byed dregs pa zil gnon lha tshogs la: dbang po'i me tog gu gul bdug pa'i spos: tshil chen mar me dmar chen dri chab gtams: 'bru nag gri khrag sbags pa'i bha ling+ta: sman sbyor drag rdzas ngar btags tshogs gtor bcas: gtum chen phyag rgya zil gnon khro bo bzhi: khrag 'thung mngon spyod lha la mchod pa 'bul: snang srid dregs pa 'dul phyir bzhes su gsol: ma rungs rgol ba 'joms pa'i dus la bab: lha 'dre mi gsum 'dul ba'i dus la bab: mtha' bzhi'i 'dre rgod 'dul ba'i dus la bab: gcan 'phrang gdug pa sgrol ba'i dus la bab:

srid gsum dbang du sdud pa'i dus la bab: dus la bab po bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ sarba pañtsa rak+ta bha ling+ta pū dza māṃ sa go ro tsa na ba su ta kha kha khā hi khā h-i: badz+ra ni ḍāk+ki nī ri ti raṃ ha la rak+ta so sa kā la bha ling+ta shab+da shang kha dum du bhi gaṇ+ḍi ye kro ta he ru ka sarba tsa dur kha kha khā hi khā hi: de nas bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: 'jigs rung e las grub pa'i pho brang nas: stobs bcu'i dbyings la ye shes rdzogs pa'i lha: dpal chen dregs pa zil gnon he ru kaḥ khros pa'i gar gyis srid gsum gnas nas spar: bdud dpung gzhom phyir spyi bor sngags zhwas brgyan: khro chu'i dbal ldan mche ba am gtsigs bsdams: spyan rtsa sdang mig smin ma glog ltar 'khyugs: snyan nas drag po'i hūm̐ sgra 'brug ltar ldir: shangs nas gnam lcags bu yug tshwa tshwa 'thor: ba spu'i dbyings nas khro bcu'i sprul pa 'gyed: phyag g.yas stong gsum snyil ba'i mkhar phur 'phyar: g.yon pa'i seng ldeng phur pas bar chad sgrol: gnam lcags phur pa sked bcug bstan dgra sgrol: dur khrod chas ldan bdud bzhi'i g.yul ngo 'joms: rin chen rgyan ldan ma sring dbang du sdud: dar nag ber chen snang srid dngangs shing 'dar: sbrul nag chings rgyan klu gnyan sa bdag 'dul: rgya lham mthing nag dam sri'i mgo bo 'gems: me dpung dmar nag 'tshub cing rlung nag g.yo: sku la mtshon cha'i bu yug chi li li: gnam lcags thog char dgra bgegs steng du 'bebs: che btsan 'gran zla bral ba'i dpa' bo che: yang le shod du dmar nag gro bo lod: yang phur bde chen snying po sgrub pa'i tshe: bar chad bgegs rnams rdo rje phur pas bsgral: phur pa rnam gsum sku gsum lhun gyis grub: bal bod mtshams su lha 'dre'i srog snying phul: dregs pa'i sde dpon shān+tiṃ ghar+bha la: rig 'dzin bdag gis gus pas nyer bstod na: sa lam bar gcod zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod:
