hūm̐: shar phyogs khro chen rnam par rgyal: 'gugs pa'i phyag rgya lcags kyu gdengs: shar phyogs dgra dang gnod byed bgegs: lam 'phrang 'jigs pa'i bar gcod rnams: lcags kyu 'bar bas snying nas zungs: g.yas pa'i bing gis rdul du rlog: mngon spyod chen po'i phrin las pa: shar phyogs dgra bgegs 'joms pa'i lha: rnam par rgyal la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: lho phyogs khro chen gshin rje gshed: 'ching ba'i phyag rgya zhags pa 'khyugs: lho phyogs dgra dang gnod byed bgegs: lam 'phrang 'jigs pa'i bar gcod rnams: zhags pa can gyis mgul nas 'ching : rtse gsum mtshon chas rdul du rlog: mngon spyod chen po'i phrin las pa: lho phyogs dgra bgegs 'joms pa'i lha: gshin rje gshed la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: nub phyogs khro chen rta mgrin rgyal: sdom pa'i phyag rgya lcags sgrog spro: nub phyogs dgra dang gnod byed bgegs: lam 'phrang 'jigs pa'i bar gcod rnams: lcags sgrog 'bar bas yan lag sdom: dbyug pa 'bar bas rdul du rlog: mngon spyod chen po'i phrin las pa: nub phyogs dgra bgegs 'joms pa'i lha: rta mgrin rgyal por bdag bstod do: hūm̐: byang phyogs khro chen dbyug pa sngo: myos pa'i phyag rgya dril bu 'khrol: byang phyogs dgra dang gnod byed bgegs: lam 'phrang 'jigs pa'i bar gcod rnams: dril bu 'bar bas myos su chug: dgra satwa 'bar bas rdul du rlog: mngon spyod chen po'i phrin las pa: byang phyogs dgra bgegs 'joms pa'i lha: dbyug pa sngon por bdag bstod do: hūm̐: de ltar bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor lha: mngon spyod las la bskul ba'i phyir: deng 'dir thugs dam gnad nas bskul: phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub pa la: drag po'i dkyil 'khor 'grub par mdzod: rtsa sngags: om̐ āḥhūm̐: artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ a hūm̐: badz+ra hūm̐: rak+ṣa hūm̐: yak+ṣa hūm̐: a ya ma du ru tsa sha na mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ

las sngags: om̐ kro ta a pa rā tsi ta bi dza ya ya mān+ta ka h+ya ghṛ wa nī la daṇ+ḍa kro ta sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ e dza bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces pa'i sngags 'di sgrub pa'i skabs su gang 'grub 'bung : mtshon phur sngags ni: om̐ ka la he ka shrī kro ta karma raṃ raṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ lam 'phrang gi bar gcod bigh+nān trig nan thar ni thar ni 'ching ya mi rgod dgra bo'i bla snying satwaṃ bha ya nan sum bha ni trig thum mā ra ya rbad rbad: ces pas sngags las phur rnams la yang yang btab: gtsang chen bye ma sngags pa rang 'gro ba'i phyogs su gtor: phur pa bcu po rnams phyogs bcur gzir zhing : khyad par rang nyid 'gro ba'i phyogs su dmigs pa drag po bya: dmigs pa ni rang nyid dpal chen phyag rgya zil gnon du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas las kyi khro bo bzhi: de las 'khor sprul pa dang bcas pa 'phros pas de rnams kyi las bzhi'i phyag mtshan gyi dmigs yul thams cad 'gugs 'ching sdom myos nas ming shul tsam yang med par sgom: yang bye ma de phyogs su gtor bas gser gyi mchod rten dang lcags kyi mchod rten grangs med par 'phros nas kho yi snying khar mnan te 'bros dbang med pa khro chu zhun khu spar ba ltar gyur par sgom: yang phur pa gdeng pa'i tshe de las mched pa'i dbal ldan grangs med kyis dgra bo'i yul zhing lam 'phrang bcas pa gtor te mun nag bskal pa'i rlung 'tshubs pa ltar gyi nang du btums par sgom: nub mo gang du bsdad pa'i sa ru lcags phur thams cad phyogs su gzugs: seng ldeng phur pa de khro bo hūm̐ kā ra bskyed de sngas khar gzugs:

hūm̐ kā ra hūm̐ kā ra badz+ra kī li kī la ya siṅg+ra wa ri sgṛ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la srungs shig nṛ bh+rūm̐ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ye swā hā: zhes sngags shing gzugs par bya'o: srung 'khor spyi 'gro sgom mkhar phur g.yas su gzugs: pha rol dgra bgegs tshar bcad par bsam: las phur g.yon du gzugs: bdud dang dam sri thams cad phur pa de mthong ba'i mod la sbur ma mes khyer gyi rnam pas thul gyis bsregs shing tshar bcad par bsam: phyag mtshan bzhi ldan gyi gcan 'phrang pa dang a ra chom po thams cad 'gugs 'ching sdom par bsams la phyag mtshan mdun du bzhag: lam 'phrang sogs gnas su bgrod tshe dur khrod chas brgyad sngags chas bcas 'chang ba'i gnad yin: g.yas zur 'tshams pa zhig tu lha mo 'od zer can gyi mda' dar rig ma'i chas kyang bzhag: gser skyems la sogs rngan chas rnams 'grigs par bya: gnas zhag thams cad du dkar phyogs la gser skyems: nag phyogs la dmar gtor phul: lam gyi bar gcod la zor chung re 'phang zhing bsgral dmigs kyang bya: de yi zor bskul ni: hūm̐: bzhengs shig drag po'i phrin las dus la bab: dpal chen dregs pa zil gnon 'khor bcas kyis: bdud rtsi sha khrag bha ling 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir mngon spyod chen po'i dus la bab: dgra bgegs byad ma gdug pa'i g.yul chen dang : gcan 'phrang 'tshe bas mi dang mi ma yin: bsgral ba'i zhing du bkod pa'i 'di nyid kyi: bla tshe rnam shes srog dbugs dbang thang bcas: rnam par rgyal ba'i lcags kyus snying nas zungs: gshin rje gshed po'i zhags pas mgul du chings: rta mgrin rgyal po'i lcags sgrog 'bar bas sdoms: dbyug pa sngon po'i dril bus myos par gyis: 'gugs 'ching bsdams nas myos shing reng du chug: khro rgyal mngon spyod chen po'i dus la bab: byad ma dgra bgegs mi rabs bdun rgyud dang : gcan 'phrang gdug pa sdang ba byad ma'i tshogs:

'bar ba'i mtshon cha du ma'i char phab ste: lhag ma ming dang rjes shul med par mdzod: om̐ badz+ra trag rak+sha kha la ya he thun nan rbad byad ma gnod byed thams cad bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: a ya ma du ru tsa sha na mā ra ya bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog byad ma nṛ tri mā ra ya rbad rbad zlog zlog: ces pas zor de gnam lcags thog gi sgyogs chen gling bzhi 'joms nus pa zhig tu gyur nas byad ma gang yin gyi steng du phog pas bskal pas bsdus pa'i rlung g.yos pa ltar gyur nas ming shul tsam yang med par sa gzhi yang rdul ltar nyil bar sgom: gzhan yang dkar gtor gser skyems sogs so sor zur du gsal ba ltar bya: sa ma ya: dngos grub 'gugs stim rnams spyi nas blang : bsngo smon yang bde gshegs kun 'dus ltar ram: las phran gzhan nas blangs pas mthus: sa ma ya: e ma: kho mo bdag 'dra bud med mtsho rgyal gyis: gu ru rje yi zhal lung bka' stsal bzhin: mi brjed gsang rgya shog ser logs su bkod: rin chen zab rgya mi mngon brag la sbas: ma 'ongs bod 'bangs gnas chen bgrod pa'i tshe: lam 'phrang 'jigs pa skyob pa'i cha rkyen du: phyag rgya zil gnon yang snying sgrub pa bzhag: bka' rgya bswe yi lha mo mched bzhis srungs: shan+ta pu ri gter gyi srung mar rgya: las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: them rgya: mi nub rgya: dam rgya: gnyan rgya: spel rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos sa khyi lor bod yul bsam yas mchims phu'i dgai'u gong nas gdan drangs shing chu mo glang lor shog ser nas legs par zhal bshus so// // tha) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: g.yul bzlog dregs pa'i dmag 'gyed shan pa spu gri bzhugs so: bde gshegs kun 'dus rtsa ba gsum gyi lha: dregs pa'i tshogs rnams 'joms pa'i gzi byin can:

'bar ba'i rtsal bcu dgyes pa'i gar dang bcas: ma rungs bdud sde'i dpung tshogs mthar byed pa: mtha' 'khob zhe sdang gdug pa'i g.yul chen 'joms: hor sog 'jigs pa'i dmag gis mtha' bskor na: chos 'khor gnyan po 'jigs la thug pa'i tshe: yid gnyis the tshom med par gsol ba thob: nga nyid lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas: dmag dpung hur thum bzlog par the tshom med: lha sras rgyal po'i thugs la de ltar chongs: snyigs ma lnga bdo'i sems can 'dul dka' yang : drag sngags mtshon chas mi shigs gang yang med: srid gsum ri rab rmang yang 'gyel nus na: skye 'gro phra mo sgrol la lta ci smos: bsad pa 'di ni rdo rje spu gri yin: bzlog pa 'di ni bar snang sgyogs chen yin: srung ba bya na rdo rje'i khrab ring yin: dmod pa bya na dug mda' rgyug 'gyel yin: rbad pa'i dus su pho nya glog zhags yin: 'bebs pa'i dus su thog mda' dbal 'gyed yin: de bas man ngag 'di la brtson pa dang : ma 'ongs de dus kho bo dus drug sgoms: spros pa chen po'i sgrub pa long med pas: spros med spros bcas cung tsam 'grel ba 'di: yang snying yin pas med thabs med do gsungs: sa ma ya: de nas sgrub pa'i bca' gzhi phra mo la: dur khrod ro sol dal bcags gnam lcags thig: de steng dmar nag gtor ma rtsang gis brgyan: bzlog pa lha grangs lta bur shes par bya: mdun du gza' mchog gtor ma dag kyang bshams: gzhan yang sman raka phud rgod la sogs bkram: rol mo rgyan bkod spyi mthun rang gzhung ltar: bsad las thams cad dmigs pa sngar las sbyar: sku mkhar ri rab rtse bzlog dpe'u ris ltar: bdag mdun thams cad dus gcig rdzogs pa'i phyir: mgo mjug tsam zhig bla sgrub nang nas blang : de bas gsang sgrub 'di ltar 'bad cing 'bungs: khyad par dug shing sna tshogs las bcos pa'i: dug phur brgya dang brgyad 'di 'debs kha yin: dgra phyogs gang byung sde brgyad las zor 'phang :

thun rgod zor rdzas bzlog pa'i mtha' nas skor: mdun du hom̐ khung nang du dgra yul bsam: liṅga dang bcas bkod pa grub rjes su: lag len khrigs chag gab dang 'khrugs med do: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de nas mchod phreng sgrub khog la sbyar nas: na mo: bla ma bder 'dus rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha: drag po thod phreng gtum chen bsgrubs nas ni: gang la gang 'dul phrin las bgyid pa yis: bdud dang mu stegs 'joms par dam bca'o: dregs 'dul dkyil 'khor lha la skyabs su mchi: gnyis pa: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: om̐ āḥhūm̐: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta ma hā māṃ sa tsit+ta go ro tsa na ba su ta bha ling+ta pū dza āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: thod pa skam rlon lcags zangs bhan+dha'i snod: dug gsum dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag dang : dbang po rnam lnga dmar chen gtor ma'i tshogs: ri ltar spungs shing khor yug kun la khyab: drag po'i dkyil 'khor mnyes pa'i rdzas su gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum gyis spel: badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: lha bskyed: hūm̐ e yam̐ ram̐ sum̐ keṃ bh+rūm̐: ru tra ti ra bam̐ ma sūr+ya tsan+d+ra sa ma ya hūm̐ bh+yoḥ a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sa ma ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā: hūm̐: e las grub pa'i gnam lcags gzhal yas khang : zur bzhi logs brgyad khro chu khol ma'i dbus: bdud dgra mu stegs bsgral ba'i snying kha ru: hūm̐ las bdag nyid bdud 'joms nag po'i sku: rdo rje thod phreng shān+tiṃ ghar+bha ni: dmod pa'i las chas dregs pa yongs kyi gtso: snying rje khros pas bdud bzhi bcom par byed: srid gsum srog bdag gshin rje khros pa'i tshul: sku mdog nag po dam nyams kun gyi gshed: mu stegs rgol ba 'joms pa'i gnod sbyin che: phyag g.yas gnam lcags rdo rje rtse dgu'i mtshon: rwa yi g.yas zur gnam lcags 'khor lo bskor: g.yon pas srog bdag khros pa'i lcags sdig ni:

mgo dgu kha dgu rwa ni bco brgyad gzengs: sdig pa'i kha nas dug rlangs mtshon cha ni: gnam lcags las grub phur bu char du 'bebs: srid gsum phrin las kun 'dus gshegs su gsol: mu stegs 'dul mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: sha khrag dmar chen gtor ma 'di bzhes la: mtha' bzhi dmag dpung bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: kham nag ral pa gzengs pa'i skra gseb nas: sprul pa'i bya khyung grangs med thog ltar 'gyed: thod skam dbu rgyan dar nag pu ru ru: dmar zlum spyan rtsa sdang mig phyogs bcur 'khyil: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril dgra yul hab kyis za: ba spu'i gseb nas khro chung mtshon thogs 'phro: glang ko zhing lpags stag sham mgo phreng brjid: rdo rje'i go dang spu gri'i sgro gshog brgyangs: lte bar chu srin rngam zhal sbrul chun 'khyugs: srid gsum tshar gcod sku smad dbal zur ni: 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug tsha ngar ldan: byad ma'i lus ngag yid gsum rdul du brlag: dgra bgegs dmag dpung gzhom phyir gshegs su gsol: gdug pa'i g.yul ngo 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod: sha khrag dmar chen rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la: pha rol g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ ma hā gu ru kī li kī la ya: om̐ sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ e dza bh+yoḥhūm̐ phaṭḥ byad ma rbod gtong gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: hūm̐: shar phyogs rtsibs steng lha yi dregs pa ni: shel khrab rmog zhu ral gri ru mtshon thogs: lha g.yag bzhon nas shar phyogs dmag sna 'dren: spyan 'dren 'dir gshegs sha khrag gtor ma longs: shar phyogs g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: a ya ma du ru tsa sha na shar phyogs dgra bgegs dmag dpung bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: hūm̐: lho phyogs rtsibs steng gshin rje dregs pa ni: mchong khrab rmog zhu khram shing ru mtshon thogs: ma he bzhon nas lho phyogs dmag sna 'dren: spyan 'dren 'dir gshegs sha khrag gtor ma longs:

lho phyogs g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: ya ma du ru tsa sha na a lho phyogs dgra bgegs dmag dpung bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: hūm̐: nub phyogs rtsibs steng ma mo dregs pa ni: dung khrab rmog zhu phur pa nad rkyal thogs: g.yu 'brug bzhon nas nub phyogs dmag sna 'dren: spyan 'dren 'dir gshegs sha khrag gtor ma long : nub phyogs dgra bgegs bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: ma du ru tsa sha na a ya nub phyogs dgra bgegs dmag dpung bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: hūm̐: byang phyogs rtsibs steng bdud kyi dregs pa ni: lcags khrab rmog zhu dgra satwa zhags pa thogs: bdud rta bzhon nas byang phyogs dmag sna 'dren: spyan 'dren 'dir gshegs sha khrag gtor ma longs: byang phyogs g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: du ru tsa sha na a ya ma byang phyogs dgra bgegs dmag dpung bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: hūm̐: shar lho'i rtsibs steng rgyal po'i dregs pa ni: bswe khrab rmog zhu zangs ral tsit+ta thogs: seṅge bzhon nas shar lho'i dmag sna 'dren: spyan 'dren 'dir gshegs sha khrag gtor ma longs: shar lho'i g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: ru tsa sha na a ya ma du shar lho'i dmag dpung bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: hūm̐: lho nub rtsibs steng btsan gyi dregs pa ni: zangs khrab rmog zhu mda' gzhu ru mtshon thogs: mtshal stag bzhon nas lho nub dmag sna 'dren: spyan 'dren 'dir gshegs sha khrag gtor ma longs: lho nub g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: tsa sha na a ya ma du ru lho nub dgra bgegs dmag dpung bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: hūm̐: nub byang rtsibs staing gnon sbyin dregs pa ni: gser khrab rmog zhu kha ṭ+wāṃ 'khor lo thogs: dom nag bzhon nas nub byang dmag sna 'dren: spyan 'dren 'dir gshegs sha khrag gtor ma longs: nub byang g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: sha na a ya ma du ru tsa nub byang dgra bgegs dmag dpung bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog:

hūm̐: byang shar rtsibs steng klu yi dregs pa ni: g.yu khrab rmog zhu sbrul zhags lcags par thogs: chu srin bzhon nas byang shar dmag sna 'dren: spyan 'dren 'dir gshegs sha khrag gtor ma longs: byang shar g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: na a ya ma du ru tsa sha byang shar dgra bgegs dmag dpung bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: hūm̐: steng phyogs rtsibs steng gza' bdud dregs pa ni: sku mdog dud kha gnam lcags thog mda' 'gyed: glog dmar rta bzhon steng phyogs dmag sna 'dren: spyan 'dren 'dir gshegs sha khrag gtor ma longs: steng phyogs g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: rā hu la na sha tsa ru du ma ya a steng phyogs dgra bgegs dmag dpung bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: hūm̐: 'og phyogs rtsibs steng dmu rje'i dregs pa ni: 'ob zhu stag thul shang lang sog le thogs: dred mong bzhon nas 'og phyogs dmag sna 'dren: spyan 'dren 'dir gshegs sha khrag gtor ma longs: 'og phyogs g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: bh+rūm̐ mi ra tsa na sha tsa ru du ma ya a 'og phyogs dgra bgegs dmag dpung bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: hūm̐: khor yug rtsibs steng yul lha'i dregs pa ni: ma nges go khrab rmog zhu mtshon cha thogs: rigs mthun rta bzhon phyogs phyogs dmag sna 'dren: spyan 'dren 'dir gshegs sha khrag gtor ma longs: phyogs phyogs g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hri ṭi ta hri ke du e dza bh+yo rā hu la ki king shag bh+yoḥn sha tsa ru du ma ya a phyogs phyogs dmag dpung steng du bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: ces gtor mdos nang du gtor chung re 'bul: mchod pa dmar chen gtor zhing : hūm̐: srid gsum g.yul bzlog drag sngags 'dus pa'i lha: dpal chen khro rgyal dregs pa 'khor bcas la: dug gsum dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'bul: phyi nang mchod sprin dur khrod bkod pa'i khyon: sha yi ri bo khrag gi rgya mtsho bcas:

dbang po zhal zas khor yug khengs pa'i tshogs: pha rol g.yul ngo khams la dmigs nas su: dregs pa'i sde dpon tshogs la 'bul lags na: bstan pa'i ru tra gzhom phyir bzhes su gsol: dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na ba su ta sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe ne wi d+yai shab+da āḥhūm̐: sngags bstod ni: hūm̐: lhag pa'i lha mchog gtum chen g.yul las rgyal: 'jigs byed rdo rje khro bo dbal gsham can: sku las spros pa'i khro tshogs sprin ltar gtibs: sha khrag srog la dbang ba'i dregs pas bskor: sde brgyad dmag dpon gza' mchog rā hu la: phyi nang gsang ba'i lha srin sde brgyad bcas: rnal 'byor bdag gis mchod cing bstod nas su: bskul zhing rbad pa'i phrin las bcol ba'i tshe: thugs dam dus las ma 'da' dam tshig can: bdag gis bla med byang chub sgrub pa la: bdud dang 'gong pos byad du ma ster nas: phyogs kyi dgra sdang nang gi yul gru bcom: dkon mchog gnyan la nyer 'tshe'i dgra dar bas: lha tshogs dam can rgya mtsho dpung la bzhengs: pha rol rgol ba 'joms pa'i phrin las mdzod: de yi thugs dam gnyan po dus 'dir bskul: dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: hor sog 'jigs pa'i dmag dpung bzlog tu gsol: bskyed rdzogs sngags bzlas mngon spyod 'grub par shog: om̐ ma hā gu ru kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ e dza bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ hrīḥrā hu la ki kang hriḥshag ru rāṃ nā ga bh+rūm̐ mi hri ṭi ta hriḥke du a ya ma du ru tsa sha na mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ

ces rgyun sngags so: thun sngags bsad sngags zlog sngags thams cad gcig tu bsgril ba ni: om̐ he ma ṭa ma ṭa da ha da ha tshin+dha tshin+dha bhan+dha bhan+dha byad ma ṇi tri ma ra ma ra pa tsa pa tsa ha na ha na hu lu hu lu dgra bo byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa nṛ tri sha truṃ trig thum spur thum hur thum tsit+ta 'gas 'gas ya ya bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog nan nan rbad rbad: ces thun sngags rnams liṅga la spyi yi 'gugs gzhug byas nas sngags sbrags te thun gyis brab skabs su btub cing sde brgyad bskul nas 'bul: bsnyen pa las sbyor gnas skabs dus dang bstun: khyad par sgrub sngags dug phur shing la btab thun sngags rnams thun rdo dag la sngags: skabs su thams cad zung 'jug sngags ring bya: phyogs phyogs dgra bo'i steng du phur zor 'phang : mnan dmigs rnams su dgra ling 'gugs stim sba: de steng phur thun thun rdzas dag kyang gzug: khyad par dmag chen phyogs nas g.yos pa'am: nang nyer g.yul 'gyed sprad dgos byung srid na: sde brgyad las la bskul zhing gtor zor rnams: phyogs phyogs 'phangs sam dgra phyogs dag la 'phang : de yis dmag dpung hur thum bzlog par 'gyur: khyad par pha rol 'joms byed drag po yis: sku 'di rdo g.yam dag la bris nas su: mjug tu dmag bzlog sngags bcas tshang bar byas: rab gnas bcol te dgra phyogs zhal bstan nas: mtha' 'khob dmag dpung bod du mi 'byung zhing : gal srid chas kyang 'phral du bzlog pa dang : dus kyi chad pa phyogs su byol bar 'gyur: dgra la lcags ri yin pas med thabs med: khyad par sgrub khang sgo kha mgon khang dang : gyang bris 'dig sogs kun la bzhengs gyur na: 'gong po spun dgu'i gnod pa 'byung mi srid: sku 'khor nang du srog yig bri ba ni: dang po phyi ni sku 'khor ji bzhin bzhengs: lte ba'i nang du lañdza'i hūm̐ yig bkod: de yi mu khyud nang du rtsa sngags bris:

rtsibs bzhir khrom̐ tram̐ zhes pa bris: rtsibs mchan bh+yoḥdza zhes pa bris: de'i phyi rim mu khyud la: dmod pa drag sngags sham bu ci mos bsgyur: de'i phyi rim rtsibs brgyad la: a ya ma sogs sde brgyad 'bru re bris: rtsibs mchan la phaṭ bris: mu khyud la sde brgyad spyi sngags tshar gcig bris: sham bu la lha srin sde brgyad dang : dam sri 'gong po spun dgu khyad par gdug pa'i phyogs nas g.yo ba'i dmag tshogs rnams srungs shig rak+ṣa: dmag bzlog yin na rdo g.yam la zlog sngags mgo nang du bstan nas bsam gtan nyal chog 'khor lo ltar bzhag: dgra phyogs la kha bstan phur thun dbal kha yang dgra la kha bstan la bzhag: sde brgyad rang gzhung gi zlog sngags rnams la sdeb cing sbrags: yang dug phur ma rnyed na rgya khab la sngags nas phyogs su gtor la sde brgyad kyi dmag tshogs sprin ltar du gtibs pas dgra yul mtshon thogs 'bum gyis gang nas phye mar brlags pa'i dmigs pa bgyis so: pha rol gyis sde brgyad kyi dmag tshogs du mthong nas dmag khri 'gyur gyi gdams pa yang zer: yang phyogs la 'gro ba'i tshe rdo thun sngags la rang 'gro ba'i phyogs su gtor te phung byed shān+tiṃ ghar+bha a tsa ra yi cha byad can khri 'bum gyis nam mkha' sa gzhi thams cad gang ste rdo char phab pas dgra yul thams cad sa rud rdo rud kyis gang bar bsam: de'i tshe dgra yi rmi ltas log par 'gyur ro: yang lcags kyi a tsa ra nag pos bdud kyi spyang ki bdun khrid nas dgra bo'i khang khyim thams cad gang bar bsam: yang zangs kyi a tsa ra gcer bu rgyan med pas zangs khab kyis dgra bo 'byung ba'i lam thams cad thul ba'i sul sgrib pa'am chu yi zam bcad pa ltar yong ba'i shul med par bsam: zangs khab sor bzhi la sngags so: kha bsgyur sngags ni: tri'u tri'u u thi ta dgra bo 'gyu ba'i lam chod chod: ces pas zangs khab rgya gram phyogs thams cad du bstan:

yang khyi brun phag brun spyang ki'i rtug brun bcas la re dug pas rtsis brlan pa la sngags 'di ci mang bzlas te rgya lam du me la bsregs pas dgra bo mun 'thib par 'gyur ro: a haṃ pra ma mu ti tsa mun nag ting tha ting tha thib thib: ces dgra bo mig bsgribs te ci yang mi mthong bar bsgom: yang : pra ma tsa la 'byung ba dam du ching ti thim: zhes pas bya rgod kyi rgyud pa dang dgra bo'i rjes sa zung du sngags la: gri lcags me cha gri khrag gis ngar brlan pa'i spra ba bya grib ri nyi ma mi 'phog sa nas me rdo bcas rgyud pa me la bsregs: dmigs pa sde brgyad thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug las gyur pa'i lha dang bdud gnyis 'khrugs te 'byung ba'i khrag thams cad 'byin pa'i nang du 'dus te de yang rjes sa de dang rgyud pa la thim: me sbar ba'i tshe rtsa bzhi thams cad 'ub kyis 'dus par bsgom: man ngag rnam gsum 'di phra ma gong khug shān+tiṃ ghar+bha'i khyad chos so: ma 'ongs dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i btsas su bzhag: gnod sbyin shan pa spun gsum rgya 'di srungs: gong gi bsgrigs chog thams cad lag len bzhin du bgyis te sngags kyi rtags tshad rdzogs par bya'o: zlog dmigs zor dmigs spyi 'gros ltar bya'o: rjes kyi bya ba yang de bzhin no: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: them rgya: kho bo rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling pas sa khyi lor bsam yas mchims phu'i dge'u gong nas gdan drangs shing lcags phag lor mdo khams sa yi lte ba mi dbang sa bdag rgyal po khri dmar po'i ur 'gos su sprel zla ba'i yar tshes la shog ser nas zhal bshus so// // da) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: sbas gnas sgo 'byed bar chad lam sel ye shes drwa ba bzhugs so: bde gshegs kun 'dus yang snying 'dus pa las: byin rlabs bla ma'i dngos grub 'byin pa'i phyir:

thugs rje'i 'od dkar gdul bya'i zhing du 'phros: 'dul zhing dgongs pas bod la smon lam mdzad: skye dgu rnams la chos kyi nyi ma shar: dngos grub zab mo rje 'bangs rnams la gnang : 'phel 'grib med pa nus pa'i rgyun thag sbrel: phangs pa med par gdams pa yi ger btab: nyams pa med pa'i rin chen gter du sbas: zad pa med pa'i dbang bzhi'i brgyud pa phog: mtshungs pa med pa byams pas 'gro ba skyong : yid bzhin nor bu'i zhal gdams bcu gsum sogs: nam mkha'i rgya mtsho'i mdzod gling thams cad kun: lha sras rje dang rje 'bangs rnams la gdams: da lta spel ba'i dus min ma 'ongs la: stod kyi phyogs nas mu stegs nag po rdol: bar gyi phyogs nas man ngag nag po rdol: smad kyi phyogs nas mon te mug ti rdol: bar khams dbus phyogs rnam smin skye rgyal 'byung : du ru kha dang dur min dur 'dra gsum: du ru kha yi dus ni 'tshogs dus med: dur min dus su sdig spyod dbang po dar: chos pa'i gzugs brnyan dam log dge bshes tshogs: dur 'dra zhes pa dam sri du ru 'dod: re re la ni ra can khri phrag bskor: bdud kyi blo mthun satwa re'i so ltar 'grig: stod nas g.yo zhing mtha' nas dbus su 'khrugs: bar nas 'thab cing smad nas chu ltar khol: 'jig rten sa la bde ba skad cig med: sdug bsngal myong zhing nya mo gzan 'tshol 'dra: mthong yang mi dga' sdug bsngal phyi thag la: 'dod chags tshwa chu bzhin du nyer len 'khor: las ngan myong dgos bsha' lug mgo 'khor 'dra: the tshom can dang skal med log lta mkhan: 'dug sa'i sa 'phrog 'gro ba'i lam yang gol: skal med de la dben ri'i go skabs med: sdug bsngal thar med sna thag yun ring bsring : gcig rjes gcig sleb chu bo'i gnyer ma 'dra: khyad par sbas gnas mi bgrod rnam pa gsum: blo sna bdud kyis bslus la las 'phro med: phyug po nor phyir 'brangs la las 'phro med:

gsang sngags gshe skur mkhan la las 'phro med: 'phro mtha' yod pa'i skal ldan rnam pa gsum: 'di phyi pad 'byung khyed shes las 'phro yod: 'khor ba phyi phyag 'tshal la las 'phro yod: smon lam bzang pos rgyas thebs las 'phro yod: las 'phro dge bas mthud cig rje 'bangs rnams: ma 'ongs smon lam dbang gis gter 'byin tshe: sa rtags lung bstan 'di ltar shar ba'i tshe: lo zlar ma 'da' gter 'byin rten 'brel sgrigs: gter kha phye nas skal ldan mang po la: spel nas 'gro ba yongs la go bar gyis: ma 'ongs blo rmongs 'ch-ing ba yang yang grol: bshad pa'i tshig kyang go ba rag las pa'i: 'bad par i byos 'di phyi'i don la gnyer: long med blo sna btung dgos dus gcig go: kha dkar gting srin can la blo ma 'dri: g.yo can khrel med grogs kyi ngo ma srungs: 'khrid ba mjug mthud can gyi zas ma za: rang mthong khengs sems can la dam ma sbrel: mi 'grub kha po can la re ma bca': gdams ngag nor 'dod can la dpe ma bstan: zob po mi chos mkhan la kha ma gtam: gdams ngag g.yo sgyu can la chos ma 'chad: dred po phyi bshol mkhan la gnad ma bslab: grogs ngan mi yi rgya ma yin pa'i phyir: snying gtam mi bya shi ba'i ro la sbos: rten 'brel lam ni chos mthun byed las rnams: mi la mi bshad bdud dbang shor dag 'ga': snga phyi med pa mi rgod gcig rgyug bzhin: gang 'grigs legs nyes de thog yo lang sbyor: skyid shog sdug shog pad 'byung khyed rang shes: kha gting med pa'i skyo bas nga la bos: the tshom med na bdag gis bslu mi 'gyur: da lta nas bzung snga phyir 'byung gyur kun: gang 'dul der ston tshigs bcad zhal gdams 'di: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal mkha' 'gro'i brda ru thob: dpal gyi mchims phur mi nub ā thaṃ rgya: ma 'ongs las can bu la sprod cig gnyer: gza' klu rgyal po khyed rnams tha tshig skyongs: sa ma ya: de yang sbas yul 'grim pa'i cha rkyen lam gyi bar chad sel ba dang :

lha srin la bka' sgo sngon gyi tha tshig bsgrags par bgyis pa la thog mar: sngon 'gro'i dkyil 'khor thams cad so so'i gzhung ltar sgrub dgos gzhir bcas shing : nye lam tha tshig 'di yi don du gnyer pa'i rim pa ni: gzhi dkar gtsang gi steng du 'bru yi pad 'dab bcu drug bkod: de yi steng du tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bshams: 'dab ma rnams su yang tshogs chung bshams: gzhan yang tshogs rdzas kyi rigs phun sum tshogs par bya: mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes kyi gtor ma zhig kyang bshams: mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i tsakli dang nyi ma 'od zer gyi tsakli bcas gzugs so: mdun du gtor mchod sna tshogs bshams: dkar gtor bcu gser skyems mda' dar lnga 'bru phud sna tshogs: gzhan yang mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i rig ldan rgyan can bcas: thog mar gser skyems gtong ba ni: gser skyems dang dkar gtor rnams rim bzhin phud bcas mchod cing lha bswau dang sbrags nas: steng 'og phyogs bcur gtor: om̐ āḥhūm̐: zhes gsum gyis byin rlabs bya: de nas 'bul ba ni: thog mar rang gi lha gzhung sogs yul lha so sor kha bsngos bya ba'i rjes su: hūm̐: nga ni rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma 'byung : nga ni sngags 'chang nyi ma 'od zer te: nga yi bka' la mi nyan gang yang med: bden pa'i tshig la mi sems gang yang med: zab mo'i don la mi dgongs gang yang med: skye 'gro rlung gis mi zin gang yang med: ye shes 'od kyis mi khyab gang yang med: de bas dkon mchog bden pa'i tshig 'di la: snang srid lha srin sde brgyad kun gyis nyon: rin chen gser skyems gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sbas yul rin chen gter gyi sgo mo phyes: hūm̐: mgon chen sde lnga bya rog gdong can dang : zhing skyong dpal 'bar yab yum sde brgyad dang : drang srong gza' mchog dpal ldan dbyings phyug bcas: rdo rje legs pa btsan rgod klu bdud che: chos skyong rgyal po dpe har dkor gyi bdag:

gter bdag klu yi dge bsnyen mthu bo che: dregs sde skyong ba'i srung ma 'khor bcas kyis: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: gter gyi sgo dang sbas yul lam phyes shig: hūm̐: tshangs pa gdong bzhi khyab 'jug sgra gcan rlung : lha chen ma hā de wa u ma de: gnod sbyin nag mo khyo med glog 'phreng ma: khyad par lha chen brgyad dang gnyan chen brgyad: klu chen brgyad dang gza' chen 'gyu ba brgyad: dbang phyug ma brgyad gnas don ma mo brgyad: 'bar ma brgyad dang pho nya drug cu bzhi: 'jigs byed dgu dang dpal mgon bdun cu lnga: bod khams skyong ba'-i brtan ma bcu gnyis dang : rje yi mgur lha byes ky-i 'brang lha dang : phyi nang gsang ba'i lha srin sde brgyad dang : rtag chags yul skyong dregs sde bco brgyad dang : sngags bdag sde dpon sum cu rtsa gnyis sogs: hal khyi dus 'dzin lo zla 'khor ba'i tshogs: khyad par yul ri'i gzhi bdag gnyan po dang : da lo deng zhag de ring nyi ma la: gnas pa'i sa bdag klu gnyan gzhi bdag rnams: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: sbas gnas lam sol gter gyi sgo mo phyes: pha nor bus len khyed kyis bdag ma bzung : bcol ba'i las dang btsong ba'i rin bzhin du: bdag gis len nas spyod pa'i dus la bab: lha srung gzhi bdag gnyan pos phrin las sgrubs: yon bdag rogs dan mthun rkyen 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: steng phyogs lha dang gnod sbyin tshangs pa dang : shar phyogs dri za grul bum mi'am ci: rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung la sogs: shar phyogs skyong ba'i lha srin sde brgyad rnams: rin chen dkar gtor gser skyems 'di bzhes la: shar phyogs sbas pa'i gter dang sgo mo phyes: kha char la sogs lam gyi 'jigs pa sol: hūm̐: lho phyogs me lha gshin rje rlung gi lha: rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po la sogs: lho phyogs skyong ba'i lha srin sde brgyad rnams:

rin chen dkar gtor gser skyems 'di bzhes la: shar phyogs sbas pa'i gter dang sgo mo phyes: kha char la sogs lam gyi 'jigs pa sol: hūm̐: nub phyogs klu dbang gnod sbyin mi ma yin: rgyal po chen po spyan mi bzang la sogs: nub phyogs skyong ba'i lha srin sde brgyad rnams: rin chen dkar gtor gser skyems 'di bzhes la: nub phyogs sbas pa'i gter dang sgo mo phyes: kha char la sogs lam gyi 'jigs pa sol: hūm̐: byang phyogs bgegs dang dbang ldan sa bdag bcas: rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras la sogs: byang phyogs skyong ba'i lha srin sde brgyad rnams: rin chen dkar gtor gser skyems 'di bzhes la: byang phyogs sbas pa'i gnas dang gter sgo phyes: kha char la sogs lam gyi 'jigs pa sol: hūm̐: rgya gar rdo rje gdan drung du: chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas su: mu stegs thams cad dam la btags: mdo sngags bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs: nga ni slob dpon de yi gdung : khyed ni dregs pa de yi rigs: sngon gyi khas blangs dam ma bcag: hūm̐: rgya gar bod yul sa mtshams su: chu mig byang chub ring mo ru: rgya bod gnyis kyi lha 'dre 'thab: sde brgyad cho 'phrul byung ba'i tshe: phur pa rnam gsum gdeng tshad thob: nga ni slob dpon de yi gdung : khyed ni dregs pa de yi rigs: sngon gyi khas blangs dam ma bcag: hūm̐: de 'og a su ra yi brag: gnod sbyin spun gsum dam la btags: drag sngags shān+tiṃ ghar+bha dngos: nga ni slob dpon de yi gdung : khyed ni dregs pa de yi rigs: sngon gyi khas blangs dam ma bcag: hūm̐: de 'og spa gro stag tshang du: dregs sde sum cu dam la bzhag: stag zhon sbrul gyi gdengs ka can: nga ni slob dpon de yi gdung : khyed ni dregs pa de yi rigs: sngon gyi khas blangs dam ma bcag: hūm̐: de 'og bal bod gnyis kyi mtshams: brtan ma bcu gnyis dam la bzhag: mu stegs sgrol ba'i dam bca' phul:

nga ni slob dpon de yi gdung : khyed ni dregs pa de yi rigs: sngon gyi khas blangs dam ma bcag: hūm̐: de 'og gung thang la thog tu: sde brgyad thams cad dam la bzhag: dge slong bzhi la dngos grub gnang : nga ni slob dpon de yi gdung : khyed ni dregs pa de yi rigs: sngon gyi khas blangs dam ma bcag: hūm̐: de 'og kha la rong gi gong : ma yams thams cad dam la bzhag: rdo rje'i phyag rtags rdzu 'phrul 'gyed: nga ni slob dpon de yi gdung : khyed ni dregs pa de yi rigs: sngon gyi khas blangs dam ma bcag: hūm̐: de 'og gtsang rong nag po ru: the'u rang thams cad dam la bzhag: 'gong po spun dgu tshar yang bcad: bran du khas blangs tha tshig phul: nga ni slob dpon de yi gdung : khyed ni dregs pa de yi rigs: sngon gyi khas blangs dam ma bcag: hūm̐: de 'og shang gi g.yag sde ru: rdo rje legs pa dam la bzhag: phyag mtshan rdo rje phyag tu phul: nga ni slob dpon de yi gdung : khyed ni dregs pa de yi rigs: sngon gyi khas blangs dam ma bcag: hūm̐: de 'og dpal mo dpal thang du: thang lha yar bzhud dam la bzhag: klu yi 'tsho ba sna tshogs phul: nga ni slob dpon de yi gdung : khyed ni dregs pa de yi rigs: sngon gyi khas blangs dam ma bcag: hūm̐: de 'og 'dam shod snye mo ru: gangs dkar sha med dam la bzhag: gnam lcags rdo rje thog ltar phab: nga ni slob dpon de yi gdung : khyed ni dregs pa de yi rigs: sngon gyi khas blangs dam ma bcag: hūm̐: de 'og mang ri dpal 'bar ru: yar lha sham po dam la bzhag: lha rabs skyong ba'i g.yar dam phog: nga ni slob dpon de yi gdung : khyed ni dregs pa de yi rigs: sngon gyi khas blangs dam ma bcag: hūm̐: de 'og gnam mtsho'i sgrub gnas su: mal gro gzi chen dam la btags: dge bsnyen kun gyi srog snying phul: nga ni slob dpon de yi gdung : khyed ni dregs pa de yi rigs: sngon gyi khas blangs dam ma bcag:

hūm̐: 'phan yul sprel gyi lha khang du: srin po he pa dam la bzhag: rak+sha mi 'gyur dam bca' phul: nga ni slob dpon de yi gdung : khyed ni dregs pa de yi rigs: sngon gyi khas blangs dam ma bcag: hūm̐: de 'og sgrags kyi yang rdzong du: mgur lha bcu gsum dam la bzhag: bod khams bstan pa skyong bar bskos: nga ni slob dpon de yi gdung : khyed ni dregs pa de yi rigs: sngon gyi khas blangs dam ma bcag: hūm̐: bsam yas has po ri rtse ru: dgongs pa me 'bar mtsho la gtad: gtsug na rin chen dam la bzhag: nga ni slob dpon de yi gdung : khyed ni dregs pa de yi rigs: sngon gyi khas blangs dam ma bcag: hūm̐: de 'og mchims phu'i brag dmar du: sde brgyad yongs rdzogs dam la bzhag: bsam yas chos 'khor lhun gyis grub: nga ni slob dpon de yi gdung : khyed ni dregs pa de yi rigs: sngon gyi khas blangs dam ma bcag: hūm̐: de 'og khams kyi g.yar mo thang : a mye bya thul dam la bzhag: rgya dang khams kyi sa mtshams gnyer: nga ni slob dpon de yi gdung : khyed ni dregs pa de yi rigs: sngon gyi khas blangs dam ma bcag: hūm̐: de 'og rong chen gnas bzhi ru: dge bsnyen bco brgyad dam la btags: sbas yul thams cad skyong bar gnyer: nga ni slob dpon de yi gdung : khyed ni dregs pa de yi rigs: sngon gyi khas blangs dam ma bcag: hūm̐: de 'og snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus: mtha' bzhi'i 'dre rgod dam la btags: sbas gnas sgo 'byed gter kha bzhag: nga ni slob dpon de yi gdung : khyed ni dregs pa de yi rigs: sngon gyi khas blangs dam ma bcag: hūm̐: rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi: snga phyi thog mtha' tha tshig bdun: bcu gsum bar du yang bskyar gyis: gnas dang rang rang gnas mchog nas: lha srin sde brgyad dam la btags: gter gnas so so'i srung mar bskos: de ltar gnyer gtad dam bzhag bzhin: dkar gtor-gser skyems gnyan po bzhes:

rin chen gter gyi sgo mo phyes: nam mkha' nyi zla mthong lam phyes: lam 'phrang ri rtse sgau mo phyes: chu gru rtsa lam sgo mo phyes: gcan 'phrang lam gyi sgo mo phyes: gar 'gro lam gyi 'phrang ring sgrol: lha 'dre mi gsum yon bdag sgrubs: bar chod ja chom za kha chings: dgra sdang 'gyu ba lam log byol: sngags 'chang pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi: bka' sgos g.yar dam gnyan po bzhin: de ring rig 'dzin rjes 'jug gis: sbas gnas gter sgo phye ba la: lha srin sde brgyad rogs dan sgrubs: hūm̐: khyad par srung ma dam tshig can: ye shes mgon po lcam dral dang : legs ldan zhing skyong seṅge'i gdong : drang srong gza' mchog rā hu la: gnod sbyin btsan rgod me 'od gdong : dkor bdag rgyal po dpe ha ra: klu yi dge bsnyen myur mgyogs can: lha btsan rdo rje 'bar ba sogs: dregs sde chos skyong mthu chen rnams: rin chen gser skyems 'di bzhes la: rig 'dzin bdag gi phrin las sgrubs: la chu 'phrang la sgrol 'don gyis: ka cha dkor nor phyi la rgyugs: dgra rkun jag chom dbang po snubs: sngags 'chang bdag la dgra sdang na: srung ma thams cad ra mdar sbran: pha rol dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: snang srid lha 'dre mi gsum rnams: rnal 'byor bdag gi dbang du sdus: ka cha dkor nor gnyer kha skyongs: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod:

ces pas dkar gtor dang gser skyems bsang mchod bcas 'bul: phrin las rang gzhung ci mos bya: 'di nyid sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen shin tu do gal che: khyad par gnad dang lam zhugs thams cad la bzang : sa ma ya: lha bskyed pa ni: hūm̐ bh+rūm̐: rang nyid skad cig pad zla'i gdan steng du: hūm̐ las rje btsun nyi ma 'od zer sku: dmar ser bram gzugs he ru ka yi chas: khro 'dzum nyams ldan phyed skyil rol stabs can: rus rgyan stag sham phyag g.yas nyi zer bsnams: g.yon pas bhan+dha kha ṭ+wāṃ gru mor brten: rnal 'byor spyod pa'i lugs la 'khril ba'i yum: bde chen dpa' mo 'od zer can ma ni: dmar mo khro gnyer rnam rol zim bu'i mdangs: skra grol thor tshugs lhag mas sku rgyab kheb: rigs lnga dar dpyangs cod pan na ra ra: phyag g.yas mda' dar g.yon pas me long 'dzin: rus pa'i rgyan dang rin chen phreng bas spras: zung 'jug zhabs gnyis bde chen yab la 'khyud: yab yum sku la ye shes gzi 'bar bsgom: phyogs bzhi dkar ser dmar ljang mkha' 'gro bzhi: rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las kyi rigs: phyag g.yas thams cad mda' dar me long thogs: g.yon pas rang rang sgo chas lde mig mtshon: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem lang tsho bcu drug ldan: bde ba'i nyams ldan gar stabs ling nger bzhugs: phyi rol mu mtha' mdun gyi sa gzhi ru: lha srin sde brgyad gzhi bdag ma lus kyis: gus 'dud phyag dang mchod 'bul bskor bar bskyed: mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas kyi khor yug tu: pad+ma 'byung gnas snang srid zil gnon tshul: de la mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas: gsal snang ma 'dres dkyil 'khor 'ja' ltar shar: stong pa'i sku la snang ba'i cho 'phrul g.yo: dpag med sprin bzhin bun long lta bur g.yo: de la bdag dang 'gro drug sems can gyis: gsol btab mos gus rtse gcig gus par bsam : 'di skabs bar chad lam sel 'don pa ni: hūm̐: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byin brlabs las:

snang mtha'i sprul pa 'gro ba'i mgon: rgya gar sku 'khrungs 'gro don mdzad: bod yul lha srin dam la btags: bsam yas ma bzhengs lhun gyis grub: rgyal po'i dgongs pa mtha' ru phyin: lho nub srin po'i kha gnon mdzad: thugs rje'i nyi ma bod la shar: yar ngo tshes bcur mngon sum mjal: skal ldan bu la lung bstan mdzad: 'gro don dgongs pa rgyun chad med: drin can bla ma sprul pa'i sku: o rgyan gu ru rin po che: thugs rjes bdag la byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur stsol: phyi nang gsang gsum bar chad sol: zad med gter la longs spyod pa'i: bdag la dngos grub stsal du gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ru sūr+ya rasmi de wi swa ra swā ti ha ri ni sa pā shaṃ sid+dhi hūm̐: hūm̐: de nas 'dzam gling gangs can du: chos kyi bstan pa btsugs mdzad tshe: gu ru yid bzhin nor bu'i sku: bdud 'dul sngags pa'i cha lugs can: shān+tiṃ ghar+bha mngon spyod tshul: rdo rje phyar zhing phur bu bsgril: gnam lcags sdig pa'i sprul pa 'gyed: bdud dang mu stegs dam la btags: drin can bla ma sprul pa'i sku: o rgyan gu ru rin po che: thugs rjes bdag la byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur stsol: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol: zad med gter la longs spyod pa'i: bdag la dngos grub stsal du gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ru sūr+ya rasmi de wi swa ra swā ti ha ri ni sa pā shaṃ sid+dhi hūm̐: hūm̐: rgya gar rdo rje gdan drung du: chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas su: mu stegs thams cad dam la btags: mdo sngags bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs: drin can bla ma sprul pa'i sku: o rgyan gu ru rin po che: thugs rjes bdag la byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur stsol: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol: zad med gter la longs spyod pa'i:

bdag la dngos grub stsal du gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ru sūr+ya rasmi de wi swa ra swā ti ha ri ni sa pā shaṃ sid+dhi hūm̐: hūm̐: rgya gar bal bod sa mtshams su: chu mig byang chub ring mo ru: rgya bod gnyis kyi lha 'dre 'thab: sde brgyad cho 'phrul byung ba'i tshe: phur pa rnam gsum gdeng tshad thob: drin can bla ma sprul pa'i sku: o rgyan gu ru rin po che: thugs rjes bdag la byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur stsol: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol: zad med gter la longs spyod pa'i: bdag la dngos grub stsal du gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ru sūr+ya rasmi de wi swa ra swā ti ha ri ni sa pā shaṃ sid+dhi hūm̐: hūm̐: de 'og a su ra yi brag: gnod sbyin spun gsum dam la btags: drag sngags shān+tiṃ ghar+bha dngos: drin can bla ma sprul pa'i sku: o rgyan gu ru rin po che: thugs rjes bdag la byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur stsol: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol: zad med gter la longs spyod pa'i: bdag la dngos grub stsal du gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ru sūr+ya rasmi de wi swa ra swā ti ha ri n-i sa pā shaṃ sid+dhi hūm̐: hūm̐: de 'og spa gro stag tshang du: dregs sde sum cu dam la btags: stag zhon sbrul gyi gdengs ka can: drin can bla ma sprul pa'i sku: o rgyan gu ru rin po che: thugs rjes bdag la byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur stsol: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol: zad med gter la longs spyod pa'i: bdag la dngos grub stsal du gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ru sūr+ya rasmi de wi swa ra swā ti ha ri n-i sa pā shaṃ sid+dhi hūm̐: hūm̐: de 'og bal bod mtshams kyi gnas: brtan ma bcu gnyis dam la btags: mu stegs sgrol ba'i dam bca' bzhag:

gu ru sūr+ya rasmi de wi swa ra swā ti ha ri n-i sa pā shaṃ sid+dhi hūm̐: hūm̐: de 'og shang gi g.yag sde ru: rdo rje legs pa dam la btags: phyag mtshan rdo rje phyag tu phul: drin can bla ma sprul pa'i sku: o rgyan gu ru rin po che: thugs rjes bdag la byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur stsol: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol: zad med gter la longs spyod pa'i: bdag la dngos grub stsal du gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ru sūr+ya rasmi de wi swa ra swā ti ha ri ni sa pā shaṃ sid+dhi hūm̐: hūm̐: de 'og dpal mo dpal thang du: thang lha yar bzhud dam la btags: klu yis 'tsho ba sna tshogs phul: drin can bla ma sprul pa'i sku: o rgyan gu ru rin po che: thugs rjes bdag la byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur stsol: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol: zad med gter la longs spyod pa'i: bdag la dngos grub stsal du gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ru sūr+ya rasmi de wi swa ra swā ti ha ri n-i sa pā shaṃ sid+dhi hūm̐: hūm̐: de 'og 'dam shod snye mo ru: gangs dkar sha med dam la btags: gnam lcags rdo rje thog ltar phab: drin can bla ma sprul pa'i sku: o rgyan gu ru rin po che: thugs rjes bdag la byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur stsol: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol: zad med gter la longs spyod pa'i: bdag la dngos grub stsal du gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ru sūr+ya rasmi de wi swa ra swā ti ha ri n-i sa pā shaṃ sid+dhi hūm̐: hūm̐: de 'og mang ri dpal 'bar ru: yar lha sham po dam la btags: lha rabs skyong ba'i g.yar dam phog: drin can bla ma sprul pa'i sku: o rgyan gu ru rin po che: thugs rjes bdag la byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur stsol: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol:

o rgyan gu ru rin po che: thugs rjes bdag la byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur stsol: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol: zad med gter la longs spyod pa'i: bdag la dngos grub stsal du gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ru sūr+ya rasmi de wi swa ra swā ti ha ri n-i sa pā shaṃ sid+dhi hūm̐: hūm̐: de 'og mchims phu'i brag dmar du: sde brgyad yongs rdzogs dam la btags: bsam yas chos 'khor lhun gyis grub: drin can bla ma sprul pa'i sku: o rgyan gu ru rin po che: thugs rjes bdag la byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur stsol: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol: zad med gter la longs spyod pa'i: bdag la dngos grub stsal du gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ru sūr+ya rasmi de wi swa ra swā ti ha ri n-i sa pā shaṃ sid+dhi hūm̐: hūm̐: de 'og khams kyi g.yar mo thang : a mye bya thul dam la btags: rgya dang khams kyi sa mtshams gnyer: drin can bla ma sprul pa'i sku: o rgyan gu ru rin po che: thugs rjes bdag la byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur stsol: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol: zad med gter la longs spyod pa'i: bdag la dngos grub stsal du gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ru sūr+ya rasmi de wi swa ra swā ti ha ri n-i sa pā shaṃ sid+dhi hūm̐: hūm̐: de 'og rong chen gnas bzhi ru: dge bsnyen bco brgyad dam la btags: sbas yul thams cad skyong bar gnyer: drin can bla ma sprul pa'i sku: o rgyan gu ru rin po che: thugs rjes bdag la byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur stsol: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol: zad med gter la longs spyod pa'i: bdag la dngos grub stsal du gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ru sūr+ya rasmi de wi swa ra swā ti ha ri n-i sa pā shaṃ sid+dhi hūm̐:

hūm̐: de 'og snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus: mtha' bzhi'i 'dre rgod dam la btags: sbas gnas sgo 'byed gter kha bzhag: drin can bla ma sprul pa'i sku: o rgyan gu ru rin po che: thugs rjes bdag la byin gyis rlobs: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur stsol: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol: zad med gter la longs spyod pa'i: bdag la dngos grub stsal du gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ru sūr+ya rasmi de wi swa ra swā ti ha ri n-i sa pā shaṃ sid+dhi hūm̐: hūm̐: rje btsun 'gro mgon pad+ma 'byung : dbyings phyug bde chen mtsho rgyal sogs: rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yis: 'di nas tshe rabs thams cad du: 'bral ba med par rjes bzung nas: rtag tu chos la spyod pa dang : rigs ldan gtsang ma'i lus thob nas: zag med bde bas 'tsho bar shog: rtag tu ngan 'gro'i las spangs shing : skye dgur chos char 'bebs pa yis: gzhan don mtha' ru phyin gyur cig: om̐ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: gu ru sūr+ya rasmi de wi swa ra swā ti ha ri n-i sa pā shaṃ sid+dhi hūm̐: rjes shes bsngo smon ci rigs bya: bkra shis dkyil 'khor ci sgrub kyang : tha tshig 'di nyid sngon du gces: mtha' ru nyi ma 'od zer nyid: rang snang stong pa'i mkha' ru bsdu: dmigs med chos skur mnyam par bzhag: sa ma ya: bka' yi rgya 'di gnyer ba yi: lha srin sde brgyad ma lus kun: gsang sngags gnyan gyi mel tshe mdzod: pad zhwa'i cod pan 'dzin rnams kyi: chos srid bstan pa rgyas gyur cig: thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog:

gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: mi nub rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos sa khyi lor brag dmar mchims phu'i dge'u gong ke'u tshang nas gdan drangs shing lcags phag lor mdo khams bkra shis zal mo'i sgang rgyud kyi tshal gter bdag klu yi pho brang gi nye 'dabs nang chen rgyal po'i pho brang rdo rje'i rwa ba gur gyi rnal 'byor 'dra ba ru shog ser nas phab pa'o// // na) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: rin chen gter sgo 'byed pa mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs bde chen dpa' mo'i rol rtsed bzhugs so: yid bzhin nor mchog bde gshegs kun 'dus la: rnal 'byor gang zhig gter la spyod pa'i tshe: sde brgyad cho 'phrul mi min 'jigs pa dang : mkha' 'gro'i gsang rgya mi phyed yi mug tshe: dam tshig zol zog med pa'i dpa' gdeng gis: yid gnyis the tshom med par gsol ba 'debs: nga nyid yi dam lha dang dbyer med pas: pha nor bu yis lon par the tshom med: o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: legs par gdams so nga yi rjes 'jug rnams: sa ma ya: zhes pa 'di yi sgrub khog bca' gzhi ni: gzhi ma dkyil 'khor bkra shis dge: nyi ma tshes grangs bzang ba'i dus: yang na lung bstan skabs dag tu: dus tshod ring thung rig pas dpag: ring na dkyil 'khor bca' gzhi bkod: thung na rig mar dkyil 'khor bkod: bskyed chog dran rdzogs wal gyis gsal: phebs pa'i dus ni tshes bzang la: bkra shis dge ba bya ba'i gnas: rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi med pa'i sar: rten 'brel dang bcas 'bebs par bya: spel ba la yang de bzhin te: yang na gang shar rten 'brel btags: rten 'brel brtag tshe spang blang dor: ya kha 'jigs na rten 'brel min: de ni gnas skabs zhal gdams so: shin tu dgos pa'i las rim las: gsang ba bde chen mkha' 'gro yi:

dkyil 'khor dag la 'bad pa ni: dkar gtsang gzhi la ras bris sam: shog bu'am ni 'bru tshom la: 'dab bzhi dbus lnga byas nas su: dbus su bhan+dha kha chod can: nang mchod byams gnyis tshang bar bya: bum pa shel phreng me long dang : gtor ma bcas pa tshom bur bzhag: mda' dar lnga dang rin chen bcas: tshogs rdzas mchod sprin spyi mthun bsham: rig ma bcu drug lnga'am gsum: rigs lnga dang bcas rgyan bkod byas: khrus bstsal spos dang dri bzang gtams: 'byung lnga'i dwangs ma so sor blang : de yang gzhi dkar steng du bzhag: thog mar gser skyems tshar lnga btang : gter nas so sor kha bsngos bya: de nas dngos gzhir 'jug pa ni: mchod rdzas 'bags bsang gtsang chu 'thor: rang nyid bde ba'i gnas la 'khod: mda' dar 'bru phud rig mar gtad: rol mo dbyangs dang bcas nas su: dkyil 'khor dal du 'jug par bya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: hoḥ na mo bla ma rigs 'dus rtsa ba gsum: sku lnga mtshan brgyad o rgyan rin po che: dbang drag khro bo badz+ra lo ha he: grub thob rgyal po stag zhon sprul pa'i sku: ḍāk+ki'i gtso bo dpa' mo he ru kar: bdag dang dbyer med gus pas skyabs su mchi: zhes lan gsum mam bdun tsam brjod: de nas mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: om̐ āḥhūm̐: gsum: hūm̐: phyi nang mchod sprin dpag yas nam mkha'i khyon: yongs su 'gengs pa rgyal ba mnyes pa'i rdzas: zab lam bde chen bsgrub pa'i ngo bor gsal: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da ā hūm̐: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta pū dza āḥhūm̐: de nas skad cig dran rdzogs lha bskyed pa ni: hūm̐ bh+rūm̐: hrīḥm ha ri ni sa bh+yo bh+yo bh+yoḥ hūm̐ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ dzaḥ hrīḥm: hūm̐ bh+yo: sa bon phyag mtshan gnas 'gyur dran rdzogs su: pho brang rdo rje bh+rūm̐ gyur e yi dbus: pad nyi gdan la stag mo grus ma'i steng :

dmar nag dbang sdud rdo rje gro bo lod: he ru ka pa'i rnam 'gyur 'gying stabs can: rgyan drug gtum nyams dpa' bo dpa' ba'i chas: phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas phur bu gdeng : sdigs mdzub rtse la sdig pa'i sprul pa 'gyed: spyi bor rigs bdag pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: dbyings phyug gsang ye dang bcas gsal bar bsgom: gtso bo'i phyogs bzhir pad 'dab rim pa bzhin: rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las kyi rigs: rang mdog khro 'dzum rus pa'i rgyan drug mdzes: phyag g.yas so so'i phyag mtshan mda' dar bsnams: g.yon pas bhan+dha bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis gtams: brkyang bskum 'gying bag gar gyi nyams ldan bsgom: de yi phyi rol bka' gter srung ma yi: gter gyi rgya bkrol sgo dbye gus par bskyed: de ltar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis: rnga yab zhing dang dpal ri'i pho brang nas: pad 'byung mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas pa: spyan drangs dza hūm̐ bam̐ ho phaiṃ phaiṃ dzaḥ de nas spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal mchod pa ni: hūm̐: gling gi gling mchog lho nub rnga yab gling : laṅka mgrin bcu srin po'i pho brang nas: che btsan khro bo gtum chen g.yul las rgyal: ma sring ḍāk+ki rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs: chags bral pad nyi'i khri 'phang gdan la bzhugs: sgrub mchog gter la spyod phyir brtan par satwaṃ: mnga' bdag dregs pa'i rje la gus pa yis: gdung bas phyag bgyi mos pas rab tu bstod: lha mchog lha la mchod pa'i bye brag ni: phyi mchod lha mo bcu drug mnyes pa'i sprin: nang mchod sman raka bdud rtsi sbyor ba'i rdzas: gsang mchod dbyangs snyan sbyor ba'i dza na mo: bsgral mchod bha ling+ta dang dbang po lnga: snang srid 'di ru ci srid bsdus pa'i tshogs: rtsa gsum kun 'dus dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: bzhes nas rin chen gter gyi dngos grub stsol:

sku gsung thugs kyi brda sgo klong du phyes: 'byung lnga drwa ba'i rgya chings dgrol du gsol: 'jigs brgyad zhi zhing las bzhi'i dngos grub stsol: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: om̐ na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ om̐ a bhe sha ya a āḥ om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da pū dza āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi: ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la khā hi: om̐ ma hā bha ling+ta te dz+wa bha ling+ta bha la bha te gu h+ya sa ma ya ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na kha kha khā h-i: de nas bstod pa ni: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ snang srid thams cad drag po e yi klong : ma skyes gsal rdzogs dran rig ngo bo hūm̐: rang bzhin ngang gis khros pa khro bo'i rgyal: bla ma drag po rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: badz+ra lo ha dmar nag he ru kaḥ dregs sde 'dul byed dpa' bo stag zhon ni: gtum pa'i shugs las khros pa'i am gtsigs bsdams: dus mtha'i me ltar dbu skra kham nag bsigs: thod skam 'bar ba'i rgyan ldan dar dpyangs 'phur: spyan rtsa 'khyil zhing sma ra smin ma gzengs: phyag g.yas gnam lcags rdo rje rtse dgu las: hūm̐ dgu phaṭ dgu ram̐ dgu'i tshwa tshwa 'phros: phyag g.yon las phur za byed sdig pa la: bh+yo dgu rbad dgu ram̐ dgu'i zi ra 'khyugs: rus rgyan stag sham thod rlon phreng ba 'dren: rin chen wang long phyag zhabs gdub bu 'khrol: stag mo grus ma'i steng na dor thabs bzhugs: sku las gzi byin me dpung lnga ldan 'khrigs: khro rgyal rdo rje srin por phyag 'tshal bstod: hrīḥmūm̐: rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug bde ba'i gar: pad+ma thod phreng dbang gi bdag nyid che: rdo rje bhan+dha bsnams shing phyed skyil bzhugs: sgeg pa'i nyams ldan rnal 'byor cha shas rdzogs: dbyings phyug mthing nag zag med bde bas 'khyud: gti mug rnam dag chos dbyings dpal lha mo: sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i thugs rjes bar chad sel:

dga' bzhi 'khor lo ye shes mdangs kyis g.yo: rol pa'i dga' ston 'gyed la phyag 'tshal bstod: bh+yoḥ bzhin bzang lha mo zhi ba'i phrin las sku: zhe sdang rnam dag me long ngo bo nyid: rdo rje mkha' 'gros sku yi bar chad sel: dkar mo 'bum gyi gtso mo shar phyogs bdag: byams pa'i 'od zer 'gyed la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: sgeg mo lha mo rgyas pa'i phrin las sku: nga rgyal rnam dag mnyam nyid ngo bo nyid: rin chen mkha' 'gros yon tan bar chad sel: ser mo 'bum gyi gtso mo lho phyogs bdag: snying rje'i 'od zer 'gyed la phyag 'tshal bstod: bh+yoḥ chags pa'i lha mo dbang gi phrin las sku: 'dod chags rnam dag sor rtog ngo bo nyid: pad+ma mkha' 'gros gsung gi bar chad sel: dmar mo 'bum gyi gtso mo nub phyogs bdag: dga' ba'i 'od zer 'gyed la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: dgyes pa'i lha mo drag mo phrin las sku: phrag dog rnam dag bya grub ngo bo nyid: karma mkha' 'gros phrin las bar chad sel: ljang mo 'bum gyi gtso mo byang phyogs bdag: btang snyoms 'od zer 'gyed la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ pad+ma thod phreng mtsho skyes rdo rje sku: dbyings phyug bzang mo lha lcam man+da ra: dmar nag gtum po rdo rje gro bo lod: stag mo grus ma bhi na sa yi sprul: mkha' 'gro sde bzhi ye shes mtsho rgyal dang : ka la sid+dhi shākya de ma dang : bkra shis khye'u 'dren bcas pa rtsa gsum lha: dngos grub zad med gter la spyod pa yi: pad 'byung yi dam khyed nyid dgongs su gsol: o rgyan chen po tshe rabs bla ma nyid: dpa' bo me phreng sgrub pa'i yi dam lha: rdo rje phag mo tshe rabs gtan gyi yum: mkha' 'gro sde lnga bsten srid rig ma mchog: rtsa gsum lha tshogs bdag la byin gyis rlobs: om̐ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: om̐ pad+ma rā dza pā shaṃ sa mā ya dza mūm̐ bud+dha ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa sid+dhi pha la hūm̐:

om̐ badz+ra kro dha lo ha tsaṇ+ḍa sarba bi na ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥswā hā: om̐ baṃ badz+ra bha ra hi badz+ra ḍāk+ki nī hūm̐: om̐ rat+na ḍāk+ki nī hūm̐: om̐ pad+ma ḍāk+ki nī hūm̐: om̐ karma ḍāk+ki nī hūm̐: om̐ bi shwa ḍāk+ki nī hūm̐: om̐ ke kā+au ri pad+ma mu ṭa rā ga he sha ḍāk+ki nī pā shaṃ sarba thun thun dza dza swā hā: zhes rtsa sngags rnams rim bzhin bzlas: las sngags sham bu kha tshar sbyar: gter kha 'byin dgos sngon nas 'gyang tsam lung bstan byung na mkha' 'gro'i cho ga dang bde gshegs kun 'dus sbrags nas sgrub pa zhag lnga bdun gsum mam ci lcogs bya: 'phral du yin na nyin chog bya: gter sgrub skabs yin na gang 'grub bya: sngags rnams bum chu la yang sbyar: mda' dar la sngags: rin chen sna tshogs blo rten 'chang : de nas gter gnas la chas pa'i tshe: rig ma rnams rgyan gyis spras la byin 'bebs bya: dby-ings kyi mkha' 'gro'i dngos grub brnyes: bar chad kyis mi tshugs pa'i srung 'khor bsgom: gter kha gdan drangs nas dbang bzhi yis rgyud smin pa'i smon lam bzang po bya: khyad par sgrub khog gang dag 'di nyid dang 'brel ba rab yin: ma 'grigs kyang sku gsung thugs kyi gter kha 'byed pa la lan gcig mjal bas: rnga yab dag pa'i zhing du rje btsun pad+ma 'byung gnas zhal mngon sum mthong zhing lung thob nas zhing khams sam chos pa rnams phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro: ci'i phyir rin chen sgrom bu las: e ma: bdag gis gter rgya gdams pa'i gnas mchog 'di: rkang pa bslebs tsam ngan 'gro'i skye sgo chod: gter rgya zhal 'byed mthong thos dran rig rnams: gnas ngan spangs nas bde chen dag zhing du: pad 'byung bdag dang mjal bar the tshom med: 'di nyid spel sgrub 'dzin 'chang klog pa'i yul: lo legs bkra shis nad mug mtshon las thar: gter chos gar bzhugs yul du byin chen 'bebs: 'di nyid 'brel thob ldan pa'i sbyin bdag dang :

tshes bcu la sogs gter gyi grogs bgyid na: phyi ma rnga yab dpal rir skye bar 'gyur: smon lam btab pas yang sprul 'gro don mdzad: 'gro mang byang chub snying po'i lam mchog ston: sngon sbyangs 'phro mtha' bzang po myur du sad: rgyal ba nga yis mngon sum lung bstan 'gyur: zhes gsungs: de nas ma 'ongs skal ldan las can rnams: pad 'byung nga yi rjes 'jug mos pa bskyed: ci byed thams cad dam pa'i chos la dmigs: 'byor tshogs thams cad dge ba'i phyogs su thongs: ma rig 'khrul pa'i blo rgya ma che bar: tshod yod bag phebs rim blo'i sna thag btung : sang bya gnangs byed g.yeng ba'i rlung ma ldang : 'di phyi kun tu rig 'dzin bla mar mos: dge byed mkhan po bdud kyis blo bsgyur bas: 'di phyi 'phral phugs yang cha bgyis te bsgrub: skye 'chi'i mgon du bla ma rtsa gsum bzang : phyi bshol can 'di g.yeng ba'i bdud dang 'brel: skra la me shor bzhin tu phyi ches bsgrub: ces pa'i zhal gdams rjais 'brang rnams kyis longs: skal ldan las 'phro can gyis de ltar bgyid: sa ma ya: de nas gter kha rnams 'gyed skabs dga' ston gyi dbang bzhi len pa ni: sku gsung thugs rten gang yin la tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bshams: rang nyid khri kha ru 'khod: rig ma rnams tshogs 'khor gyi mdun du 'khod: skyes pa pho rnams g.yas gral bya: za ma mo rnams g.yon gral bya: thams cad kyis bsam pa lhun 'grub ma tshar gcig gam gsum 'don: tshogs 'khor la byin 'bebs bya: badz+ra gu ru'i gdangs dbyangs btang : de nas dbang bskur ba ni: rten rnams thogs te: hūm̐ hrīḥm: o rgyan mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing khams nas: pad+ma 'byung gnas bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku: rdo rje drag po mkha' 'gro kun gyi yab: dpa' bo dpa' mo rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i tshogs: mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rje skur bzhengs la: byin chen phob la dbang chen bskur du gsol:

'dir 'dus skal ldan las can pho mo rnams: rnga yab gling du yang yang 'tshogs pa yi: smon lam bslu med rten 'brel dbang bzhi stsol: gnas ri 'di dang gnas khang sgrub phug dang : bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor la: bkra shis dge legs 'grub pa'i dngos grub stsol: rig 'dzin sgrub la tshe chos zas nor dang : 'byor drug gos sogs snyan grags dbyar rnga ltar: sgrog cing dpal 'byor dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel zhing : gzi 'bar nyi 'od rab dkar zla rgyas ltar: rtag tu bkra shis rnam mang skar tshogs bzhin: 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol: om̐ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: sarba sid+dhi badz+ra pha la hoḥ zhes pas dbang dang dngos grub yang yang rol: de nas bkra shis rab gnas dang rten 'brel du mas mtshams sbyar: sa ma ya: ma 'ongs las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: them rgya: o rgyan rtsa gsum gl̥ng pa chos kyi rgya mtsho yis sa khyir lor bod yul bsam yas mchims phu nas gdan drangs shing lcags phag lor mdo khams sa yi lte ba nang chen khri gdung gi gdan sa ur 'gos su sprel zla ba la shog ser nas zhal bshus so/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // pa) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: sbas yul sgo 'byed o rgyan dpa' bo ging sgrub rin chen lde mig bzhugs so: bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs rtsa gsum lha: ye shes rol pa dbyer med nam mkha'i khyon: gang 'dul der ston mtsho skyes pad+ma 'byung : ma 'ongs dus su thugs rje'i nyi ma shar: rang byung bla ma'i zhal gdams gsol 'debs ni: gang phyir snyigs ma rtsod ldan dus kyi tshe: mtha' 'khob dmag gis bod 'bangs hab shar spyod: de dus sbas yul ma gtogs bde skyid zad: gang zhig sbas yul gnas bzhi bstan pa ni: shar du sbas yul rgyal mo tsha ba rong : lho ru sbas yul rnam dag pad+ma bkod: nub tu sbas yul bal po kha la shod:

byang du sbas yul bhe ba ag ta rong : mtshams bzhir nye ba'i sbas yul rnam pa bzhi: gro ma lung dang mkhar ljongs skyed mos tshal: rnam dag bkod chung bcas te nye mtshams so: thog mar sbas yul 'grim pa'i dus kyi tshe: sa bcu sgo 'byed rten 'brel brtag pa ni: rig 'dzin gter chen zhig gis dbu mdzad nas: ber phod rgyal po'i cha lugs cha gcig dang : he ru ka yi chas gnyis zung du 'jug: skal ldan rig ma lnga la rgyan gos sprad: mda' dar gser skyems pi waṃ gling bu sogs: snyan pa'i dbyangs dang rgyan 'phyang cod pan bcas: gser gyi rgyal mtshan nang du bla rdo dang : srog 'khor so so'i rten 'brel rdzas rnams bzhag: sgrub rten de dang gza' klu rgyal po yi: bris sku dar bcas sngon du lam sel bya: bon po'i chas dgus phywa gyer bon yas bsngo: sngags pa dgu yis lam gyi bar chad sgrol: rig 'dzin dgu yis srung ma gter bdag mchod: gar pa dgu yis lha srin glu bro brngan: ging pa dgu yis tshogs las gtor ma 'bul: bu mo dgu yis 'bru sna srid tshad thogs: skyes pa dgu yis rtsa lam gegs sel byed: rab byung dgu yis klu gtor cha gsum gtong : tshogs rdzas la sogs phun sum tshogs pa khur: thog mar mi mda' brgya rtsa 'gro bar bya: rus sbal 'gros kyis sbas yul lam la zhugs: spyir ni thams cad cha tshang legs par gzab: ri bstod rlung rta bum gter gang mang thongs: go khrab dang bcas lha 'drer spyad kha 'bul: 'jig rten 'dir srid mkho ba'i chas rigs rnams: gang yang thogs pa med par khur ba gnad: phal cher lcags dpyad zangs rnams mang bar bya: rta drel bong bu ma gtogs rkang phran rigs: thams cad gnas su bgrod pa snga nas gzab: lam du 'dzing rtsod la sogs shin du spang : thog mar pad+ma bkod du 'jug pa la: gnas kyi rnam dbye cung zad bshad pa ni: rdo rje phag mo gan rkyal lta bu ste: dbu yi gnas ni rgya la seng ldeng yin:

de la gnas dang yul ni gnyis tsam yod: phag mgo zer tog tsā ri gsar rnying yin: phag mo'i gnas chen byar dang kong po yin: kong rje spun gsum de yi gter srung yin: gu ru thim brag de yi sgrub phug yin: byin g.yag rin phug mkha' 'gro'i sgrub gnas yin: spur chen spur chung gter rgya drwa mig yin: byang gi rngam pa sgra sgrogs ma mo'i gnas: kong btsun de mo ban bon thun mong gnas: dgra lha mo dang g.yung drung spyi mthun spun: thim par thim pas phur pa'i gdeng tshad 'grub: phyag g.yas kong phyogs ba chags shing ring yin: ma la ba la sbas yul gnas chen bzhi: phyag g.yon rnam dag pad+ma bkod chung yin: ka ma ru la gnas dang yul gru brgyad: 'phrin pa dung ri 'ja' tshon 'khyil pa yin: lam bla ka la gnas dang yul gru gsum: rnying kha shrī dz+nyā na gnas chen bcu: yul dang yul chen bcas pa dgu tsam yin: mon gnas bzung ste tri sha ku ne yin: de ru gnas dang yul gru bcu gsum yin: zhabs g.yas mtshams su mchod rten ku shu ka: sprin nag can gyi dur khrod ces kyang bya: dai ru gnas dang yul gru bdun tsam yin: gla bam gnas rtsa pre ta pu ri yin: de ru gnas dang yul gru drug tsam yin: zhabs g.yon 'ja' yul nas bzung dpa' bo ri: bikhan pa dang bcas gnas yul dgu tsam yod: de rnams pad+ma bkod kyi chags tshul lo: yar chab gtsang po dbu ma'i tshul du 'gyu: rgya la'i phyogs nas dang po shar du 'bab: de nas 'gyu nub lho phyogs nas bskor nas: de nas byang 'gyu rong du shar la 'bab: de bzhin zhags pa'i gru yi rnam par 'gro: gnas chen re re mdud pa'i gru khug 'dra: spyir ni sa yi chags tshul rnam pa la: rang la ca sogs bar du brag ri spungs: lung rtse thams cad nags spang phyed ma dang : 'ga' zhig rdza khrod gangs chag phran bu re: ri sul spang ljongs skyed tshal shin tu mang : rnam bcas shin du dag kyang na bun 'khrigs:

ri zhal phal cher de yis sgrib pa yin: lam log gyur nas don med 'byung srid kyis: ri yi brtag zhib shin tu mkhas pa dgos: shrī ru na tshun chod lam yangs pas: gzhi bdag 'brug lha ga pas bsu skyel 'byung : glo grong bcu gnyis 'das mtshams lung sgo ni: nub tu kha gtad yod pa'i la rtser phyin: brag ri nag po sog po khros 'dra yod: de yi mdun du spang ljongs chen po yod: sngar gyi sgrub phug dang ni rtsig rmang yod: de yi shar phyogs mkha' ri la kha yin: de na gangs ri gsum yod rgyab tu bzhag: de nas mtsho mo sngo nag deng nge ba: g.ya' ma mdung rtse gzengs pa 'dra ba yod: de la sgrub phug lu ma lung zhes bya: de nas phyin pa'i spang la chen po zhig: la rtser rje yis brtsegs pa'i mchod rten ni: rang byon zhig dang khrol rtsig byas pa gnyis: de yi la rtser phyin nas lta ba'i tshe: lung pa'i kha ni shar du gtad pa la: yul ljongs thams cad pad+ma kha phye 'dra: gangs dang rdza spang rig 'dzin gral 'grigs 'dra: nags rdzong skyed tshal bde chen zhing bkod 'dra: rje yi sgrub phug shel gyi pho brang 'dra: nang na bde gshegs rtsa ba'i lha tshogs rnams: gya gyu phra khrig 'ja' tshon rnam pa can: ri klung thams cad mkha' 'gro'i gar 'cham skad: dngos su bltas na mig gis mi mthong bar: rang bzhin thugs rje'i rang skad kyu ru ru: gar rtsed 'khrab pa 'dra ba'i rnam pa yod: gzhan yang gzugs med du mas rang skad thos: phog thug shor sa rang skad rgyag pa 'byung : ma rmos lo thog bsam las 'das pa yod: gzhan yang shing 'bras sna tshogs las grub pa: 'jig rten 'di ru gang srid rnam pa yod: ri klung phal cher mtsho dang skyed tshal du: rtag tu 'ja' tshon sna tshogs gur rwas g.yogs: skal ldan rnams kyis dag pa'i lha zhal mjal: khyad par pad+ma bkod chung nas bzung ste: gnas kyi cha ru gtogs pa yin pa'i phyir: sman sna 'bru sna shing sna 'tshogs tshad skye:

khyad par gnas phu dang ni rdzong rnams su: rtswa mchog kun tu bzang po'i zil pa g.yo: klu bdud rdo rje nges par 'byung ba'i gnas: 'byung ba'i chu klung g.yo ba ji snyed rnams: bdud rtsi 'od ldan zhes su grags pa ste: kha ru myong bas ngan song skye sgo chod: gnas der sgrub mtshon dkyil 'khor dal bzung na: skye ba kun tu pad 'byung go 'phang 'grub: gnas chen de yi mthun rkyen gang bsgrubs pa: bde gshegs dpa' bo mkha' 'gros zhing du bsu: gnas de thos sam gsol btab zhal mthong na: sdig spang bram ze'i rigs su skye bar 'gyur: ma 'ongs sems can sdug bsngal myong ba'i tshe: o rgyan sbas yul rnams la blo gtad 'chang : ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga brgya'i tha ma la: sbas gnas dben ri ma gtogs bde skyid zad: bsags pa'i tha ma zad long med par 'phrog: skyes pa'i tha ma shi long med par gsod: bros pas bgrod long med par rting nas sleb: dag gtsang bshad long med par khrims la gtug: sbrang tshang nang du me 'obs 'khyil ba bzhin: dbang med las kyi dmag gis gtum zhing 'ded: skyabs med rngon pas ri dwags ded pa bzhin: sa btsan rdzong mkhar rang mgo bskor ba'i rgyu: lo re bzhin du bar do ngo sprod bzhin: dmyal ba mngon sum bkod bzhin rang thog sleb: de bas dben pa'i ri la blo gtad gyis: gang tshe gnas la rten 'brel sgrig pa dang :

smon lam skal ldan lo dang blo rig ldan tshe la dbang bya'o ma 'ongs sde dpon gza' skar kha byang rta 'dra ེ nges par 'byung ba'i bag zon yid la bcag: sbas yul nags khrod dben pa 'grim pa'i tshe: kha char bu yug 'tshubs pas lam bkag nas: stag gzig dom dred dug sbrul mche ba can: 'jigs pa brgyad kyis nye bar 'tshe ba na: yid gnyis the tshom med par gsol ba thob: nga nyid dpa' bau ging dang srung ma bcas: gdug pa'i sems can skrod par the tshom med: legs par gdams so lha sras rje 'bangs rnams: ma yengs dran pa'i lcags kyus yid la bcag: sa ma ya: de nas sgrub pa'i cha rkyen rim pa ni: gtsang gzhi steng du ras bris yod na rab: med na 'bru yi tshom bu bskor bya ste: pad ma 'dab brgyad mu khyud ldan pa la: bkra shis rdzas rtags brgyad kyis mtha' nas bskor: phyi rol rdo rje phreng ba me ri bya: dbus su rtsa gsum gtor ma rgyan ldan bzhag: pad 'dab rnams su dkar gtor re re bzhag: dkyil 'khor mtha' nas mchod pa gzhung bzhin bshams: gzhan yang mkho ba'i rdzas kyang gong bzhin bkram: rten 'brel sna tshogs ldan pa'i ngang nyid du: srung ma rnams la gser skyems bka' bsgo bya: bde gshegs kun 'dus tshar gcig rdzogs rjes su: sgrub pa rang gzhung dag la 'bad pa ni: na mo: bde gshegs kun 'dus mchog gsum rtsa ba gsum: sku lnga mtshan brgyad sku la skyabs su mchi: bdag ni dben ri sbas yul bgrod pa la: mgon mchog pad 'byung lam sna drang du gsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: om̐ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐ bh+rūm̐: badz+ra āt+ma ko3 haṃ: hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las rin chen gzhal yas khang : gru chad sgo rdzogs phyi nang bkod pa rdzogs: de dbus pad+ma rin chen 'bar ba'i khrir: pad+ma 'byung gnas bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku: rgyal po'i cha lugs snang srid zil gyis gnon: rdo rje mkhar gdengs thabs shes bhan+dha bsnams:

kha ṭ+wāṃ gru mo brten mdzad 'gying bag can: g.yas g.yon bde chen dbang phyug yum chen gnyis: 'khor du dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ging dang bcas: snang la ma 'dres 'ja' tshon dkyil 'khor ltar: sku gsung thugs kyi sa bon yig 'bru yis: rje btsun yid bzhin nor bu spyan drangs gyur: byin gyis rlobs la gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: gnas 'dir thugs rje'i dgongs te gshegs nas kyang : sbas yul dben rir bgrod par byin gyis rlobs: bdag gis byang chub snying po mchis kyi bar: sku gsung thugs kyi dbang bzhi bstsal nas su: 'bral ba med par rtag tu skyong gyur cig: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ a be sha ya āḥ gnyis pa: hūm̐: gtan gyi skyabs gyur pad 'byung chos kyi rje: 'gro mgon bla ma dpa' bo ging dang bcas: mi 'bral dbyings kyi spyi bo'i mkha' ru bzhugs: sgo gsum 'du 'bral med par phyag 'tshal bstod: dam pa nyid ltar thugs rjes bdag gyur nas: lam 'phrang bar chad zhi ba'i dngos grub stsol: om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ gsum pa: hūm̐: phyi mchod me tog bdug spos mar me dri: zhal zas rol mo gzugs sgra dri ro reg: nang mchod sman gtor rak+ta dbang po lnga: gsang mchod bla med sbyor sgrol tshogs kyi mchod: spyan gzigs dkor cha gling bzhi ri rab bcas: maṇ+ḍal mchod pa gcig tu bsdus nas kyang : rtsa gsum bder 'dus dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: mtshungs med 'gro mgon o rgyan rje la 'bul: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ging dang srung mar 'bul: dgyes par dgongs shing brtse bas bzhes su gsol: lam 'phrang gegs med bgrod par byin gyis rlobs: om̐ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta pū dza āḥhūm̐: ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta āḥhūm̐: bstod cing gsol ba gdab pa ni: hrīḥ

ma bcos spros bral bla ma chos kyi sku: bde chen lhun grub bla ma longs spyod rdzogs: pad sdong las 'khrungs bla ma sprul pa'i sku: sku gsum rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal bstod: hrīḥ nam mkha'i gos can dbyings phyug man+da ra: bde chen gtso mo ye shes mtsho rgyal yum: zab lam bde stong ma cig rnal 'byor ma: ḍāk+ki'i gtso mo rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod: hrīḥ gar gyi nyams dgu ldan pa'i dpa' bo dang : rngam gshe dpa' bar 'gro ba ging gi tshogs: gnas yul mkha' la 'gro ba ma mo ste: dpa' bo ging dang ḍāk+ki rgya mtshor bstod: hūm̐: snang srid zil gnon pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: dbu la sha ba'i snyan zhu gsol ba yis: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byin rlabs thugs rje sdud: sku lnga ye shes lhun gyis grub par byed: gnam lcags thog gi 'jigs pa bskyab tu gsol: rdo rje sgro phod dar snas brgyan pa yis: grub thob rig 'dzin sprin ltar gtibs par byed: nga rgyal seṅge'i 'jigs pa bskyab tu gsol: me long lnga dang nyi zlas brgyan pa yis: dbyings kyi ḍāk+ki dbang du sdud par byed: gti mug glang po'i 'jigs pa bskyab tu gsol: sgo bzhi khyung du 'dab ldan rgyas pa yis: mkha' 'gro sde bzhi'i lha tshogs 'ja' ltar gsal: zhe sdang stag gi 'jigs pa bskyab tu gsol: sku la phod kha lhab lhub gsol ba yis: khro bo khro mo zil gyis gnon par byed: phrag dog mi rgod 'jigs pa bskyab tu gsol: sku rags ljang dmar sngags chas spras pa yis: gsang ba ḍāk+ki grogs lam bsten par byed: nyon mongs chu srin 'jigs pa bskyab tu gsol: chos gos gser gyi 'ja' ris gsol ba yis: drang srong grub thob rig sngags dmod par byed: dmag 'khrug rgyal po'i 'jigs pa bskyab tu gsol: za ber smug nag bklubs shing gsol ba yis: snang srid lha srin zil gyis gnon par byed: zhe sdang sbrul gyi 'jigs pa bskyab tu gsol:

phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga phyar ba yis: lam gyi 'byung po ma rungs 'dul bar byed: cho 'phrul me yi 'jigs pa bskyab tu gsol: phyag g.yon bhan+dha tshe bum bsnams pa yis: ma sring mkha' 'gros phrin las sgrub par byed: lam 'phrang tshe yi bar chod bskyab tu gsol: kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum mchan du bcug pa yis: 'dre rgod 'byung po rdul du brlag par byed: gcan 'phrang gru gzings 'jigs pa bskyab tu gsol: zhabs la rgya lham dar chen gsol ba yis: sgab 'dre dam sri rdul du brlag par byed: lam log lam gol 'jigs pa bskyab tu gsol: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ging gis bskor ba yis: sbas yul sgo 'byed bstan pa skyong bar byed: bar gcod mi mthun phyogs kun bskyab tu gsol: gsol ba 'debs so o rgyan rin po che: byin gyis rlobs shig gu ru thod phreng can: 'jigs pa brgyad dang bcu drug bskyab tu gsol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: om̐ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa mā ya dza sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: hrī ma ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrī ya tsit+ta hriṃ hriṃ dza dza sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: om̐ dha sha gṝ wa ging ka ra sarba tshin+dha tshin+dha ya hūm̐ bh+yo phaṭḥ ces pas rgyun du sngags bzla bar bya: thog mar gnas la rten 'brel sgrig pa'i tshe: gong du sgrub pa 'di nyid shin tu gtso: khyad par sbas yul ma lags kyang : gnas gang la la zhig tu bgrod kyang 'di nyid ltar bsgrubs pas bar gcod mi 'byung : lhag par gnas gsar pa gtsug lag dang sa 'dzin gsar pa ci bya rung 'di nyid rten 'brel kun la mchog tu gyur nas bkra shis pa thams cad kyi thog ma'o: lhag par lam byes su 'gro ba'i tshe yang rten 'brel cho ga 'di dag bgyis pas lam du bar gcod mi 'byung : 'phral du sgrub na nyin tshogs bya yang rung : bsam pa lhun grub ma tshar bcu gsum 'bung bar bya'o:

rjes gtor ma las dbang blang : dkar gtor phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad du cha rkyen zur bkod ltar bsngo: dbang blang ba ni: hūm̐: pad+ma 'byung gnas 'gro ba thabs kyis sgrol: ye shes mtsho rgyal grol lam mtha' ru phyin: man+da ra ba tshe yi rig 'dzin thob: sangs rgyas ye shes bdud las rnam par rgyal: dpa' bo ging bzhis sbas yul gter sgo 'byed: lha srin sde brgyad bstan pa'i sbyin bdag 'grub: rtsa gsum kun 'dus dkyil 'khor mtha' ru phyin: deng 'dir dngos grub 'gugs pa'i dus la bab: tshe chos zas nor mnga' thang snyan grags dang : srid dang rgyud 'dzin gter la spyod pa yi: bkra shis dngos grub deng 'dir stsal du gsol: om̐ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes dbang blang bkra shis bsngo smon bzang pos rgyas gdab: phrin las rten 'brel lo legs tshogs bzang po las 'phro mthun pa'i smon lam rnga yab ma yang bya: rten 'brel brtag skabs tshig phra mas bar mi chod par bya: skal ldan dad pa can la 'phrad par shog: log lta bdud rigs ngan pa'i dbang po snubs: gnyer gtad gza' klu rgyal pos bya ra gyis: mchims phu'i brag btsan rgya 'di'i bstan pa srungs: zhing skyong mgon pos sbas gnas mel tshe mdzod: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: mi nub rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos sa khyi lor bsam yas mchims phu'i ke'u tshang nas gdan drangs shing*/ lcags phag lor nang chen sa bdag rgyal po'i pho brang ur 'gos su shog ser nas zhal bshus so// // pha) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: ma rgyud 'pho ba ka dag ye grol ngo sprod bzhugs so: rdo rje rigs kyi lha yi rnal 'byor ma la gus pas 'dud: de yang tshe gcig gis sangs rgyas sgrub pa la: las dang rgyu 'bras m-i re bar: sdig po che skad cig gis sangs rgyas pa'i gdams pa bstan par bya ba ste:

de yang don gsum las: ngo sprod dngos gzhi stong ra lha sku mtshams sbyor gsol 'debs ngang la dmigs pa: rjes su smon lam gyis mtshams sbyar ba'o: de la sngon 'gro ngo sprod bya ba la ni: bdag don sbyang ba yang yid la rgyun du bzhag par bya: gzhan don du yang : de'i sgra tshig thos par bya zhes pa'i: skad chen pos tshe 'das ming nas lan gsum 'bod do: sa ma ya: ho: khyod la mi rtag pa'i 'chi ba zhes bya ba sleb pa yin no: de 'byung ba'i thim rim bsdu ba'i rtags shin tu mang yang : gnyer don bsdu na: phra ba bzhi bcu: rags pa so bdun thim pa la: 'chi ba zhes bya ba yin te: tshigs su bcad pa lhug par brjod pa ste: phyi rtags lus dkyil sa yi khams chu la thim pas lci zhing 'gul skyod mi nus shing zungs mi thub: nang rtags shes pa bun bun dbugs sna thung zhing du ba lta bur gnas: chu'i khams me la thim pas phyi rtags lus kyi rdul dang kha chu thams cad bskams shing : so la dreg pa chags te mig 'bras 'gyur mi shes: nang rtags shes pa smig rgyu bskyod pa ltar nye 'brel mi ngo cher mi mthong : me yi khams rlung la thim pas: phyi rtags lus drod mtha' nas bsdu zhing dbugs cher mi thon: dbugs sna rgod gtum mo me yi mdangs nyams shes pa 'phyo: nang rtags srin bu me khyer lta bur gser ri mi gsal nye logs kyi sgra tshig cher mi thos: rlung gi khams rnam par shes pa la thim pas: phyi rtags dbugs phyir 'gyu 'phro nang du bsdu mi nus mig rdog rdog tu 'khor: ham̐: chu'i khams nyams mig kyang gyen du ldog: rna bas sgra mi thos: 'ur chem 'byung : nang rtags dkar me rlung gis bskyod pa ltar snang ba sprin bar gyi nyi ma tsam zhes pa rlung lnga phyogs gcig tu 'dus: de'i tshe shes pa bag klod cing lus cher mi 'gul bar bya: rlung rnam par shes pa la thim pas phyi rtags tshe 'di yi snang ba nub pa'i 'jig rten mi lus kyi yid dpyod thams cad 'gags:

nang rtags sems nam mkha'i khams nyams pas gsang gnas chu yi 'khor lor 'jug: rtsa chu rang lud du 'gro: gsang ba'i thig le 'chor: de nas phra ba rnam pa gsum thim pa ni: rnam par shes pa snang ba la thim pas sprin med kyi nam mkha' la nyi ma gzas zin pa ltar snang ba: dmar lam lam pa zhig 'byung : 'dod chags las gyur pa'i rtog pa bzhi bcu 'gags: ma las thob pa'i thig le dmar po lte ba nas snying khar ldog: rnam par shes pa la khrag gi char pa lan gsum 'bebs: de nas snang ba mched pa la thim pas sprin med kyi nam mkha' la zla 'od shar ba ltar dkar lam lam pa khra zi dang bcas pa 'byung : zhe sdang las gyur pa'i rtog pa so bdun bcas 'gags: spyi bo nas pha las thob pa'i thig le dkar po thur du babs: char drag po'i rnam pa chu la byings snyam byed: de nas mched pa nyer thob la thim pas sprin med kyi nam mkha' la srod mun gyi smug pa gtibs pa ltar snang ba nag lam lam pa zhig 'byung : gti mug las gyur pa'i rtog pa so bdun 'gags: dran med nag thom du 'gro: thig le dkar dmar gyi srubs su sbyar te ci yang mi dran pa 'byung : de nas srog 'dzin gyi rlung brgyad po so sor bral te rnam shes brgyad kyi lam dang ro rkyang du 'gro: cung zad brgyal ba rig pa rjen ne ba zhig 'byung : de 'od gsal gyi ma yin de nas shin tu stong pa dpe ston gnam dri ma med pas mtshon pa ltar gsal la ma 'gags pa zhig 'byung : de 'od gsal gyi bu yin: de'i ngang las ye shes kyi pho rlung mo rlung gi rnam par 'pho la khad du dar cig mnyam par bzhag pas: sems rig pa ma ning gi rlung bcas rtsad pa'i yongs su gsal ba zhig 'byung : sgom 'od gsal ma bu bsre ba zhes pa'i don yin thugs dam pa rnams de dag las ma g.yos shing mnyam par bzhag la: bsam gtan bsam bya blo las 'das pa zhes: re zhig 'dug par 'gyur ro: sa ma ya: de ltar ngos ma zin na pho yi mig g.yas:

mo yi mig g.yon: rtogs ldan nyams len pa dpral ba'am spyi bo nas thon te: de nas ma yi rig pa dang 'phrad par 'gyur ro: dpral bar don te yun du gang gi mdangs mi nyams: spyi bo nas don pas zil pa khrom khrom du gyur: sdig po che rnams la gsang gnas rkang mthil nas don par 'gyur ro: phal po che thams cad bu ga ba spu gang rung 'pho bar 'gyur ro: de'i tshe lus sems dang bral ba'i kho thag chod pa'o: rgyud las: sngon 'byung srid pa'i sha gzugs can: dbang po kun tshang thogs med du: las kyi rdzu 'phrul stobs dang ldan: rigs mthun lha mig ldan pa mngon: ri rab zang thal thogs med rgyu: zas su de ni dri za zhing : rdo rje gdan dang ma yi mngal: ma gtogs bgrod sa mi nges so: zhes gsungs pa ltar ngos bzung zhing 'chi kha chags sdang gi 'khri ba gcod: gnyis pa ni: 'o na de ltar ngos ma zin zhing bar dor 'pho bar gyur nas: 'pho ba 'di yis mtshams sbyar zhing phyi nang gi mtshams zhes pa 'di dam tshig gis 'di bzhin du mdzod cig: ho: stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs can: zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dang ldan pa: spyi bor phag zhal ngur ba: phyag na gri gug thod khrag bsnams te gru mor kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa: gcer mo nu ma bha ga rab tu rgyas shing : dar dmar gyi cod pan 'phur ba: rin po che dang rus pas brgyan cing : zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gi gar gyis: baṃ ro'i snying kha nas brdzis shing 'od lnga'i klong du bzhugs pa'o: rnal 'byor ma'i khog pa'i dbus su rtsa dbu ma phyi sngo la mtshan nyid dang ldan pa: drang zhing chu shing gi sdong po lta bu: stong pa phru mar phu btab pa lta bu: dmar ba la rgya skag gi khu ba lta bu: gsal ba til gyi mar me lta bu: mtshad nyid dang ldan pa'o: de yang yar sne tshangs bug: mar sne gsang gnas su zug pa ste:

snying khar tshigs kyis bcad pa lta bu'i steng du pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa: de'i steng du rang gi rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo thig le dkar dmar 'od lnga'i mdangs dang ldan pa: rgya sran gyi rdog po tsam zhig 'phar la khad 'phur la khad: ba spu rtse brgyar gshags kyi sne mo rlung gis bskyod pa ltar ram: āḥdakar po gcig tu sgoms shig: yar sne rgya mthongs kha phyes pa ltar yod pa'i steng du: ngo bo drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la: rnam pa rje btsun pad+ma 'byung gnas sku mdog dmar po he ru ka'i cha lugs can rgyan du ma dang ldan pa: gar gyi nyams dang ldan pa: ḍā ru dang bhan+dha bsnams pa: snang la rang bzhin bral ba: de'i phyogs bzhir gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro bzhi mkha' la spyod pa'i nyams 'gyur can du sgoms shig:
