mtshams sbyor gsol 'debs ni: om̐ āḥhūm̐: chos sku yum chen mo la gsol ba 'debs: ye shes 'pho ba 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs: phung po 'ja' lus mkha' spyod bgrod pa dang : bdag sogs rnam shes tshe 'phos gyur ma thag: myur lam gsang ba mchog gi zhing khams su: ka dag zang thal ngang du skye bar shog: om̐ āḥhūm̐: longs sku mthing 'od ma la gsol ba 'debs: ye shes 'pho ba 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs: phung po 'ja' lus mkha' spyod bgrod pa dang : bdag sogs rnam shes tshe 'phos gyur ma thag: myur lam gsang ba mchog gi zhing khams su: ka dag zang thal ngang du skye bar shog: om̐ āḥhūm̐: sprul sku rdo rje phag mo la gsol ba 'debs: ye shes 'pho ba 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs: phung po 'ja' lus mkha' spyod bgrod pa dang : bdag sogs rnam shes tshe 'phos gyur ma thag: myur lam gsang ba mchog gi zhing khams su: ka dag zang thal ngang du skye bar shog: om̐ āḥhūm̐: sku sprul rdo rje ḍāk+ki la gsol ba 'debs: ye shes 'pho ba 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs: phung po 'ja' lus mkha' spyod bgrod pa dang : bdag sogs rnam shes tshe 'phos gyur ma thag: myur lam gsang ba mchog gi zhing khams su: ka dag zang thal ngang du skye bar shog: om̐ āḥhūm̐: gsung sprul pad+ma ḍāk+ki la gsol ba 'debs: ye shes 'pho ba 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs: phung po 'ja' lus mkha' spyod bgrod pa dang : bdag sogs rnam shes tshe 'phos gyur ma thag: myur lam gsang ba mchog gi zhing khams su: ka dag zang thal ngang du skye bar shog: om̐ āḥhūm̐: thugs sprul gsang ba ye shes la gsol ba 'debs: ye shes 'pho ba 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs: phung po 'ja' lus mkha' spyod bgrod pa dang : bdag sogs rnam shes tshe 'phos gyur ma thag: myur lam gsang ba mchog gi zhing khams su: ka dag zang thal ngang du skye bar shog: om̐ āḥhūm̐: yon tan rat+na ḍāk+ki la gsol ba 'debs:

ye shes 'pho ba 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs: phung po 'ja' lus mkha' spyod bgrod pa dang : bdag sogs rnam shes tshe 'phos gyur ma thag: myur lam gsang ba mchog gi zhing khams su: ka dag zang thal ngang du skye bar shog: om̐ āḥhūm̐: phrin las karma ḍāk+ki la gsol ba 'debs: ye shes 'pho ba 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs: phung po 'ja' lus mkha' spyod bgrod pa dang : bdag sogs rnam shes tshe 'phos gyur ma thag: myur lam gsang ba mchog gi zhing khams su: ka dag zang thal ngang du skye bar shog: om̐ āḥhūm̐: rnal 'byor ḍāk+ki rgya mtsho la gsol ba 'debs: ye shes 'pho ba 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs: phung po 'ja' lus mkha' spyod bgrod pa dang : bdag sogs rnam shes tshe 'phos gyur ma thag: myur lam gsang ba mchog gi zhing khams su: ka dag zang thal ngang du skye bar shog: om̐ āḥhūm̐: rigs 'dus he ru ka la gsol ba 'debs: ye shes 'pho ba 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs: phung po 'ja' lus mkha' spyod bgrod pa dang : bdag sogs rnam shes tshe 'phos gyur ma thag: myur lam gsang ba mchog gi zhing khams su: ka dag zang thal ngang du skye bar shog: rnam shes dbu mar chos dbyings lam brgyud de: he ru ka yi thugs yid dbyer med bsgoms: hika: gam: phaṭḥ ces pas skar mda' chad pa ltar 'phang rlung sbyong yin na spyi gtsug gi dbu la he ru ka'i zhabs g.yon mthe bong gis mnan par reg pa tsam byas par bsgoms: yang ka zhes pas mar dbab bsres: snying khar bzhag pa rtags ma byung bar du res mos bya: gzhan la 'pho ba bya na sngar ltar hika'am phaṭḥ drag pos 'phang bar byas sam: he ru ka ye shes dbyings kyi dbu ma'i lam brgyud de thugs kar thim par bsam: yang phaṭ re re la dmigs rkang sbyar ba ni: rdo rje rnal 'byor he ru ka la bsre: mkha' 'gro brgyud pa'i rim pa rnams: tho brtsegs gi rnam par yod par bsre: chos sku yum chen dbyings phyug ma dbu ma man chad thams cad zung du 'brel bar bsams la:

mtshams ma chad par zang thal 'ja' shar ba ltar bsgoms: phaṭḥre re bzhin rdo rje phag mo he ru ka la thim dbu ma gyen du ldog: de nas rnal 'byor ma 'od lnga'i mdangs can he ru ka la thim: he ru ka de phrin las karma ḍāk+ki la thim: de bzhin yum chen mo dbyings phyug ma la thim: phaṭḥ byas pa'i rnam shes mkha' 'gro gcig nas gcig gi thugs kar 'pho mtshams dwang ma'i mkha' 'gro de 'ja' yal ba ltar go 'phang la thim: de lugs ldog zab lam sangs rgyas 'khor lo'i brgyud pa'o: de nas rnam shes dang yum chen gyi thugs gnyis chu la chu thim pa ltar dbyer med du gyur te nam yang 'khor ba'i 'khrul rgyun chad de phyir mi ldog par bsam: rang sbyong ba'i tshe ka zhes pa: chos sku longs skur thim pa snga ma ltar phab: thams cad he ru ka la thim: mthar he ru ka rang nyid mgo dbu ma nas snying khar rnam shes la thim: de 'ja' yal ba ltar skye med ngang la bzhag: yang na rig pa he ru ka tshon gang ba phyag g.yas rdo rje nam mkhar phyar zhing g.yon pas lte ba'i thad sor bhan+dha dam tshig lnga'i bdud rtsis gtams pa bsnams te: zhabs rol stabs can thugs kar hūm̐ dmar nag mdangs dang ldan pa bskyed: snang la rang bzhin bral te: nyi ma 'bum gyi zer ldan bzhugs par bsgoms pa la sems gtad de mnyam par bzhag: 'pho ba sbyong ba'i tshe spyi bor za zing bshu thul dang tsha breg gam nag thom thom: dran pa mi zin pa 'byung : nag thom dran med sbyangs na spyi bor lag pas rdung zhing ka yis yang phab pa'o: rtags byung tshe bco lngar sbyang ba ma chag tsam bya: dper na yur tshang wa kha shor ba ltar slar gso ba'i rang mal du legs par blta: 'pho ba mi sbyong ba'i dus ni chang 'thung ba: shes rgyud 'khrugs pa dang mdangs dang ma nyes pa'i kha yog byung skabs rnam shes 'khrugs pa'i rkyen dogs 'ga' rer spang bar bya'o: sa ma ya: de nas gsang sngags 'pho ba 'di ni phyi nang sa mtshams yin zhes pa la:

'pho ba gdams pa'i yul: nam gdab pa la: gdab dgos mi dgos: gdab tu med pa'i gang zag sogs so sor 'byung ba ste: 'pho ba gdab pa'i yul yin na: gshin po yig lam du bkod pa: ming nas 'bod pa: gdab pa'i yul ni phyi dbugs chad pa'i nang dbugs ma bral skabs su: gdab pa'i gnad ni skad chen pos 'bod cing : spyi bor skra nas 'then: shin tu bab par mnan: gdab pa'i gang zag ni: sngar chos kyi sgor zhugs shing nyams len gyi rtsal ma zin pa nad drag po btsan thabs su phog pas dran pa 'thor zhing nyams pa'i mtshams su phal mo che'o: gdab mi dgos pa ni: nyams len gzhi tshugs: rtogs pa'i gting len pa: lta ba'i phu thag chod pa rnams so: gdab tu med pa gnyis ni: rab rtogs pa mngon du gyur pa rnams dang : rnal 'byor pa lus zhig nas sangs rgyas zhes pas gdab tu med: tha ma sdig po las ngan rnams kyi phyi dbugs chad nang dbugs ma bral bar dmyal ba'i snang ba 'char te: khrag gi char pa 'bebs pa khrag mtshor byings snyam 'byung ba dang : me lcags gdab pa'i yun gyis dmyal ba'i lus thob pa'o: gdab kyang mi 'jug pa bzhi'am lngani: snying la mda' thebs pa dang gcig: chur bying ba dang gnyis: gsum g.yang sa lhung ba: bzhi gang bur dang : sa rud kyis mnan pa dang : de dag rig pa'i thim rim ma rdzogs bar: dbang med du 'pho rigs rnams gdab pa'i go skabs ma mchis so: zhes gsungs so: de yang rab chos sku'i 'pho ba: 'bring longs sku'i 'pho ba: tha ma sprul sku'i 'pho ba: 'pho ba gdab pa gsum yod: rab chos sku zang thal thos grol yid bzhin zung : 'bring bar do longs sku'i bskyed rim yi dam lha'i ngo bor bzung ste sprul bsgyur dran pa mi mnyam pa'i ngang du 'pho ba dge ba'i snang stong zer stong zhing khams mthong : tha ma skye ba 'dzin pa sprul sku ni: bla ma bzang pos mtshams sbyor bgyis pa las de'i mya ngan 'du ba'i rigs rnams so:

de'i nyams len bla ma'i rnal 'byor dran pas mngal ngan pa bgag: yi dam lha dran pas mngal ngan pa bgag: dkyil 'khor gsal 'tsher dran pas mngal ngan pa bgag: pha ma yi dam yab yum gyis 'dun pa bskyed pas mngal ngan pa bgag: sprul sku mtshan dpes brgyan pa thob par 'gyur ro: de yang bar do'i ngo sprod 'pho ba'i mtshams sbyor zung du 'jug pa ni: 'di ni go rim rnams dang dpal ldan bla ma'i zhal lung thob cing dmigs rkang sogs: nyams rtogs goms 'dris can zhig gis gdab pa ni: thog mar 'pho ba rtags thon zhig sgoms: de ci bzhin yin zhu ba mtsho rgyal gyi lung las: rang rgyud nang nas ma thul na: gzhan rgyud phyi nas grol bar dka': zhes pa don ni: rlung rig dbu mar ma sbyang na: 'pho ba'i gdams pa slad med do: skye ba med par srung dang 'dra: gzhan gyi shes rgyud ma mthong ba'i: mkhyen gnyis mngon shes 'chad pa de: long ba lha khang bslebs pa 'dra: bka' tshig 'dzin pa'i chos bshad de: bong bur gser dngul bkal ba mtshungs: sbyangs pa med pa'i thos pa de: brag la ku co btab pa 'dra: thos pa med pa'i sgom blta de: 'on pas pi waṃ nyan pa 'dra: zhal rgyun med pa'i phyag len de: yul sa chad pa'i rdzing bu 'dra: gnad du mi phebs bzhed pa kun: rdo thog so nam btab pa mtshungs: zhes sogs 'di lag len dang : brtson 'grus kyang do gal yin: de ltar gnad du sgrub par bya'o: gsum pa rjes la smon lam gyis mtshams sbyar spyi ltar ro: e ma zab pa'i mthar thug ti la ka: tshe gcig 'ja' lus mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i thabs: nyams len gsang rgya yid bzhin nor bu zhes: ma rgyud 'pho ba'i snying khrag dum bu nyid: lha sras de yi rjes 'brang rnams la gdams: gu ru nga la thugs rje 'pho 'gyur med: bdag ni mi gnas srin yul bzhud pa'i tshe: zhal gdams 'di bsgom ma chad rnam pa gnyis: 'chi kha ngo sprod 'chi tshe 'pho ba sbyong : ma bsgoms sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i gdams pa mchog:

mtsho rgyal dbang gi mkha' 'gros yi ger thob: rgya 'di srung ma lnga yis rtag tu skyongs: dpal gyi mchims phur mi nub ā thaṃ rgya: ma 'ongs las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: mi nub rgya: spel rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos sa khyir lor bsam yas mchims phu'i brag dmar ke'u tshang nas gdan drangs shing*/ chu glang lor bdud 'dul gsang sngags chos 'khor gling du shog ser nas zhal bshus so// // ba) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: bde chen zhing gi smon lam sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor bzhugs so: bde gshegs kun 'dus rtsa ba'i lha la 'dud: de yang bde chen zhing sgrub kyi smon lam 'bad pa la: cho ga gzhung gi dkyil 'khor lha thams cad mngon sum du mdun gyi nam mkhar dmigs nas smon lam 'bad par bya'o: sa ma ya: dang po skyabs yul zhing khams dmigs la: na mo hūm̐: bde chen lhun grub spros pa'i mtha' bral yang : zab mo'i don kun rnyog med ston pa yi: sku dang zhing khams nam mkha'i mtha' yas khyab: thugs rje 'pho 'gyur med pa'i rlabs po che: ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i rkang gnyis mchog: gtso bo'i sku la mtshan dang dpe byad ldan: 'gro ba'i mgon mchog sangs rgyas 'od dpag med: ches cher brtse ba'i snying rje'i 'od zer gyis: sems can rmongs pa'i mun rum sel mdzad pa: dam pa'i zhal mthong tsam gyis ngan 'gro sel: skye bo'i tshogs rnams ye shes thob par shog: las kyis 'khor ba'i skye gnas rnam pa bzhi: de las bsdus pa'i rigs drug sdug bsngal tshogs: byams mgon dam pa'i nus pas sel bar shog: tsha ba'i ngar ldan mnar med dmyal ba'i me: bsil ba'i ye shes chu dang 'grogs par shog: chu tshan dang ni chu bo rab med dang : sngangs skrag sgyid lug khro chur bying ba rnams: zla ba'i 'od kyi cha shas ldan par shog: mtshon rtse'i tshal du 'gro na'ang phyin pa dang :

sha lus zhig snyam sil bur 'thor ba'i tshe: brdzus skyes rnam pa lha yi lus thob shog: grang bas mnar ba kyi hud so tham tham: pad+ma ut+pal ltar du gas pa'i tshe: ye shes 'od kyis bsil ngar skem par shog: dmyal ba'i mi dang gcan gzan ngar ba'i sgra: ya nga gsum gyi g.yang la lhung ba'i tshe: sngangs skrag spu gzengs bag tsha med par shog: dge sdig bshan pa'i zangs kha mthong ba'i tshe: bcud ldan snod dang 'dod yon mthong bar shog: rnam smin rang byas lan chags mthong ba'i tshe: dgra la sdang ba'i snang ba mi skye shog: chags pa'i snang bas log lam gol ba'i tshe: gnyen la byams pa'i brod kha mi 'byung shog: zla med gcig pur kyi hud 'debs pa'i tshe: lha dang lha mo'i grogs kyis bsu bar shog: gcong rong rtsub dang mun gling 'khrigs pa'i tshe: snang ba ye shes mdangs kyis gsal bar shog: de las langs nas gang zhig bkres pa yis: 'dod yon thams cad rnag khrag mthong ba'i tshe: ro mngar bcud ldan zas la rnyed par shog: rod pa'i gling dang dbul ba'i nyams shar tshe: gzugs byed mthong snang lha yi bab ldan shog: bkres pa zas med skom sel chu nub tshe: rang nyid smod pa'i lha yi zas ldan shog: snang ba go log bdud ltar sdang ba'i tshe: dag snang nges shes lha dang mnyam par shog: de las langs te glen lkug yul brgyud tshe: kun rmongs nags ljongs dran med thom me ba: de tshe rang rig ye shes blo ldan shog: srog bcad bkol spyod rnam smin mdun sgug tshe: yid lus 'jigs skrag g.yeng ba med par shog: rwa can sder chags 'dab chags ded snang bgyid: ya nga mi snang nges blo brtan par shog: shugs ldan yod pa'i glang chen la sogs dang : stong gzugs sgyu ma'i mig 'phrul chod par shog: de las langs nas skye gnas 'du 'phrod mthong : gang du chags pa'i yul la skye ba'i phyir: mig ser 'khri ba'i zhen pa chod par shog: sngar goms yid lus snang ngor sred pa yis:

nu ma mtshan ma phru gu la sogs pa: kun snang shar la zhen pa chod par shog: pha ma spun zla byams pa'i tshig gis bslu: rnam smin bslu ba'i snang ba ngo shes shog: dkar dmar nag sogs g.yang sar lhung snyam tshe: bag yod dran pas shes pa rnyed par shog: kha char dad snyam ngam grog sdong 'dab btsal: de tshe gsal stong 'dzin med skye bar shog: de las langs te mi ma yin par gol: 'khrul snang gling du mtshon cha'i char 'bebs snyam: mtshon cha bzlogs nas me tog mthong bar shog: shi'am gson nam bu yug 'thib po mthong : de tshe bdag med yid lus ngo shes shog: res mos shi sos rang nyid du khaḥmyangs: snang ba mi skye rig pa ngo shes shog: stong pa'i rtsal las 'dod khams bskor ba'i tshe: nges 'byung brtan pos sa lam bgrod par shog: de las langs te khams gang brod pa shar: sngar sbyangs zhing khams khyon ltar mthong ba'i tshe: dga' brod mi bya sdug bsngal mi sdang shog: skyed tshal dpag bsam bsil grib mthong ba'i tshe: brod pa dang po'i zhing khams yin nam snyam: de la sngar gyi nyams len dran par shog: khor yug 'od dang drwa bas bskor ba'i tshe: rang snang klong lnga'i rtsal du shes par shog: de la gnyis snang rtog pa langs pa yis: 'jug pa'i gnas la nges pa cha med tshe: mnyam bzhag dang po'i rang tsho zin par shog: kun bzang snang mtha' rgyal ba'i thugs rje yis: dmyal ngan rigs drug gol sa chod par shog: e ma hoḥ zhing khams mchog rab bde ba can gyi gling : de ru sangs rgyas 'od dpag med pa bzhugs: gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas 'khor gyis bskor: g.yas su thugs rje'i bdag po spyan ras gzigs: g.yon du sprul sku'i gtso bo pad+ma 'byung : byang sems rig 'dzin bde gshegs rgyal ba yis: zhing khams khor yug bkod pa'i khyon kun gang : dag zhing gtsang ma'i mngon par bkod pa'i gnas: bdag sogs 'di nas tshe 'phos gyur ma thag: rab tu dga' ba'i sa der bgrod par shog:

bde gshegs 'od dpag med kyis mdun nas bsus: 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyis lam sna drongs: rje btsun pad 'byung dam pas zhing du skyol: bde gshegs rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i 'phrul gyis phul: skyon med pad+ma'i sbubs su 'khrungs nas su: mngon shes drug ldan 'ja' lus thob par shog: mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i lus bzang thob nas su: sna tshogs mchod pas rtag tu mchod par shog: sred pa bral zhing tshims pa'i dga' bder gnas: zhing khams spyod pa'i go 'phang thob nas su: phyogs bzhir bde gshegs rigs lnga'i zhing khams dang : mtshams bzhir sprul sku rig 'dzin zhing khams dang : dag pa'i zhing nas dag pa'i zhing du gzigs: gzigs stangs gsum gyi thugs rjes 'gro la skyongs: rang dbang thob pa'i rgyal sa zin pa'i tshe: gdod ma'i mgon po chos sku'i klong du bzhugs: longs sku'i rtsal las 'gro ba'i don phyir 'gyed: thabs kyi sprul skus sems can dag zhing ston: dper na rig 'dzin grub thob ldan pa zhig: cig car gnyis sprul mkha' la bskyod pa bzhin: bden pa'i sa thob bden pa de ltar rig: de ltar de bzhin shin tu reg gyur cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐: shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams su: bde gshegs gtso bo rdo rje sems dpa' bzhugs: zhe sdang zhi ba'i gnas mchog dam pa der: me long ye shes ngang du skye bar shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐: shar lho lta na sdug pa'i zhing khams su: rig 'dzin gtso bo rdo rje thod phreng bzhugs: rtag par lta ba zhi ba'i gnas mchog der: byams pa chen po'i ngang der skye bar shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lho phyogs dpal dang ldan pa'i zhing khams su: bde gshegs gtso bo rin chen 'byung ldan bzhugs: nga rgyal zhi ba'i gnas mchog dam pa der: mnyam nyid ye shes ngang der skye bar shog: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lho nub 'thug po bkod pa'i zhing khams su: rig 'dzin gtso bo rat+na thod phreng bzhugs: chad par lta ba zhi ba'i gnas mchog der:

snying rje chen po'i ngang der skye bar shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐: nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams su: bde gshegs gtso bo rnam par snang mdzad bzhugs: 'dod chags zhi ba'i gnas mchog dam pa der: sor rtog ye shes ngang der skye bar shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐: nub byang mkha' dbyings brtsegs pa'i zhing khams su: rig 'dzin gtso bo pad+ma thod phreng bzhugs: dngos por lta ba zhi ba'i gnas mchog der: dga' ba chen po'i ngang der skye bar shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐: byang phyogs las rab rdzogs pa'i zhing khams su: bde gshegs gtso bo don yod grub pa bzhugs: phrag dog zhi ba'i gnas mchog dam pa der: bya grub ye shes ngang der skye bar shog: om̐ āḥhūm̐: byang shar lcang lo can gyi zhing khams su: rig 'dzin gtso bo karma thod phreng bzhugs: mtshan mar lta ba zhi ba'i gnas mchog der: btang snyoms chen po'i ngang der skye bar shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐: rnga yab pad+ma 'od kyi zhing khams su: rig 'dzin gtso bo pad+ma 'byung gnas bzhugs: nyon mongs zhi ba'i gnas mchog dam pa der: dag pa bde gshegs ngang du skye bar shog: 'og min mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing khams su: thog ma'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang po bzhugs: gti mug zhi ba'i gnas mchog dam pa der: chos dbyings ye shes ngang der skye bar shog: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ na moḥ deng nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob par: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams dang mi 'bral shog: pad 'byung dbyer med dgongs pa'i klong gyur nas: snang mtha' gdod ma'i mgon po bdag gyur cig: snang mtha' pad 'byung khyed sku ci 'dra ba: de 'drar bdag kyang rtag tu 'byung gyur nas: nam yang g.yo ba med pa'i sa thob ste: mtha' yas 'gro ba 'dren pa'i dpal du shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐: a mi dhe wa gu ru sid+dhi hrīḥ

zhes bsngo smon yang dag gis rgyas gdab bo: nam zhig tshe yi 'phen pa zad pa'i skabs gsol 'debs tshar gcig dang bskyed rim sbrags nas rnam shes pad 'byung snang mtha'i thugs kar bstim: 'di nyid bde chen zhing sgrub kyi smon lam sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor zhes te: tshe gcig sangs rgyas sa lam mchog lha sras dang grogs lnga la gdams pa: ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis pradz+nyā a ku ra yi pags pa'i logs su bris te mchims phu'i dge'u gong du sbas nas gter rgyas btab bo: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: gsang rgya: zab rgya: them rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos sa khyi lor bod yul rdo rje gdan mchog rgyal po gnam la khri bdun sa la legs drug bar la btsan brgyad yod pa'i btsan po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi pho brang dam pa'i rgya mkhar rtsa dgu lcog bco brgyad yod pa'i mdun du dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i brag dmar gling bzhi mchims phur bde gshegs bka' brgyad dgongs 'dus sde lnga rtsa gsum bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho sogs zhal phyes bsgrubs nas ke'u tshang gong ma nas bde gshegs bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho gdan drangs nas lo bdun bka' rgya bsdams/ zhal kha phyes nas tshes bcu'i mchod pa'i cha skor bstan pa'i chos skyong dregs pa sde lnga'i skor bcas phab/ lcags mo phag lor mdo khams sa yi lte ba btsan bdud lha klu dge bsnyen chen po bcas kyi pho brang yod pa'i gnas/ lha las babs pa'i gdung rgyud khri bco brgyad seṅge dgu brtsegs kyi gdan sa pho brang dge bsnyen rdo rje bdud 'dul gnas pa'i skyed tshal gdan sa ru mi dbang rgyal po jo rog thi'u jis dbus mdzad/ phyag mdzod dkon mchog tshe 'phel bcas kyis sngon nas maṇ+ḍal dang bcas pas bskul/ bsam pa lhun grub ma'i chos bka' gtan la phab/ de rjes dpal tai lo pa nas gling ras pad+ma rdo rje rgya ras ye shes rdo rje nas grub thob zam ma chad pa'i bka' brgyud 'brug pa'i chos rgyud skyong zhing rig 'dzin rdo rje sngags kyi rig pa 'dzin pa zam me sprul sku pad+ma las 'brel rtsal lam mtshan du mar grags pa de nyid kyis thugs sgrub dbang chen gyi skabs bkas bskul/

dge bshes kun dga' blo gros kyis bskul ba bcas rten 'brel du ma 'grigs pa'i shugs kyis mtshams sbyor bzang po bcas dge bsnyen rdo rje mtshan grags mdun na gnas bzhin shog ser zhal bshus so/ sarba bha wan+tu// // ma) ye shes mkha' 'gro khro gnyer can ma las: gdong lnga'i gsang sgrub gnam lcags ur mo bzhugs so: ma cig rdo rje bde chen dpa' mo'i sku la 'dud: de yang ye shes dbyings kyi dpa' mo mkha' 'gro seṅge'i gdong can gyi phrin las mngon rtogs kyis rnam par brgyan pa'i bskyed chog la 'jug pa ni: mchod rdzas bca' gzhi gzhung bzhin la mdun du nye ba'i me tog gi khar mkha' 'gro'i gtor ma dpal gzugs 'khor bcu gnyis bcas bshams la: sha khrag dmar gyis brgyan: khrag skyu gsum gyi nang du ling chung gsum bcas bzhag: sha chen tshil chen gyi gsur bcas btang nas: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ dang om̐ āḥhūm̐: sbyangs spel gyur nas bdag bskyed dran rdzogs bya ba ni: hūm̐ bh+rūm̐: thod pa dmar smug brtsigs pa'i pho brang dbus: chos 'byung dmar nag gdengs ka gyen du phyogs: de nang pad nyi ro yi gdan steng du: bdag nyid mkha' 'gro seṅge'i gdong pa can: sku mdog mthing nag seng zhal khros pa'i gdong : g.yu ral gseb nas seng chung sprin ltar gtibs: rab 'jigs thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan: phyag g.yas gnam lcags gri gug mkha' la phyar: phyag g.yon bhan+dha rak+ta bcud bzang bsnams: gru mor kha ṭ+wāṃ brten pas dug gsum 'joms: ḍāk+ki'i rgya rtags rus rgyan me long spras: thod rlon mgo phreng ga shar dar dpyangs spras: g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bam ro'i gdan la 'gying : gtso mo'i phyogs bzhir drag mo gdong can bzhi: stag dang phag zhal dom gdong gcan spyang mgo: rigs bzhi gtso mthun phyogs mdog rang rtags spras: gzhan yang sgo skyong srung ma nyid sprul bcas: snang la rang bzhin bral ba'i gnas gsum las:

'od 'phros ma sring mkha' 'gro spyan drangs nas: bdag la dbang bskur byin rlabs mchog thun stsol: om̐ badz+ra ḍāk+ki nī baṃ singha mu kha ha ri ni sa sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ a be sha ya a āḥ zhes pas spyan drangs bdag dang dbyer med bsgom: mchod bstod la sogs phyam cig bstan pa ni: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed pa'i yum: chos dbyings ye shes mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma: rigs lnga bde chen lhun grub rang bzhin 'bar: dbyings las ma g.yos rnal 'byor ḍāk+ki'i tshogs: gus pas phyag bgyid brtan par bzhugs su gsol: om̐ na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ drag mo seṅge'i gdong can gtso 'khor la: phyi mchod gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'bul: nang mchod sman raka bha ling gtor ma 'bul: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol ga ṇa'i tshogs mchod 'bul: rkang gling thod rnga rol mo sgra ldan 'bul: om̐ rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: sarba pañtsa rak+ta bha ling+ta ga ṇa tsakra pū dza kha kha khā hi: bh+yoḥ khyad par mnyes shing mthun pa'i dam rdzas ni: dur khrod pho brang rgyan spyod bkod pa 'di: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: thod pa ltag sprod zhing lpags g.yogs pa 'di: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: mchog chen gri rkang gling bu'i dbyangs ring 'di: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: bhan+dha lcang lo rak+ta rnam lnga'i tshogs: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: sha chen tshil chen dri gsur ngad ldan 'di: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: dmar chen dpal gtor dar nag ba dan can: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: dgra bgegs sha khrag ri ltar spungs pa'i tshogs: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: mi lpags rgyal mtshan dar nag g.yab mo phyar: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: phyag mtshan rnon po mtshon cha 'khor lo'i rtsibs:

ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: ging pa dpa' bo dpa' mo'i gar bsgyur tshogs: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: gnas nyul dus mtshan ma mo gcer bu 'bum: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: gzhan yang mthun pa'i dam rdzas dgyes pa'i phud: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: 'bod pa'i gdangs chen 'brug ltar ldir ba bcas: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su 'bul: bh+yoḥ mchod rdzas bsgrub rdzas bskang rdzas sna tshogs kyis: rdo rje mkha' 'gro seng gdong thugs dam bskang : pad+ma mkha' 'gro stag gdong thugs dam bskang : sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro phag gdong thugs dam bskang : rin chen mkha' 'gro dom gdong thugs dam bskang : phrin las mkha' 'gro spyang gdong thugs dam bskang : las byed lcags gdong nag mo'i thugs dam bskang : las bdag mtshan mo sgra sgrogs thugs dam bskang : sprul pa ma mo mched gsum thugs dam bskang : yang sprul srin mo stong sde'i thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs nas g.yar dam dngos grub stsol: ma sring ḍāk+ki rgya mtsho'i spyan lam du: mchod pa lo zlar 'das pa mthol lo bshags: tshogs dang bskang mchod chag pa mthol lo bshags: sbyor sgrol gnad du ma khel mthol lo bshags: dus sgrub dus su 'das pa mthol lo bshags: dus min las la sbyor ba mthol lo bshags: bcu nya stong bzhi chag pa mthol lo bshags: rten 'brel sna tshogs chad pa mthol lo bshags: thabs shes kha 'byed spyod pa mthol lo bshags: bde stong zung du ma 'jug mthol lo bshags: dam tshig spang blang bgyis pa mthol lo bshags: rdo rje sngags dang 'gal ba mthol lo bshags: 'gyod tshangs dge bas mnyam nyid la gnas shog: ces yig brgya bzlas: de nas bstod pa baṃ ri 'bar ba ni: bh+yo bh+yoḥ baṃ ri thod mkhar 'bar ba'i pho brang nas: ma cig 'dod khams dbang phyug seṅge'i gdong : g.yu ral sprugs pas stobs bcu'i phrin las rdzogs:

khro mo'i gdong ni za byed 'jigs la rngam: dmar la 'khyil ba'i spyan rtsa sdang mig bgrad: rno ba'i 'od ldan 'bar bas phyag mtshan gdengs: mdangs ldan 'od ris dmar chen bhan+dha gtams: mkhar phur las mtshon rtse gsum gyen du gzengs: ma rgyud 'bum gyi gtso mos rus rgyan gsol: me long 'od ldan lhag lhag ma sring sdud: nu ma bha ga rgyas pa'i bde drod 'phel: 'khor ba stongs phyir mgo phreng tshal du dngar: brkyang bskum 'gying ba'i dga' bzhi'i gar dang ldan: 'bar zhing sreg pa'i me dpung sku la 'khril: ye shes mkha' la rol pa seṅge'i dpal: dur khrod rgyan drug spras la phyag 'tshal bstod: bh+yoḥ sku yi sprul pa bde chen mkha' 'gro ma: nad gdon zhi mdzad dkar mo seng gdong ma: dza lan+dha ra'i gnas kyi dbang mo che: badz+ra ḍāk+ki'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: bh+yoḥ gsung gi sprul pa brda sgrogs mkha' 'gro ma: tshe bsod dbang sdud dmar mo stag gdong ma: lam pā ka yi gnas kyi dbang mo che: pad+ma ḍāk+ki'i gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod: bh+yoḥ thugs kyi sprul pa ye shes mkha' 'gro ma: gnas lugs mngon gyur phag gdong mthing nag ma: a tsi rta yi gnas kyi dbang mo che: bud+dha ḍāk+ki'i thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod: bh+yoḥ yon tan sprul pa dga' bzhi mkha' 'gro ma: 'byor drug rgyas mdzad ser mo dom gdong ma: tri sha ku na'i gnas kyi dbang mo che: rat+na ḍāk+ki'i yon tan phyag 'tshal bstod: bh+yoḥ phrin las sprul pa rab g.yo mkha' 'gro ma: dgra bgegs sgrol mdzad sngon mo spyang gdong ma: tshan+dho ha yi gnas kyi dbang mo che: karma ḍāk+ki'i phrin las phyag 'tshal bstod: sngags bstod ni: bh+yoḥ rgyal yum rdo rje rnal 'byor rigs: drag mo khro gnyer mche ba gtsigs: nam mkha'i mdog can me 'od 'phro: seṅge'i gdong can lha mor bstod: rtsa sngags ni: om̐ baṃ ḍāk+ki singha mu kha hūm̐ bh+yoḥ las sngags: om̐ badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma bud+dha ya ha ri ni sa ḍāk+ki sa ma ya hūm̐ bh+yoḥ

drag sngags/ aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphaṭḥ ces sgrub pa'i skabs rtsa sngags: las phran skabs las sngags: dmod pa'i skabs su drag sngags: yang bzlog gi mthar khaṃ e ka tsa na e e sa bh+yo zlog: raṃ dza tri mu tri rmug thuṃ rbad bh+yo zlog: yaṃ sha ma na du shen bh+yo zlog: ces pas bzlog pa'i skabs su lag g.yas zla ba chu yi dkyil 'khor: g.yon nyi ma me yi dkyil 'khor du bskyed lag rdeb sngags dang sbrags nas me chu'i bar du dgra bgegs byad ma gtums nas bskal pa 'jigs pa'i me chu ltar 'phrod pas brgyal zhing ming shul med par bsams shing sa rdul ltar gyur ba ste yang sngags spur bas rlung las kyi 'tshubs pa ltar gyur pas mtha' yi rgya mtsho'i pha mthar lcags bsregs ri la gtor ba dmigs te lag pa'i tshigs rgyud nas sor rtse dgra la gtad nas spur: des ni byad ma 'bum stong nus pa bzlog par the tshom med: 'joms byed me chu go ldog ces gsungs so: bzlog dmigs grub nas ma bcos de bzhin nyid kyi ting 'dzin ngang la: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ skye med ye shes mkha' 'gro ma: 'gags med hūm̐ sgra 'brug ltar sgrog: gnyis med bh+yo dang e ka ra: rang bzhin me dpung tshwa tshwa 'khrigs: cis kyang mi shigs srung 'khor gyur: hūm̐ hūm̐ sogs bh+yo bh+yoḥ sogs ci 'grub bzlas dam ye sa bon skye med bsdu: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos sa khyi lor bod yul bsam yas mchims phu'i dge'u gong ke'u tshang nas gdan drangs shing lcags phag lor zam me sprul sku pad+ma las 'brel rtsal la thugs sgrub dbang chen gdams pa 'bog pa'i tshe bkas bskul ba dang rten 'brel bcas nang chen rgyal po'i e waṃ sgar ur 'gos su shog ser las zhal bshus so// // tsa) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: lha mo khro gnyer can gyi byad khrol gser gyi lde mig bzhugs so:

'phags ma ri khrod lo ma gyon ma'i sgrub thabs nas khol du phyung ba: gzhan gyis mi thub pa lha mo gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i rgyud zung 'jug gi nang nas pha rol gyi byad dang rgol ba khyad par dam sri pho mo'i gnod pa zhi bar byed pa'i las tshogs la: thog mar gzhan gyi rig sngags thams cad tshar gcod byed pa dug sbrul nag po stong thub kyi srung bas dbang bskur ba'i rim pa la: thog mar shing shog gam shog bu gang 'dra yin rung sman chen gyis ngar btags: snag tsha la gri lcags phye ma bsres: thog mar lte bar rus sbal gyi gzugs bris: ling tshe dgu la: yig rgod dgu sme ba rang mdog gyi kha bsgyur: sbal pa'i yan lag bzhi ru sbrul mdud bzhi: sme ba dgu'i mtshams su mu khyud dang po la: om̐ ma ma tsakra he hu phu lu sha wa ṇi uṣ+ṇi ṣa sa ha kriṣ+ṇa badz+ra dz+wa la par+ṇa wa ri sarba ut+pa rma ra ta sarba ka khor dha nan badz+ra bhir+dha ra ṇa ga wa ṇa sha ra ṇa sarba kun+ta ya swā hā: bdag 'chang ba po la pha rol gyi byad zor gzhan gyis dmod pa'i sngags thams cad kyis mi tshugs par srungs shig: badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: pha rol gyi rigs sngags kyis gzir ba bcings pa mnan pa bsdams pa bsregs pa bskrad pa thams cad shig shig: nā ga shig tiṣ+ṭha shig shig: om̐ ma ma dh+wa dza ke la sha sirta ṇi ma ma h+ya hi ma ma tshin+dha ya ha he hūm̐ phaṭḥ ma bi na bi na satwaṃ bha ya shig shig: byer byer da ha da ha hūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas rus sbal gyi phyi rol yan lag la klu chen brgyad la sbrul mdud 'dzin pa: sbrul mdud nang du yig mgo nang du bstan la: om̐ badz+ra aṅku sha ya dza ka ra ti ka ya he hu nā ga shig shig gzhan gyis gdug pa klu bdud pho la gtad pa'i byad kha rig sngags kyi mthu gtong ba thams cad da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭḥ lag pa g.yas kyi sbrul mdud yin: om̐ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐ he hu nā ga kha ra ga byer byer gzhan gyis gdug pa klu bdud mo la gtad pa'i byad kha rig sngags kyi mthu gtong ba thams cad da ha da ha bhan+dha bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭḥ

lag g.yon pa yin: om̐ badz+ra pad+ma s+pho ṭa baṃ phaṭ badz+ra khargā na bhu mi ma ma gtor gtor gzhan gyis sa bdag pho la gtad pa'i byad kha rig sngags kyi mthu gtong ba thams cad da ha da ha ma tha ma tha hūm̐ phaṭḥ rkang pa g.yas: om̐ badz+ra karma ghaṇ+ḍe ho ṇa ṇa tri shu la dz+wa la bhū mi ma ma byol byol gzhan gyis sa bdag mo la gtad pa'i byad kha rig sngags kyi mthu gtong ba thams cad da ha da ha ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ rkang pa g.yon: sbrul gyi mtshams bzhir mda' gzhu 'gengs pa bzhi mde'u phyi rol du bstan: gzhu'i sgal pa la: om̐ badz+ra ṇa ṇa ma ma tshin+dha ya ha he hūm̐ phaṭḥ gzhu'i nang du: om̐ hrī badz+ra dz+wa la sarba karma hūm̐ phaṭ ku si ya swā hā: de'i phyi rol mu khyud gcig gi nang du rdo rje'i rwa ba phyi rol me ri 'tshubs rgyas bris: 'di yab 'khor yin: yab yum lte ba ma gtogs khyad med: yum gyi lte bar:

rdzas ni thog lcags sbal sha sbrul sha: lcags sdig bcas kyi sha: lcung ka'i snying : pho rog gi snying : glag gi snying : spyang ki'i snying : stag gzig dom dred rnams kyi mche ba sder mo dur bya'i mchu: khrung khrung gi rgyud pa: g.yag rgod kyi rwa phag rgod kyi mche ba bcas rdzas thams cad dar nag pos dril la lte bar bzhag: sman gla rtsi shu dag spru nag thang phrom gu gul nag po shing kun bcas byug par bya: sngags 'dis rab gnas bya: om̐ badz+ra uṣ+ṇi a ne le bi shud+dhe bai re bai re badz+ra pā ṇi sa ma ya badz+ra dz+wa la dz+wa la pra dz+wa la sarba pi sha tsi par+ṇa sha ba rī ut+pa dz+wa la pra sha bi ma tsakra hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces thog mar 'khor lo yi ge la me long 'gying logs la gzungs khrus bya: om̐ badz+ra bi dho bhi dho bhi dza ya a pa rā tsi ta ma ma tshin+dha ya ha he hūm̐ phaṭḥ gzhan gyis byad du bcug pa dang bcings pa thams cad khrol khrol shig shig sarba nā ga hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ ku lu mi li tsu lu hu lu hu lu tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha bhan+dha bhan+dha ha na ha na a mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ pi sha tsi par+ṇa sha ba rī sarba u pa dhe wa bhūr khu ma hā pra ma ṇa ya bur tsi phur tsi bur ki ma ṇa si uts+tsha ma a kro te hūm̐ phaṭḥ pha rol rig sngags kyis byad du bcug pa mnan pa bcings pa bskrad pa gzir ba thams cad byer byer khrol khrol shig shig bhan+dha bhan+dha ha na ha na da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa sarba tsu ru tsaṇ+ḍa tsaṇ+ḍa sarba maṇ+ṭa maṇ+ṭa hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces pa ci mang bzlas nas bum chu la bsngags: de nas me long 'gying log sngags 'dis khrus byas: de nas chu des slob ma gang la dgos pa de la khrus kyang brgya re bya: de nas 'khor lo bum pa ku sha gsum gyi dbang brgya khrus brgya 'grub pa dang : srung ba de gri lcags kyi gwa'u nang du 'chang : 'khor rang sngags brgya dang dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying pos rab gnas bya la 'phral du 'chang :

sa ma ya: 'di nyid byad ma 'bum thub sngags pa khri thub mu stegs stong thub ces bya ba yin te: sngon rgya gar bha ga la'i rgyal po a shwa ka zhes pa la mchod gnas mu stegs pa bhi ru sha bya ba nang pa'i chas su ste: rgyal po'i pho brang rdo bcal mthil du 'khar gsil gyi kha ru rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs pa skad: de'i zhogs la rgyal po'i pho brang rtse nas khrus byas te gzigs pa dus mnyam du gyur: blon po rnams kyis pho brang rtser spyan 'dren zer: blon po'i kha bzhin rgyal po yang ya mtshan skyes nas zhabs tog bsgrubs nas bla mchod bgyis pas: sras mos de yi 'thad rmi ltas la legs tshogs kyi rgyur ma mthong : mu stegs de kha che ho phen ta bya ba'i bla mchod yin te: nang pa'i rgyal sa bcom la mngags pa'o: zla ba bdun gyi ring du mu stegs rlung gi spu gri klu nā ra chu 'thung bsgrubs nas grong khyer 'bum tsho bdun liṅgar bkod pas: rgyal po rmi lam 'khrugs pa'i tshe nyin gcig rgyal po pho brang shar phyogs logs kyi ri siṅga la mthong ba'i rtser bud de bltas pas nub phyogs o rgyan gyi yul nas sprin nag po zhig byung nas de'i nang du: mu stegs phra man ral pa dmar ser yod pa ma he nag po la bzhon nas lag tu thog ser gyi sgrom bu tshwa tshwa khol ba zhig 'brug sgra ha cang che ba dang bcas byung bas: rgyal pos mu stegs kyi byad kha zhig yin nam bsams te cung bred pa dang nang du log par chas nas o rgyan la gsol ba phur tshugs su btab pa'i mod la siṅga la nas 'ja' dmar ser zhig lhag ge shar ba'i steng du gu ru nyi ma 'od zer mngon sum du mdun du byon: khyod bred mi dgos gsungs nas mdung rtse gsum pa de'i phyogs su gdeng bas 'brug gi skad chags mu stegs kyi dmu rtsa mo de shin du bred te rang log tu song : rgyal pos gsol ba lan bdun btab pa dang :

lung bstan te sang nyi ma rtse shar gyi skabs su khyod kyi sras mo lha lcam rin chen gsal sgron gdams ngag len du thongs shog siṅga la'i brag phug rasmi ko ṭi la'o: de ltar ma bgyid na: mu stegs bhi ru shas khyod kyi mnga' thang stong par byed nges so: zhes sgra de thos ma thag tu nang du log pas: mu stegs pas rgyal po byon pa'i shul du ri rlung thams cad byad kyi gtad bkram nas rang yul bros thabs kyis song ngo : rgyal pos phyi bsnyags pas rting ma zin par gyur to: phyi nangs snga zhogs rin chen gsal sgron bya ba de rje btsun rdo rje phag mo'i sprul pa mkha' 'gro seng gdong gi rnal 'byor ma yin pas: rgyal pos rin chen sna tshogs maṇ+ḍal bskur te: khol mo zhig bcas siṅga lar brdzangs: rje btsun nyi ma 'od zer mjal maṇ+ḍal phul zhing gsol ba btab: slob dpon la zhus pa: kye hoḥ mu stegs bla mchod bgyis nas ngan sngags mthu dang 'grogs: mchod gnas brtag gzhig med pas bar chod bdud kyis bslus: rgyal sna blon gyis bsgyur bas phung gtad sa gzhi gang : gnod rdzas phug tu bzhag na god kha rgyun mi 'chad: mi ngan grogs su bsten na gtam ngan rgyun mi 'chad: rdzas ngan lus la btags na dri ngan rgyun mi 'chad: phung shig yul la gtor na 'thab rtsod rgyun mi 'chad: des na nged kyi rgyal po blon 'bangs la: zhang zhung ngan sngags mkhan gyis tshad btsugs pas: dam pa rig 'dzin nyid kyis rjes bzung nas: 'di las grol ba'i gdams pa stsal du gsol: ces phul bas gu ru'i zhal nas: lha lcam rin chen gus pas rtser son la: khyod nyid rgya gar ḍāk+ki'i gnas mchog tu: rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i chas 'dzin nas: lo ma mun pa'i nags la gnas pa'i tshe: g.yul las rnam rgyal 'bar ba zhes su grags: res 'ga' sha za mo yi cha lugs 'chang : gdams pa 'di ko 'od zer dpal mos 'chang : zhag gsum bsgrubs nas rgyal blon 'bangs rnams la:

khrus bstsal dbang bskur srung ba 'di ltar 'chang : yul gru sa gnad ri mtho skyed mos tshal: byad du gang bcug gzungs chus 'khru bar gyis: lha khrus gtsang khrus byad khrus rnam pa gsum: 'grub par bgyis na grol nges the tshom med: byad kha rig sngags kho rang steng du 'gro: lha 'dre mi 'khu bar chad sel bar byed: klu gtad nag po'i shog bu rul ba'am: byad khang nang du sdod kyang ya mi nga : de bas gud du sbos shig sa ma ya: khyod kyis gdams pa 'di ri ri dhi pa la sprod nas dbang lung bgyid de rgyal po'i mchod gnas gyis: zhes gsungs shing man ngag de lha lcam rin chen gsal sgron la gdams pa bzhi skor shog dril ma bu gsum bgyis nas snyan brgyud gter rgya gnyis yod pa: gcig ye shes mtsho rgyal la gdams pa bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi them med skor ro: sa ma ya: de ltar gu ru'i bka' bzhin rje'i drung du zhag gsum bsgrubs pas dngos su yi dam gyi zhal gzigs: gsang mtshan la lha mo 'od zer can btags: rjes byin rlabs dang rab tu gnas nas rgyal po'i rang yul du brdzangs: rgyal po la sngar bzhin rje'i zhal gdams bshad pas shin tu dad pa thob: sras mor phyag 'tshal khri brtsegs nas khri gdan kha ru bzhag: yul der bram ze ri dhi pa zhes bya nags la gnas pa spyan drangs: rgyal po dang drang srong nang blon rnams la rin chen gsal sgron gyis gdams pa byin: de'i tshe drang srong bla mchod bgyis: rtag tu phan pa'i srung ba btags: lha lcam dang drang srong dpon slob kyis byad zor zlog pa'i lag rdeb yi ge bcu bzhi dang gdugs dkar g.yul bzlog sngags phra men ma tri ma'i sngags sbrags pas: kha che'i grong khyer bdun stong nus pa'i gdeng tshad thob: des mu stegs pa'i dmag byad zor thams cad rgyal po'i mnga' 'og lo stong phrag bdun la mi 'byung ba'i rten 'brel byung : de nas slar yang siṅga la bha ga la sham+bha la bcas gsum la gu ru nyi ma 'od zer rdzu 'phrul gyis phebs rgyal pos pho brang du gdan drangs:

lha lcam rin chen gsal gyis brtsams pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi phung po bsam las 'das pa phul: rgyal po smon lam bzang pos rgyud smin par mdzad: gu ru nyi ma 'od zer dang lha lcam rin chen yab yum dur khrod so sa gling du spyod pa la gshegs nas lo gsum bzhugs: slar rin chen gsal siṅga la'i shar phyogs shrī bha tra'i gnas la spyod pa la gshegs: lhar skye ba'i tha ma bod khams kyi dpung gnyen du 'byung bar lung bstan pa'o: sa ma ya: de nas dbang gi rim pa la 'jug pa ni: dkyil 'khor tshom bu kha ru bum pa me long ku sha dar tshon sna lnga bcas bzhag: mchod pa sna lnga yang bkod: mdun du zor gtor 'khor gsum pa zhig liṅgas brgyan pa bzhag: dkar bgegs la sogs grub rjes su: om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ āḥhūm̐: swa bhā wa shud+dho sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ: stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las bum pa ye shes kyi gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs pa'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma raṃ las nyi ma a las zla ba ste sum brtsegs kyi steng du baṃ dmar taṃ ljang muṃ dkar po ste yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa la bskyed pa'i rje btsun ri khrod kyi rnal 'byor ma sku mdog ljang mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma zhabs bzhi dang ldan ma: g.yas zhal gtsug tor rnam rgyal dkar mo 'dzum bag ldan pa ma rtsa zhal ljang mo 'phags ma sgrol ma ri khrod rgyas par bzhad ma: g.yon zhal dmar mo drag mo rdo rje khro gnyer can: mche ba gtsigs ma: phyag g.yon dang po gdugs dkar dang kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin ma: bar gnyis dgra satwa dang zhags pa thogs ma: tha ma gnyis mda' gzhu 'gengs ma: dbu la rin chen rgyan cha rnam par spras shing shing lo'i cod pan rnam par spras ma: sku stod dar ljang yug gos gsol nas nor bu dang rin chen rgyan drug spras ma: sku smad dar dmar ang rag gsol nas zhabs gnyis phyed pa'i skyil krung bzhugs ma:

sku la ye shes 'od zer dang 'bar ba'i me dpung 'bar bas bskor nas bdud dang mu stegs tshar gcod ma: snang la rang bzhin bral ba'i dam tshig dang ye shes dbyer med sgom pa'o: de ltar gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ om̐ sa ma ya satwaṃ: a be sha ya a a pra ti sarba satwaṃ: hūm̐: rang bzhin rtog med dbyings spros mkha' 'gro ma: dam tshig lha mo ye shes dpa' mo'i tshul: gnas 'dir spyan drangs dbyer med bzhugs su gsol: phyag 'tshal rab gus dwang bas mchod pa 'bul: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhu pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da āḥhūm̐: om̐ rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: de nas bstod pa ni: om̐: ye shes lha mo 'od rab 'byin: nyon mongs kun la sman pa'i mchog: sdug bsngal nad las grol mdzad ma: lha mo'i sku yi gzi byin gyis: gzhan gyis dmod pa'i rig sngags dang : dug dang nad mtshon chu la sogs: pha rol rgol ba'i byad ltas rnams: lha mo khyod kyis zhi bar mdzod: rtsa ba gsum bsgril: gzungs sngags ni: om̐ pi sha tsi par+ṇa sha ba rī sarba u pa smra ra pra sha ma na ye swā hā: om̐ sarba uṣ+ṇi ṣa bī ma le pra treṃ gh+ri ṇa bir ba tsakra na ma sa man+ta a dzi te dz+wa la dz+wa la pra dz+wa la khan+dha khan+dha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭḥ om̐ dzam+bha ni satwaṃ bha ni laṃ bha ni mo ha ni ha ha phaṭḥ he he phaṭḥ tshin+dha tshin+dha phaṭḥ da ha pa tsa phaṭḥ ma tha dhu na phaṭḥ shrī gh+raṃ badz+ra sarba ka ri hūm̐ drun hriṣ+ṭom̐ kriṣ+ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭḥ badz+ra muṃ ka ra badz+ra bhai ro tsa na badz+ra yo gi ni badz+ra ha ri ni sa dza hūm̐ phaṭḥ badz+ra ma tri ṇi phaṭḥ badz+ra ya ma ye phaṭḥ badz+ra ra tri ye phaṭḥ badz+ra ta tri ye phaṭḥ badz+ra ko au ma ri ku lan dha badz+ra singha mu ha hūm̐ bh+yoḥ badz+ra na mo dha ra ya baṃ ka ra phe ka ra bh+yoḥ gzhan gyis rig sngags dang byad du bcug pa khrol khrol:

mnan pa dang bskrad pa dang gzir ba dang : dmod pa dang mu stegs kyi ngan sngags ban bon gyi hoṃ sbar sogs gnod pa thams cad shig shig 'ur 'ur om̐ badz+ra me thun satwaṃ bha ya byer byer hri karma ku ru kī la ya dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces rtsa ba'i sngags ring yab yum 'brel ba 'di tshar brgya me long gi khrus byed pas bskrad: dbang la sngags ring tshar re yin: rdo rje slob dpon gyis sngags thams cad lcogs na mchod 'dzin gsum bzhi sogs gang yin kyis grangs bsags: sngags chu de la sbrus pa'i sāts+tsha lnga bcu'am yang na brgya btab: de rnams 'byung ba chus 'jig pa'i yul du bskyal: de la 'byung ba rang log zer ba yin: khrus dang dbang 'di nyi ma shar nas bzung nyin phyed mtshams nas bor: phyi dro nyi ma brgal ba'i dus bskrad zor re 'phang : bzhag mtshams nyin mo nyi ma rtse shar la bzhag: de nas bum pa thogs la: hoḥ khyed rnams la bum pas dbang bskur ba'i lus lha'i gzhal yas su tshud: khrus bstsal nas gzhan gyis dmod pa'i rig sngags sde brgyad kyi byad kha las grol: rtswa mchog ku sha g.yabs pas mthu gtad dang rig sngags dmod las gdug pa'i dbal kha la sogs zhi bar 'gyur ro: hūm̐: rdzu 'phrul bum pa gzhal yas lha: rig sngags 'dzin ma sku gsum dngos: skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: dbang bskur dang ni khrus bstsal nas: rdzas mchog ku shas rlung bkrol nas: 'byung lnga lha mos sku phyis pas: byad gtad zhags pa khrol gyur cig: om̐ sarba bhidha ya hūm̐ badz+ra dha ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ hūm̐: badz+ra sho dha sho dha hūm̐ hūm̐ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta satwaṃ bha khrol khrol: om̐ e ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ sum̐ ha he badz+ra phaṭ swā hā: 'di'i skabs gzungs ring thung gi mthar sde brgyad so so la rgyun du: om̐ āḥhūm̐: zhes pas byin gyis brlabs nas sbyang : ngar glud changs bu ting lo zhig bsngos nas: om̐ ā dhe wa lhas byad du bcug pa dang mnan pa bsdams pa rig sngags kyi dmod las byad zor phur kha'i gnod pa shig shig khrol khrol:

om̐ bhi dza ya ma hā bha la a dzi te tsit+ta hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: lha yi rgyal po 'khor dang bcas: shar phyogs sa bdag klu gnyan la: 'dod yon yas glud 'di bsngos pas: tshe rabs lan chags byang ba dang : dus kyi chad pa grol bar gyis: gzhan gyis byad du bcug pa dang : rig sngags dmod pas rbad pa sogs: 'dod yon glud 'dis 'khor bar gyis: bzung ba thongs la bcings pa khrol: phyin chad gnod pa ma byed cig: hūm̐: sems kyi glud 'di mkha' la gtong : mkha' la gnas pa'i lha 'dre dang : shar phyogs lha yi sde tshogs rnams: glud dang changs bu 'di khyer la: 'khor 'dir gnod pa ma byed cig: snying rje phan sems ldan gyur nas: bla med byang sems reg gyur cig: ma skyes pa dang mi 'gags pa: stong pa'i chos ni rtogs pa yi: rtag tu ye grol la gnas shog: om̐ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐: a a badz+ra mu swā hā: hūm̐: sha yi glud 'di sa la gtong : sa la gnas pa'i lha 'dre dang : shar phyogs lha yi sde tshogs rnams: glud dang changs bu 'di khyer la: 'khor 'dir gnod pa ma byed cig: snying rje phan sems ldan gyur cig: bla med byang chub reg gyur cig: ma skyes pa dang mi 'gags pa: stong pa'i chos ni rtogs pa yi: rtag tu ye grol la gnas shog: om̐ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐: a a badz+ra mu swā hā: hūm̐: khrag gi glud 'di chu la gtong : chu la gnas pa'i lha 'dre dang : shar phyogs lha yi sde tshogs rnams: glud dang changs bu 'di khyer la: 'khor 'dir gnod pa ma byed cig: snying rje phan sems ldan gyur nas: bla med byang chub reg gyur cig: ma skyes pa dang mi 'gags pa: stong pa'i chos ni rtogs pa yi: rtag tu ye grol la gnas shog: om̐ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐: a a badz+ra mu swā hā: hūm̐: drod kyi glud 'di me la gtong : me la gnas pa'i lha 'dre dang : shar phyogs lha yi sde tshogs rnams: glud dang changs bu 'di khyer la: 'khor 'dir gnod pa ma byed cig:

om̐ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐: a a badz+ra mu swā hā: hūm̐: rus pa'i glud 'di rdo la gtong : rdo la gnas pa'i lha 'dre dang : phyogs skyong 'jig rten skyong ba rnams: glud dang changs bu 'di khyer la: 'khor 'dir gnod pa ma byed cig: snying rje phan sems ldan gyur nas: bla med byang sems reg gyur cig: ma skyes pa dang mi 'gags pa: stong pa'i chos ni rtogs pa yi: rtag tu ye grol la gnas shog: om̐ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐: a a badz+ra mu swā hā: hūm̐: rtsa rgyus glud 'di shing la gtong : shing la gnas pa'i lha 'dre dang : phyogs skyong 'jig rten skyong ba rnams: glud dang changs bu 'di khyer la: 'khor 'dir gnod pa ma byed cig: snying rje phan sems ldan gyur nas: bla med byang sems reg gyur cig: ma skyes pa dang mi 'gags pa: stong pa'i chos ni rtogs pa yi: rtag tu ye grol la gnas shog: om̐ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐: a a badz+ra mu swā hā: hūm̐: nang rol glud 'di lam la gtong : lam la gnas pa'i lha 'dre dang : phyogs skyong 'jig rten skyong ba rnams: glud dang changs bu 'di khyer la: 'khor 'dir gnod pa ma byed cig: snying rje phan sems ldan gyur nas: bla med byang sems reg gyur cig: ma skyes pa dang mi 'gags pa: stong pa'i chos ni rtogs pa yi: rtag tu ye grol la gnas shog: om̐ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐: a a badz+ra mu swā hā: hūm̐: pags pa'i glud 'di thang la gtong : thang la gnas pa'i lha 'dre dang : phyogs skyong 'jig rten skyong ba rnams: glud dang changs bu 'di khyer la: 'khor 'dir gnod pa ma byed cig: snying rje phan sems ldan gyur nas: bla med byang sems reg gyur cig: ma skyes pa dang mi 'gags pa: stong pa'i chos ni rtogs pa yi: rtag tu ye grol la gnas shog: om̐ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐: a a badz+ra mu swā hā: hūm̐: gos kyi glud 'di sprin la gtong : sprin la gnas pa'i lha 'dre dang :

phyogs skyong 'jig rten skyong ba rnams: glud dang changs bu 'di khyer la: 'khor 'dir gnod pa ma byed cig: snying rje phan sems ldan gyur nas: bla med byang sems reg gyur cig: ma skyes pa dang mi 'gags pa: stong pa'i chos ni rtogs pa yi: rtag tu ye grol la gnas shog: om̐ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūm̐: a a badz+ra mu swā hā:

zhes bsngo mkhan zhig 'dug la bsngo: mtshams su rdo rje rgya gram spyi bor brgyan: hūm̐: rdo rje gcod pa'i ral gri las: 'phros pa'i rang bzhin steng 'og khyab: dkyil 'khor bya ba ma rdzogs bar: bgegs dang 'byung po'i mtshams chod cig: om̐ badz+ra tsakra hūm̐ hūm̐: de nas dgong thun bzlog pa las: dpal 'bar btsugs te: mkha' ru btegs la: hūm̐: bzhengs shig ma sring dbyings nas bzhengs: lha mo nyer gcig dbyings nas bzhengs: 'phags ma sha za chen mo bzhengs: khro gnyer rdo rje gtum mo bzhengs: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: mu stegs 'dul ba'i rdzu 'phrul 'gyed: dam sri sgrol ba'i mtshon cha thogs: mtshon cha rdo rje'i mda' thogs ma: 'bar ma rtse gsum thogs pa mo: g.yul las rgyal ba'i gdugs dkar 'dzin: sha za dgra satwa thogs pa mo: khro gnyer mche gtsigs zhags thogs ma: ma mo'i lus la gzi brjid 'phro: mo ni srid gsum g.yo ba mo: dug mtshon me chu'i byad kyis ni: 'jigs par mi nus gtum pa mo: nyid kyi sprul pa'i rol rtsal las: gnas nyul phra men srin mo'i gzugs: srod la rgyu zhing sha la za: mu stegs khrag la dgyes pa mo: dzā phran chen mo'i dus la bab: srid pa'i ma mo glog ma sprin: dzā min gshin rje'i las byed ma: gsod la dga' zhing gcod la rngam: phyag na gnam lcags thog mda' bsnams: byad zor phur kha bzlog tu gsol: pho rgyud khro bo'i drag sngags zlog: mo rgyud khro mo'i thun sngags zlog: ban+de sngags pa'i hoṃ sbar zlog: g.yung drung bon gyi mthu gtad zlog: mu stegs rnams kyi ngan sngags zlog: sde brgyad dregs pa'i rbad 'dre zlog: lha srin yongs kyi rbod gtong zlog: drang srong rnams kyi dmod pa zlog: nag po klu la gtad pa zlog: sa bdag gnyan la bcol ba zlog: rig sngags zor kha 'debs pa zlog: gnam nas dal kha 'bebs pa zlog: sa nas dug mda' g.yos pa zlog: phyogs nas dmag chen langs pa zlog:

dam sris phyi nang dkrugs pa zlog: phung sri kha gyod 'phen pa zlog: 'gong po'i rbab 'dre thams cad zlog: lo dang gza' skar mi mthun zlog: gshed bzhi'i dur kha 'debs pa zlog: gzugs med gshin skad 'don pa zlog: dur nas bla 'bod byed pa zlog: srid kyi phywa g.yang nyams pa zlog: dbul sri phugs su tshud pa zlog: 'byung pos mgo skor byed pa zlog: than dang cho 'phrul 'gyed pa zlog: srung rta'i rgya ma chags pa zlog: sme ba rlung rta nyams pa zlog: pho skag mo la rtsub pa zlog: mo skag pho la rtsub pa zlog: che skag chung la rtsub pa zlog: chung skag che la rtsub pa zlog: rgas skag gzhon la rtsub pa zlog: gzhon skag rgas la rtsub pa zlog: nor skag mi la yo ba zlog: mi skag nor la yo ba zlog: rgyal skag blon la yo ba zlog: blon skag rgyal la yo ba zlog: rje skag 'bangs la yo ba zlog: 'bangs skag rje la yo ba zlog: dus skag nad skag 'chi skag zlog: tshe zad za 'grangs thebs pa zlog: brgyag dang gos grangs them pa zlog: nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zlog: bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zlog: ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu zlog: glo bur brgyad cu rtsa gcig zlog: dus min 'chi ba bco brgyad zlog: dar sri gri sri thams cad rnams: bzlog go dmod pa'i mtshon gyis zlog: bsgyur ro dgra la bsgyur du gsol: pha rol byad ma sdig can gyi: rang mthu rang nus steng du zlog: dgra bo'i lha srung gshed du phob: sde brgyad za kha dgra la ston: mngon spyod phrin las 'grub par mdzod: e ka du na e sa bh+yo zlog: phaṭ ya ra ma sa ra da sha tsa ra ma sa ka aḥ e ka du ru bh+yo zlogaḥ ma tri ya tri re ma tri bh+yo bh+yoḥ na sha tsa tu du ma ya āḥ trig khroṃ bh+yo zlog: ma ṇi ma ra bh+yo zlog: mā ra ya du bh+yo zlog: rbad sa ma ya bh+yo zlog: ha la ha la hal ta hal ta bh+yo zlog: sarba ka khor du mā ra ya bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog:

ces lag rdeb bcas dgra bgegs byad ma'i phyogs su 'phang ngo : dmigs pa ni gtor ma gnam lcags kyi ri rab zur gsum pa rno dbal gdug pa'i mtshon 'debs pa'i shugs bcas ri rab mgo mjug ldog pa ltar 'phang bas pha rol byad ma'i yul zhing srung skyob ban bon mkhar khang dang bcas pa mgo mjug ldog nas thal me'i 'obs su chu blugs pa ltar phyur zhing brgyal nas ming shul tsam yang med par bsgom: de 'byung ba gsum gyis gtor bsregs spur 'ja' yal ba ltar byad ma bcas rtsa med du btang bar bsgom: dmigs med cho rol ka dag ngang la mnyam par bzhag pa'i rjes shes bya: rang nyid dang bsrung bya gnam lcags khro chu'i zhun ltar tshwa tshwa dang bcas pa'i lte ba'i dbus su hūm̐ mthing nag bsgom: rdo rje'i phyi'i steng du gdugs dkar po rtsibs stong ldan pa rtsibs kyi nang du sangs rgyas stong rtsa bsgom: g.yas g.yon mtshon cha'i gur khang : bar thams cad rdo rje'i drwa ba rwa: de'i lte bar khro mo kha dog lnga ldan bh+yo bh+yo phaṭ phaṭ kyi sgra sgrog pas bdud dang dam sris glags mi rnyed par bsgom: hūm̐ ni bh+rūm̐ badz+ra tsakra tsakra hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces brgya phrag bzlas rgyun gyi rnal 'byor yin: sa ma ya: de yang bsam gtan nyal chog gi gdams pa lha srin gdug pa kun grol zhes bya ba ste shin tu dam lci'o: 'di nyid sngags pa nang rgyas phyogs kyis gzhan mthu bskul ba'i gnod pa khyad par mi chen drag rim rnams mtho gnon chags sdang gis nye bar bskul nas byad zor phur kha gtong ba klu dang sa bdag sde sogs la gtad pa la: zhi ba'i sbyin pa btang : dmigs pa rig sngags khru ba phyi ba skyob pa'i srung ba 'dogs pa: drag po'i zor 'phen pa sogs rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas byed pa ste: 'di nyid ma rgyud lugs kyang zer: sangs rgyas gur khang lugs kyang zer: spyir ni bram ze ma'i lugs so: rgya gar nang pa rnams kyi bram ze rnal 'byor ma zer phyi pa rnams mu stegs kyi rnal 'byor grub thob ma yang zer:

spyir ni phyi nang gi bden pa mngon du gyur pa ste: ri khrod mar grags so: de ni nags ma'i khrod du bsgoms pa'i ming yin: zas su 'tsho ba shing 'bras skom bu ram shing gi khu ba sogs gos su shing lo gyon ma grub pa mnyes pa ma'o: de nas 'byung lngas bsdus pa'i bar chad kyi rigs thams cad mthong thos dran rigs dang : snying po bzlas pa tsam gyis chog par 'gyur ro: sngags 'di dang sngags chu rnams kyis snang srid lha srin gang gis zhags pa phog kyang nges par grol lo: 'dis rgyud las bdud bzhi grol zhing mi 'byung bar bshad: zhing khang dang khang pa la zhing gsar khang gsar bzo bar sde brgyad kyi byad du tshud pa'i ltas byung ba yin na gdams pa 'di nyid mchog tu 'gyur ro: khyad par sems can gyi srid dang dkar gzhon zhing gi sa bon zas kyi bcud nyams pa thams cad sde brgyad 'gong po'i za kha bcings nas mi 'byung bas de dag la yang dar dmar po dang seng ldeng phur bu la sngags nas lus la 'chang na za kha grogs 'byed kyang zer ba yin: khyad par dbang po 'thib pa'i rigs: rlung gis snying rtsa bcud pa yan lag zha ring gis bsdams pa thams cad byad gtad kyi sgrog tu tshud pa yin pas byad gtad 'grol ba'i snying po 'di glang chen smyon pa la sbyar nas na ba'i srang du blugs na phan no: srung skud dmar po la mdud pa nyer gcig brgyab sngags kyis rab tu gnas pas phan no: 'di nyid dgra byung ba'i tshe zlog sngags dang sbrags nas sgyogs la gnam lcags thog ser phog pas phye mar gyur pa'i dmigs pa bya ste bud med nyi shu rtsa gcig gis gcer bur bud la dor rta g.yas pa sngags pas zor 'phang dus gcig bgyis pas sgyogs kyi mde'u chag gzhu'i 'chang bzung log me mda'i sbo 'gad: sngags 'dis kyang bya: tshwa a thi nag po raṃ rbad li kham mu ra thun bh+yoḥ yang bzlog sham bu yin: zor 'phen skabs su bud med thams cad mdun nas dgra la kha gtad rgyu mtshan ci zhe na ming por ngo tsha ba'i dam tshig yod pas ma mo rang la tshur bzlog mi 'byung ba gnad sa ma ya:

las mtha' bcas pa grub nas slob ma gdan g.yung drung kha ru bzhag: gos dkar bskon tshe dbang bya: mthar gdugs dkar khri rdzogs 'don: zhag bdun bar 'khrig pa'i las dang sha mar grib la 'dzems: rtag tu srung ba lus la 'chang yang na spyi bor gdugs ltar phub zer ba yang 'dug pa sa ma ya: man ngag rin chen gsal bkod 'di: gu ru'i thugs kyi yang bcud nyid: bram ze dbang mo'i snyan brgyud yin: las 'phro can gyis 'byin nas kyang : skal ldan rnams la spel ba'i tshe: bar gcod bdud las rgyal bar mdzod: rgya 'di gnod sbyin gsum gyis srungs: gser srang gang gi maṇ+ḍal phul: de ma byung na dam rgya yin: de bas dam tshig thub par srungs: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: them rgya: ྀatsha rgya: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos sa khyi lor bod yul bsam yas mchims phu'i dge'u gong nas gdan drangs shing lcags phag lor mdo khams nā ga dhe wi ko ṭi ru shog ser nas zhal bshus so// // tsha) 'phags ma khro gnyer can ma las: sreg pa zangs kyi sgrom bu sog le dmar chung bzhugs so: khro gnyer khros pa'i drag mor 'dud: de nas khro gnyer can gyi las tshogs nyams su len pa'i tshe: zhi rgyas dbang drag lnga'i las la bsten pa ste: raṃ sreg byed kyi las la sbyor bar byed pa ni: ri gnyan sa gsum gyi rdo gsum la thod skam bris pa'i sgyed pu'i kha ru drag po'i lcags slang nang du shing tsher ma can gyi hom bya: skyer pa la byang bu'i liṅga bya yang na dug shog kha gang la dug khrag blugs la byad zor gyi bdag po liṅgar bcug: gzhan yang bsgral chas thams cad bkod: seng gdong ma'am cho ga tshar gcig btang : sāts+tsha dkar po la cu gang cong zhi ka la ma bcas la gdab: sāts+tsha nag po rdo sol dang bye nag skyer pa'i sol ba sreg pa la gdab: mda' hoṃ 'phang hoṃ rtsig pa'i kha ru bzhag: tsha dkar srid pa'i gangs chu: tsha nag byad kyi ri bo nag po ste gnyis:

pha rol mthu byed na phung shig gi rdzas dang stobs re tsha dkar nag gi mnan pa zhal shes so: 'di bu chu tsha dkar bshig pa ni: tsha dkar srung ba lugs ltar rdza pho btang ba'i srung 'khor bzhag la 'chang ba'i thabs kyang yod: bskyed rdzogs kyi don gcig yin: mda' hoṃ byed thabs thag sna lngas dkris pa de sngags re dang liṅga re sbrags la dum bu brgya re bcad nas sreg pa'i nang du 'bul: gri lcags kyi me cha dur rdo'i me rdo gri khrag gis ngar btags pa'i spra ba bcas dgos: bcad pa'i gri gug gam be gcod dam satwa re shang lang gang rigs gri lcags la bzo: de nas gser skyems gtong ba ni: hūm̐: dbyings las ma g.yos rdzu 'phrul drag mo'i sku: snang srid 'di ru gzhan gyis 'gran zla bral: nga nyid drag mo khros pa seṅge'i gdong : nga las che ba med do kun gyis nyon: ma nga nyid pho brang gnas chen u tsa la: dur khrod chen po rngams chen me 'bar rong : ri bo rus pa 'bab chu khrag dang zhag: rtsi shing thams cad mda' mdung mtshon cha gzengs: sgra skad thams cad rgyob sod 'brug ltar sgrogs: ro lang keng rus gcan spyang nyi li li: ngan sngags 'brug sgra gnam lcags sha ra ra: sha za srog gcod dbugs len rongs se rong : 'chi bdag phra men srog len zhungs se zhung : me 'bar mun rab sprin nag 'u ru ru: sprin gseb gnas nyul ma mo glog ltar myur: srid pa'i ri rab yom yom shig shig 'gul: de 'dra'i gnas nas bzhengs pa'i dbang mo che: che ba lha rnams thams cad nga yi 'khor: chung ba dregs pa sde brgyad nga yi bran: srid pa 'dir gnas nga yi las mkhan te: nga yis dmod pa'i las 'di gnyer ba'i phyir: phyi nang lha dang srung ma sku bskyod 'tshal: dbyings la gnas shing 'gyu ba'i lha tshogs rnams: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: kun kyang bdag nyid las bcol dpung la bzhengs: dmigs pa'i byad ma sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod:

ces phyogs bcur gtor: hom bskyed pa ni: phaṭḥ rang nyid ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma drag tu khros pa khro gnyer seṅge'i gdong pa can: shin tu gtum pa dur khrod chas brgyad dang ldan pa: phyag g.yas srog gcod las kyi gri gug nam mkha'i mthongs la phyar zhing g.yon pas kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum thog ltar 'bebs pa: zhabs gyad kyi dor stabs can: chos 'byung 'bar ba'i dbus su gnas pa: mdun du phrin las kyi sprul pa drag mo lcags gdong nag mo gcer mo mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi dmar po gyon nas nu ma gyen thor du 'khyil ba phyag g.yas dang g.yon pas lcags kyu 'dzin pa: dgra bgegs kyi srog la dbang ba'i rnam par gsal: ma mo gsod byed ma'i g.yas g.yon bya rog dang 'ug pa'i gdong can dgra bgegs lha dang dbye ba'i rdzas thun nag po thogs pa: mdun du bla 'gugs kyi ma mo srog 'phrog gsum ni: dmar mo me mdog sngon mo chu mdog nag po mun pa'i mdog thams cad kyi lag tu bla 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu bla 'ching ba'i zhags pa bla 'dzin gyi drwa ba bla dwags kyi ring cha bla 'bod kyi gri rkang g.yab mo 'debs pa'i rnga ma dmar nag bcas thogs nas dgra bgegs gdug pa can 'gugs pa'i rang bzhin du gsal ba'o: bh+yo ba singha ḍāk+ki kro ti kā li ma mo bh+yo bh+yoḥ a ka sa ma ra tsa sha da ra sa ma ra ya phaṭḥ ma tri thun ma bh+yo dza bh+yo trag rak+mo bh+yo bh+yoḥ kha la rak+mo e ka tsa ti bh+yoḥ kha khā hu lu ma mo bh+yoḥ tri dza tri dza baṃ shag byin tu bh+yo bh+yoḥ ma mo tri rak+mo dza tri ma bh+yo bh+yoḥ thun thun bh+yo bh+yoḥ o kaṃ shaṃ nṛ tri thun dza phaṭḥ mdun du gnam lcags las grub hom khung nag po zur gsum kha dogs mthil yangs pa bang rim dgu kha khyer gsum dang ldan pa: kha khyer dang po la sgrol byed shan pa nag mo glog ltar 'gyu ba: gnyis par lha bdud nag mos gshin skad 'o dod drag tu 'bod pa: gsum par bla 'gugs dus kyi pho mo srid gsum gling bzhi yud kyis bskor zhing dgra bo'i bla srog rnam shes skad cig la 'gugs pa:

las kyi brub khung chen po de la mngon spyod rtags kun tshang ba gshin rje'i bsad khang bdud kyi bsha' ra sde brgyad kyi 'du sa pho nya'i 'gyu lam klu bdud kyi gre ba: gza' bdud kyi lto ba: srog gcod nyi khri dgu 'bum tshogs pa'i gling chen po: gshin yul zangs thang dmar po'i rnam pa mngon sum du bkod pa'i mthil du: nṛ tri dmar nag gnyis las bskyed pa'i dam nyams pa'i dgra bgegs: byad ma sdig can de nyid lus sngo zhing ham pa mig shi mig can: bu ga dgu nas khrag 'dzag pa: yan lag mya ngan gyi cha byad can la lcags sgrog dang zhags pas bsdams pa: gcer bu byang thang gi lhag pas phyur ba la grang dmyal brgyad kyi ngad dang ldan pas rab tu gzir nas smre sngags kyi keg bu 'don pa'i dbyibs su bskyed pa'o: bsad khang nag po de'i nang las kyi rlung dmar 'u ru ru 'tshubs pa: phyi na zhe sdang gi me 'bar ba: nang na 'dod chags kyi khrag mtsho 'khyil ba: bar du gti mug gi mun pa 'khrigs pa: logs na phrag dog gi thog dang ser ba'i bu yug 'tshubs pa: las kyi bdud mo dam sri ma dang mtshan mo rgyu ba: srod la nyul ba sreg ma 'phrog ma skem byed ma bcas bdud mo thams cad cho nge lhang lhang byed pa ste las kyi pho nya rnams kyis bzung nas thar pa med pa'i rang bzhin du gyur: phaṭḥ na mo: drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang : chos kyi bka' bden pa dang : dge 'dun? gsang sngags gsar rnying rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor rnams kyi? gsang sngags kyi rgyal po khro bo rig sngags kyi bdag mo khro mo rnams kyi? khyad par nyi ma nub phyogs o rgyan sprul pa'i zhing khams nas: ma ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seṅge'i gdong pa can rigs lnga: u tsa la yi dur khrod chen po nas sku sprul seṅge'i gdong pa can:

gsung sprul stag gi gdong pa can: thugs sprul phag gi gdong pa can: yon tan gyi sprul pa dom gyi gdong pa can: phrin las kyi sprul pa spyang ki'i gdong pa can: sgrol byed nag mo lcags kyi gdong pa can: phra men ma bya rog 'ug pa'i gdong pa can: dus kyi pho nya mo dmar mo srog gcod btsan gyi bu mo: sngon mo dbugs len klu yi bu mo: bla 'gugs nag mo bdud kyi bu mo lo zla zhag dus za ma chu tshod dus kyi pho nya mo drug cu rtsa bzhi: srid pa'i nag mo shwa thogs rgyan thogs khram thogs rtsis thogs bdud mo bcu gnyis: skye 'gro gling bzhi'i srog bdag mo srin mo khrag gi ral pa can brgyad: ma bh+yo dzaḥgasum las 'chi bdag tshe bdag srog bdag ma mo gsum: ye shes dang 'jig rten las la grub pa'i phra men ma bcu gnyis: dgra lha dmu rtsa mo rtsa brgyad: gzhan yang ma rgyud mkha' 'gro srid pa'i lha mo dus bdag ma gtso 'khor dang bcas pa'i mthu stobs nus pa dmod pa'i rigs sngags drag po 'di la brten nas zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bgegs byad ma ming nas dmod de 'gugs pa'i las su bcol ba ni: spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig pa: dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smad pa: dge 'dun gyi chos sde bcom pa: bsam gtan bsgom pa'i dben ri gnyen po gtor ba: khyad par gsang sngags kyi bstan pa rin po che spyi dang bye brag bstan pa'i bdag po rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi brgyud 'dzin dpal ldan rnying ma'i chos gral mtshon pa'i 'dus sde rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la: tshad btsug pa ya bor bzung ba do bsdo ba phod btsugs pa 'gran brtsal ba mi nga la lha med zer ba: lha khyed la mthu med zer ba: chos skyong srung ma'i nus pa gshe ba: gzhan yang nyi ma phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas gzugs can sdang bar byed pa'i dgra: gzugs med gnod par byed pa'i bgegs:

tshe la bar du gcod par byed pa'i mtho gong nas brgal ba dma' chad du 'bebs pa: sde chen la gnyer ba: chu chen la sgug pa: zam chen nas bkag pa: 'phrang chen nas gcod pa: la so nas bsrung ba: lung gsum nas rku ba: sngon 'gugs rgyab 'ded byas pa: longs spyod za lam du dug 'debs pa: 'gro lam rkang zhabs su rtsang btsugs pa: shag ngan gyi sna 'dren byas pa: ngos bstod lkog nas smad pa: kha dar las 'jam pa: khog tsher las rtsub pa: dmag sna jag sna rkun sna ston pa: dgra kha dang mi kha zug pa: nad kha dang yams kha rims kha 'tshub pa: bdud srin bgegs dang 'byung po byur yul khyad par du yang dgra mgo thog nas bab pa: dgra ri rtse nas langs pa: dgra lung gsum nas langs pa: dgra mi chen nas langs pa: dgra yul mi nas langs pa: dgra mthun gsum nas langs pa: dgra pha spun nas langs pa: dgra khyim mtshes nas langs pa: dgra sgo them nas langs pa: dgra gzhi gshed nas langs pa: snga dgra yid la sems shing : da dgra thad nas langs pa: spyi dgra rlung ltar 'tshubs pa: sgos dgra rbab ltar brgyugs pa: zur dgra khyi ltar zug pa: lam gyi mgron po bcom pa: ngo log rgyab ston byed pa: bka' dang dam las log pa la sogs khyad par gdug cing sdang ba'i ban byed bon byed skye bo'i mda' zor bud med dmod zor: yugs sa'i thal zor: rigs sngags kyi thun zor: zhang zhung gi mthu zor: la sogs pa bdag cag sgrub pa po'i lus ngag yid gsum khyim sgo lam gsum: gzhi lam byes gsum thams cad du gnod cing sdang bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs byad ma rnams kyi mi rabs bdun rgyud dang bcas pa thams cad gnam sa gling bzhi ri rab gling phran gling bar mun bar ban bon srung ma'i skyabs 'og gang du gnas kyang rang dbang med par gzugs liṅga la bkod pa bla shog bu la bris pa: rnam shes sa bon la btab pa 'di la khug cig: lha'i dkar byang la phob cig: btsan gyi dmar byang la phob cig:

bdud kyi nag byang la phob cig: gshin rje'i khram byang la phob cig: tshe phyi ma la dus ma btab skye 'chi gnyis la khung ma g.yar: las kyi rnam par smin pas bkug ma dgos par gzugs liṅga 'di la rang dbang med par khug cig: om̐ badz+ra aṅku sha ya dza dzaḥ rat+na pā sha hūm̐: pad+ma s+pho ṭa baṃ: karma gaṇ+ḍe hoḥ

de nas 'gugs gzhug lan gsum bya'o: pho nya 'gyed pa ni: dza bh+yoḥ snang srid bdag mo srog bdag har len mo: pho nya mi bsrun bdud kyi dbang mo che: nag mo srog la myur byed dus la bab: dam nyams byad ma'i bla srog khug la shog: keṃ keṃ me 'bar rtsar nas rgyug byed ma: dmar mo zangs 'phar gdong can dus la bab: byad ma'i bla 'khyams ma shor khug la shog: sngo dmar rlabs phyur 'phyo ma mun par gtibs: gcan spyang lag ring gdong can dus la bab: dmigs pa'i dgra bo bla 'khyams khug la shog: bh+yoḥ bla 'dzin lcags kyu 'bar bas zungs la shog: bla 'ching zhags pa nag pos sdoms la shog: bla 'dzin drwa ba'i nang du tshud la shog: bla 'bod gri rkang gling bus sdus la shog: phyags pa'i rnga ma dmar nag g.yobs la shog: ring cha tshon skud sna lngas sgril la shog: bla 'ded bya can rnams kyis chum la shog: dgra bo'i bla dwags ming byang 'di la phob: byad ma gdug pa'i bla tshe rten dang phrol: gzugs byang 'di la khug cig mā ra ya: tri tri nṛ tri aṅku sha ya dzaḥ thun thun ma tri ma tri dgra bo bla sha re ma tri thun dza dzaḥ bla 'gugs skabs dang bstun bya rog 'ug sgro thogs la: bh+yo dzaḥ mun pa nag po khā kha mu kha ma: dgra bgegs ban bon byad ma lha dang phyes: sdig can brnag pa'i dgra bo lha dang phyes: pha lha ma lha zhang lha skyes lha phyes: dgra lha srung skyob ban bon rnams dang phyes: bh+yoḥ hu lu nag mo dug 'debs 'ug gdong ma: ltas ngan brgyad cu dgra bgegs bdud dang sprod: dmigs pa'i byad ma 'chi bdag bdud dang sprod: dmod pa'i dgra bo srog bdag bdud dang sprod: byad ma sdig can phung bdud nag por sprod: satwar thogs bdud kyi bu mo'i dus la bab: dgra bgegs lha dbye bdud sprod dus la bab: mngon spyod mā ra ya yi phrin las mdzod: bh+yoḥ khā kha mu kha dgra bo shag phyes: hu lu mu kha dgra bo shag phyes: tri tri nṛ tri thun thun rbad nan:

de nas phur pas gzir la mchod g.yog pas thun brdeg cing : dzaḥ las byed chen po dus la bab: dgra bo'i phung po bshig pa'i phyir: dmod pa nag po thun gyis brdeg: dzaḥ nyungs thun drag sngags dmod pa'i rdzas: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: rdo thun rbab rgod hri li li: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: dug thun smyo 'bog thibs se thib: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: me thun tshwa tshwa si li li: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: chu thun sbos 'gad 'u ru ru: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: khrag thun nad rlangs chi li li: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: mtshon thun rno ngar zengs se zeng : dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: mda' thun thog rgod sha ra ra: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: gnam lcags phur thun hril li li: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: phaṭ ya ra ma sa ra da sha tsa ra ma sa ka aḥ thun bh+yo thun bh+yoḥ hūm̐ bh+yo dzaḥ las la khros pa'i sha za mo: phra men nag mo lcags gdong can: khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab: phyag g.yas zangs gri 'bar ba bsnams: yar rtse rdo rje rtse lnga yi: ye shes mkha' 'gro las la bskul: 'chang bzung zlum skor chu srin kha: 'jig rten mkha' 'gro'i pho brang nas: dbal so zangs gri 'bar ba yis: dgra bo'i bdun rgyud rtsad nas chod: dgra bo'i sgo dgur dzaḥkhraṃ ya: phyag g.yon gnam lcags mkhar phur bsnams: yar rtse dug gsum rtsad nas chod: 'chang bzung gza' bdud pho nya 'gyu: chu srin mtshon cha'i zi ra khol: zur gsum gnam lcags thog rgod 'bebs: srog bdag ma gsum dus la bab: dam nyams dgra bo sdig can gyi: spyi gtsug rkang mthil yan chod kyis: dbang po sgo dgur kī la ya: rtsa mdud lnga la kī la ya: dbang po drug la kī la ya: rnam shes brgyad la kī la ya: 'byung 'dus gzugs la kī la ya: pho rgyud mo rgyud kī la ya: rigs rgyud bcas par kī la ya:

dkar nag snying la kī la ya: srog gcod dbugs sdud phung po shigs: mā ra ya yi phrin las mdzod: om̐ badz+ra lo ka ma tri ya sarba ka ra ti ka ya dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: badz+ra kī li kī la ya tri shu la dgra bo'i snying rtsa myog myog mā ra ya phaṭaḥ ces gri gug snying khar gdab nas gnas spar ba ni: hoḥ rnam shes ngo bo āḥdakar de: phung po bshig nas klong du bstim: phaṭḥ lan gsum gyis spar: de nas spu gri sogs kyis: bh+yoḥ gdug pa'i dgra bo byad ma la: 'bar ba'i mtshon cha char phab pas: ming shul tsam yang med par gyis: gtubs shig ral gri 'bar ba'i mtshon: lha'am 'on kyang brlag par byed: bcad cing gtub pa'i dus la bab: gtubs nas rdo rjes gtun du brdung : rig sngags dmod pa'i byad zor rnams: phye mar shig cig mā ra ya: om̐ badz+ra ka ra ti ka dgra bo gtub gtub: kha ra ka dgra bo shig shig: a yu dha dgra bo myog myog: badz+ra kī li kī la ya byad ma bh+yo bh+yoḥ rbad rbad nan nan chod chod bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭḥ shog ling shing ling skabs dang bstun: de nas me hoṃ bskyed pa ni: bh+yo bh+yo bh+yoḥ mdun du drag po e yi me thab zur gsum pa kha khyer mtshon cha drwa bas bskor ba de'i dbus su ma bh+yo dzaḥ gsum las bskyed pa'i gru gsum du me sdig dmar po chu'i sdig pa sngo nag lcags kyi sdig pa sngon po de'i dbus su khro mo za byed kha la rgyas 'debs ma lcags gdong nag mo zhal gdangs pa'i dbus su dug gi gdong can sdig pa kham nag lus thams cad gnyer mas gang ba mgo dgu rwa bco brgyad pa yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa lus thams cad mig gis gang ba zhal thams cad bar snang du gdangs pa: mche ba spu gris gtams pa'i so ltar gtsigs pa lce hom gzar ltar dmar nag gnyis brkyangs pa ngo bo srid pa las kyi ma mo gnam sa sdig rgod 'bar ba ltar bskyed pa'i zhal du dgra bgegs byad ma pha rol gyis rig sngags kyi mthu gtong ba'i ban bon byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa byad ma rang gshed phab nas zhal du gsol ba'i rang bzhin can du gyur:

bh+yoḥ za byed 'bar ba las kyi ma mo'i tshogs: gnam lcags sdig rgod 'bar ba zhal gdangs nas: dgra bgegs byad ma gnod byed zhal du bstab: rigs sngags byad zor phur kha bzlog tu gsol: om̐ badz+ra ma tri rak+mo bh+yo lo ha bhiṣatsha kha byad ma a pa ya mā ra ya kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes pas rigs sngags kyi mthu gtong ba'i ban bon byad ma rnams pho nya las kyi ma mos zhal du bstabs nas byad ma rang gshed phab par bsam: dgra bo zhal du bstab pa kha sgyur yin: dgra bo mnan pa'i tshwa nag zhal la gab 'di gzhung bsreg gtor sbyangs bkrus gdams pa yin: las mtha'i sngags 'bul ni: dzaḥ 'joms byed chen po srog bdag ma mo gsum: dgra bgegs srog la dbang phyir hoṃ zhal phyes: dgra bgegs byad ma mi rabs bdun rgyud rnams: srog bdag ma mo gsum gyi zhal du 'bul: om̐ ma tri ma bh+yo bh+yo byad ma'i bla srog rnam shes la kha kha khā hi: om̐ dza tri ma bh+yo bh+yo dgra bo'i phung po lnga la kha kha khā hi: om̐ tri tri rak+mo kha la rak+sha bh+yo bh+yo dgra bgegs kyi lha srung dang bcas pa kha kha khā hi: baṃ raṃ bh+yoḥ phaṭ ya ra ma sa ra da sha tsa ra ma sa ka a ma tri lo ha kā li yak+sha pra mo mi mu raṃ mu tsa dza bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog pha rol byad ma rnams dang rigs sngags kyi mthu gtong ba thams cad nan brub ruṃ ha la bhig nan thum thum myog myog rbad rbad: ces pas phul: de nas tsha dkar byad thag bcad pa ni: spu gri gri gug gang rung gis: bh+yoḥ ye shes mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma: phyag na gnam lcags mtshon cha thogs: ban bon mu stegs dmod pa yi: snang srid yongs kyi byad thag chod: bh+yoḥ aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphaṭḥ om̐ sarba karma ṇi ka khor+dha bhan+dha bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas bsreg pa ni: sngags 'dis: bh+yoḥ ma tri mu raṃ dza tri kha la shig sarba ka khor+dha raṃ raṃ ye swā hā: tsha khrus ni: bh+yoḥ ye shes seng gdong dkar mo yi:

thugs kyi 'od zer bdud rtsi yis: byad kyi ri bo nag po shigs: dmod pa'i phung shig nag po gtor: om̐ mu mu mu laṃ mu saṃ dha mu khaṃ mu raṃ mu yaṃ ye swā hā: dgra yul mchod rten dkar nag: 'di ni mthu bya na ma gtogs mi dgos: zhal la gab dbyangs gsal gyi las sbyor gnyis yod: mthar chu la dor ba ni: hūm̐: dbyings las ma g.yos mā ma kī: 'byung ba chu yi gsher brlan la: byad ma bsregs gtor bkrus nas su: skye med dag pa'i klong du thim: chu yis khyab pa'i sems can rnams: byad dang gtad las grol gyur cig: om̐ badz+ra dharma shud+dhe ye muṃ sa ma ya: mā ma kī ye swā hā: ling ro mnan pa zhal las shes: 'di'i nang du dgos pa min: byad ma sgrol ba'i 'debs ka yin: dza bh+yoḥ rim pa dgu yi sa 'og nas: sa srin nag mo lcags ral ma: lag na sbrul gyi zhags pa thogs: srid pa las kyi kha gdengs nas: 'gugs byed dbal gyi lce rkyongs shig: dam nyams dgra bgegs khyod la gtad: zhal du bstabs nas kha bsdams te: bskal pa stong du ma shor cig: nag po ti pa sha kā li dung dung tri mun tri mun thun thun satwaṃ bha ya nan nan: seng ldeng phur pa'am dug shing ngo : me hoṃ bshig pa ni: hoḥ bsreg bya sreg byed rang bzhin me: dgra bo'i phung khams ma gtogs pa: pho nya mo rnams skye med hoḥ phaṭḥphaṭḥphaṭḥ zhi drag ci bya dmigs pa gsal rdzogs so: tsha dkar srung ba dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying po rab gnas bya la srung sgrom mam gzhi dkar la bzhag: sbyang spel lugs la snga ma ltar ro: bsad pa lugs la zhal shes: sa ma ya: 'di nyid phra men zangs 'bar gdong gi las tshogs sreg pa zangs sgrom dmar po ma mo khrag ral ma'i rgyud nas bram ze ma'i lugs dgra bo byad du ma bcug pa rnams bcug pa'i gdams pa: mnan sreg bgyis pa'i gdams pa byad du bcug pa bkrol nas dbang bskur ba'i gdams pa dbang bskur nas srung 'khor rab tu gnas pa'i gdams pa ste:

'di nyid srung bzlog bsad gsum gang du 'jug pa gzhung gcig 'bebs kha gsum chog pa'o: gsang sngags 'khrul 'khor gsum yod: sāts+tsha dkar po gsang ba mkha' 'gro kun 'dus ma: sāts+tsha dmar po srin mo zangs kyi mgo bo can: sāts+tsha nag po ma mo nag mo gcan spyang gdong can ma dgra bo mnan: khyad par rgya gar bram ze'i lugs rlung zhags ma'i rgyud: khro gnyer can gyi skor sogs them med do: ma mo las bdag mtshan mo sgra sgrogs kyi rgya gnyer ro: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: bdag 'dra phyogs med kyi rnal 'byor rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling pas sa khyi lor brag dmar dpal gyi bsam yas nas gdan drangs shing lcags phag lor shog ser nas nang chen e waṃ sgar du bsgyur ba'o/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // dza) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bar chad kun sel las: bum gter ri khrus kyi bkram bkod ye shes me long bzhugs so: bde gshegs rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i sku la 'dud: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e ma nyon dang ye shes mtsho rgyal lcam: ma 'ongs yang mtha' dus kyi tha ma ru: sde brgyad 'khrugs pas sems can bsod nams dman: de yi shugs las yul gru dgon sde 'khrug: de tshe skyes lha srung ma thams cad nyams: de la ri bstod ri khrus bum gter dang : dam sri mnan pa sa gnad bcos pa gtso: mtsho rgyal brda yi ri mor yi ger gzugs: ma 'ongs bstan pa gso ba'i btsas su bzhag: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de yang sa rtags dus dang lo zla sogs: khyad par snang srid 'khrugs pa'i sde tshogs 'di lta bu 'byung ste: steng du lha dang lha min 'khrugs: bar du sde brgyad 'og gi klu srin 'khrugs: gza' dang rgyal po 'khrugs: btsan dang ma mo 'khrugs: sa bdag dang the'u rang 'khrugs: bdud dang gnod sbyin 'khrugs: gshin rje dang dmu bdud 'khrugs: skyes lha dang dgra lha 'khrugs: mgur lha dang brtan ma 'khrugs: de'i rkyen gyis yul gru so sor 'khrugs:

dmag 'khrug gi rlangs pa yul lha la phog pas yul lha nyams: skyes lha nyams pas rang mgo mi 'og tu 'chor: phrag lha nyams pas dgra lha mi 'khor: mi 'khon lha la phog pas lha 'khon srung ma dbyings su gyes: lha 'khon mi la phog pas nad yams kyis mi thog bud: srid rdzong du gri khrag 'khyil: sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams nyams pas byin rlabs dang thugs rje nyams: bden pa'i nus pa dbyings su yal: yul du dgra sna dang dmag sna phog pas bkra mi shis pa'i lam dod: rten 'brel log: ban sngags mthu chen gyis yul zhing byad du bcug pas yul dang grong du lo nyes rgyun mi 'chad: skyes lha dang yul lha 'khon gyis grib phog pas yul mdangs nyams: mi yi bkrag shor: lus kyi chas 'gyur: dkar gzhon mi 'byung : khyad par du yul mi kha 'thor gyis liṅga dang 'gong po spun dgu'i yas thag phyogs nas bskyal ba'i dam sri ldang : sde dgon dang yul mi nang zhig tu 'gro: mgur lha dang bod skyong rnams kyis bstan pa mi skyong zhing dgra 'bod kyi g.yab g.yob 'then pas sa gnad kyi me btsa' thams cad 'byung ba rang bzhin du stong : yul lha rgyal bsren 'gong po dam sri spun dgu chags: gtsug lag khang dang gnas gzhi nyams rgyal 'gong gi bstan pa me ltar 'bar: phung byed nag pos yul nas dmag gi sna thag 'dren: des bod 'bangs thams cad chags sdang me ltar 'bar: nang tshan ngo log dgra la phyogs: khyad par 'byung ba dug gi kha rlangs mun ltar 'thib pa'i dus 'byung : de yi dus bod kyi mgur lha mchod thabs ri bstod bum gter dang ri khrus: dgra sri dang dam sri mnan pa bcas bgyis pas yul gru bkra shis shing lo phyugs legs: mi nad dang phyugs nad zhi khyad par dmag dang mu ge'i bskal pa zhi zhing : chos srid bstan pa dar la yun ring gnas: yul gyi 'dre chag thams cad kyi gdug pa zhi: dgra lha dar: mgur lha brtan ma rnams kyis grogs dang rogs dan bsgrub:

yul gyi nyams grib sangs: lha srin sde brgyad kyang brten la chags par gyur: de dag gso ba'i tshe yang rdzas dang rten 'brel sogs ma nyams pa dang : dus dang gnas skabs tshes grangs kyi ngos shin tu legs par bya: sa ma ya: de yang thog mar ri khrus rtsom pa'i rdzas sman gyi bye brag phra mo la 'jug pa ste: mda' dar sna lnga: rin po che'i me long ngam: yang na shel sgo rma med do: li yi me long sogs yul gyi gzugs mthong ba zhig dang : gzhong pa zangs kyi ka to ra klu brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor shong ba: sku gsung thugs kyi rten khyad 'phags klu sman sna tshogs: dzā ti li shi gur gum gi waṃ tsan+dan dkar dmar: cu gang ka ko la a ga ru rgya mtshal snying zho sha mkhal ma zho sha mchin pa zho sha: dbang lag 'bras bu gsum rgya mtsho'i lbu ba: cong zhi sogs sman bzang po'i rigs phon gang che bcas: zhib btags phye ma nor bu'i rigs phye lnga rin po che sna tshogs: rtsi bcud lnga sogs bum rdzas spyi 'gro: bdud rtsi bum pa sgrub pa'i phye ma sogs dri bzang bum pa'i rdzas: gter bum bsgrub na srog shing tsam gyis tshang : rin chen sna lnga sogs yul lha'i bla rten gzhan yang khrus dar bkra shis rtags brgyad cha tshang : rig ldan ma bcu drug gis rgya bod rnams nas blangs pa'i chu sna sa rdo shing sna sogs so sor brgya tshar re tshang ba: khyad par gangs ri gtan du sdod pa'i sa dang mtsho mo gtan du 'khyil ba'i chu: chu mig bkra shis kha shar du gyu ba gang mang gi chu sna: dal ldan gtsang po yar 'khyil gyi chu rdo: sa rdo rigs kyang rgyal rigs: gangs ri rtse ma nyams pa rje rigs: brag ri rtse rgyal: bram ze brag dkar bya rgod 'tshogs 'dra: me tog skyes pa'i spang ljongs: dmangs rigs btsun mo 'dra ba: nor bu'am bu spang : rdza spang mtshan ma 'dra ba: gdol pa brag nag ri srin po khros 'dra mda' mdung ral gri gshibs 'dra sogs: de dag mtho ba'i rlung mtho rtse nas len thub na rab:
