khyad par rje rigs bram ze sogs gsum gyi sa: dma' sa nas mi blang chu rnams kyang de dang mtshungs pa legs: shing kyang mar shing mang la 'bras bu can gang 'grub mya ngan med pa gces: ri dwags sna tshogs pa'i rwa co dbyangs gsal dang sngags rgod yi ges brgyan pa: g.yag lug sna tshogs kyi rwa co la rten 'brel snying pos brgyan pa: lho byang gi ri chen: mgur lha dang brtan ma gnas pa dgu'i rtse nas blangs pa'i rdo sna la rab gnas kyi yi ges brgyan pa: gzhan yang ri bstod cha lag lha mkhar dang rnying gter du bum pa lnga: rnga thug dkar nag dmar gsum rgyal mtshan lnga ldan: 'dzam gling dge ba'i dar lcog lnga ldan: mda' dar bzhi ldan: me long gsum: yul lha dang mthun pa'i phyag mtshan ba dan: rlung rta lnga ldan lha mkhar re re la brgya las mi nyung ba: go khrab dang dpyad kha'i rigs gang srid: yul lha dang mthun pa'i rkang 'gro 'dab chags sder chags: mtshon kha zhi ba'i phyir rgya khab gang mang : mtsho 'bul gser g.yu sogs rin po che'i rigs ci mang : 'bru sna tshogs shing 'bras sna tshogs: rgyan bstod kyi mda' dar gang mang : tshe ring gtor ma: sku lha mo 'od zer can gyi ca lag zur du gsal: gser gyi rgyal mtshan nang du gu ru phyag rgya bzhi sgrub: bar chad lam sel gyi tsakli: sgo ma'i lde mig bzhi: sde brgyad mnga' gsol gyi ca lag:

sa ma ya: de yang ri bstod kyi cha lag rdzas sogs tshang ma grub rjes: yar gzhir lha gzhung ltar gtor mchod tshang ma bkram: mdun bskyed stegs bu mda' gang ngam 'dom gang zhig byas la: sa gzhi dag gtsang ni: rig ma rnams kyis rigs lnga mda' dar bum pa 'bru sna spos sprin thogs la: gar stabs dbyangs len brda 'gros kyi ngang nas dkyil 'khor la bskor ba bya ba ni: hūm̐: sa yi lha mo dbyangs can rdo rje'i gdangs: dri za 'bum gyis bsgrun du med pa'i gsung : rnam dag zla ba'i bdud rtsi bsil ba'i char: dag gtsang rtsal ba'i zhing rdul 'jam por gyis: om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta nā ga tsak+ṣa sarba ga ga hoḥ de nas dri bzang gi chur: hūm̐: zag med bde chen 'khyil ba'i bum bzang ma: mgrin sngon lta bur ldu ba'i spyi blugs rnams: dri bzang chag chag gdab pa lag mthil ltar: baiḍūr mdangs ldan 'jam por gnas gyur pa'i: om̐ gan+dhe hu pe bh+rūm̐ ba swā na la satwaṃ: me tog 'thor zhing : hūm̐: klu yi dbang mo yid 'ong mdzes 'phro ma: yid la rnam par 'joms pa'i dbang mo che: dri bsung chags pa ha lo'i skyed tshal du: rnam par bskul phyir rab tu spro bar bgyi: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe ku mu ta pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: bkra shis pa'i gnas bskur ba ni: hūm̐: bkra shis lha mo gang zhig nam mkha'i khyon: yongs su gang ba'i brda gar rol rtsed kyis: sa gzhi 'di nyid byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir: ḍāk+ki rgya mtsho'i bkra shis deng 'dir stsol: om̐ swa ra swā ti lā s+ye mā l+ye gīrti maṅga la ku ṭa swā hā: zhes rig ma rnams kyis bkra shis pa'i sa gzhir spel: de nas thig gdab pa ni: rdo rje slob dpon nub tu 'khod: rig ma rnams shar du gnas: thog mar thig sna mkha' la gtad: hūm̐: kun gzhi skye med nam mkha'i klong : dbyings phyug bzang mo'i mkha' lam du: longs sku ma 'gags rang rtsal phyir: rang byung ye shes thig gdab bo: om̐ e haṃ ga ga na ye swa bhā wa at+ma ko3 haṃ:

de nas rig ma rnams la: thig sna gtad de: hūm̐: bde chen dpa' bo dgyes pa'i yum: shes rab gsang ba'i mkha' lam du: zung 'jug rdo rje'i thig btab pas: rten 'brel sna tshogs sa bon spro: om̐ badz+ra rā ga pad+ma su kha pra mo ti hoḥ zhes pas yab kyi kun tu bzang po yum gyi mkha' la sbrengs par bsgom: de nas dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi la gdab pa ni: hūm̐: dbang chen pad+ma'i sa gzhi la: ri rab rdo rje'i thig btab pas: bkra shis gling mchog rol mtsho rgyas: nyi zla gza' skar 'od 'bar gyur: om̐ bh+rūm̐ mi rā dza sūr+ya tsan+d+ra na rat+na dz+wa la ye swā hā: zhes thig chen bcu drug gis sa gzhi byin brlabs kyis sa phyogs bkra shis par 'gyur ro: de'i steng du rdul tshon bkod pa'am ras bris 'bru tshom gang rung la: dbus su pad+ma 'dab bzhi bya: de'i phyi rol pad 'dab lnga: de'i phyi rol bcu gnyis: de'i phyi rol pad+ma'i phreng ba: de'i phyi rol bum pa bcu gnyis kyi phreng ba: de'i phyi rol pa tra nor 'dzin nyer brgyad: de rnams 'byung ba gang yin gzugs bkod: de'i phyi rol nor bu'i phreng ba: de'i phyogs bzhir bum pa bzhi: de rnams mdzes pa'i mtshon gyis spras: dbus su bum pa che ba zhig dri bzang bcud gtams pa bzhag: mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i tsakli 'dzu+ugs: pad 'dab bzhi la bum pa chung ba zhig bzhag: de'i phyi rol brtan ma lnga'i gtor ma tsakli 'dzugs: de'i phyi rol bod khams skyong ma bcu gnyis kyi gtor ma yang de ltar rang rang gi tsakli 'dzugs: 'byung ba rnams kyang so sor de bzhin bya: gzhan yang mchod tshogs yo byad phun sum tshogs pa bsham: sa ma ya: de nas skyabs sems sngon du song nas dkar gtor spyi 'gro bsham: bgegs gtor ni: hūm̐: phyogs bcu steng 'og bar mtshams khor yug tu: rab 'jigs pho nya'i tshogs kyis yongs su khengs: deng 'dir dkyil 'khor sgrub la mi dbang ba'i: gnod byed gdon bgegs dpung tshogs gang yin pa:

gtor ma len phyir myur du gnas 'dir mchis: om̐ badz+ra ṭāk+ki rā dza hūm̐ dzaḥ de nas bgegs bskrad pa ni: hūm̐: nga ni dbang drag dpal chen he ru kaḥ sku las sprul pa'i khro tshogs sprin ltar gtibs: gsung las sprul pa'i drag sngags 'brug ltar ldir: thugs las sprul pa'i pho nya glog ltar 'khyugs: las byed rdo rje'i mtshon cha thog ltar 'bebs: dam sri glags lta'i gzugs phung rdul du bsnyil: me dpung ser ba drag pos bsregs bcom nas: bskal pa'i rlung dmar drag po des gtor cig: om̐ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ a hūm̐ badz+ra hūm̐ rak+ṣa hūm̐ yak+ṣa hūm̐: a ya ma du ru tsa sha na mā ra byad ma gnod byed thams cad bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: ces thun kyis brdeg cing rgyal tho brgal ba'i phar mthar bskrad: de nas phyogs bzhi gdong can bzhi yi rgyal tho zhig sgo byang tshig dang sbrags nas 'dogs: gtor ma gser skyems dang bcas nas: hūm̐: shar phyogs sgo ma seng gdong ma: dkar gtor gser skyems 'di 'bul gyis: bzhes nas shar sgo'i bar chad srungs: dam sri 'gyu ba'i mtshams chod cig: om̐ badz+ra rat+na rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: lho ru: hūm̐: lho phyogs sgo ma phag gdong ma: dkar gtor gser skyems 'di 'bul gyis: bzhes nas lho sgo'i bar chad srungs: dam sri 'gyu ba'i mtshams chod cig: om̐ badz+ra rat+na rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: nub tu: hūm̐: nub phyogs sgo ma stag gdong ma: dkar gtor gser skyems 'di 'bul gyis: bzhes nas nub sgo'i bar chad srungs: dam sri 'gyu ba'i mtshams chod cig: om̐ pad+ma rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: byang du: hūm̐: byang phyogs sgo ma dom gdong ma: dkar gtor gser skyems 'di 'bul gyis: bzhes nas byang sgo'i bar chad srungs: dam sri 'gyu ba'i mtshams chod cig: om̐ karma rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: zhes rgyal tho'i phrin las bcol: de nas srung 'khor bsgom pa ni: hūm̐: sku las sprul pa'i khro bos nam mkha' gang :

gsung las sprul pa'i khro mos sa gzhi gang : thugs las sprul pa'i sras mchog bar snang gang : gnyis med sprul pas khor yug khyon yang khengs: phyi nang bar med ye shes me dpung 'khrigs: glags lta bdud rigs gang yin mtshams chod cig: om̐ badz+ra kī li kī la ya biṣatsha ṣa ā yu dha sarba bhan+dha rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: zhes mtshams phur bcu gdab: de nas dkyil 'khor gyi rigs rnams kyang mchod g.yogs pa ma gtogs mtshams bcad nas srung 'khor du mi btang : gnas yul la bsrung mtshams su gyis pa'i don no: de nas bum pa 'dzin rig mar khrus gtsang gu gul bdug dri bzang blug: sngon du bla ma yi dam gyi las byang tshar gcig btang : mdun bskyed kyi mchod pa bsang sbyangs bya: hūm̐: phyi mchod bcu drug nang mchod rnam pa lnga: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol bla med bde ba'i rgyu: zag med ye shes chen por dgyes pa bskyed: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe? sogs shab+da āḥhūm̐: om̐ badz+ra rū pa nas spar+she āḥhūm̐: om̐ badz+ra a mṛ rak+ta bha ling+ta āḥhūm̐: ma hā māṃ sa tsit+ta go ro tsa bha su ta āḥhūm̐: de nas brtan ma skyong ba ni: om̐ swa bhā w stong p stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las dbang chen sa gzhi rim par brtsegs pa'i steng du: bum pa ye shes gzhal yas khang : gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan bkod phyi nang phun sum tshogs pa'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i nyi zla'i lte bar mūm̐: shar du lām̐: lho ru mām̐: nub tu pām̐: byang du tām̐: sa bon de dag yongs su gyur pa las: dbus su yum chen dbyings phyug mtsho rgyal sku mdog mthing ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis la zhi 'dzum mdzes pa'i 'od zer 'phros pas sku la za 'og sna lnga'i na bza' gsol zhing rin po che'i prog zhu dang rgyan phreng gdub bu 'khrol ba mu tig drwa ba'i rnam par spras shing me long dar tshon sna tshogs kyi cod pan 'phur ba: phyag g.yas in+d+ra nī la'i bum pa ye shes lnga yi bdud rtsi dang lha klu mi yi rig 'dzin rnams kyi 'chi med tshe bcud kyis gtams pa nyon mongs brgyad khri bzhi stong bag chags skad cig la dag par bgyid pa:

g.yon snang srid dkar dmar sbyor ba'i dri med 'od 'bar 'bum 'bum du 'khyil zhing pra ltar gsal ba'i me long rin po che'i tshom bu'i drwa bas bskor ba bsnams pas snang srid sgrib med du ston pa'i 'od kyis phung khams 'byung ba 'khrugs pa'i dri ma rab tu bsal bar mdzad ma: zhabs gnyis gshibs te bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa: phyogs bzhi'i pad 'dab la spyan ma dkar mo: mā ma kī ser mo: gos dkar dmar mo: dam tshig sgrol ma ljang mo: de dag thams cad kyang lha mo'i cha lugs 'chang ba: g.yas thams cad dngul gser byi ru g.yu yi bum pa bsnams shing : g.yon thams cad rin po che'i snang gsal gyi me long thogs pa: rigs bdag kun bzang rdor sems rin 'byung snang mtha' don yod grub pas brgyan zhing : sku yi cha las ye shes lnga yi 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho 'khor bcas til gyi gang bu kha phye ba ltar nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang thams cad khyab par byon te dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa dbyer med mi phyed par bsgom: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: mkha' spyod klong nas skur bzhengs pa: dbyings phyug mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol: me long klong nas skur bzhengs pa: sangs rgyas spyan ma gshegs su gsol: mnyam nyid klong nas skur bzhengs pa: yum chen mā kī gshegs su gsol: sor rtog klong nas skur bzhengs pa: gos dkar lha mo gshegs su gsol: bya grub klong nas skur bzhengs pa: dam tshig sgrol ma gshegs su gsol: nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas mchog nas: ḍāk+ki rgya mtsho gshegs su gsol: om̐ badz+ra mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ dza dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrī āḥ badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma ā li kā li ye swā hā: zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag: chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rigs lngas dbu brgyan par gyur: bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal bya ba ni:

hūm̐: ye shes pho brang nyams re dga': pad+ma dri med mdangs dang ldan: nyi zla spel ma 'od re gsal: thabs shes spel ba'i khri 'phang du: ḍāk+ki rgya mtsho dgyes par bzhugs: gus pa'i yid kyis lha phyag 'tshal: dam tshig gdung bas rab tu 'dud: om̐ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: na mo pū ru sha ya hoḥ mchod pa ni: hūm̐: dri med dbang gi me tog dmar: kun khyab ngad g.yo bdug pa'i spos: snang gsal mdangs ldan sgron me sbar: sman mchod sbyar ba'i dri chab gtams: ro brgya'i bcud ldan zhal zas bkram: snyan pa'i dbyangs dang rol mo brjid: bdud rtsi pañtsa a mṛ ta: rak+ta bcud bzang bha ling spungs: sbyor sgrol dbang po kho na nyid: bla med mchog gi mchod pa 'di: ma sring yum chen tshogs la 'bul: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang : dam tshig nyams pa bshags su gsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe? sogs rū pa shab+d om̐ pañtsa rak+ta bha ling+ta māṃ sa tsit+ta go ro tsa na bha su ta pū dza āḥhūm̐: de nas bstod pa ni: hūm̐: rang bzhin ka dag ngo bo nyid: nam mkha'i mdangs ldan dbyings phyug ma: bde chen dpa' mo mtsho rgyal lcam: sku gsum rdo rje rigs kyi bdag: rgyal kun yum gyur ma la bstod: hūm̐: don dam chos dbyings ma g.yos kyang : 'byung bzhi sbyang phyir thabs kyi sku: ye shes lha mo 'od rab gsal: lha mo bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod: de nas sgrub pa'i rtsa sngags dri med 'od phreng ni: om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrī āḥ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ dz+nyā na pañtsa a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ phaṭḥ mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i khrus sngags ni: om̐ ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa mu khaṃ a mṛ ta ye swā hā: nyams grib zhi ba'i gzungs sngags ni: om̐ bhur khur ma hā pra ma na ya bhurtsi bhu khi bi na ma si na ra ga ga shud+dhe ye swā hā: las sngags ni: om̐ ḍāk+ki pā shaṃ ma ma rā ga he sha dza dzaḥ zhes sgrub sngags tho rangs: khrus sngags nyi shar: grib sel nyin phyed las sngags phyed yul du'o:

de'i dmigs pa ni: rang nyid pad+ma thod phreng du gsal zhing : mdun bskyed bum lha mkha' 'gro sde lnga so so'i srog gi thig le'i mthar sngags phreng 'khor ba gcig las gnyis mched kyi rnam pa grangs med kyis phyi nang gi khyon thams cad yig 'bru'i sa bon sku gzugs kyis gang bas: steng 'og phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems ye shes 'jig rten gyi bdud rtsi'i bcud thams cad 'ub kyis bsdus nas bum lha'i mkha' 'gro sde lngar thim: mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i mkha' lam las byang sems kyi bdud rtsi lnga babs pas bum pa'i bdud rtsi ye shes lnga yi ngo bor bsgom: yang mkha' 'gro sde lnga gnas gyur te bum pa'i mkha' ru 'phags pa: sngags bzlas pa'i tshe zung 'jug sbyor ba mdzad pa'i mkha' lam las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi kha dog lnga ldan babs bum pa mer gyis gang : de las spros pa'i lha mo grangs med bdud rtsi dang me long thogs pa gtso bor 'phros: brtan ma rigs lnga yul skyong bcas la khrus bstsal bas nyams sgrib thams cad dag ste gzi brjid ches cher 'bar bar bskyed: slar 'phros snang srid snod bcud thams cad la ye shes lnga yi khrus bstsal bas: ya ki kun bzang nas ma gi rigs drug phra mo yan chad thams cad kyi nyams sgrib dag: khyad par snang srid 'byung ba 'khrugs pa thams cad kyi dug zhi: 'byung ba rang sar dag cing sor chud: 'byung lngas bsdus pa thams cad mdangs dang dpe byad legs pa'i yon tan rgyas shing rnam mkhyen gyi go 'phang thob par bsam: nyi ma rtse shar dang sprad pa'i lha khrus tshar gcig btang bas bum pa kha gsab: 'dzab bstod mchod pa'i skabs su sngags 'bul tsam mo: spro na: hūm̐: dus gsum rgyal ba bskyed yum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: 'dzab kyi phrin las bskul phyir mchod pa 'bul: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub bstsal ba'i phyir: ye shes lha mo'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: om̐ āḥhūm̐:

ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa i daṃ bha ling+ta kha kha khā hi: zhes pa bdun nam lnga sogs pas sbyangs: sa ma ya: de nas mkha' 'gro'i phrin las grub pa'i rtags: 'dzam gling nyi zlas gang ba dang : stong gsum 'od kyis drwa bas khengs: chu 'brub mtsho chen 'khyil ba dang : me tog nags tshal shin tu rgyas: dar phyar dung 'bud rnga chen brdung : rol mo gling bu pi waṃ sgra: snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis bskul ba dang : khrom 'dus bud med rgyan bzang 'tshogs: gar 'cham bde ba'i nyams 'gyur bstan: shing 'bras 'bru sna dpag med byin: ja chang 'dod rgu'i longs spyod 'du: rin chen dar zab du ma spungs: phyug nor zhing khang phun sum tshogs: ma nges khrom chen go mtshon can: rgyan bzang spras pa mang po yis: lha gsol bsang mchod dga' ston gyis: zhing zhing yul gling thams cad du: mya ngan med pa'i ltas byung nas: snang srid 'khrugs pa lo mang zhi: lha dang srung mas drag tu skyong : yul gru bkra shis nad mug dkon: dmag mtshon dus kyi bskal pa zhi: yul lha nyams gso 'khrungs pa'i rtags: dngos grub 'byung ba the tshom med: lo re bzhin du nan bskyar gtso: 'grub sbyor dbyar re kun re sbyar: dbyar gyi dbyar sol 'phel ba'i mgo: ston gyi shing 'bras smin pa'i dus: de tshe ri bstod lha mkhar gsol: bkra shis dge ba'i tshes la brtsam:

e ma zab pa'i mthar thug las: ri khrus mkha' 'gro'i sgrub pa bzhag: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: tha tshig bka' yi srung ma'i rgya: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo sngags 'chang rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos/ sa khyi lor bsam yas mchims phu'i ke'u tshang nas gdan drangs shing chu glang lor shog ser las zhal bshus so// // wa) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: ri khrus bag chags stobs 'joms bzhugs so: bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: ri khrus zab mo bcud kyi yang snying bstan: sa ma ya: sgrub pa'i skabs su nyi ma rtse shar dus: gu ru'i sku tshab mthong ba don ldan sogs: sku gsung thugs rten khyad par sngon bshams par: mchod sprin byin rlabs bcud kyis sku khrus gsol: de nas skyabs yul dran rdzogs kyis gsal: na moḥ ka dag dbyings las lhun grub thugs rje'i rtsal: 'ja' zer thig le'i 'od phung 'khyil ba'i klong : pad+ma 'byung gnas bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags pa'i tshogs: rig 'dzin dpa' bo ḍāk+ki sprin ltar 'khrigs: bdag sogs 'gro ba'i gnyen du lham mer gsal: na mo: dbyings rig ngo bo ma bcos thod phreng rtsal: rig 'dzin bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor la: phyag 'tshal skyabs mchis phyi nang gsang mchod 'bul: brtse chen thugs rje'i gzi byin deng 'dir skyed: mchog thun dngos grub 'bad med char ltar phob: snod bcud bag sgrib nyes skyon kun sbyangs shing : snang srid phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor mngon du stsol: de nas me long gi ngos su bkram pa'i dkyil 'khor 'char bcug cing rten khrus 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: rig 'dzin thod phreng bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku: snang stong mkha' la sgrib pa'i g.ya' bral ba: sems can 'dul bya'i 'jigs brgyad sbyang ba'i phyir: rtse gcig dad dung mos pas khrus 'bul lo:

gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: rig 'dzin thod phreng bde gshegs 'dus pa'i gsung : grags stong rdo rje'i rang mdangs 'gags med kyang : sems can 'byung 'jug las rlung sgrib sbyang phyir: gsang sngags snying po'i bcud kyi khrus 'bul lo: gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: rig 'dzin thod phreng bde gshegs 'dus pa'i thugs: rang grol ye shes 'khor 'das ka dag kyang : sems can a 'thas 'khrul 'dzin sbyang ba'i phyir: gsal stong rdo rje'i bcud kyi khrus gsol lo: gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: rig 'dzin thod phreng bde gshegs yon tan rdzogs: thugs rje 'pho 'gyur skye 'gag ris med kyang : sems can rgyud la ye shes gsal bya'i phyir: kun 'byung rin chen bcud kyi khrus gsol lo: gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: rig 'dzin thod phreng bde gshegs phrin las rdzogs: gang la ci 'dul thogs med thugs mnga' yang : sems can dug lnga'i rtog tshogs sbyang ba'i phyir: rtsal chen ye shes lnga yi khrus gsol lo: gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: rig 'dzin rgyal ba bder 'dus thod phreng rtsal: mtshan brgyad rje 'bangs dus gsum gter ston sogs: dngos su zung 'jug sprul pa'i 'khor lo la: snod bcud bag sgrib sbyang phyir khrus gsol lo: gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: bder 'dus rig 'dzin ye shes klong dgu'i gar: kun bzang rigs lnga zhi khro dpal chen lha: rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor thams cad la: srid gsum snang ba sbyang phyir khrus gsol lo: gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐ rgyal ba kun 'dus bde chen 'od kyi rtsal:

sku gsum mkha' 'gro zhing skyong ḍāk+ki'i tshogs: snod bcud zhing khams gcig tu rdzogs pa las: 'byung 'khrug rten 'brel sbyang phyir khrus gsol lo: gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i phrin las thogs med shugs: mthu stobs gzi 'bar ma mgon lcam dral sogs: dam can chos srung rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor la: dug lnga dgra gdon sbyang phyir khrus gsol lo: gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: rig 'dzin sku mchog dge 'dun mtshan dpe 'bar: gsung mchog yan lag drug cu dam pa'i chos: thugs mchog zab gsang gdod nas mngon sangs rgyas: mchog gsum yongs 'dus ngo bor khrus gsol lo: gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: snod bcud snang ba bde gshegs rgyal ba'i sku: 'byung 'jug rlung sgra bde gshegs rgyal ba'i gsung : gsal snang rol pa bde gshegs rgyal ba'i thugs: gdod nas 'khor 'das dbyer med ngo bo la: bya rtsol 'dzin zhen dag pa'i khrus gsol lo: gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: de nas sku phyi ba ni: hūm̐: 'khor 'das gdod nas dag pa chos sku'i ngang : gzung 'dzin 'khrul rtog bag chags rnam dag kyang : 'gro kun zhing rdul tshe rabs las sbyang phyir: rten 'brel 'od lnga'i rdzas kyis sku phyi'o: oṃ mūm̐ hūm̐ lām̐: trām̐ mām̐ hrī pām̐: a tām̐: kā ya bhi shwa dha na ye swā hā: zhes rgyas par nus na khrus tshar bzhin sbyar: de ltar gsal ba'i khrus bum par blug: gzhung ltar sgrub pa'i rtags tshad rdzogs pa dang : mgur lha dge bsnyen brtan ma gnas sa'am: ri mtho rtse dang skyed tshal lha mkhar sogs: yul gru gang du brtsams pa'i gnas mchog der: ri bstod gter mkhar bum gter dang 'gro na: sde brgyad brngan cha la sogs rgyas par bshams:

spyan 'dren bsang gzhung rdzogs mtshams las la sbyor: thog mar rig 'dzin khrus chog tshar gcig phul: mdangs gsal me long phyogs mtshams kun tu bstan: khrus kyi rgyun bstsal gyer sgom ting 'dzin gsal: hūm̐: ma rig mkha' khams gnas dag pa: dbyings phyug dpal mo ye shes chus: snang srid kun la khrus bstsal bas: lha 'dre mi gsum rme mnol grib: rnam dag thugs rje'i rten 'brel gyis: chos dbyings ngang du dag gyur cig: mūm̐ om̐ shud+dhe shud+dhe ye swā hā: hūm̐: zhe sdang chu khams gnas dag pa: sangs rgyas spyan ma'i mkha' dbyings chus: snang srid kun la khrus bstsal bas: lha 'dre mi gsum rme mnol grib: rnam dag thugs rje'i rten 'brel gyis: me long ngang du dag gyur cig: lām̐ hūm̐: shud+dhe shud+dhe ye swā hā: hūm̐: nga rgyal sa khams gnas dag pa: mā ma kī yi mkha' dbyings chus: snang srid kun la khrus bstsal bas: lha 'dre mi gsum rme mnol grib: rnam dag thugs rje'i rten 'brel gyis: mnyam nyid ngang du dag gyur cig: mām̐ trām̐ shud+dhe shud+dhe ye swā hā: hūm̐: 'dod chags me khams gnas dag pa: gos dkar mo yi mkha' dbyings chus: snang srid kun la khrus bstsal bas: lha 'dre mi gsum rme mnol grib: rnam dag thugs rje'i rten 'brel gyis: sor rtog ngang du dag gyur cig: pām̐ hrīḥshud+dhe shud+dhe ye swā hā: hūm̐: phrag dog rlung khams gnas dag pa: dam tshig sgrol ma'i mkha' dbyings chus: snang srid kun la khrus bstsal bas: lha 'dre mi gsum rme mnol grib: rnam dag thugs rje'i rten 'brel gyis: bya grub ngang du dag gyur cig: tām̐ āḥshud+dhe shud+dhe ye swā hā: hūm̐: phyi nang 'byung khams 'khrugs pa'i dpal: 'byung lnga dag pa yum lnga'i chus: snang srid kun la khrus bstsal bas: lha 'dre mi gsum rme mnol grib: rnam dag thugs rje'i rten 'brel gyis: ye shes lnga ru dag gyur cig:

om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥmūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ dz+nyā na pañtsa a mṛ ta shud+dhe shud+dhe ye swā hā: hūm̐: 'di ltar thabs shes rten 'brel gyis: rig sngags dmod dang 'byung 'khrugs kyi: rgyu rkyen log pa'i sbyor ba kun: ting 'dzin ngang du dag gyur nas: 'byung ba sor chud 'phel bskyed shugs: yul khams bkrag dang gzi mdangs ldan: lha 'dre mi gsum stobs dang ldan: rdzogs ldan dpal la yongs gnas gyur: om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥmūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ dz+nyā na pañtsa a mṛ ta shud+dhe shud+dhe ye swā hā: hūm̐: phyi nang snod bcud srid gsum dbu ma'i zom: bde chen thabs kyi cha 'dzin dbang phyug ham̐: stong nyid shes rab rang bzhin dbu ma aḥ zung 'jug gnyis med ma ning rā sa mi: snod bcud srog 'dzin sku gsum rdo rje'i rtsal: gza' klu rgyal po'i rnam pa shar ba'i sde: rang byung bdud rtsi bcud kyi khrus bstsal bas: 'khrul pa'i gdon tshul bag chags ma lus pa: rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bor dag gyur cig: om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥmūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ dz+nyā na pañtsa a mṛ ta shud+dhe shud+dhe ye swā hā: hūm̐: lha brgyad klu brgyad gza' brgyad 'jigs brgyad dgu: rgyu skar nyer brgyad phyogs skyong rgyal chen sogs: bdun cu rtsa lnga gtsang ris dpal mgon la: bka' gsang dam tshig gnyan gyi khrus bstsal nas: nad mtshon dug sbyor nang dbyen dme 'khrug sogs: mi dge than ltas byur rkyen ma lus pa: mthu stobs 'bar ba'i klong du dag gyur cig: om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥmūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ dz+nyā na pañtsa a mṛ ta shud+dhe shud+dhe ye swā hā: hūm̐: srid pa'i ma lnga gan dang kun tu rgyu: brtan ma bcu gnyis ya ma bcu gnyis dang : skyong ma bcu gnyis pho nya drug cu sogs: lo zla zhag dus rten 'brel dbang rnams la: dbyings rig rang rtsal bcud kyi khrus bstsal bas: tsha grang 'byung ba 'khrugs pa'i nad dal yams:

'od gsal ma mo'i klong du dag gyur cig: om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥmūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ dz+nyā na pañtsa a mṛ ta shud+dhe shud+dhe ye swā hā: hūm̐: srid pa'i lha dgu dge bsnyen nyi shu gcig: rje yi mgur lha 'bangs kyi srog lha dang : skyes lha che btsan 'dzam gling gzhi bdag sogs: gtsang ma rigs dang 'jig rten skyong rnams la: lha sngags ting 'dzin bcud kyi khrus bstsal bas: snod gzugs 'byung ba 'khrugs pa'i yo lang dang : bcud kyi mthong snang log pa'i mi mthun rkyen: phyogs med rten 'brel klong du dag gyur cig: om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥmūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ dz+nyā na pañtsa a mṛ ta shud+dhe shud+dhe ye swā hā: hūm̐: dbang phyug rnam sras tshogs bdag dzam+bha la: gnod sbyin skya brgyad nor rgyun phywa g.yang bdag: mgon zhing sdongs grogs byed pa thams cad la: yid bzhin bdud rtsi bcud kyi khrus bstsal bas: stobs dpal srid rkun dbul 'gong 'byung po'i gdon: dgos 'dod char 'bebs klong du dag gyur cig: om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥmūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ dz+nyā na pañtsa a mṛ ta shud+dhe shud+dhe ye swā hā: hūm̐: sa chu me rlung nam mkha' 'byung ba'i bdag: dkar phyogs lha dang nag phyogs bdud kyi rigs: srid rtse mnar med srid pa'i 'dzin khyon kun: 'od gsal mnyam pa nyid du khyab brdal ba: rgyu 'bras rnam par dag pa'i khrus bstsal bas: 'khor 'das ro gcig thig ler dag gyur cig: ces pa'i rtsa sngags grib sel las sngags thams cad tshar gsum mam bdun sogs bzlas la bum chu kha rgyan yal 'dab kyis phyogs bcur 'byil lo: de ni sku gsum rang bzhin byin 'bebs shes par bya'o: bden tshig brjod pa ni: hūm̐: ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje sku gsum gyi: mthu stobs byin 'od 'ja' zer chi li li: sku dang zhing khams tshom bu me re re: rig 'dzin ḍāk+kis 'dzab dbyangs 'u ru ru:

dam can chos srung rgyud rtsal ya la la: nor lha gter bdag longs spyod chi li li: srid pa'i lha dgu dgyes gar lhags se lhag: nyams dbyangs bde stong tshor ba 'u ru ru: rtsa rlung dbang thang gzi byin chi li li: lha mi'i dpal 'byor 'dod rgu thibs se thib: bkra shis phywa g.yang char 'bebs si li li: gnas yul byin chags rdzogs ldan dpal 'bar ba'i: rten 'brel rtag tu shis pa'i dge legs stsol: ces dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying po lan gsum brjod: khrus chu lha rten sogs gang rung 'khod pa'i sar 'thing shing dpal bzang por shog: e ma ri khrus mkha' 'gro'i gsang bcud kyi: las sbyor bag chags stobs 'joms 'di: rol pa thugs rje 'od kyi rtsal: gnyis med gnyis yul zung 'jug gar: rten 'brel bskal pa sngags kyi klong nas 'byin: dam tshig 'gro don dus bab pas: mtshams sbyor rgyud bskul zla med gces: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos sa khyi lor bsam yas mchims phu'i ke'u tshang nas gdan drangs pa'o// // zha) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: bstan skyong yul gyi cho ga bde legs kun 'byung bzhugs so: rig 'dzin pad+ma thod phreng rtsal la 'dud: sa ma ya: de yang bstan ma bskyed pa ni: sa yi lha mo ltar sgrub pa ni spyi khog dkyil 'khor mkha' 'gro'i gzhung la 'jug pa'i phyir: mchod phreng bsham tshogs las rim gyi don ltar las: slar yang mchod pa gcig kha gsos nas: om̐ swa bhā wa sogs? stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che sna tshogs kyi snod du rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa las byung ba'i mchod rdzas phun sum tshogs pa nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par gyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs? de nas rten bskyed pa ni: stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid pad+ma thod phreng rtsal du gsal ba'i mdun du rin chen gzhal yas khang phyi nang mtshan nyid rdzogs pa'i dbus su ri rab lhun po bang rim gsum pa'i steng du bh+rūm̐ las sa yi lha mo bstan ma sku mdog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma:

sku la rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas spras pa dar tshon sna lnga'i cod pan 'phur ba stod g.yogs dang ang rag bklubs pa phyag g.yas yid bzhin nor bu dang : g.yon bum pa 'dod yon sna lnga'i bcud kyis bkang ba bsnams pa: rgyan dang cha lugs phun sum tshogs shing glang po che sa la rab brtan la zhon pa: de'i phyi rol bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis te snang srid kyi bdag mo rdo rje kun grags ma mthing nag drel rta rkang gsum la bzhon nas be con dang rgyu zhags thogs te g.yang gzhi dang re lde gsol ba ya bdud kyi bu mo: dpal ldan ha ri rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong ser nag chu glang la bzhon nas khram shing shwa rdel thogs te mi lpags gsol ba ma bdud gshin rje'i bu mo: gangs dkar sha med rdo rje kun bzang ma dmar nag dre'u nag po la bzhon nas phyag na thog ser gyi sgrom bu 'dzin cing bar bdud kyi bu mo: 'brog chen 'khor 'dus rdo rje bgegs kyi gtso mo ljang nag ba dan dang nad rkyal thogs nas rnga mong zhon cing g.yang gzhi dang mgo phreng gis brgyan pa bdud kyi bu mo: gangs kyi yum chen rdo rje g.yu bun ma sngo skya phyag na mda' dar dang shel bum thogs nas chu dar sngon po gsol zhing g.yu 'brug la zhon pa gshin rje dha sha dhe ha'i bu mo: kha rag khyung btsun rdo rje dpal yum ma sku mdog dmar mo phyag na pad+ma dang sgrom bu bsnams te dar dmar gsol nas chu rta la zhon pa dgra lha'i bu mo: gser chen mkha' lding rdo rje klu mo dung skyong sku mdog smug nag phyag na lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin cing rin po ches brgyan te bya khyung la zhon pa dzi na mi tra'i bu mo: rma ri rab 'byams rdo rje drag mo rgyal sku mdog dmar smug g.yas thod dbyug dang g.yon bhan+dha bsnams te dar nag gsol nas stag la zhon pa yak+sha spyan gcig gi bu mo: kong btsun de mo rdo rje bod khams skyong dkar mo g.yas mda' dar dang g.yon gter sgrom bsnams te rin po che'i rgyan dang dar dkar gsol nas gser sha yu mo la chibs pa gnam lha skos rje'i bu mo:

btsan la rol pa'i rdo rje sman gcig ma dmar mo phyag na 'khor lo dang bhan+dha thogs shing dar dmar gyi ral ga gsol te rta dmar la zhon pa ya ba skya gcig gi bu mo: sman btsun ug chos rdo rje g.yar mo sil sngon mo nor bu dang rgyal mtshan thogs pa rin po che du mas spras shing cod pan lha rdzas bklubs te drel rta sngon po la zhon pa gtsug na 'od 'bar gyi bu mo: g.yu'i dril bu rdo rje si le ma ljang mo rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa dar dmar gsol nas g.yag dkar la zhon pa spyi bdud rgyal mo'i bu mo: de thams cad rgyan rin po che sna tshogs zhi ba'i cha lugs drag mo thams cad khro gnyer chas te rgyan dang phyag mtshan ma nges du mar ldan pa bkrag mdangs gzi brjid 'od du 'bar zhing rgyas pa: gzhan yang sprul pa nyid sprul sogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba gsal bar gyur: de las 'od zer 'phros pas skad cig sngon tshe slob dpon pad+ma'i bka' bzhin bdag cag sgrub pa po'i g.yar dam skyong ba'i slad du gnas 'dir spyan drangs: om̐ bhū mi ma ma ting ting shag shag le le dza dzaḥ

de nas spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: sngon tshe slob dpon pad+ma dang : slob ma rlangs chen dpal seng dang : mthu chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyis: ru tra bsgral ba'i zhing gdan du: bka' bsgos bro bor dam bcas bzhin: sangs rgyas bstan pa skyong ba dang : gsang sngags dam chos spel ba'i phyir: ma sring brtan ma'i tshogs bcas rnams: ma thog gnas 'dir spyan 'dren no: hūm̐: dgung sngon dbyings dang rang bzhin gnas: gangs ri g.ya' spang mtsho dang nags: spang ljongs ne'u seng chu klung sogs: ri rab rol mtsho gar gnas kyang : gnas 'dir spyan 'dren da tshur byon: brtan ma'i tshogs rnams spyan 'dren no: sa yi lha mo gshegs su gsol: ri rab rol mtsho'i dbang mo che: gter bdag lha mo gshegs su gsol: brtan ma bcu gnyis gshegs su gsol: skyong ma bcu gnyis gshegs su gsol: ya ma bcu gnyis gshegs su gsol: sman phran 'bum sde gshegs su gsol: om̐ badz+ra s+d+ya bi ra pa ti kal pi ta ma ma ting ting shag shag le le tiṣ+ṭha pā la sa mā ya dza dzaḥ bzhugs gsol mchod pa 'bul ba ni: skad cig gis spyan drangs pa'i dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa dbyer med du gyur: om̐ pad+ma ka ma la ye satwaṃ: hūm̐: bod skyong brtan ma yang dag sman: rang rang dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs: bod khams bde legs mdzad pa'i phyir: rtag chags brtan par bzhugs su gsol: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha satwaṃ: gser skyems dang 'bru sna mchod cing : hūm̐: gling bzhi ri rab zom shed dang : rol mtsho gser ri mu khyud du: 'khor zhing rang bzhin gnas pa dang : khyad par sa 'dzin dbang mo bcas: bstan pa srung ba'i ma sring la: rin chen phud dang gser skyems 'bul: sa bdag lha mo gter mdzod la: bdud rtsi sman mchod sna tshogs 'bul: dgyes shing rab tu dge ba'i phyir: gling 'dir bkra shis rab gnas spel: 'byor drug rgyas pa'i phrin las stsol: dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i las mdzad mo: bstan pa srung ba'i zhal bzhes ma:

bdud kyi bu mo sngags srung bzhir: rin chen phud dang gser skyems 'bul: yul gru 'jig rten 'dzam gling 'dir: dmag 'khrug zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: bar chod zhi ba'i las mdzad ma: gnod sbyin sras mo mel tshe bzhir: rin chen phud dang gser skyems 'bul: rig 'dzin bdag gi rogs dan mdzod: hūm̐: dngos grub gter gyi las mdzad ma: sman lcam phywa sdud bu mo bzhi: rig 'dzin bdag gi dam chos spel: bstan pa gnyan la dgra dar na: bstan srung mthu chen bcu gnyis kyis: bal bod mtshams su khas blangs bzhin: dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: sa bdag lha mo rab brtan ma: sa 'dzin dbang mo nye 'khor dang : bod khams skyong ma bcu gnyis rnams: dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: phyi mchod sna tshogs dbang ba'i gar: nang mchod sman gtor rak+ta bcud: bla med mchog gi mchod pa 'di: bstan srung skyong ma bcas la 'bul: bzhes nas bod 'bangs bkra shis shing : dge legs mchog gi dngos grub stsol: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ye shab+da ma hā pañtsa rak+ta bha ling+ta khā hi: 'bru sna dang dar zab mchod cing : hūm̐: ri rab gling shar dbang bsgyur ba: gnod sbyin ma hā dhe wa yis: shar phyogs dri za'i bu mo la: sbyor bas sa bdag dkar mo srid: lag na shel gyi bum pa thogs: shar gyi dbang lag bu mo la: rin chen 'bru sna dar zab 'bul: nad gdon zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: ri rab lho gling dbang bsgyur ba: gnod sbyin ma hā dhe wa yis: lho phyogs gshin rje'i bu mo la: sbyor bas sa bdag ser mo srid: lag na gser gyi bhan+dha thogs: lho yi bde 'byung bu mo la: rin chen 'bru sna dar zab 'bul: 'byor drug rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: ri rab nub la dbang bsgyur ba: gnod sbyin ma hā dhe wa yis: 'dod pa khams kyi gtso mo la: sbyor bas sa bdag dmar mo srid: lag na pad gzhong nor bu thogs:

nub kyi klu dbang 'phrul mo la: rin chen 'bru sna dar zab 'bul: khams gsum dbang sdud phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: ri rab byang la dbang bsgyur ba: gnod sbyin ma hā dhe wa yis: byang phyogs mgrin sngon bu mo la: sbyor bas sa bdag ljang mo srid: phyag na rin chen bang mdzod thogs: byang gi ru sbal ye 'phrul la: rin chen 'bru sna dar zab 'bul: dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: rdo rje kun grags mthu mo che: 'khor ni bdud kyi bu mo gsum: dgra bgegs srog la rngam pa'i phyir: gcer mo dur khrod gnas nyul la: rin chen 'bru sna dar zab 'bul: yul gyi dmag 'khrug zhi bar mdzod: hūm̐: gangs kyi yum chen g.yu bun ma: 'khor ni gnod sbyin bu mo gsum: rig 'dzin phrin las sgrub pa'i tshe: rin chen rgyan dar na bza' gsol: gsang sngags bstan pa'i bya ra mdzod: hūm̐: kong btsun rdo rje bod khams skyong : 'khor ni 'jig rten sman mo gsum: rin chen gter la dbang bsgyur tshe: rgyan spyod sna tshogs lhun ldan gsol: rin chen 'bru sna dar zab 'bul: yul 'dir rten 'brel sna tshogs spel: hūm̐: bstan skyong ma mo bcu gnyis la: rin chen phud rgod 'bru sna 'bul: khyed rnams bstan pa'i bya ra phyir: rin chen 'bru sna dar zab 'bul: rtag tu bkra shis dge legs stsol: om̐ sarba pū dza a mṛ ta rat+na bhi shwa pañtsa li ka hūm̐: zhes mchod pa bya zhing ting 'dzin gyi thugs su 'khod: hūm̐: ri rab mnga' dbang dpal gyi mdzod 'dzin ma: sa la gnas pa'i sems ma 'dod 'byung gter: bsam 'phel bzhin bzang gtso 'khor legs par bstod: hūm̐: rgyal ba'i bstan srung bdud grol gnod sbyin sman: bcu gnyis mdzes pa'i lha yi cha shas dang : rten 'brel so so bcu gnyis rnal 'byor ma: dug lnga dbyings grol ye shes lha mo'i tshul: rtag chags zhen pa'i 'khri ba gdung sel ma: yul srung bstan pa'i cha 'dzin dpa' mor bstod:

hūm̐: ye nas thams cad chos sku'i ngang klong nas: sna tshogs sgyu ma'i gar gyis bstan skyong ngogs: chos bzhin sgrub pa'i bstan 'dzin bu bzhin skyong : gsang sngags gnyan la dgra dar 'joms mdzad ma: ye shes grub kyang rtag chags phra men gzugs: bod khams skyong ma bcas la bdag bstod do: zhes bstod la brtan ma'i sgrub sngags ni: om̐ ma ma kyed pa ṇi ho ku len ṇig nal ting ting shag shag phe sha dza dzaḥ de nas sngags ji ltar 'di bzhin mkha' 'gro sde lngar 'os 'tshams dang sbyar ba gnad shes par bya: sngags phreng 'di brjod pas rang bzhin srid gsum thams cad dngos su khengs pa phyogs las rnam rgyal ye shes drwa ba'i sngags drug brjod do: zur gyi don rgyas 'khrugs sdeb rnams nyams len rdo rje'i zhal du gab: de'i rgyud rdo rje slob dpon gab pa mngon sum zhes rig pa 'dzin pa'i bla ma'am gang rtogs skyes bu la sngon mtha' sad pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen du brten zhing phyag rgyun la ches mthong du 'dzin nas thos bsam la dgra ru mi sdang ba zhig la mngon du sbyin pa gal che: mthar gyi rjes spyod thams cad kyang de ltar mngon par bya ba khrus lung gong ma'i rgyud dang bstun: 'di la sum sgrub kha sgyur yod pa zhal las shes pa rjes rim mo: zhag ci tsam sgrub kyang rjes chog lha bstod bgyis par bya: om̐ swā na rin chen snod yangs su: bde chen bdud rtsi'i mchod gtor nyid: dru ma'i pad+ma'i brgyan gyis spras: nī laṃ bde ba'i mchod pa 'di: margad bstan skyong tshogs la 'bul: pū dza mchod pas dgyes gyur cig: om̐ āḥhūm̐: zhes mchod pas dgyes par bgyid nas bstan skyong du gnyer bgyid par bsam pa mngon rtogs kyi skor ro: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas sa khyi lor gdan drangs shog ser las zhal bshus so/ dge'o/ bkra shis//

// za) bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: rgya gar chos kyi rgyal po in+d+ra bo dhi dang bod kyi rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sku ring la sku tshab bzhengs pa'i dkar chag bsdus pa rin chen mgul rgyan bzhugs so: dpal ldan sangs rgyas pad+ma skyes: kun mkhyen ye shes mdzod 'dzin pa: rgyal po sgyu 'phrul sna tshogs 'chang : che ba sangs rgyas rig sngags 'chang : sa ma sti: de yang dpal yongs su grub pa'i mnga' bdag kun gyi khyab bdag thog ma'i theg pa gong ma'i kun bzang nas 'og ma'i dpal snang mtha' rig pa'i mgon po 'od dpag med pa ste rigs lnga ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid bde gshegs thams cad bkod pa dang dgongs pa gcig la rdzogs par mdzad: phyogs bcu sangs rgyas thams cad kyis rgyal thabs spyi blugs rgyal po la dbang bskur: chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong theg pa che phra mtha' dag gi rgyud nam mkha' ye shes mdzod kyi bkod pa thams cad 'phags pa'i rdzu 'phrul zhi khro ya ma zung ston nus pa'i rdo rje 'chang dbang thams cad kyi rigs bdag 'ja' lus skye 'chi bgres rgud bral ba skyon bral pad+ma las rab tu byon pa'i tshul mdzad pa bla ma za hor pa ru grags pa de nyid 'dzam bu gling 'dir mdzad pa bcu gnyis sgo nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba'i thog mar: gzigs pa lnga yi sgo nas byon pa ste: yul la gzigs pa o rgyan za hor gyi yul: gnas la gzigs pa ni lho nub 'o ma can gyi mtsho: 'dul bya la gzigs pa ni rgyal po in+d+ra bo dhi: 'dul zhing la gzigs pa ni lho 'dzam bu gling skye 'gro srid pas ma bsdus pa dang bsdus pa rnams so: snod la gzigs pa ni mkha' 'gro lha lcam man+dha ra ba bud med ye shes mtsho rgyal te: ye shes dang 'jig rten gyi snang ngor grub pa dang ma grub pa mkha' spyod dbyings kyi rnal 'byor pho mo grangs las 'das pa la gzigs:

lnga po de yi sgo nas thog mar chos kyi rgyal po in+d+ra bo dhis rgyal ba'i sras su spyan drangs: rgyal srid skyong ba'i rgyal por mnga' gsol: rgya gar gling dgu'i che ba brjod: rgyal khrims dang chos khrims kyi srol bstod: mnga' 'bangs la chos kyi bstan pa'i ba dan nyi ma ltar gsal bar mdzad: dus re zhig tshe gdul bya dus su smin pa'i ched du brtul zhugs kyi spyod pas dur khrod kun tu byon: 'og min gyi zhing dang mtha' yas pa'i zhing la byon: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa klong gcig tu 'dus pa'i bka' yi bsdu ba mdzad: rgya bod gling thams cad la byon zhabs kyis bcag: khyad par sku yi sprul pa shrī singhas rgya nag gling bcu gnyis la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor: sku sprul 'jam dpal du bskyed nas rtsis dang kun rdzob kyis 'gro ba btul: gsung sprul bod gangs can gyi khrod du mang bkur 'jig rten dbang phyug gis 'gro ba skyong bar mdzad: thugs rje'i sprul pa rig 'dzin dga' rab rdo rje ri bo ma la ya ru bzhugs te rgya bod dang sngags kyi rig 'dzin pho mo dpa' bo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs la chos 'khor bskor: rdzu 'phrul rdo rje 'chang gi skur bzhengs nas rgyal po dzā sogs la smin grol gyis lung bstan mdzad: bkod pa rig 'dzin gsar rnying bcu drug: mtshan brgyad grub thob brgyad cu'i skur bzhengs nas gang la gang 'dul chos kyi 'khor lo bskor: sprul pa sna tshogs kyi sgo nas 'dzam gling 'jig rten grangs med pa rta rmig gi 'og tsam ma lus pa dgongs pa'i zhabs kyis bcag: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas yul dur khrod kun tu yid bzhin gyi nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung gi zab mo'i gter nyi shu rtsa lnga: lnga phrag lnga tshom gyi brda rtags grangs las 'das pas bkang : rgya gar sogs 'dzam bu gling du rig 'dzin grub pa thob pa khyad par mkha' spyod rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dang bcas pa rdzu 'phrul gyis byon nas dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho thams cad kyi bkod pa phye nas bskal pa chags nas:

'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du mi 'jig rgya rtags lhags pa'i gnas dang gter kha grangs med bzhag: yang rten 'brel sna tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba'i dus la bab pa'i tshe: in+d+ra bo dhi la grol byed kyi khrid dang : smin byed kyi dbang bcas dgongs pa rdzogs par mdzad: yang de'i tshe ma 'ongs skye 'gro thams cad kyi skyabs dang dpung gnyen dam par dgongs pa'i sgo nas: bod yul mun pa'i gling gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i chos rna ba'i bu gar bkag nas ma thos shing : spre'u gdong dmar gyi rigs long ba lha khrid mkhan gyi yul: nga rgyal dang khengs sems kyi srid pas rab tu bcings pa ye nas grol ma myong ba'i gling du: rje btsun pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi sku yi sprul pa khri srong lde'u btsan gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud gong ma'i theg pa blo la 'gro zhing : mu stegs dang dmyal ba nyan thos gsum gyi theg pa la mi 'jug pa'i rgyal po sangs rgyas mi yul du byon pa spyod la gzhol ba nyid gtso bor bgyis pa dang : nye lam gyis ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga bdo'i mthar thug yin tshe: bha ta hor gyi sgom grwa bcom pa'i tshe: dge bsnyen nor bsnyag pa rnams kyis phyi la 'brang ba bsad pa rnams dus gcig tu 'tshogs te: rgyal po gsang sngags kyi chos la mos pa khyad par pad 'byung nga yi rig 'dzin rnams kyi dgra dang gshed du gyur pa'i rigs: dam sri btsun pa dge bshes gzugs phal cher bsnyen sgrub dang nyams len rlung la bskur nas dkor ham dang rgyu gnag nor la 'khreng ba bha ta'i sgom grwa bcom pa'i bag chags sad pa rnams kyi kha rlangs khong dug sbrul gyi ngad pa can gyis gsang sngags bstan pa la 'tshe zhing dkar phyogs dge ba la bar du gcod pa'i dam nyams phal cher gyis rab tu byung ba'i gtam kha nas bshad: lkog tu bud med bsten skye bo'i grib la ban+de'i bag bca': dkor gzan sdig to can gyis zhon lkog nas byed pa'i bu mngon du skyes pas mo gzhis kyi gsos byed:

gshin zas kyis rtag tu khe tshong dang bshas tshong gis bun te gzhi btsugs: sems can phra rags phal cher la sdug bsngal khur gyis gnon: bcom ldan thub pa'i dbang po'i mdzad spyod thams cad khyad du bsad: dam med dred po lcags mgo can dge slong legs skar 'dra ba mang po tshogs pa'i dus la dgongs: bye brag mtha' drug sgo bzhi lcags kyi 'dan bus bsdams pa'i sems can sngon ru tra thar pa nag po tshe 'phos pa'i skabs sems can phra mo rnams smon lam gyis dge ba'i rlung log nas snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus su: mi gtsang ba'i zag rdzas la sbrang bu 'khor ba ltar 'dus pa dge bcu sngon nas ma bsags bsod nams phral du rdzogs pa'i rigs khengs sems 'gong po zhugs nas smyo ba nad pa sman chen 'thung ba rlung la phog ltar bzod blag med par dge ba zad pa'i thabs la brtson pa rnams kyi don du bzhengs pa dang : nye lam dge ba tshul bzhin sgrub pa bdud dbang ma song bar nyin mo'i skar ma tsam las mi 'byung ba'i dus chos kyi bstan pa skyong zhing spel bar dgongs te: in+d+ra bo dhi la bod du 'byon pa'i dgongs pa'i zhal gdams dpag tu med par gsungs in+d+ra bo dhis bzhugs pa'i zhu ba dpag tu med pa phul kyang : rje yi zhal nas: bstan pa spyi yi chos skal bcad pa dang : skal ldan gcig gi don du sdod pa gnyis: shor thob kyi mtshan nyid yin: dper na skal ldan gcig ni: tho rangs kyi skar rgyan dang 'dra: nyi zla yod kyang gcig pur chos med kyang : lam gol med pa rgyun du 'gyur ba ltar ro: dper na mang po gcig gi byed las yin pa nyi zla ltar ro: nyi zla mi snang sems can kun la mun pas non pa ltar yin no: zhes sogs rgyal po'i zhus lan gyi skor la dpag tu med par gsungs so: de'i tshe rgyal po yang phan yon gyi rgyu mtshan la thugs yid ches nas: slob dpon 'byon par thag bcad de'i tshe rje nyid bzhugs pa dang 'dra ba'i sku gsung thugs rten zhig med par mi rung dgongs te zhu ba phul lo:

kye ma gnyis snang mi rtag rlung gi 'khor lo ltar: ya yol ngang la mi tshe rmi lam bzhin: nyin 'khrul mtshan 'khrul bag chags gtan du 'byams: yeng ma lam la rje btsun sprin bar tsam: yun ring bzhugs pa zhag gcig gdung ba'i mod: rje btsun dam pa phyogs su bzhud lags na: nyid sku bzhugs pa'i thugs rje ji bzhin dang : mthong thos dran reg 'brel tshad don ldan pa'i: da lta'i bdag dang ma 'ongs don gyi phyir: nyid dang 'dra ba'i sku tshab gter lnga zhu: zhes zhus pas: e maḥ mi yi mchog gyur mi dbang 'khor los bsgyur: chos kyi mchog gyur gsang sngags rdo rje theg: gnas kyi mchog gyur za hor rgyal po'i khab: mi rje lha yi mdzad pa dam pa'i don: khyad par rig 'dzin dam pa'i 'khor rnams dang : ma 'ongs skal ldan las 'phro can gyi ched: rdzu 'phrul bkod pa'i khyon gyis 'di ltar bgyis: dam pa nyid kyang mos pas gsol ba thob: ces gsungs so: yang de'i tshe mos gus kyis gsol ba btab cing mi rtag pa gdung shugs bsgoms pa la brten cung zad rlung log pa'i shugs kyis rgyal po sku khams mi bde ba'i tshul bstan: de la phan pa'i thabs rlung rdo rje rab gnas tshe sgrub ye shes lnga ldan kyi bdud rtsi bcas: bī na pa la bka' bab pas rgyal po'i gsang sngags theg chen blo yi gol sa chod: yin min gdeng len pa'i phyir rje btsun gu ru'i zhal gdams mang du gsungs: rgyal pos kyang thugs yid ches pas smon lam mang du btab: de'i tshe 'chi med lnga ldan gyi bdud rtsi de klu yi yul du yod pa ni bī na pa rdzu 'phrul gyis len du byon: de yang bdud rtsi lnga ldan zhes pa klu yi rgyal po gtsug na rin chen nam nor bu'i pho brang yod pa ma dros pa yang zer: mtsho yi kha dog thams cad lnga ldan du yod pa: de la ye shes lnga yi zer 'phro ba rlung gis bskyod pa'i dri bzang phyogs bcur khyab pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas la mchod pa 'bul ba:

de la shing dzam+bu la pṛk+ṣa ku ne bya ba rlung gis bskyod pa'i rang sgras 'dzam bu gling zhes rang sgra sgrog pa: chu dzam+bu ma le lha mo ma le sngon po pi waṃ gi sgra sgrog pa: bya ka len ta'am dzam+bu pṛk+ṣa ku tas rtag tu snyan pa'i dbyangs len pa: shing de la ro drug nus pa brgya rtsa ba dgu: me tog bcu drug lo ma stong dang rtsa bzhi yod pa: sbrul snying yang zer: shing ga phu si la yang zer: mtsho de'i nang na nor bu che ba ri phran tsam 'bring po tha mi dad pa: chung ba rta rnga brgyad gshag tsam mo: la gzhi nyungs dkar chu zhag nyag ris lta bu che chung ma nges par yid la dgos 'dod kun 'byung du grub pa che phra zhing rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam pa gser dngul brdar phye lta bu ste rgyu dang mtshan nyid kyis phyug pa: de la bdud rtsi kha zhag kyang zer: klu 'jim yang zer: don rgyu ye shes lnga ldan las grub pa ste rtag tu: 'chi med kyi bdud rtsi g.yo ba dri zhim gyi ngad pa phyogs bcur 'khyil ba: de'i nang nas klu yi lha mo nor bu 'od rab 'byin mas 'chi med bcud dril bya ba 'bul ba'i par bu ye shes lnga ldan gyi kha zhag las grub pa'i ma ṇi ta ka taṇ+ṭa dang : ko la ka rod ta sogs dpag tu med pa spyan drangs pa rje yi phyag tu phul: bdud rtsi de myangs pas rgyal po mi rtog ye shes 'pho 'gyur med pa'i gdeng thob pa'o: de nas man+da ra bas mtha'i rgya mtsho'i pha mthar nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung bzhugs pa'i phyogs kyi chu dha ri ta ma pham gyi bye ma a krong ta gdan drangs: lha mo dhe wa ku shas lha tshangs pa'i pho brang dbus ma'i gsang mdzod nas 'chi med rang byung tshe chu gdan drangs mkha' 'gro nyi zla dngos grub kyang zer mthing 'od 'bar ma'i phyag nas byung ba'i 'chi med 'ja' lus mkha' spyod kyi sgrub rdzas: sman kyi lha mo 'tsho byed gzhon nu mas phul ba'i rigs gsum mgon po'i a ru rnam rgyal gsum phyogs gcig tu dril ba'i zhun khu bcas gdan drangs:

yang las kyi dbang mo ches phul ba'i dur khrod chen po bcu drug la sgrub pa mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor sgrub rdzas: byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje chos kyis rigs gsum 'chi med don ldan ril bu'i 'dig gu: rig 'dzin brgyad cus brtul zhugs mdzad de baiḍūr+ya yi gling nas gdan drangs pa dga' rab rdo rjes chos sman bsgrubs pa dang skye bdun sangs rgyas rab bdun gyi gdung ring bsrel rin po che stong sbyar gyi phye ma dang zung du spel ba'i skye bdun sangs rgyas 'od kyi sgong bu bcas gdan drangs: gzhan yang drang srong grub thob thams cad kyis rdzu 'phrul du mi sgo nas spyan drangs pa'i bye brag mthong grol myong grol reg grol bcas thams cad bskal pa bzang po'i dus nas bcud ma yal ba'i byin rlabs thams cad phyogs gcig bsdus pa: rgya gar sprul pa'i rig 'dzin rgya nag lung gi rig 'dzin: mkhas grub sprul pa'i rig 'dzin: skye 'chi spangs pa'i rig 'dzin: grub thob sngags kyi rig 'dzin: ma rgyud gsang lam rig 'dzin: mkha' spyod sa spyod kyi rdo rje theg pa gsang sngags rlabs po che'i rig 'dzin grangs las 'das pas mngon sum rdzu 'phrul gyis spyan drangs: 'chi med pad+ma 'byung nas ye shes mkha' 'gro bcu drug sogs thams cad kyis smon lam dus gcig bgyis nas sprel lo sprel zla'i tshes bcu nas bzhengs pa'i 'bum tsho bcu dang sa ya bcu: kun nas 'phags pa lnga brgya: yongs su 'phags pa nyer lnga bcas rdzu 'phrul gyis bzhengs: tshes bco lnga la rab tu gnas par mdzad: rab kyi gtso bo 'bras bu mngon gyur a ti ru grags pa lung gi rig 'dzin kun bzang dga' rab rdo rje shrī seng pad+ma 'byung gnas: grub thob rig 'dzin hūm̐ ka ra mañdzu shrī nā gardzu na pra bha hastī bi ma mi tra dha na saṃ skṛ rom+bu gu h+ya shān+tiṃ ghar+bhaḥ brtul zhugs rig 'dzin in+d+ra bo dhi sa ra ha ḍaṃ bhi pa klu sgrub snying po dril bu pa pad+ma badz+ra lo hi pa ku ku ri pa gzhan yang bde gshegs rgyal ba rig 'dzin mkha' spyod sa spyod bcas thams cad kyis byin brlabs rab tu gnas par mdzad:

rje btsun gyi sku tshab pad+ma badz+ra mtsho skyes rdo rje pad+ma mthong grol pad+ma sam+bha pad+ma bshes gnyen rgya gar paṇa chen: pad+ma bdud 'dul pad+ma rgyal po pad+ma las rab pad+ma yongs grol: pad+ma gong zhu pad+ma mnyam bzhag: pad+ma bdud bzhi g.yul rgyal sogs dpag tu med pa bzhengs pa'i skor rnams brgya dang brgyad rgyal po'i thugs dam rten mdzad: 'ga' zhig rgya gar sogs mkha' spyod gling tshun 'dzam bu gling khams thams cad khyab par sbas: stong phrag gcig tsam bsam yas su mkha' 'gros gdan drangs: khri srong lde'u btsan gyi thugs dam rten brgya bzhag: thams cad gter la sbas 'ga' zhig mtha' yangs kyi gtsug lag dang rten gyi gzungs su bzhugs: rjes 'brang so so la chos ka so so dang sbrags pa'i las can gyi skal ba rin chen gter lnga ldan pa ji srid bar gyi rten skal gnang ba thams cad gter du sbas: de nas slar yang rgya gar gyi gling nas byon pa'i gter rdzas bod du gdan drangs: thams cad la chos rgyal sku ring la dung phyur gcig dang 'bum phrag bdun bzhengs pa thams cad ji srid nas de srid bskal pa'i bar du mi zad pa'i rgyun yang yang du bsrings: sku tshab de rgyu gcig pa'i dam rdzas a daṃ ma ma daṃ ma hri daṃ ma: spyir rigs lnga yab yum gyi sa bon phyag mtshan rnams rje btsun yab yum mtshan brgyad thod phreng sde lnga rnams kyi phyag mtshan thams cad rang byon yod pa thams cad kyis rgyas btab pa dam rdzas thams cad gter la sbas par mdzad de yang sku tshab gsung shog ser thugs gter sgrom mam thugs rten yon tan myong grol gyi dam rdzas a tham ma phrin las phyag mtshan bcas: sku tshab kyi rtse dang shog ser gyi rgya chings rnams tsan+dan sbrul gyi snying po'i phye ma la bgyis pa: gter du mi 'jig pa'i chas su khyung gi sgong bu'i chu: seṅge'i 'o ma: stag gi klad pa: glang chen mkhris pa'o: drag po'i shog bu phal cher dug sbrul gyi klad pa:

ma he rtse drug rnams kyi klad pa yin: gdan 'dren la bab pa'i tshe mig la seṅge'i 'o ma ma byug na: rig dug mthong dug gnyis yod: rgyud sgrub skor gyi shog ser shing kal pa bak+ṣi: pradz+nyā a ku ru ta byang chub shing : n+ya gro ta: nya gro ta: rtag sha pa la sogs kyi pags pa la grub pas brda 'gyur sngags 'gyur sgra 'gyur sogs du ma'i sgo nas rgyas btab pa'o: sa ma ya: sku tshab dang shog ser gyi mtshan nyid rnams sangs rgyas mtsho rgyal gyi bka' tho gsum pa nas khol phyung rgya bod lo rgyus phyogs gcig tu 'dug pa'i sde nas rgya gar ma nyer lnga'i nang nas paṇa chen lugs so: in+d+ra bo dhi'i thugs dam la bcu gsum gras kyi dkar chag go: sa ma ya: dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro mthing 'od mtsho rgyal gyi: dkar chag mthong ba nor bu'i mgul rgyan 'di: las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: dregs pa sde bzhis rgya 'di legs par srungs: sku tshab yid bzhin nor bu dbang gi rgyal: shog ser mkha' 'gro'i snyan brgyud sgrib g.yogs bral: de ltar gtai+er byon dam pa rin chen 'di: phyag bskor mchod 'bul snyan dar rgyan gyis rigs: gang gis bkur sti phu dud bgyis pa'i yul: bkra shis lo legs dmag 'khrug nad yams zhi: rtag tu dge shing dam pa'i chos la spyod: bsam pa lhun grub the tshom med pa'i rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: dz+nyā na shrī yis mtsho nas gdan drangs pa gter rgya ma grol ba'i skor yin kyang sbas yul du than pa chen po byung bas thugs rje che phra gang gis kyang ma phan pas/ sku tshab zhal phyes nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bgyis pas/ phyogs nas dmag skad chen po yod pa zhi/ yul grur char chen po babs pa'i tshe dad pa'i gdeng chen po thob par gyur to/ dge'o// //

'a) sku tshab mthong grol gyi dkar chag bzhugs pa'i dbu yi gzigs phyogs lags so: na mo gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: chos dbyings ye shes ngo mtshar bkod pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo gtso bo rtsa ba gsum gyi lha la 'dud: de yang sku lnga mtshan brgyad bla ma saṃ bha wa'i rten gyi dkar chag bkod pa ste: rgyud las: e ma rje btsun sprul pa'i sku: 'gro mgon dbang po pad+ma 'byung : pre ta bod kyi sems can rnams: las ngan dbang gis sdug bsngal che: khyad par lha 'dre gdug pa'i rigs: gnyan dang dbang po klu yi sa: dge ba rtsom du mi ster ba'i: lha 'dre 'di nyid 'dul dul lau: bdag gi bsam pa 'di 'grub pa'i: chos kyi nyi ma 'char ba dang : sems can bde skyid 'byung ste mchis: zhus so: zhes pas dkrol ba ni: de yang 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis bod kyi gtsug lag dpal gyi bsam yas sgrub pa'i tshe lha 'dres sgrub tu ma ster bas: mkhan po zhi ba mtsho'i lung bstan ltar: pad+ma 'byung gnas spyan drangs: de yis mnga' bdag la bka' mang du bstsal zhing sngon gyi las 'phro bcas lung bstan: khyad par bod kyi lha 'dre gdug pa can gyis dang po mchod yon 'brel ba: bar du gtsug lag bsgrubs pa: tha ma mchod khang gi rgyan btags yongs su grub nas: chos bsgyur ba dkyil 'khor brtsams pa bcas thams cad dus su bar chod brtsams te lam du ma bsgyur ba mang zhig byung ba'i tshe: rje btsun rin po ches: dang po brag phug mā ra ti kar mnyam bzhag: tha ma stod lung sgrol pa lung du mnyam par bzhag ste: de gsum mchod 'brel ba'i lha 'dre dam la btags: gnyis pa dang po bsam yas bzhengs pa'i mnyam bzhag: gnyis pa rgyan btags pa'i mnyam bzhag: gsum pa dbang bskur ba'i mnyam bzhag: gsum pa'i dang po chos bsgyur ba'i mnyam bzhag: gnyis pa dkyil 'khor rgyas pa'i zhal phyes pa'i mnyam bzhag: gsum pa las 'phro can la bka' gtad pa'i mnyam bzhag ste de ltar ma ltos pa'i:

mnyam bzhag brgya dang rtsa brgyad mdzad: de'i don ci zhe na: 'di nyid rgyud las bshad pa ste: thugs sgrub yid bzhin nor bu skor gsum gyi bka' rje 'bangs nyer lnga la gtad pa'i tshe bod kyi lha 'dre rnams kyis 'khu ba la dmigs te bsam yas mchims phu'i dge'u gong la pad+ma yongs grol gyi mnyam bzhag la bzhugs pa des: mkha' 'gro ye shes kyi 'dra 'bag ma 'ongs par pad 'byung bzhugs pa dang 'dra ba'i sku tshab nyi shu rtsa lnga bzhengs pa'o: de la pad 'byung sku gsum gyi mtshan nyid ni: thugs chos kyi bsam yas mchims phu ru mnyam bzhag mdzad: gsung longs spyod rdzogs pa drag po me phreng can gyis dkyil 'khor gyi bar chad bsal: dbu rtse bar khang du sku slob dpon rdau rje thod phreng gis rje 'bangs nyer lnga la gdams pa'i chos kyi bka' gtad nas lung 'bogs te tshe rabs su dran pa mi brjed pa'i gzungs thob par byin gyis brlabs pa'o: de ltar sku tshab phal mo cher mtsho rgyal gyis bzhengs pa rnams mnyam bzhag 'byung ba'i rgyu gter nas 'byung tshad thams cad kyis bsdus don no: khyad par sku tshab sangs rgyas yongs grol 'di nyid kyi sku yi rgyu sngon gyi rgyal po in+d+ra bo dhi'i thugs dam rten man+da ra yi zhing khams bcud nas yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rigs dang : dam chos sgrub pa spyi yi gzhung chen bcu 'phel gdung bdun pa'i rigs: skye bdun pa'i rigs: de la sogs pa sman 'dam chen mo gzhan yang chang tshong ba'i na bza'i 'og klu yi pho brang gnas pa'i chu sa 'dzin gyi snying po bdud rtsi yan lag brgyad pa'i kha zhag in+d+ra bo dhi la phul bas: phye ma brag phug mā ra ti ka'i tshe sgrub rten rnams lha klu mi yul thams cad nas man+da ra bas bsdus pa: khyad par gnod sbyin rtag myos kyis yul ri lung thams cad rin po che'i dgos 'dod yid bzhin dang : mchims phur bsags nas rang bskyed pa'i rigs thams cad yod pa:

de yi gnas ni mtsho dbyibs ri klung gi rnam pa mang yod: mtshams su rgyal srid sna bdun gyi gling yod gnod sbyin gyi pho brang de yi mtsho 'dul brag las grub pa'i kha zhag gi bye ma kri sha ku yang zer: de la 'dra 'bag bzhengs pa ni: bye ma a krong zer: bdud rtsi klu 'jim yang zer: mthong grol skye bdun yang zer: gzhi de lta bu deng sang dkon pa'i rgyu mtshan byung khungs rnyed dka' ba'i don de lta bu yin phyir pad+ma 'byung gnas dang man+da ra ba ye shes mtsho rgyal rdzu 'phrul mnga' brnyes pas rdzas de rnams bsam yas su spyan drangs sku tshab rnams bzhengs: lhag ma rnams gter du sbas: phran tsam re mtha' 'dul gyi lha yi gzungs dang bum gter du sbas: de nas bsam yas sogs 'gangs che ba'i rgyu bla gter bton nas bcud nyams pa'i rgyu de ltar dang rang gzhung gu ru thugs sgrub kyi thugs lung rin chen mdzod bya ba ru bzhugs bzhin nyer mkho rnams bkod: rgyas pa yi bzhengs tshul rab gnas sogs rten 'brel bcas bri mi long rung : deng sang sku tshab rnams rgyu ci las grub: byin rlabs ci yis bskyed: nus pa ci dang ldan: bzhengs pa'i don ci yin: bzhugs pa'i bsod nams ci yod: de la zhabs tog byas na 'bras bu gang mchis sogs: thams cad kyi don gong du bstan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs la ltos pa'i nor bu sna tshogs pa'i yon tan rgyal ba rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i bden tshig bcas thams cad kyi bsod nams las grub bzhin dgongs shes skal ldan yang rab rnams kyis sku tshab la dad pa che ba'i rgyu mtshan no: las gsum pa'i rgyu mtshan ni: rje 'bangs nyi shu rtsa lnga la gter gnas nyer lnga chos ka nyer lnga sku tshab nyer lnga gnang ba la: khyad par thugs kyi bu chen sku yi bka' bab sangs rgyas ye shes la: sgrub pa'i gnas mchog yang rdzong shel brag: lung gi gnas mchog rong chen bzhi yod pa ste:

de yi nang nas shar phyogs gangs ri rtse brgyad kyi lho nub tu pha rgyud 'dus pa dgu'i bla mtsho yod: de yi nub kyi cha ru 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgrub gnas yod: gnas de yi phu la gangs ri shel gyi gur phub pa 'dra ba yod: de yi mgul du bka' brgyad 'dus pa spyi ti yi gnas yod: de'i dbus su ze'u glang po che 'dra ba yod: de'i nub byang du mu le mthing gi mtsho ne'u rkyal pa 'dra ba yod: gong du gshin rje'i pho gdong mo gdong bzhi yod: mi 'gyur ba'i rtags su phag rgod mgo gyen du 'gro ba 'dra ba'i rdo rtsig yod: gnas de ru da lta bka' brgyad zhi khro rig 'dzin rtsa sgrub gsang gter mang po khyad par nga yi sku tshab pad+ma mthong grol dang chos ka 'di mtsho de'i nang du sbos shig: sangs rgyas ye shes khyod gshin rje'i mnga' bdag yin pas: drag sngags rlung zhon 'di yang de ru sbos shig: gnas ni spyang ki ro gzan lta bu'i mtsho de yin: de yi gong du gshin rje'i gter yod pa: gshin rje thams cad 'dus pa'i dpe yin: khyad par mtsho bhan+dha 'dra ba de dngos grub kyi mtsho yin: de la rin po che'i rgya bum gang 'di sbos sogs lung mang po gsungs: ma 'ongs dus sangs rgyas khyod kyi skye ba bcu bdun mtshams lung pa de yi nang du lan bzhin 'dul zhing skye ba gnyis len: 'dul zhing gi ming gnam lcags las grub par nges med kyi rlung lta bu 'byung : de yis 'byin par 'gyur ro: ma hā gu ru'i gsung bzhin mtsho rgyal gyis gter du sbas nas rab tu gnas nas gter srung klu sman dang lha btsan dam can gsum la bcol: 'don pa'i tshe bshos gtsang dkar gtor klu sman dang ra yi sha khrag mchod dngos grub kyi gter bum bzhag: grogs bya yos bu stag sbrul ma bgyis nas 'byin: gsang rgya lo bdun yin: gter lhong chen po 'byung bas mkha' 'gro la gsol ba thob: ces sogs gsungs nas zhal gyis gdams pa'o:

zhus lan las: e ma: yang grol chos kyi snying po rdzogs pa che: rgya bod chos rnams gcig bsdus bdud rtsi 'di: gang gis mthong yang ngan song myong re kan: bdag ni mnga' bdag 'od du gshegs gyur kyang : da lta'i sku tshab 'di dang bdag dang mnyam: gsol ba thob cig rje 'bangs grogs rnams kun: 'di yis bslu ba med do yid ma bcag: ces gsungs mang du bzhin no: slar yang sngags 'chang rtsa gsum gling pas sbrul lor rgyang phu gangs kyi rwa ba nas khrom brgya rtsa dang bcas nas gdan drangs pa'o// // ya) ༄༅/ ༁ྂ: bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: dbang chen in+ḍa nī la'i mchod sdong rin po che'i phreng ba bzhugs so: bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus yid bzhin nor bu las: dbang bskur rgyal po'i rgyud la 'jug pa ste: don gsum las: thog mar sngon du 'gro ba lo rgyus kyis phyug pa: bar du ma smin pa smin par byed pa ngo sprod gsal rdzogs tshig gis rgyas thebs pa: tha ma bka' 'grol 'bras bu bstan nas dam tshig la mi 'gal ba'i bsrung bya 'bog nas: bkra shis rab tu gnas par byed pa'i don gsum mo: de la dbye ba phyi nang dbang gi ngo bo rnam pa lnga ste: lha dbang lus la bskur ba: sngags dbang ngag la bskur ba: chos dbang sems la bskur ba: chas dbang lus la brgyan pa: rdzas dbang lag tu gtad pa: dgos dbang la don bzhi: 'ja' lus la bum pa'i dbang : ye shes la rlung gi dbang : bde chen la thig le'i dbang : mngon sum rig pa'i rtsal dbang : brda don la gsum: snang stong me long gi dbang : grags stong rol mo'i dbang : gsal stong shel rdo'i dbang : 'dzin med kyi dbang gsum: 'ja' tshon snang la rang bzhin bral ba: brag dang rlung sgra nges tshig med pa: chu zla ma 'dres so sor gsal ba'o: dbang gi nges tshig ni: bum pa'i dbang thob pa gzhal yas khang : bum chu myong ba lha'i dngos: byin rlabs shugs la gnas pa ngo bo:

bden pa'i gtong len mos pa nges tshig gi don no: dbang gi 'khyer so ni: lha dbang bskur ba bskyed rim snang stong gi lam 'khyer: sngags dbang bskur ba rlung 'phro 'du grags stong gi lam 'khyer: tshig don chos dbang bskur ba yid 'gyu stong gi lam 'khyer: dbang gi dgongs pa ni: bskyed rim gyi dbang thob pas lus lha bsgom pa la dbang : bzlas pa sngags kyi dbang thob pas bsnyen sgrub 'bad stsol rung ba la dbang : rdzogs rim ngo sprod thob pas yid ka dag bde ba chen po nyams su myong ba la dbang : chas dbang so sor thob pas rgyan gos rnal 'byor gyi cha lugs 'chang ba la dbang : rdzas dbang du thob pas mchod tshogs phra rags byed las bskang gsol sogs la dbang : gnang ba du ma'i lung bstan thob pas phrin las bzhi'i bya ba las su rung : 'bras bu bla na med pa'i dbang la ni: dbu ma rtsa gsum 'khor lo drug gi dbang : bde chen thig le srog 'dzin bcu drug gi dbang : rlung lnga brgyad ni 'phro 'du 'gyu ba'i dbang : ye shes lnga ni kun byed rgyal po'i dbang : phyag rgya drug ni bca' thabs 'khrul 'khor gyi dbang : ā haṃ 'bar 'dzag gtum mo me yi dbang : zung 'jug lnga ldan thabs lam pho nya'i dbang : sbyor ba bzhi ldan gdams ngag btsan thabs kyi dbang : bdun 'khor gsum pa man ngag rgya mtsho'i dbang : nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor 'ja' lus sgrub pa'i dbang : bcu po 'di ni gsang dbang chen mo'o: dkyil 'khor rnam pa dbye ba phyi nang gi: rab ni chos sku gsal rdzogs gzhal yas khang : 'bring ni bskyed rim snang stong gzhal yas khang : tha ma dmigs rten ras bris 'bru yi tshom: spros bcas ltar na rab 'bring tha ma gsum: rab ni blos blang 'bring ni rdul tshon dang : tha ma dmigs rten ras bris sam 'bru tshom: gzhal yas tshom bu lha yi dkyil 'khor yin: bum pa gzung thag sngags kyi dkyil 'khor yin: me long shel rdo rdzogs rim dkyil 'khor yin:

bum pa rgyan ldan lha yi dkyil 'khor yin: 'bring ba rang gzhung sngags kyi dkyil 'khor yin: gsal stong shel sgo ting 'dzin dkyil 'khor yin: bha ling rgyan rdzogs mchod pa'i dkyil 'khor yin: phyag mtshan rnon po las mtha'i dkyil 'khor yin: lnga po 'di la dkyil 'khor cha gcig tshang : mchod pa phyi nang dbang gi rnam dbye ni: phyi mchod gsang mchod sbyor mchod sgrol mchod las: phyi mchod lha mo bskyed rim gzugs kyi dbang : glu mo gar mo grags stong sgra yi dbang : thabs shes zung 'jug bde chen ka dag dbang : sgrol dbang dug lnga rtsad bcad lam khyer dbang : bdud rtsi sman raka gtor ma phrin las bzhi: bdud rtsi lnga ldan nad gdon zhi ba'i dbang : sman mchog kun ldan 'byor drug rgyas pa'i dbang : rak+ta bcud bzang khams gsum sdud pa'i dbang : bha ling zur gsum dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i dbang : de nas gzhal yas tshogs kyi rnam dbye ni: dkon mchog mchod pas tshogs gnyis bsags las dbang : gnyis pa bskang ba nyams chag sor chud dbang : gsum pa bshags pa lan chags mi 'khor dbang : bzhi pa bsgral ba nga bdag rtsad gcod dbang : lnga pa zhal bstab rtog med ro snyom dbang : drug pa lhag ma gnas nyul 'gyed pa'i dbang : drug po 'di ni tshogs bsags dbang zhes so: rnam pa bdud rtsi byed las dbang la ni: bhan+dha phyi mchod gzhal yas lha yi dbang : byin rlabs yig 'bru sa bon sngags kyi dbang : rigs lnga yum lnga bde chen thugs rje'i dbang : sha chen brgyad ni rtsa brgyad yon tan dbang : mchod pa'i lha mo stong sbyor phrin las dbang : bdud rtsi myong ba dngos grub dam tshig dbang : drug po 'di ni yan lag dbang zhes so: bskang ba'i mchod pa la dbang ba ste: spyan gzigs sku 'bag bshams pa phyi yi dbang : srog 'khor bhan+dha 'chang ba gsang ba'i dbang : bla rdo dam tshig gsang mtshan nang gi dbang : bskang gsol dus mchod rgyun khyer yon tan dbang :

rbad bsad bzlog zor mnan sreg phrin las dbang : rjes shes rgyas 'debs las mtha' yongs rdzogs dbang : drug po 'di ni gang 'dul mchod pa'i dbang : de yang chos sku ni mi rtog pa ye shes chen po'i dbang : longs sku sprul bsgyur rtsal snang ci yang mi 'gags pa la dbang : sprul sku ni gang 'dul der ston pa'i las su dbang : rnam pa gsum tshogs pas thabs dang shes rab kyi bar lag 'brel ba ste gnyis bsdus kyi chos thams cad gnyis su med pa'i rnal 'byor chen po'i rang bzhin gyi dbang thob pa yin: dper na dbang sgyur ba'i nus pa shugs las yod pa la bdag gis kyang de bzhin du sgyur nus pa'i smon lam gyi dbang zhu ba dang : dbang bskur ba rgyal bas bsngags pa bden pa'i byin rlabs nas ched du gnyer ba gang gis gzhan la dbang bskur ba la dmigs te lung bstan pa sogs dbang bskur ba la yang rnam dbye mang ba ste: nyi mas drod bskyed nas rang bzhin gsal ba: zla bas sgrib g.yogs bral nas bsil zhing gsal ba: yid bzhin gyi nor bu dgos pa gang du yod pa'i sa phyogs 'byung ba: chos sku mtha' dbus bral te khyab pa: nam mkha' dang rlung gis mi khyab pa med pas: 'byung ba lnga yang so so'i rang gzugs ston nus pa: sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs la nye ring med pa: smon lam gyi bden tshig la sa mtshams kyis bar mi chod pa: srid pa'i rang gzugs rang grub kyi rnam pa dod pa ltar: rang bzhin gyi dbang shugs la yod pa ste: de lta bu'i dbang la mos pas dbang zhu ba la: bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa: slob ma snod dang ldan zhing chos la blo mthun pa zhig 'dzoms dgos: de ltar bla ma mi ldan pa'am: slob ma mi ldan par gyur na: lag rdum brag la 'byar ba'am: long ba lha khang nang du bslebs pa'am: bsod nams ma bsags pa'i sprang po'i mnga' dbang chen po la rlom pa'am: rdo thog so nams btab pa'am: lag stong tshong dus su bslebs pa'am:

ri gzar rdo 'dril ba gnyis 'tshogs pa cig gis grogs cig gis gnyer pa ltar ro: de bas dbang gi mtshan nyid kyi don go dgos: dkyil 'khor la brten nas dbang bskur ba ngo sprod kyi dbang yin: gong bzhin du dbang gi ngo sprod kyi brda rnams don go thog nas nyams su len dgos: nyams su ma blang ba'i dbang zhu ba ni: btsan po'i longs spyod dmangs po'i 'u lag bkal ba rgyab tu khur ba lta bu'am: dud 'gro la gser dngul bkal ba lta bu'am: dbul po nor med kyi mi'i lung stong gi rtswa bzang po bdag tu 'dzin pa ltar: 'bag kyang 'bras bu mi 'byung ba'o: ci'i phyir zhe na: dad pa'i gzhi: brtson 'grus kyi grogs: mos gus kyi 'dun pa gsum la rag las so: de yang rgyud las: dbang thob dam ldan slob ma yi: sgom sgrub nyams su len pa'i tshe: 'bras bu bde blag nyid la 'grub: ces gsungs pas: dam nyams dang sdig can la bdud kyi grogs byed pa ni ngan lam du 'khrid pa'i thabs yin: yang dag pa'i don ma yin no: de bas yi dam gyi lha dang srung ma yang mi 'khor bar 'gyur ro: des na dbang bskur zhu ba la dam tshig mig gi 'bras bu ltar bsrung dgos: de yang lus gus pas byin rlabs 'jug: ngag gsol ba btab pas bden tshigs 'grub: yid gdung ba skyes pas nyams rtogs 'bar: sgo gsum tha mal du ma song na thugs rje dang nus pa rab tu gnas: maṇ+ḍal phun sum tshogs pas rgyu bsod nams tshogs bsags: 'bras bu ye shes kyi tshogs smin: dbugs dbyung gzengs bstod pas chos la dbang bsgyur ba'i dad dpon du 'byung : bkra shis dang smon lam thob pas skye ba dang tshe rabs su bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa'i mi lus kyang thob nas 'phro mtha' chos kyis bsu: lhag pa'i lha dang mjal: skye ba ngan pas bar mi chod: bram ze dang drang srong gi rigs 'dzin par 'gyur ro: mu stegs dang bdud kyi dbang du nam yang mi 'gro bar 'gyur ro:
de ltar phyi nang gsang ba gsum gyi dbang go rim bzhin 'gag gi rtsa tho bsdus pa'o:

sa ma ya: de yang bla ma'i thugs sgrub yid bzhin nor bu'i dbang bskur ba la: thog mar dkyil 'khor bkod pa sgrub chen ltar la: bye brag mkho ba'i rdzas dbang gi gzhung tshig dang bstun pa tsakli sogs rgyas bsdus ci ltar 'grub pa dang bstun: dbang 'di la bskur lugs gsum 'byung ste: dkyil 'khor chen po ltar na bsam pa lhun 'grub ma'i dbang yang thabs su btsud: 'bring po sta gon mi bya bar bskyed rim 'bog nas chas dbang lus lha tsam la mtha' rten bya: bsdus pa sku lnga'i dbang la mtha' rten rab gnas bya: dbang chen gyi skabs su sngon du mtshams gcod dang sta gon nang du ma tshud pa la dbang mi sbyin: sngon du dbang zhu mkhan gang tsam yod pa tshogs pa'i rjes su khrus bya: mtshams bcad me chu thun gsum bya: de ging dkar nag gi chas su zhugs: rdo rje slob dpon he ru ka'i cha lugs 'chang : thog mar slob ma rnams kyi shar phyogs sgo drung nas sgo zhus bya ba ni: thams cad kyis phyag thal mo sbyar nas 'di ltar zhu: hoḥ shar phyogs ging chen rnam par rgyal ba yis: byams pa tshad med sgrub pa'i snyan gson la: nyon mongs zhe sdang zhi ba'i brda sgo phyes: me long ye shes gsal ba'i ngo sprad nas: mngon dga' zhing khams bgrod pa'i lam sna mdzod: rdo rje dbyings kyi lha dang bdag sprod cig: sgo ba rnams kyis: hoḥ nged rnams rdo rje rigs kyi ging : lha bu bdud kyi cho 'phrul las: khyed rnams skal par mi ldan pas: shar sgo bcad kyis dam longs 'tshal: slob mas: kyeḥ nged rnams skal ldan las can te: me long ye shes zhal mjal phyir: sgo ba chen pos sgo phyes 'tshal: dam tshig mi 'da' srog ltar bzung : ging rnams kyis: hoḥ de ltar dam tshig ldan lags na: rdo rje rin chen pad+ma dang : las kyi rigs sogs rim pa bzhin: so sor dam longs dbang mchog sbyin: de nas lho sgor phyin te sngar bzhin: hoḥ lho phyogs ging chen gshin rje gshed po yis:

snying rje tshad med sgrub pa'i snyan gson 'tshal: nyon mongs nga rgyal zhi ba'i brda sgo phyes: mnyam nyid ye shes gsal ba'i ngo sprad nas: dpal ldan zhing khams bgrod pa'i lam sna mdzod: rat+na dbyings kyi lha dang bdag sprod cig: sgo ba rnams kyis: nged rnams rin chen rigs kyi ging : phung po bdud kyi cho 'phrul las: khyed rnams skal bar mi ldan pas: lho sgo bcad kyis dam longs 'tshal: slob mas: kye nged rnams skal ldan las can te: mnyam nyid ye shes zhal mjal phyir: sgo ba chen pos sgo phyes 'tshal: dam tshig mi 'da' srog ltar bzung : de nas nub kyi sgor phyin la: hoḥ nub phyogs ging chen rta mgrin rgyal po yis: dga' ba tshad med sgrub pa'i snyan gson 'tshal: nyon mongs 'dod chags zhi ba'i brda sgo phyes: sor rtog ye shes gsal ba'i ngo sprad nas: bde chen zhing khams bgrod pa'i lam sna mdzod: pad+ma dbyings kyi lha dang ngo sprod cig: sgo ba rnams kyis: hoḥ nged rnams pad+ma rigs kyi ging : nyon mongs bdud kyi cho 'phrul las: khyed rnams skal bar mi ldan pas: nub sgo bcad kyis dam longs 'tshal: slob mas: kye nged rnams skal ldan las can te: sor rtog ye shes zhal mjal phyir: sgo ba chen pos sgo phyes 'tshal: dam tshig mi 'da' srog ltar bzung : de nas byang sgor phyin la: hoḥ byang phyogs ging chen dbyug pa sngon po yis: btang snyoms tshad med sgrub pa'i snyan gson 'tshal: nyon mongs phrag dog zhi ba'i brda sgo phyes: bya grub ye shes gsal ba'i ngo sprod nas: las rabs zhing khams bgrod pa'i lam sna mdzod: karma dbyings kyi lha dang bdag sprod cig: sgo ba rnams kyis: hoḥ nged rnams karma rigs kyi ging : 'chi bdag bdud kyi cho 'phrul las: khyed rnams skal bar mi ldan pas: byang sgo bcad kyis dam longs 'tshal: slob mas: kye nged rnams skal ldan las can te: bya grub ye shes zhal mjal phyir: sgo ba chen pos sgo phyes 'tshal:

dam tshig mi 'da' srog ltar bzung : bgegs bskrad pa ni: hūm̐: khyed rnams yang dag snod ldan na: dkyil 'khor nang du 'jug pa'i tshe: bsgrub la mi dbang gdon dang bgegs: dngos grub bar du gcod pa'i tshogs: khro rgyal sprul pa'i pho nya ni: 'bar ba'i ging chen glog ltar 'gyu: gnod byed 'brang ba'i go skabs med: lan chags gtor ma 'di khyer la: so so rang rang gnas su dengs: ci ste mi 'gro 'tshe byed na: dmar nag me phreng thugs khros nas: bgegs tshogs thal ba'i rdul du rlog: de bas gzhan du phyir dengs shig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ a hūm̐: rak+ṣa hūm̐: yak+sha hūm̐: a ya ma du ru tsa sha na sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ gnod byed 'byung po u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ ces rdo thun gyis brab: yol ba'i phyi nas khrid la: yol ba'i phyi nas 'di skad zhu: kye thugs rje'i dbang phyug bla ma rje: bde gshegs bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor du: skal ldan yang dag 'jug pa'i phyir: dam pas rjes bzung gnang ba stsol: slob dpon gyis: hūm̐: rdo rje gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du: yang dag nges par 'jug nas su: dkyil 'khor gnyan la mi 'da' na: dam longs rdo rje'i dam tshig sbyin: de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi phyag g.yas pas rdo rje thogs te: hūm̐: rdo rje theg pa'i yang rtse mchog: rdo rje gseng lam chos sku'i dbyings: rdo rje'i lde'u mig sna tshogs thabs: rdo rje sku gsum sgo phye ltos: oṃ badz+ra pra be sha ya phaṭḥ de nas ye shes lnga'i lam la 'khrid pa ni: hūm̐: nga ni bud+dha thod phreng rtsal: skal bar ldan pa'i las can khyod: ma rig gti mug bsal ba'i phyir: rang byung dar thag sngon po zungs: chos dbyings ye shes lam la shog: oṃ sarba bud+dha puṣ+pe hoḥ me tog 'thor: hūm̐: nga ni rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: skal bar ldan pa'i las can khyod: zhe sdang khengs sems bsal ba'i phyir:

zhi ba'i dar thag dkar po zungs: me long ye shes lam la shog: oṃ sarba badz+ra puṣ+pe hoḥ me tog 'thor: hūm̐: nga ni rat+na thod phreng rtsal: skal bar ldan pa'i las can khyod: nga rgyal khong khro bsal ba'i phyir: rgyas pa'i dar thag ser po zungs: mnyam nyid ye shes lam la shog: oṃ sarba rat+na puṣ+pe hoḥ me tog 'thor: hūm̐: nga ni pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: skal bar ldan pa'i las can khyod: 'dod chags sred pa bsal ba'i phyir: dbang gi dar thag dmar po zungs: sor rtog ye shes lam la shog: oṃ sarba pad+ma pu+uṣ+pe hoḥ me tog 'thor: hūm̐: nga ni karma thod phreng rtsal: skal bar ldan pa'i las can khyod: phrag dog gdug pa bsal ba'i phyir: drag po'i dar thag ljang khu zungs: bya grub ye shes lam la shog: oṃ sarba karma puṣ+pe hoḥ me tog 'thor: hūm̐: nga ni rje btsun pad+ma 'byung : gling 'di rnga yab dag pa'i zhing : lha 'di bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi: dkyil 'khor ma 'dres 'ja' ltar lhags: skal ldan rnams kyi smon lam 'grub: skal med srid na dung bas gdungs: nges par snying nas gsol ba thob: oṃ badz+ra maṇ+ḍal mu ḍa hoḥ thams cad dkyil 'khor la phyag phul zhing thal sbyar dang bcas la rjes zlos bya: e ma hoḥ nub phyogs bde chen dag pa'i zhing khams su: snang mtha'i sprul pa 'dzam bu gling du byon: o rgyan dha na ko sha'i mtsho las 'khrungs: in+d+ra bhū tis rgyal srid mnga' gsol mdzad: za hor rgyal po'i bstan pa chos la btsud: 'gro ba'i mgon po o rgyan rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: rgyal srid spangs nas dur khrod gnas brgyad byon: ta na ga na'i sbyor sgrol spyod pa mdzad: rgya gar mu stegs dmag tshogs dam la btags: man+da ra sogs mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpon mdzad: rgya gar thams cad rin chen gter gyis bkang : rig 'dzin gtso bo o rgyan rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol:

bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: thugs rje'i dgongs pas bod la gzigs pa'i tshe: bal bod mtshams su lha srin dam la btags: mkhan slob chos gsum bod la nyi ma shar: bsam yas la sogs mtha' 'dul yang 'dul grub: mdo sngags gnyis kyi chos kyi sgron me sbar: thugs rje'i bdag nyid o rgyan rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: bsam yas mchims phur bde 'dus sgrub chen mdzad: rje 'bangs rgya mtshor chos kyi bka' chen phab: sku tshab nyer lnga bod kyi don la bzhag: dgongs brda nam mkha' rgya mtsho'i shog ser la: ye shes lnga ldan tshom bu'i tshul du zug: kha byang yang byang lung byang rgya chen bsdams: dus gsum kun mkhyen o rgyan rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: khra 'brug rtsa gsum bka' 'dus zhal phyes tshe: man+da ra ba mkha' spyod gnas nas byon: dkyil 'khor byin 'bebs bkra shis mtha' rten mdzad: 'gro don mthar phyin o rgyan rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: thugs sras lnga dang rje 'bangs nyer lnga la: zhal gdams don tshan ma 'ongs lung bstan bzhag: 'dzam gling khams kun rin chen gter gyis bkang : lho nub gdong dmar srin po'i kha gnon mdzad: thugs rjes bod kyi sems can don la gzigs: grub thob rgyal po o rgyan rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: skal ldan las can gsol ba btab pa'i tshe: nangs re dgong re bod kyi don la byon: yar mar tshes bcu'i dus su dngos su byon: rig 'dzin rnams kyi zhal mjal lung bstan gnang : gnas chen dus bzang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpon mdzad: gtan gyi skyabs mchog o rgyan rin po che:

gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gter la dbang sgyur smin grol dkyil 'khor gyi: chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba'i tshe: rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs: byin 'bebs dbang bskur bkra shis rab gnas mdzad: mchog thun dngos grub 'byung bar the tshom med: byin rlabs kun 'dus o rgyan rin po che: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: deng nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob bar: rigs dang dkyil 'khor lhag pa'i lhar gyur nas: bde gshegs kun 'dus rtsa gsum bdag gyur pa'i: phrin las 'gro 'dren dpal du 'byung gyur cig: om̐ gu ru badz+ra yo gi ni sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: zhes pa pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs nas 'khod: dam chu sbyin thon nas lus gnad dang bcas nas 'khod: dam chu thogs nas: hūm̐: 'di ni byang chub snying rje'i chu: gsang sngags mos par ye shes 'gyur: sngags la mi mos log lta can: dam tshig nyams pa'i dug chur 'gyur: de bas dam srungs chu 'di 'thung : gnas khang 'di yi phyi rol du: dam med rnams la smra mi bya: log lta can la shin tu gsang : oṃ badz+ra na ra ka a su tri pre du nṛ+-i sa ma ya i dan+te badz+ra hū?m̐ hūm̐: de nas dkyil 'khor bar chad bsrung phyir dpung skud sngags 'dis byin rlabs bya: oṃ badz+ra he ru ka yak+sha kā la badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ mdud pa'i sngags ni: raṃ triṃ ṭaṃ tsakra ka ra hūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas pho yi lag pa g.yas mo yi g.yon du 'dags: hūm̐: ye shes lnga yi legs mtshon pa: dam tshig sems dpa' gnas pa dang : ye shes phebs nas brtan pa'i phyir: de ring rdo rje'i rgya chings gdab: oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ tsakra tsakra badz+ra tsakra swā hā: de nas rmi lam brtag pa'i phyir: skye med yi ge āḥre gtad: om̐: dang po skye med stong pa āḥ
