bar du 'gags med gsal snang āḥ tha ma bde stong 'dzin med āḥ rang sems dri med āḥdakar sgoms: oṃ a a āḥ de nas gdan du ku sha gtad: hūm̐: sngon byon rig 'dzin grub thob kyis: 'jag spyil phub nas ku sha yi: gdan byas rnams snang chos bdun gnas: de yi rten 'brel rtswa 'di zungs: oṃ badz+ra dz+nyā na dha ra gar+bha sid+dhi hoḥ rtswa rgya gram bgyis pa de la sngas gdan bya: de nas 'bru tshom mam maṇ+ḍal steng du dkyil 'khor zhu ba snod dang mi ldan so shing tsan dan la bzos pa sor bcu drug gi tshad bya: mgo bo me tog rtsa ba rgya mdud yin: mtshon bya rang lus kyi khams bcu drug gi mtshan nyid dbu ma'i mtshon: 'ga' zhig gis so shing la kha 'drad brgyab mkhan yang ste don dang tshig go log pa red: gser shing kyang zer: bdud la yang zer kyang 'di sor ka yin: srin mdzub dang gung mo mdzub kyi sor rtse gsor thabs su 'phang : so shing gi rtse mor pad+ma dgos pa yin: snying kha'i pad+ma chu shel gyi me tog ltar kha bye ba'i dbus sngar gyi lung 'bog pa'i āḥde sems nyid skye ba med pa'i dkyil 'khor gtso bo'i thugs ka ru 'phros pas yi dam lha'i go 'phang thob par bsgoms la smon lam kyang de bzhin dmod nas btab: so shing gi rtse mor cod pan kyang brgyan dgos: de nas dor ba'i tshe: hoḥ drug ldan rdo rje lus kyi dbu ma ru: skye med dbang po me tog āḥdakar brgyan: deng 'dir dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul lags na: tshe rabs 'di phyi'i rten 'brel gang 'grub ston: oṃ dharma mu le puṣ+pe ku mu ṭa gar+bha āḥ zhes dor bas ci bzhin gyen du phyogs na rten 'brel rab yin: 'phen khar sdod nas snying rus dang smon lam gyis mtshams sbyor: mgo mjug ldog na bla ma dang dkyil 'khor la bshags pa bzang po bya: so shing g.yas su mgo bo gtad na zhe sdang yin: g.yon 'dod chags yin: mgo nar mor 'phrad pa gti mug yin:

zhe sdang la tshe thar btang : 'dod chags la sbyin pa bya: gti mug la dkar me brgya tshar sogs gang mang : thams cad ngan na ngan 'gro yin pas dge ba rlabs chen bya: ma byas na chos bsgrub pa la bar chad 'byung : lhag par tshogs brgya skong bshags brgya rtsa sāts+tsha dang dar lcog sbyin pa sogs rgya cher dgos pa'o: de nas so shing gi cod pan de spyi bor btags nas sgom lung 'bog : hūm̐: deng nas brtsam ste bu khyod kyis: dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa'i sgor zhugs nas: yi dam spang blang mi bya zhing : dkyil 'khor 'di la gtso bo gyis: oṃ badz+ra mu tra sarba kā ya badz+ra dha ra hūm̐: zhes pas rdo rje sems dpa' dang skyabs gsum sdom pa'i dbang rtags yin pas spyi bor brgyan: 'di yi don lnga ni: dam chu kha ru sbyin pa dam tshig mi nyams pa'i khas len mna' tho rang chad kyi rnam dbye: cod pan spyi bor brgyan pa dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i dbang rtags mi nor ba'i mi lta bu: dpung skud legs par 'dogs pa mi 'gyur ba'i rgya chings: āḥsnying khar sgom pa mi 'khrul ba'i dam mdzer: rtswa gdan 'og tu 'ding ba sgrub pa mthar ma phyin par mi 'gul ba'i dam bca' ste sngon du 'gro ba'i gzer bu lnga'o:

de nas rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom lung 'bog pa ni: thams cad kyis phyag rgya spyi bor sbyar la: hoḥ bdag lus spyi gtsug dung khang pho brang ste: rdo rje sems dpa' dri med shel gyi mdangs: rdo rje dril bu thabs shes phyag rgya can: snyems ma dkar sngon rdo rje dung dmar 'dzin: yab yum zung 'jug 'khril thabs skyil krung bzhugs: lha rdzas rin chen rgyan mdzes thugs ka ru: hūm̐ yig mtha' ru yi ge brgya pa ni: g.yas g.yon 'khor bas bag chags sdig sgrib dag: chu zla'i snang bzhin dri med rjen par shar: oṃ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐: om̐ rat+na sa twa hūm̐: om̐ pad+ma sa twa hūm̐: om̐ karma sa twa hūm̐: om̐ gu ru sa twa hūm̐: om̐ dhe wa sa twa hūm̐: om̐ ḍāk+ki sa twa hūm̐: yi ge brgya pa ring ba bgrang : de nas rdo rje sems dpa'i sdom bzung ni: hūm̐: sangs rgyas byang sems bdag la dgongs: bdag gis 'di bzung byang chub bar: 'gro ba'i don du sems bskyed nas: tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa bsrung : bzod pa dka' thub brtson 'grus brtsam: bsam gtan bsgoms nas shes rab 'chang : sbyin btang smon lam thabs stobs 'byin: bud+dha rdo rje rat+na dang : pad+ma karma bhi shwa yis: dug lnga sku lnga ye shes lnga: phung po lnga nyid ye sangs rgyas: rtsa khams dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yi: dkyil 'khor gsum gyi dam tshig bzung : oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya tsit+ta hūm̐: de nas yan lag bdun pa ni: hūm̐: rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas dbyings nas gshegs: nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs: phyi nang gsang gsum kho na nyid: gling bzhi maṇ+ḍal mchod pa 'bul: gus pas phyag bgyi sdig pa bshags: gsol 'debs chos kyi 'khor lo bskor: dbang bskur smin grol dge ba bsngo: lha khyed rdo rje dbyings kyi gtso: nyid ltar bdag gzhan 'byung 'gyur shog: oṃ gu ru badz+ra bai ro tsa na bo dhi sa twa hūm̐: zhes pas nyams chag bshags pa'i snying po ci 'grub bya: rmi lam brtag:

rmi ltas sgrub khog gi pra khrid ltar: bzang po byung na lha sgrub thag nye: ngan tsam byung na chos kyi mjug 'khyong ba do gal gtso bor bshags pa dgos rtags yin: 'di yan rten 'brel sta gon no: de nas slob ma rnams mig dar dang bcas gral du 'khod la: maṇ+ḍal phul nas dbang gi gnang ba zhu ba ni: hoḥ dkyil 'khor gtso bo bla ma nyid: rdo rje slob dpon rigs kyi bdag: bde gshegs bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor du: bdag 'jug bka' stsal zhu ba'i rten: bdag lus longs spyod dge rtsa dang : zhing khang yul zhing chung ma bcas: 'dzam gling bye ba phrag brgya dang : grangs med 'jig rten dang bcas te: 'dzam gling 'di ru bkod nas kyang : maṇ+ḍal gcig tu bkram pa'i tshogs: dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul na: dbang bskur rjes su gnang ba stsol: oṃ badz+ra bhū mi i pa maṇ+ḍa la kaṃ nir+ya ta ya mi: de nas dam chu sbyin pa ni: hoḥ gsang sngags dkyil 'khor gnyan po yi: dam tshig srog ltar bsrungs ba 'dis: snying la ye shes lha rnams gnas: dam nyams rnams la gshin rjer 'gyur: oṃ lo ha biṣatshas ha la i dan+te swā hā: slob dpon gyis: hūm̐: skal ldan dam tshig gnas pa rnams: dkyil 'khor thugs sgrub rdo rje'i dbyings: khyod rnams 'jug cing smin pa'i phyir: dbang mchog bskur phyir legs par ltos: slob mas: hoḥ bdag ni grangs med 'khor bar 'khyams: a 'thas bag med 'khrul 'khor gyis: nyon mongs ling thog gis bsgribs pas: dam pa'i thugs rjes phye bar stsol: slob dpon gyis rdo rje'i thur ma thogs la: hūm̐: nga ni zag bcas 'khrul rgya zhig: 'khrul med shes rab spyan dang ldan: rtsal spros ye shes thur ma yis: khyod kyi a 'thas sgrib mun bsal: oṃ badz+ra tsak+ṣu pra be sha ya phaṭḥ nyon mongs pa yi sgrib pa rnam gsum bsal nas dag pa ye shes spyan dang ldan par gyur cig: de nas dkyil 'khor gyi ngo sprod bya ba ni: hūm̐:

nga ni rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i gtso: lha khrid bskyed rim phyi la bkram: brda don gsum gyi ngo bo sprad: gnas lugs dkyil 'khor nang du bkod: 'gyu 'ong gsum gyi ngo bo sprod: bskyed rdzogs nyi zla kha sbyor tshul: zung 'jug gnyis med ngo bo sprod: skal ldan rnams kyis legs par nyon: oṃ dharma shū n+ya ta āt+ma ko3 haṃ: 'di yan dkyil 'khor mjal bar byed pa'i dam bzung brda sgo'o: hoḥ de yang skal ldan rnams legs par gsan 'tshal: deng 'dir bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor zab mo zhal phyes skal ba dang ldan pa rnams la ngo sprod bgyis pa yin te: thog mar gzhi nam mkha' kun tu bzang mo'i bha ga yangs pa'i klong du snod kyi snang ba dang snod kyi 'jig rten rnams pas mkha' klong gi dkyil 'khor yum lnga'i 'byung ba rim brtsegs su chags pa ni kun gzhi 'gyur ba med pa'o: rdo rje rgya gram gyi lte ba ru bh+rūm̐ ye shes lnga ldan gyi dkyil 'khor bkod pa ni chos sku'i rol rtsal ma 'gags pa'o: gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rtsig pa 'dod snam pha gu drwa ba drwa phyed shar bu mda' yab rin po che sna tshogs kyi tog bcas phyi nang gi rgyan spyod phun sum tshogs pa ni: longs sku sgyu ma mkhan gyi zhing khams bkod pa'o: pad phreng rdo rwa dur khrod me ri sogs: de rnams bkod pa yongs su rdzogs pa ni: longs sku'i rgyan 'phyang la rnam pa ma nges pa'i rol rtsed cho 'phrul sna tshogs ston pa'i don no: de yi dbus su rin chen khri 'phang nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la: rje btsun rin po che gu ru dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas la: rgyal po'i cha lugs za ber pad zhwa dang chos gos rnam gsum rdo rje bhan+dha kha ṭ+wāṃ dkur brten nas rgya lham gsol ba ste: rgyal po rol stabs su bzhugs pa ni ye nas snang mtha' 'od mi 'gyur ba 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku bgres rgud bral ba rgya mtsho las 'khrungs bzhin rgyal po in+d+ra bo dhi'i rgyal srid bskyangs nas mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi sgo nas rig pa'i gnas lnga'i bye brag so sor ma smos pa'i dad dpon rig 'dzin chen po sangs rgyas kun gyi nang nas 'gran zla dang bral ba'o:

thod phreng sde lnga sku'i gnas su bzhugs pa ni: ye shes lnga'i thugs rje zad pa med pas gang 'dul der ston 'gro don bgyis pa'o: spyi bor bla ma rdo rje 'chang yab yum bzhugs pa ni: kun tu bzang po'i cho rol nyid la rdzogs pa'i brda'o: phyogs bzhir rta mgrin 'jam dpal spyan ras gzigs dang phyag rdor bzhugs pa ni: yi dam rigs 'dus dgongs pa nyid kyi sku la rdzogs pa'i brda'o: phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad gu ru mtshan brgyad bzhugs pa ni: dkyil 'khor brgyad kyi gtso bo yin zhing gang 'dul der ston thabs kyis 'gro ba 'dren pa'i brda: rdo rje dpa' bo ging gis bskor ba ni: dkyil 'khor skyong zhing phyi nang bar chad srung ba'i brda: bar khyams gsang ba'i lha mo sna tshogs bzhugs pa ni: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i gtso bo yin pa'i brda: dbang phyug zhing skyong gnas nyul la sogs bzhugs pa ni: gsang sngags zab mo'i dkyil 'khor nang du log lta can mi btang zhing tshar bcad de sgo bzhir skyong ba'i brda: gzhan yang dkyil 'khor khor yug kun tu rje 'bangs nyer lngas byin 'bebs mdzad cing gsang ba mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis 'khor lo bskor ba ni: thugs rje'i byin rlabs nus pas 'gro ba sgrol zhing mchog dang thun mong dngos grub 'byung ba'i brda: dkyil 'khor phyi rol drwa ba sham bu me long me tog phreng ba nyi zla mda' dar ral gri stag sham thod phreng rus rgyan phur pa mda' gzhu cod pan gnam rgyan yol ba sogs dkyil 'khor gyi ca lag sogs tshang zhing tshogs pa ni: rten 'brel dge mtshan du ma dang ldan te: bar chad bdud kyis glags mi rnyed pa'i brda: rdo rje slob dpon la che ba'i rgyal chas kyis spras nas khri gdan phun sum tshogs pa'i kha ru bzhugs te nyer mkho'i rdzas phun sum tshogs pa: khyad par maṇ+ḍal phyi nang gsang gsum tshogs pa ni: skal ldan dam pa chos la spyod pa'i tshe 'dod rgu dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i brda:

slob ma dad ldan pho mo thams cad rgyan gos mdzes pa'i chas dang ldan pas gral du 'khod pa ni: phyis 'byung rgyan dar phun sum tshogs te rten 'brel 'phro bzang mthud nas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs gral bsleb par 'gyur ro: de ltar dkyil 'khor zab mo 'di 'dra'i sgor zhugs pa ni: smon lam dang mthar thug gi 'bras bu ngo mtshar gyi gnas su gyur: sa ma ya: de nas thams cad kyis me tog mtheb srin bar du bzung nas 'dun pa dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor nang du dor: kyaiḥ bdag ni grangs med lus blangs kyang : 'di dang phyi ma nyer len du: bsgrubs dang sgrub par byed pa yis: lhag pa'i lha dang bdag sprod cig: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe ā yu ṣe swā hā: zhes dor bas dkyil 'khor phyogs gang du babs pa'i gsang mtshan btags: de nas cod pan spyi bor brgyan pa ni: hūm̐: ye shes lnga yi dbang rtags ni: rigs lnga'i cod pan sa bon brgyan: deng 'dir lha dang skal bar mnyam: rtag tu chos 'di spyod par shog: om̐ maṅga laṃ mu ku ṭa sarba pañtsa su pra tiṣ+ṭha ye swā hā: cod pan mgor bzhag la rtag tu 'chang ba'am ci rigs bya'o: khyod ma 'ongs pa'i dus su sangs rgyas pa'i ming ni rig 'dzin gzhon nu 'od zer dpa' bo rnam par rol pa zhes sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro: de nas rdo rje spyi bor bzhag phur pa lag tu gtad: hūm̐: deng nas brtsam ste bu khyod kyis: bla med dkyil 'khor srog ltar srungs: dam tshig rdo rje'i rgyas gdab nas: bar chod srung ba'i phur bu 'chang : oṃ badz+ra tsakra oṃ badz+ra kī la ya dha ra hūm̐: zhes gong ba la 'dogs: de nas ma dag pa'i rgyud sbyangs shing dag pa ye shes su ston pa la bskyed rim 'bog pa ni: bsang chu 'thor zhing : oṃ badz+ra a mri ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dho sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ: slob ma mi dmigs pa stong pa'i ngang las: khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo'i gtsug tu:

paṃ las pad+ma a las zla ba raṃ las nyi ma'i gdan du hūm̐ mthing nag las rje btsun ma hā gu ru rin po che dus gsum sangs rgyas de nyid sku mdog dmar smug khro 'dzum gyi nyams can thugs rje'i spyan gsum phyogs bcur 'khyil zhing gzigs pa: phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar 'dzin cing g.yon ka pā la mnyam bzhag gi nang du 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis bkang ba'i bum pa 'dzin cing : sku la phod ka lhab lhub dang chos gos dmar po gser gyi pa tra ris gsol zhing za 'og gi ber chen dmar smug bklubs pa: dbu la shwa ba'i snyan zhu la rgod sgro dar sna lnga'i cod pan dang me long nyi zla nor bu khyung gshog la rin po che'i tshom bu bkod pa gsol ba: gru mor yum mtshon pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang de la g.yer kha sogs rgyan du mas spras pa: zhabs la rgya lham dar chen gsol nas snang srid zil gyis gnon par rol stabs su bzhugs pa: de yi spyi bor bla ma chos sku rdo rje 'chang la yum rnal 'byor dmar mo 'khril ba: gu ru'i gnas lnga ru thod phreng sde lnga phyi rol rta mgrin 'jam dpal spyan ras gzigs phyag na rdo rje'o: de yi phyi rol gu ru mtshan brgyad dpa' bo ging bzhi gsang ba'i rig ma bcu drug laṅka gnas nyul sprul pa nyid sprul dang bcas pa: gzhan rje 'bangs nyer lnga grub thob brgya rtsa rig 'dzin 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs rnams snang la rang bzhin bral bar nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang gang zhing rnga yab dag pa'i zhing mchog nas 'ja' 'od gur khang 'khrigs te skad cig gis byon nas bdag dang mos pa'i bu la thugs rje'i byin rlabs sprin gtibs pa ltar sgoms: oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ de nas spyan 'dren pa'i rol mo dbyangs dang bcas: hūm̐: sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la: sogs nas? oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra tsakra badz+ra a be sha ya badz+ra hoḥ slob mas: hūm̐: rig 'dzin rgyal ba dbyings nas gshegs:

nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs: lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal: phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul: sgo gsum dam tshig nyams chag bshags: skyabs mchis 'gro don chos 'khor bskor: mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol: dbang bskur dam pas rjes bzung nas: sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol: ces maṇ+ḍal rgyas par 'bul zhing : de nas dbang bskur ba ni bum pa thogs la dmigs pa 'bog pa ni: phyi bskyed rim sgyu ma'i rnal 'byor las: de yang khyed rang rnams la rje btsun gu ru rin po che dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyi sku'i dbang bskur ba yin te: bum pa 'di nyid phyi ltar na rig 'dzin bde gshegs 'dus pa'i pho brang : nang ltar na bdud rtsi gsang ba ye shes ḍāk+ki dam tshig rdzas la brten pa ste yi dam lha'i ngo bo so sor ma 'gags par shar ba'i rnam pa: bskur bya'i dbang du gyur na 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku 'grub pa'i mos pa mdzod: hūm̐: bum pa rang byung bla med gzhal yas khang : bum chu rigs 'dus rje btsun ngo bo nyid: bde gshegs sgrub pa sku yi lha tshogs kyis: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: des bum pa gzhal yas lha tshogs kyi bskyed rim snang stong zung 'jug bsgom pa la dbang rdo rje theg pa'i go 'phang 'grub pa'i skal ldan byas so: maṇ+ḍal phul bkra shis pa'i me tog 'thor ba byas: de nas bhan+dha gsung gi dbang mgrin par bskur ba ni: de yang khyed rang rnams la rje btsun snang srid zil gnon gyi gsung gi dbang bskur ba yin te: bhan+dha 'di nyid phyi ltar na snod dung khang gi gzhal yas khang : gsang ba ḍāk+ki 'bum gyi tshogs khang gi mtshon: nang ltar na bcud 'byung ba lnga yi dwangs ma ste ngo bo rlung lnga rang bzhin 'byin 'jug gi byed las thugs rje thabs kyis bskul ba'i rang mdangs la shes rab rol pa'i snang ngor sgyu ma mkhan gyis gar bsgyur ba ltar spro bsdu yi rnam par mtshon pa:

bskur bya'i dbang du gyur na gsung bhan+dha'i dbang bskur: grol bya'i dbang du gyur na mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo'i rtsa mdud grol: thob bya'i dbang du gyur na 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'grub pa de ltar du mos pa gyis shig: hūm̐: bhan+dha bde chen snang srid 'byung ba'i snod: snod bcud gsang ba ye shes ḍāk+ki mchog: bde gshegs kun 'dus longs sku'i lha tshogs kyis: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ badz+ra gu ru ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: des bhan+dha chos dbyings yangs pa sngags bzlas brjod thams cad gsung dbyangs ā li kā li drug cu rtsa bzhi'i rang sgras gsang ba ḍāk+ki'i bsnyen rgyud thams cad dgongs pa gcig rdzogs sa lam mngon par rdzogs pa'i skal ldan byas so: maṇ+ḍal bkra shis 'thor nas kyang bya'o: de nas thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbang snying khar bskur ba ni:

de yang khyed rang rnams la rje btsun rgyal ba kun 'dus kyi dbang bskur ba yin te: gsal stong 'od kyi dkyil 'khor 'di nyid phyi ltar na spros bral dri med rjen pa chos nyid mngon sum rnam pa ngos bzung bral ba nang ltar na ka dag zang thal ris med du 'gyu ba lug rgyud mched pa'i rnam pa mi bden bzhin du 'khrul pa rmi lam stong gzugs ngos ma non pa lta bu zhig 'dug pa de'i ngo bor cer gyis lta ba rang byung rang shar rang grol ba ste: phyi ltar dkyil 'khor ngo sprod nang ltar rdzogs rim 'bras bu mngon sum myong ba'i brda du ma'i rten 'brel ste: bskur bya'i dbang du gyur na thugs ye shes sems dpa' yi dbang bskur: grol bya'i dbang du gyur na sems nyid ma pang bu 'jug gi rig pa zhes bya ba chos dbyings kyi klong du bu gya gyur 'phro ba'i ngo bo de rig thog tu rig pa'i rang tsho zin nas snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa mdud grol: 'thob bya'i dbang du gyur na ye shes stong len gyi 'phro 'du byed po rang sems spyang po 'di ga kho na nyid yin pa las: gzhan du ma grub pa thag chod pa'i ngang la the tshom gyi 'ching rgya grol byed yid dpyod thams cad nges par snying po med pa thag chod 'khrul rjes mi 'brangs pa ste dri med 'od gsal la gzhol ba'i 'dun pa mnyam par bzhag: hūm̐: snang zhing gsal la stong zhing 'gag pa med: gsal la nam mkha'i rang bzhin khor yug ltar: chos sku rdzogs chen thugs rje'i lha tshogs kyis: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: des thugs chos sku ye shes sems dpa' de yi zab yangs nam mkha'i dbyings klong khor yug rwa bas bskor ba'i ngang nyid las mi rtog ting nge 'dzin gyi nyi zla kun tu mu mtha' med par gsal ba bzhin: chos sku'i khyon gyis snang srid thams cad mi mkhyen pa med pas ye shes de khyed la rdzogs te yang dag bde chen snying po'i rgyun stsol med du 'grub pa'i 'bras bu byas so:

maṇ+ḍal dang bkra shis tshig bcas 'thor nas bgyis: de nas yon tan gtor ma'i dbang lte bar bskur ba la: de yang khyed rang rnams la rje btsun kun 'dus ma hā gu ru'i yon tan gyi dbang bskur ba yin te: rmad byung rgyan ldan gyi gtor ma 'di nyid: phyi ltar na gtor zhes bya ba snod 'jig rten gyi khams 'di rlung g.yos pas spur te gtor bas me la phog me gtor bas 'jig rten snod kyi chu la phog chu khol bas rba tshub gtor ba kun chu'i ngo bor gyur: de la tshangs pa'i yul nas zhi btul gtor bas spur ba la bskal pa khrag khrig chags pas khor yug tu gyur snod kyi ming btags pa'o: gtor ma ni gtor ba'i rlung lnga la ma byas te bcud thams cad 'dus pa 'bras bu 'khrungs pa ste phyi snod kyi gtor ma'o: nang bcud kyi gtor ma ni: chos sku'i mkha' nas rang rtsal rol pas 'phro ba'am gtor dor ba 'gyed pa bcas rgyu gcig bye brag tsam de la ma byas te dngos po mtshan ma byed las thams cad ma gyur zhing : de mtshan nyid kyi gtor ma grags pa ste: phyi nang ro bcud kyi rtsa ba dngos grub gtor ma zhes bgyid pa na: rmad byung gtor ma bha ling brgyan pa yon tan gtor ma ste: phun tshogs 'dod don kun ldan gyi gtor ma zhes: 'di nyid snyigs mar ru tra'i snying yin pas phyi nang ru tra'i spyi khog sgrub chen gyi dkyil 'khor du 'jug pas tsit+ta zur gsum pa'i dbyibs su 'dod: dper na yon tan chas dbang 'brel ba'o: spyi rgyud ltar 'khor lo yin cing chos 'khor bskor ba'i dbang ste tshig dbang ngo : 'di nyid rmad byung zhes bskur ba'i dbang du gyur na gtor ma yon tan gyi dbang : grol bya'i dbang du gyur na 'ching ba lte ba'i rtsa mdud sprul pa'i 'khor lo shing rta ltar 'khor ba grol: thob bya'i dbang du bya ba thun mong mchog la gzhol bas mchod pa rnam nges kyi 'bras bu gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod:

hūm̐: rmad byung gtor ma bla med mchog gi rdzas: ngo bo 'dod yon mtshan nyid lha rnams kyi: dngos grub kun 'byung bla ma'i yon tan gyis: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: om̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa gu na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: des byin rlabs gtor ma dngos grub 'gugs pa skong bshags 'bung ba rgyun mchod gtong ba las kyi rim par 'jug pa la dbang ba'i skal ldan du byas so: maṇ+ḍal bkra shis tshigs bcad rab gnas gtor: de nas rdo rje dril bu gtad de: de yang khyed rang rnams la rje btsun 'gro ba kun grol khyab bdag pad+ma kā ra'i phrin las kyi dbang bskur ba ste: rdo rje ni thabs dang dril bu ni shes rab ste: phrin las sna tshogs kyi 'byung gnas thabs dang shes rab 'brel ba'i rgyu las byung ba yin te: mi 'gyur rdo rje'i ngo sprod ma 'gags dril bu shes rab kyi sgra ste de la phrin las bzhi'i las mtha' 'dzin pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi phyag rgya 'chang ba'i phyir: bskur bya'i dbang du gyur na thabs shes rdo rje dril bu phrin las kun gyi byed pos dbang bskur: grol bya'i dbang du gyur na nyon mongs brgyad khri bzhi stong de bsdus na dug lnga dug gsum ste: de yi gnyen po chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong de bsdus na gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis: de bsdu na 'dul ba mdo sde mngon pa gsum lung rigs pa gnyis bden pa gnyis don ngo sprod pa bde skyong lug 'byung lug ldog gi gnad grol las kyi mtha' bzang ngan thams cad sdud par nges: thob bya'i dbang du byas na phrin las lnga'i sgo nas bya ba dang byed pa khur bor ba dang : shin tu glang chen ltar brtan pa mi 'jigs pa'i gdeng bzhi: rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa brgyad lung bstan pa'i sde sogs mngon du 'gyur ba'i 'dun pa mdzod: hūm̐: rdo rje rgyal po thabs kyi mgon mchog nyid: shes rab drug ldan yan lag bcu gnyis sogs:

dkyil 'khor chen po'i dam tshig phrin las kyis: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro: oṃ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma ḍāk+ki ha ri ni sa gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: des phrin las kyi dbang thob las kyi rim pa du ma'i sgo nas zhi bas nyon mongs 'dul ba'i gnyen po: rgyas pas bsod nams 'phel ba'i las tshogs: dbang gis tshe bsod srung ba rlung rta dpal dang grags pa sgrub pa sogs dbang gi las tshogs: drag pos bdud dang 'gong po ma rungs pa'i phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i mngon spyod byed pa'i las tshogs te rgyud 'di'i phrin las sogs spyir gang la spyod du rung ba'i skal ldan du byas so: maṇ+ḍal phul zhing bkra shis rab gnas 'thor: de nas chas dbang sbyin pa ni: hoḥ khyod la pad zhwa'i dbang bskur bas snang srid thams cad zil gyis gnon par sgoms: phod kha'i dbang bskur bgyis pas dregs pa thams cad zil gyis gnon par sgoms: chos gos kyi dbang bskur bas theg chen mdzod la dbang bsgyur bar sgoms: ber chen gyis dbang bskur bas srid gsum thams cad dbang du bsdus nas rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i mchog tu gyur par sgoms: rin chen rgyan cha'i dbang bskur bas 'dod yon lnga'i gter la spyod par sgoms: sku reg gis dbang bskur bas thabs shes zung 'jug mkha' 'gro'i rtags su sgoms: rgya lham gyi dbang bskur bas bdud dang dam sri kun gyi mgo bor non par sgoms: hūm̐: pad zhwa phod kha chos gos ber chen dang : rin chen rgyan mdzes sku reg rgya lham sogs: sku'i chas gos du ma'i dbang bskur bas: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i sras su mnga' sgyur cig: oṃ sarba bhi shwa bha tra swā hā: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: phyag mtshan rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas sku lnga ye shes kyi don dang ldan par sgoms: bhan+dha tshe bum gyi dbang bskur bas chos dbyings skye ba med pa'i don rtogs shing 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku thob par sgoms shig:

kha ṭ+wāṃ gyi dbang bskur bas dug lnga rtsad nas bcad de dug gsum sku gsum gyi 'bras bu mngon du gyur par sgoms: hūm̐: rdo rje rtse lnga bhan+dha tshe bum dang : kha ṭ+wāṃ g.yer kha thod pa gsum gyis mtshan: sku yi rgya rtags las kyi phyag mtshan gyi: dbang bskur rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' thob shog: oṃ badz+ra dharma ko3 haṃ dz+nyā na swā hā: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rigs bdag rdor 'chang thogs la: deng 'dir khyed rang rnams la rigs kyi bdag po'i dbang bskur bas rigs rnams kun gyi gtso bor dbang bar sgoms: hūm̐: drug pa'i bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang : yum mchog snyems ma zung 'jug 'khril: thabs shes dbyer med dbang bskur bas: rgyud sde'i gtso bo bdag gyur cig: oṃ badz+ra dha ra pradz+nyā swā hā: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sku gnas lnga'i thod phreng sde lnga thogs la: khyed rang rnams la gu ru thod phreng sde lnga'i dbang bskur bas dug lnga gnas su dag sku lnga'i 'gro don mdzad de ye shes lnga mngon du gyur par sgoms: hūm̐: bud+dha badz+ra rat+na trām̐: pad+ma karma la sogs pa: bla ma thod phreng sde lnga yi: dbang bskur ye shes don ldan shog: oṃ badz+ra kā ya pañtsa dz+nyā na shrī swā hā: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rta mgrin 'jam dpal rigs gsum bcas thogs la: hoḥ khyed rang rnams la dbang chen rta mgrin dang : 'jam dpal dbyangs spyan ras gzigs phyag na rdo rje rnam bzhi'i dbang bskur bas rta mgrin ye shes rol pas yi dam kun 'dus 'grub: 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis shes rab mtha' dag dang rig pa gnas lnga'i rtsa kha 'byed: spyan ras gzigs kyis snying po bla na med pa'i go 'phang thob: phyag na rdo rjes bdud dang dam sri 'byung po 'dre rgod ma rungs pa tshar bcad pa'i nus pa dang ldan par sgoms: hūm̐: rta mchog khro rgyal 'jam dpal dpa' bo'i sku: spyan ras gzigs dbang gsang bdag gtum po sogs: go cha 'jig rten gsum mgon dbang bskur bas:

lta ba shes rab snying po'i mthu ldan shog: oṃ badz+ra pradz+nyā ma hā bha lo ka ru ṇa swā hā: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: gu ru mtshan brgyad thogs la: gu ru mtshan brgyad kyi dbang bskur bas shes brgyad gnas su dag lam brgyad mtha' ru phyin mngon shes drug dang bden gnyis mngon du gyur: rjes dran drug dang thabs shes gnyis kyi bden pa thob: dur khrod brgyad dang gnas brgyad kyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyis rtag tu skyong : he ru ka brgyad kyi dbang rtags thon par sgoms shig: hūm̐: pad+ma 'byung gnas pad+ma sam+bha wa: blo ldan mchog sred pad+ma rgyal po sogs: lhun grub rig 'dzin bzhi yi dbang bskur bas: lam bzhi grol nas rgyud bzhi smin par shog: oṃ gu ru dhe wa tsa tur hūm̐ swā hā: oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: hūm̐: nyi ma 'od zer shākya seṅge dang : seṅge sgra sgrogs rdo rje gro bo lod: mu stegs tshar gcod bzhi yi dbang bskur bas: phrin nas rnam bzhis 'gro ba 'dul bar shog: oṃ badz+ra he ru ka sarba hūm̐ swā hā: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: dpa' bo yab yum dang ging yab yum thogs la: dpa' bo yab yum gyi dbang bskur bas yul brgyad rtog pa bcom dur khrod brgyad kyi dpa' bo rig 'dzin thams cad dbang du bsdus te he ru ka yab yum brgyad kyi dgongs pa mngon du gyur par mos: ging chen yab yum brgyad kyi dbang bskur bas: rngam pa'i brjid dang rol pa'i gar sgyur ba gtum pa'i gyad dang gshe ba'i shugs la sogs: rtsal bcu nus pa brgyad sogs dbang bar sgoms shig: hūm̐: rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las kyi rigs: dpa' bo dpa' mo ging chen yab yum bcas: he ru ka yi gnas bcu byin brlabs pa'i: dbang bskur yon tan bcu drug la gnas shog: oṃ tshin+dha tshin+dha ghṛ wa ghṛ wa hūm̐ swā hā: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: lha mo bcu drug thogs la: gsang ba'i lha mo bcu drug gi dbang bskur bas phyi yi snang ba dbang du 'dus shing dbang bsgyur nang gi stong nyid bcu drug gnad du phyin gsang ba'i thig le bcu drug brtan par chags shing rtsa rlung pho nya bcu drug gi ljon shing bskyed 'ja' lus rdo rje'i gsang lam la dbang bar bsgom mo:

hūm̐: bzhi gnyis rnam shes tshogs brgyad bcu drug khams: g.yo ba rtsa gnyis yang g.yo drug cu bzhi: mchod 'dzin lha mo rnams kyi dbang bskur bas: gsung dbyangs drug cus 'gro ba sgrol bar shog: oṃ badz+ra ḍāk+ki sarba ud ta rā ga he hūm̐ swā hā: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: dbang phyug zhing skyong laṅka thogs la: hoḥ dbang phyug zhing skyong laṅka gnas nyul rnams kyi dbang bskur bas dbang phyug yan lag bdun ldan 'phags pa'i nor dang bcas te rdzu 'phrul la mnga' ba'i dbang mo bran du bgyis te zhing khams skyong zhing dbang bskur bas phyogs bcu'i bstan pa skyong : laṅka'i dbang bskur bas gdong dmar srin po thabs kyis 'dul he ru ka la nges: gnas nyul lam sgo skyong ngam mu ran skyong ba'i dbang thob pas phyi nang sgrub pa'i bar chad bsal zhing phyi yi bar chad nang du mi btang nang gi dngos grub phyi la mi skyel sgom dang rtogs pa che chung gi ru shan phye ba'i dus nyul ma'i rnal 'byor gyi drod tshad nyul ba ste lta ba'i grogs byed rtogs pa'i bogs 'don sgrub pa'i gegs sel bar sgoms shig: hūm̐: dbang phyug ma mau zhing skyong laṅka gdong : gnas nyul tshogs khang 'grims nas drod tshad nyul: dkyil 'khor gnyan po'i las byed dbang bskur bas: skal ldan sgrub pa'i bar chad zhi bar shog: oṃ badz+ra iṣ+ṭa dwa ra bha la hūm̐ swā hā: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas zhi ba yongs rdzogs kyi rgyan spyod thogs la: deng 'dir khyed rang rnams la chas dbang lus la brgyan pa yin te: rigs lnga'i dbang gis sku lnga lhun grub cod pan gyi dbang gis ye shes pa'i rgya rtags 'dzin: stod g.yogs kyi dbang gis sa bcu'i go 'phang thob: ang rag gi dbang gis sa lam thogs med bgrod: ga shal dbang gis gsang sngags nye lam ldan: rin chen phreng ba dang rgyan gyis 'dod rgu gter la longs spyod: pad+ma'i phreng bas skyon gyis ma gos pa'i yon tan ldan:

de ltar zhi ba'i lha rdzas yongs rdzogs dbang bskur bas: thugs rje'i rang rtsal gyi dbang thob par sgoms shig: hūm̐: rigs lnga dar dpyangs stod g.yogs ga shal dang : ang rag rin chen rgyan cha pad+ma'i phreng : zhi ba'i lha rdzas yongs rdzogs dbang bskur bas: zhing khams lta bur mkho dgu longs spyod shog: oṃ sarba mu ṭa ku su me ku su ma ṇi hūm̐ swā hā: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas sku gsum ngo sprad kyi tshig dbang mtshon bya dmigs rten byed po rnam bshad bcas la: thog mar gzugs snang stong lha sku'i 'gying logs sgyu ma'i ngo sprod las: 'ja' tshon 'od sku yang rung : hoḥ khyed rang rnams la gzugs snang stong gi dbang ngo sprad pa yin te: dper na me long 'gying logs kyi 'od nam mkha'i dbyings nas tshangs pa'i gzhu chen shar ba bzhin du snang zhing stong pa'i gzugs su snang rung sprul pa sgyu ma rmi lam zla gzugs sgyu ma ste thams cad snang stong gi rang bzhin la gzugs kyi sgro btags pa tsam mo: 'di yi dbang thob pas ma dag sgyu lus kyi srid pa chod de dag pa ye shes kyi lha skur gyur nas zhing khams bgrod par 'gyur ro: hūm̐: snang ba bden med nam mkha' bzhin: sna tshogs cho 'phrul rang sar te: nam mkha'i dbyings kyi 'ja' tshon bzhin: sprul pa sgyu ma ltar bstan no: oṃ swa bhā ko'u ta paṃ swā hā: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐:

de nas rol mo'i rigs gang rung zhig snang rung sgra dang bcas la: hoḥ grags shing stong pa rlung dang brag cha'i sgra 'thabs pa'am pi wang gi gling bu lag pa'i rta la bskyon pa bzhin ci phyir stong pa'i rang sgra rlung gyen rgyu mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo ru rang bzhin gyi sgra bsdebs dang khyad par 'byung ba tsha grang 'thabs te gnam sa 'khrig par sbyor ba'i sgra sgrog pa bzhin du bzang ngan gyi rnam rtog ma zhugs pa'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag pa'o: hūm̐: rang byung 'byung ba rlung gi shugs: rol pa'i rtsal gyi cho 'phrul las: stong sgra sgrog pa sgra bcag ltar: rtag dpyad gzhig bral mnyam par zhog: oṃ badz+ra shab+da sa ha k+ṣaṃ swā hā: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas me long la sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor bkod pa hūm̐ yig gi tsakra thogs la: hoḥ gzhi mi shigs kun bzang skye ba med pa'i klong na rang byung gi sgra las a a āḥ hūm̐ zhes pa de la rig dang ma rig pa'i rlung gnyis g.yos pas rig pa'i rlung la ye shes lnga: ma rig pa la nyon mongs pa lngar gyur pa las: rig pa'i ye shes lnga yi ngo bo la ye thog gi sangs rgyas lnga yi gzhi smin ma rig pa'i rlung lnga'i ngo bo rigs drug gi gzhi grub: rig dang ma rig pa'i cho 'phrul sna tshogs ci rigs kyi 'char sgo gzugs te snang ba ngan goms la shor bas a 'thas kyi rtog pa 'ba' zhig tu gyur pa de nyid dper na rig pa'i ngo bo skye med kyi ā yi rang mdangs ltar mi rtog ye shes stong gsal 'dzin med ngang la mnyam par bzhag: ā stong gsal 'dzin med chos kyi sku: mi rtog ye shes ngo bo hūm̐: zhabs kyu ha khog mgo sked zla tshes dang : thig le nā da ka dag skye med āḥ oṃ dharma hūm̐ a āḥswā hā: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas srog gi yi ge hūm̐ de las rang 'khor spro bsdu'i bzlas lung sbyin pa ni: phreng ba thogs la: hoḥ phreng ba 'di nyid skyon bral yon tan rdzogs pa pad+ma'i phreng ba ste sngags phreng ba'i rnam pa:

'od zer phreng thag gi rnam pa: bzlas pa bgyis pa'i tshe bung ba rtsi'i bcud la ro myong ba lta bur rang sngags rang sgra sgrog cing spro bsdu phrin las bzhi'i bya ba lhun grub kyi ngo bo nges shes la mnyam par bzhag: hūm̐: bla med sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa: snying po 'dzab dbyangs sgrog pa'i phyir: bzlas pa rdo rje'i phreng ba gtad: dri med pad+ma lug gur rgyud: om̐ badz+ra ma li ta sarba swā hā: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: tshe yi dbang bskur ba ni: hoḥ khyed rang rnams la bum pa'i dbang bskur bas: deng phyin chad 'chi med bsgrub pa la dbang zhing tshe yi rig 'dzin thob par sgoms: hūm̐ hrīḥ snang mtha'i dbang phyug rje btsun pad+ma 'byung : tshe 'dzin lha mo mgyogs ma sgo bzhis bskor: snang srid 'byung lnga nyi zla tshe bcud bcas: bsdus nas skal ldan slob ma'i lus la stims: oṃ ā yur+dz+nyā na swā hā: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas chos kyi dbang bskur ba ni: po ti gtad la: hoḥ khyed rang rnams la po ti glegs bam gyi dbang bskur bas yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po de nyid kyis mchod rten rnam dag chu bo gaṅgā wā rā ṇā si bya rgod phung ri yang pa can rdo rje gdan ma ga dha sogs rnams la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bas rdzogs sangs rgyas pa dang phyag na rdo rjes lung bstan rgyal po dzā la gsang sngags kyi bka' bab pa ltar chos kyi bka' 'bog pa'o: hūm̐: yang dag sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das: chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong rnams: lha dang mi dang lha ma yin: chos bstan de bzhin khyod la gtad: om̐ dharma mi kha te swā hā: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas snyan grags kyi dung dkar gtad la: hoḥ khyed rang rnams la dung dkar gyi dbang bgyis pas lha yi dbang pos sangs rgyas la dung dkar phul bas snyan pa'i ba dan dkar po phyogs bcur bsgrengs pa'i rtse mo gsang sngags kyi chos thams cad brgyan te snga 'gyur rdo rje theg chen gyi bsnyen pa'i chos sgra 'brug ltar sgrogs pa bzhin du khyod kyis bka' yi 'chad po dpag tu med pa gnang ba sbyin pa yin no:

hūm̐: dga' ldan lha las babs pa'i theg chen sgra: dam pas srol gtod mdzad pa snyan pa'i dung : chos kyi rnga chen sgrog par bskul ba pos: de ring skal ldan khyod la bskor bar bskur: oṃ badz+ra dharma shaṃ kha la swā hā: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas rin po che'i 'khor lo gtad la: hoḥ de ring khyed rang rnams la gser gyi 'khor lo'i dbang bskur bas tshangs pas gser gyi 'khor lo maṇ+ḍal phul bas rtsibs stong chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong mu khyud thog pa'i go rim bam po'i cha sogs grangs med rin chen phra bkod pa ltar sgrub sngags kyi theg pa'i yang zhun ltar gyur pa bzhin du deng 'dir khyod la che ba'i yon tan gyis dpal la spyod phyir sbyin par bya'o: oṃ: rin chen las grub gser gyi 'khor lo ni: rtsibs stong mu khyud khor yug bsgribs nas su: mdo sngags sgron me sbar ba'i ched du sbyin: dam pa'i yon tan lhun gyis grub par shog: oṃ swa na tsakra sa le sbraṃ swā hā: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas nor bu rin po che gtad la: hoḥ khyed rang rnams la nor bu'i dbang bskur ba ni: klu'i rgyal pos nor bu phul bas chos thams cad yid bzhin gyi nor bu ltar gang gis mchod gnas bgyis kyang de la dngos grub de ltar 'byin pa bzhin du chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong byang sems thig le nyag gcig ltar dngos grub thams cad gcig la 'dus pa'i gnad gnang ba'o: hūm̐: yid bzhin nor bu lhun grub 'od rab 'byin: dgos 'dod kun 'byung bla med rdzogs pa che: zab lam snyan brgyud nges don sa kun rdzogs: rin chen lag bcang lta bu khyod la sbyin: oṃ ma ṇi rat+na trām̐ swā hā: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rin chen gzhong pa gtad la: hoḥ khyed rang rnams la rin po che'i gzhong pa'i dbang bskur bas gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po rin po che sna tshogs kyis bkang ba'i gzhong pa bse ru spyi bo'i gtsug rgyan nor bu me shel me yi snying po chu shel chu yi snying po thabs rgyal po'i rna cha shes rab btsun mo'i rna cha zung 'jug blon po'i rna cha rgyal po'i bla rten glang chen mche ba btsun mo'i bla rten byi ru dbang gi rgyal mo:

blon po la mu tig sna lnga'i phreng ba bcas maṇ+ḍal phul bas chos thams cad 'dzam gling gi mdzod kha phye ba ltar gang la gang 'dul der ston pas spyod yul du gyur pa bzhin du de ring gling bzhi rgyal po'i mdzod gtad pa'o: hūm̐: rgyal po lta bur thabs kyi chos rnams ni: blon po lta bur phra zhib nyams su myong : shes rab btsun mo yon tan rgyan gyis phyug: phyi nang gsang gsum deng 'dir khyod la sbyin: oṃ sarba badz+ra prañdza hūm̐ swā hā: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas bkra shis rdzas rtags lag tu sprad nas: hoḥ khyed rang rnams la bkra shis pa'i rdzas rtags brgyad rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun gyi dbang bskur ba la rgyal srid ni chos skyong ba'i rgyal pos srid spel bar: btsun mos rigs rgyud spel: 'khor los kha lo bsgyur: blon pos blo gros ster: nor bus dgos 'dod 'byung : glang pos rtsal che: rta mchog bang mgyogs: sgo srung zhing phyogs las rgyal ba dmag dpon bcas: bkra shis pa'i rdzas dbu la bkra shis gser gdugs spyan la gser nya snyan la dung dkar ljags la pad+ma mgul la bum pa thugs la dpal be'u spyi bor mi nub rgyal mtshan lag la chos kyi 'khor lo bkra shis pa'i chas thams cad phul nas gsang sngags rlabs po che dbang khrid zhu bar byed pa maṇ+ḍal gyi gnang ba gtad pas deng phyin chod maṇ+ḍal phun sum tshogs pa 'bul bar bgyi: hūm̐: rgyal srid sna bdun dgos 'dod yid bzhin mdzod: bkra shis rtags brgyad mthar thug dge ba'i rdzas: de ring skal ldan khyod la sbyin pa yi: rdo rje slob dpon rtag tu bsnyen bskur bgyid: oṃ rat+na maṇ+ḍal maṅga laṃ shrī ye swā hā: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes pas dbang gi gzhung khrid: de nas rtag tu nya stong dus bzhi sogs mchod pa nar ma'i lung 'bog pa ni: de nas phyi mchod gtad la: hūm̐: me tog bdug spos mar me dri: zhal zas rol mo dbyangs len sogs:

dkyil 'khor phyi yi mchod pa 'di: de ring skal ldan khyod la gtad: oṃ badz+ra pū dza me gha s+pha rā sa ma ye swā hā: gsang mchod gtad la: hūm̐: gzugs mdzes sgra snyan dri dang ni: ro mchog reg bya bye brag rnams: dgyes pa bcu drug lha mo'i gar: de ring skal ldan khyod la gtad: oṃ bhi shwa mi tra swā hā: de nas sbyor mchod gtad la: hūm̐ lnga ldan thabs kyi rdo rje dang : shes rab yum gyi pad+mo'i mkha': zag med bde bas dgyes pa nyid: de ring skal ldan khyod la gtad: oṃ badz+ra pad+ma pañtsa ti ri hūm̐: de nas phyag rgya'i mchod pa gtad la: hūm̐: ang grol lus kyi phyag rgya'i gar: bā+ai ta chos kyi phyag rgya'i rgyan: bhan+dha dam tshig phyag rgya 'chang : de ring skal ldan khyod la gtad: oṃ ma hā mu tra rā ga he sha hūm̐: kho na nyid kyi mchod pa gtad la: hūm̐: he ru ka yi nyams gyur las: mnyam bzhag dgongs pa sa gnon can: bskyed rdzogs zung 'brel gsal stong ngang : de ring skal ldan khyod la gtad: oṃ badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: de nas sman mchod thogs la: hūm̐: bla med mchog gi rdzas la brten: rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar 'd-i: dug lnga sel ba'i ye shes sman: de ring skal ldan khyod la sbyin: oṃ a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐: de nas gtor ma thogs la: hūm̐: phyi snod 'jig rten gtor gzhong du: nang bcud skye 'gro gtor mar bsgyur: 'bru bcud sna tshogs gtor ma'i rdzas: de ring skal ldan khyod la gtad: oṃ āḥhūm̐ bha ling+ta swā hā: de nas rak+ta thogs la: hūm̐: skye med rnam dag mkha' lam nas: ra sa me gha rak+ta mo: rgyud 'byung ngad ldan dmar chen 'di: de ring skal ldan khyod la sbyin: oṃ āḥhūm̐ rak+ta pū dza hoḥ de nas bsgral mchod thogs la: hūm̐: dug lnga dbyings la rab bsgral bas: dbang po rnam lnga dgyes pa'i phud: gnyis 'dzin ru tra'i bsgral mchod 'di: de ring skal ldan khyod la gtad: oṃ ma hā māṃ sa tsit+ta go ro tsa na ba su ta oṃ āḥhūm̐:

de nas tshogs mchod gtad la: hūm̐: bsod nams rgyu las legs byung ba: sna tshogs bzang ngan gtsang sme bral: mnyam pa nyid kyi mchod pa 'di: de ring skal ldan khyod la gtad: oṃ ga ṇa tsakra sa ma ye swā hā: de nas dza gad gser skyems tshogs chang gtad la: hūm̐: bla med nang gi mchod pa'i tshogs: zag med bde bas dgyes pa 'di: dngos grub rtsa ba bla na med: de ring skal ldan khyod la gtad: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrī ṭhaḥ de nas bskang rdzas spyan gzigs gtad la: hūm̐: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mnyes byed pa: phyi nang nyams chag bskang ba dang : nyes ltung bshags pa'i khrigs sdeb sogs: de ring skal ldan khyod la gtad: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya su ra hūm̐: de nas mu ran skyong ba'i lhag ma ni: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor gnyan po'i mtha' nas 'gyu: rnal 'byor stangs 'byed drod tshad nyul: de la lhag ma sbyin pa'i phyir: de ring skal ldan khyod la gtad: oṃ ma tri mu ṣa ye swā hā: de nas chad mdo sbyin pa ni: hūm̐: sngon tshe dkyil 'khor gnyan po 'di: ci ltar bka' bzhin tha tshig skyong : gter srung mchod pa'i gtor ma 'di: de ring skal ldan khyod la gtad: oṃ ni dhi pā la swā hā: hūm̐ dzaḥ de nas bstan skyong gtad pa ni: hūm̐: rten 'brel bcu gnyis dus bdag ma: bod khams skyong phyir brtan ma sman: de dag dgyes par mchod pa'i rdzas: de ring skal ldan khyod la gtad: oṃ ma tri ma ma le le hūm̐ dzaḥ de nas bka' srung gtad la: hūm̐: bstan pa'i las mdzad phyag bzhi pa: mgon chen sde lnga bya rog gdong : zhing skyong legs ldan seṅge'i gdong : gza' mchog btsan rgod me 'od gdong : tshangs pa dge bsnyen ging ka ra: klu rgyal dge bsnyen chen po bcas: ma gcig las kyi mkha' 'gro dang : gter srung mchims phu'i brag btsan sogs: bka' yi tha tshig gnyer ba yi: dkyil 'khor 'di yi bya ra mdzod: dam chos 'di yi bstan pa skyongs: slob bu 'di yi rogs dan sgrubs:

rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i gdung rgyud skyongs: dam nyams log lta bdud kyi rigs: skal med lag tu ma shor bar: rgya 'di srung ba'i mel tshe ru: de ring slob bur bka' gtad pas: rtag tu dus mchod brtson pa yi: phrin las sgrub pa'i sdongs grogs mdzod: oṃ dharma pā la ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ swā hā: de nas dkyil 'khor gtad pa ni: gzung thag slob ma'i lag tu sprad: rig ma dngos su yod na rig ma'i phyag brgyud nas dam tshig sbrel te gtad: hūm̐: bla med dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa'i phyir: rdo rje dbyings kyi lha tshogs rnams: maṇ+ḍal gcig tu bsdus nas kyang : dam tshig bum pa gang byos bzhin: de ring slob bu 'di la sbyin: deng nas brtsam ste bu khyod kyis: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i tshab yin pas: 'dzin 'chang spel dang skyong ba dang : sgrub brtson gzhan phan bla med bgyis: ma 'ongs o rgyan dag pa'i zhing : mkha' spyod dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i gral: nges par tshogs pa lung bstan pas: ting 'dzin thang lhod med pa yi: nyams len snying po skyong ba dang : dkyil 'khor 'di yi dam tshig ni: srog la babs kyang mi btang bzung : ci ste nyams shing 'gal gyur na: na rag myong bar gdon mi za: de bas dkyil 'khor mig ltar zungs: oṃ sa ma ya i dan+te tsit+ta dha ra hūm̐ swā hā: zhes dkyil 'khor la phyag 'tshal slob dpon gyi zhabs spyi bor len cing rig ma'i phyag mgor bzhag la ma 'ongs pa ru dmigs te smon lam bzang pos mtshams sbyar: dkyir 'khor zab mo 'di snying nas chos byed ma gtogs par mi sbyin: gar thod sa ru mi bkram: khyad par rjes gnang tsam khol phyung bya ba las: gzhung gi mchod rim khyad par bka' srung ni: rigs kyi sras la'ang gcig brgyud ma gtogs mi sbyin: 'di yang nang nas gdams pa bzhi skor: gsang dbang bde chen dpa' mo nye lam mkha' 'gro'i gcig brgyud zur du yod pa 'di: chos 'di byang chub phyi nang gi sgrub pa mthar ma phyin par mi bskur:

phyogs su gshegs kha yin nges par bskur dgos byung kyang dbang rten gyi rig ma med na mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad 'byung bas shin tu bka' gdams pa'o: khyad par skyon can gyi slob ma g.yo rgyu can: dam nyams chos rkun mkhan gyis gzhan la tshong zog byed pa: gzhan gyi yon tan rang gi 'phrag la ma shong nas ngom pa'i rigs: gdams ngag bu ltar phog pa gsang zhing rang mthong 'brug sgra ltar mi grags pa: de la gdams par gyis shig: sa ma ya: deng 'dir bla ma'i thugs rjes sgrub pa nyams su len nas lhag pa'i lhar sgom snyam pas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos gyis: gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa che: dam pas bka' ni legs bstsal pa: dam tshig mi g.yel srog ltar bsrung : deng nas nyid kyi bran du mchis: rje yi slob mar bzung nas su: rgya cher spyod la skyong du gsol:

ces sku drin gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal bzang po 'bul: bkra shis ni: hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa'i: rje btsun pad+ma badz+ra zhes: bde chen yum mchog man+da ra: pad 'byung yab yum bkra shis shog: tsan dan nags la spyod par gshegs: stag zhon rdo rje gro bo lod: bkra shis khye'u 'dren mtshan ldan lcam: drag po yab yum bkra shis shog: mchims phur bde gshegs sgrub pa mdzad: grub thob rgyal po zil gnon zhabs: zung 'jug dbyings phyug mtsho rgyal ma: rig 'dzin yab yum bkra shis shog: zab rgya'i gnas mchog gter gyi sgrom: mchims phu brag dmar ke'u tshang : dregs sde srung mas bya ra mdzod: chos skyong gter srung bkra shis shog: ces pas rab tu gnas mthar: hoḥ de yang khyed rang rnams la 'dir bla ma rtsa gsum bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'i bde gshegs kun 'dus thugs kyi sgrub pa: 'di nyid la sgrub pa rnam pa gsum ste: tshe sgrub thugs sgrub drag po'i sgrub pa: rtsa ba gsum yin te: bla ma pad+ma 'byung gnas: yi dam dbang chen rta mgrin: mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes: 'di rigs gsum yin te: sku 'jam dpal dbyangs: gsung spyan ras gzigs: thugs phyag na rdo rje ste mdo dang sngags kyi dkyil 'khor kun tshang ba yin: de yi brda don rgyud sde chen po'i rnam bshad rgyas pa thams cad na gsal lo: 'di yi dam tshig mdo ltar bsrung ba'i skabs su: ma byin pa ni len mi bya: de bzhin 'phrog dang rkus pa dang : thabs kyis bslus nas blang mi bya: mi gtsang pa ni mi spyod do: sku gsung thugs kyi dam mi nyams: dam nyams grogs la 'grogs mi bya: gnas khang nyams grib byi mo spang : nyams can zas gos 'bag mi bya: rdzun du smra bar mi bya zhing : dge 'dun mthun gnyis phye ba dang : sangs rgyas bstan pa'i sel byed dang : 'khrug sdeb gzhi bzhag la sogs pa: zob por 'gro ba'i rdzun mi bya: srog ni bcad par mi bya zhing :

de bzhin pham par gyur pa ni: lto gos gtan du re ba yis: sgo nor pha ma'i srog mi bcad: sgyu lus g.yar khang gnyer ba yi: lus kyi pha ma srog mi bcad: tshe gcig sangs rgyas ster ba yi: rdo rje slob dpon srog mi bcad: gnas skabs grogs su bca' ba yi: bran 'khor chung ma'i srog mi bcad: don med rnams ni lta ci smos: de bzhin mtshon gyis btab pa dang : dug dang gzhan mthu bskul ba dang : bsam sbyor tshig gis bskul ba sogs: rang gzhan kun nas las de spang : de bzhin sangs rgyas sku la ni: ngan sems khrag ni byug mi bya: sangs rgyas rnams ni smos ci bya: chos spang las ni yongs su spang : dge 'dun pa ni dkrugs mi bya: bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos: de bzhin bla ma rdo rje 'chang : gzugs sku bsod nams tshogs las grub: don dam dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings: de bzhin sum ldan bla ma yi: sku yi grib ma 'gom mi bya: sku gsung thugs rten 'bum 'gyur gyi: gtsug lag gnyan po bcom pa dang : bla ma'i thugs sems dkrugs pa sogs: ltung ba phog pa'i las mi bya: de bzhin mi dge bcu po dang : mtshams med mnar ba'i las sogs spang : rtogs pa mngon du ma gyur pa'i: thog mar dkyil 'khor zhugs pa tsam: kha bsags rang rgyud ma dul ba'i: rtog ge ba yi nyan thos rnams: nam zla dpyid kha'i ljang bu 'dra: lam 'jug de yis 'joms par 'gyur: rdzogs chen bla med lam zhugs nas: 'bras bu theg chen rtogs pa yi: spyod pa lam khyer rnal 'byor pa: bzang ngan thog rdzis byed pa'i tshe: nyan thos pa yi lam zhugs spang : rang bcing nyon mongs zhags pa bcad: de yi lam khyer 'di lta ste: ma byin pa ni len par bya: dge ba bzang po thabs kyis bskul: shugs la byung ba dngos grub yin: blos thong gzhan gyi phul ba de: ma byin bar du yang yang bslang : de la bsngo ba rgyas 'debs bya: chu yis sa khyer lta bu ste: gtsang po'i bye ma ded pa bzhin:

ma byin blangs kyang nyes pa med: kun rdzob rdzun ni gang la smra: dper na dge ba'i bskul ma las: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis: dmyal ba zhing khams bstan pa dang : blo yi dpag pa'i tshad bzung dang : kun rdzob chos brgyad brgyad khri bzhir: sems can khrid pa'i lam du zad: drang don rdzun gyi phung po yin: nges don dbang po gtan du med: chu bur mig gis ga la mthong : brag dang rlung sgra 'thab pa bzhin: bden rdzun gnyis kyi ngo bo stong : rdzun du smras kyang nyes pa med: mi gtsang pa ni spyod par byed: gnas ngan dur khrod phung shul nyul: bdud dang 'dre la dam tshig bsre: mdze sme yugs sa grogs su bsten: zas su ro za ro gos gyon: gtam du gang shar nges med smra: skyid sdug bral ba'i gcer bu 'gro: ngo tsha bral ba'i smyo spyod bya: gzhan gyi bud med spyod par bya: srod la dud 'gro'i rnam 'gyur ston: nam mkha'i chu sprin rlung g.yer bzhin: bzang ngan yul med rjes med la: mi gtsang spyod kyang nyes pa med: snying rjes bsad pa'i dam tshig las: sems can nyon mongs dug lngar gyur: gti mug phag dang 'dra ba de: bsgral nas rnam shes chos skur bsgyur: zhai sdang sbrul dang 'dra ba bsgral: las ngan bshig pas lus ngan bral: 'dod chags bya dang 'dra ba de: sor rtog rim gnyis dag gis bsgral: chags pa bral nas chags med yin: gang zhig lan chags bsnyags pa yi: pha ma phru gu thams cad bsad: 'khor ba chod pa'i smon lam bgyi: gang phyir bdud las sdig to can: sems can yongs la gnod pa yi: las ngan gzhi bzhag de nyid bsgral: khams gsum stong ba'i smon lam btab: de bzhin bsgral ba'i zhing bcu rnams: rlung gis shing bcag lta bu ste: srog bcad bya la nyes pa med: sangs rgyas sku la smad pa ste: kun tu bzang po nam mkha'i thugs: khu rlangs gtibs bzhin sdug mi bsngal: nyi zla gsal kyang nyams mi dga': bzang dang ngan gnyis ngo bo mnyam:

nam mkha'i stong pa had po la: tshogs drug snang ba med pa'i phyir: ro dud sprin ltar gtibs pa dang : spos dud dri bsung chags pa gnyis: yang dag don la ngo bo mnyam: dus gsum sangs rgyas mdun du ni: gser gyi phung po spungs pa dang : dug gi yon chab gtams pa gnyis: chags pa med pa ngo bo mnyam: rnam rtog 'dzin pa grol ba la: ro ras nag pos dkri ba dang : le brgan dar dkar g.yogs pa gnyis: nges pa'i don la ngo bo mnyam: gtsug lag khang dang sku gsung rten: bshig dang brtsegs la dga' sdug med: rang gis bsod nams bsags pa tsam: don la bden par ma grub pas: sangs rgyas bstod dang smad pa mnyam: tshogs drug sgo khyud 'dan na gsal: rnam rtog brtsegs pa bshig na brling : 'khrul pa'i pha ma bsad na dge: ngan goms chung ma bye na mthun: ser sna'i sgo nor zad na phyug: ngar 'dzin rabs chad bu rgyud 'phen: spang blang zad na srung sdom bde: de phyir bsrung pa'i dam tshig lnga: bsrungs du med pa'i dam tshig lnga: mdo dang sngags kyi dam tshig gam: bskyed dang rdzogs pa gnyis kyi don: bskyed pa mngon sum snang ba'i ngog: rdzogs pa 'ja' tshon lag myong ltar: de bzhin dam pa 'di rnams kyang : gang zag rab 'bring tha ma gsum: rab ni chos sku'i rang bzhin grol: 'bring ni dam chos rim 'jug grol: tha mas bzang ngan cir mi rtogs: nyan thos theg par 'jug pa rnams: rdza yi be'u bum chag pa bzhin: slar las gso ba ma mchis pa'i: mtshams med rgyu bsags spang bar gyis: gsang sngags gser dngul snod zhum kyang : slar yang rang sar bzo bas legs: bsrung du med pa'i dam tshig lnga: lam khyer gnas lugs gzhi la phob: de ltar 'bras bu phyi na lci: so sor nyams len sor gnas bzhin: nges par gdams pa e ma hoḥ de yang dbang chen thugs kyi sgrub pa'i bca' bzhi 'khyer so lag len brda sprod bcas grub pa yin te phyin chod kyang de ltar nyams su len par bgyis:

sa ma ya: gter gyi rgya 'dzin nag po che: legs ldan mthing nag phyag bzhi pa: zhing skyong khyab 'jug dmar 'od 'byung : me 'od gdong can chos rgyal che: ma gcig dbyings phyug klu yi rgyal: khyad par mchims phu brag btsan sogs: rje btsun chen pos gnyer gtad pa'i: bka' yi srung ma tha tshig can: dkyil 'khor skyong ba'i mel tshe mdzod: bstan pa mi nub a thaṃ rgya: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: them rgya: kho bo rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos sa khyi lor bsam yas mchims phu dge'u gong nas gdan drangs shing*/ mdo khams zangs gling rngam pa 'od ldan gyi nye 'dabs gze rgyal dung ri 'ja' 'od 'khyil ba'i gling klu ljongs skyed mo'i tshal gyi yar 'khyil spang ljongs me tog 'khrungs pa'i ri sul nang chen sa bdag rgyal po'i ur 'gos su lcags mo phag gi lor shog ser nas zhal bshus pas yar rgyas tshes la gza' skar dge ba'i nyin mo ḍāk+ki'i tshogs mang po dang bcas grub pa'o// maṅga laṃ// // ra) ༄༅/ bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: bum dbang ye shes 'od kyi drwa ba bzhugs pa'i dbu phyogs lags so: rtsa gsum kun 'dus tshom bu'i lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: de yang tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor bsam pa lhun grub kyi bum dbang bgyis pa la: thog mar bum pa bca' gzhi gzhung ltar grub nas: slob ma rnams la khrus bstsal: gral du 'khod nas maṇ+ḍal dang bcas te: kyaiḥ bde gshegs gtso bo bla ma rje: deng 'dir bka' 'dus dkyil 'khor du: bdag cag skal ldan 'jug pa'i phyir: rdo rje rgyal po'i gnang ba stsol: slob dpon gyis: hoḥ skal ldan dam gtsang rigs kyi sras: snod kyi dam pa mchog rnams nyon: deng 'dir bka' 'dus dkyil 'khor du: smin phyir bdag gis dbang mchog sbyin: de nas dam chu btang ba ni: hūm̐: 'di ni bde gshegs bla med chu: bsrungs pas mchog gi dngos grub brnyes:

nyams pas ltung ba'i las su 'gyur: de bas dam srungs chu 'di 'thung : om̐ badz+ra sa ma ya i dan+te na ra kan: zhes dam chu sbyin: slob mas: hoḥ rig 'dzin rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i lha: sku gsum dag pa'i dbyings nas gshegs: mchog gsum rgyal ba brtan par bzhugs: sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi: dam tshig rnam gsum srog ltar bsrung : bslab gsum rnam dag mi btang zhing : bskyed rdzogs sngags gsum la gnas so: de nas bskyed rim 'bogs nas: las bum gyi chu 'thor zhing : om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ: khyed rang rnams mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma ram̐ las nyi ma: ā las zla ba'i steng du: rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo hrīḥdamar gsal las rje btsun gu ru dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas sku mdog dmar smug dbang gi phrin las thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa: zhal gcig phyag gnyis thugs rje'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa: dbu la pad+ma mthong grol rgyan ldan gsol zhing : phyag g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon bhan+dha tshe bum bcas bsnams shing : sku la phod kha chos gos ber chen bklubs te gru mor kha ṭ+wāṃ ga brten pa: zhabs la rgya lham dar chen gsol te rgyal po rol pa'i cha lugs can du bskyed pa'o: spyi bo'i mkha' ru thog ma'i sangs rgyas dang 'od mi 'gyur ba la bde gshegs rigs lnga'i zhing khams lhar bcas gsal ba'i: g.yas su zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor: rgyab tu nor lha'i dkyil 'khor: g.yon du drag po'i dkyil 'khor: mdun du rten 'brel rnam bzhi'i dkyil 'khor: phyi rol rig 'dzin drang srong grub thob dang dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs sprin ltar du gtibs pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs su gsal ba'i gnas nas 'od zer 'phros pas: dag pa ye shes dbyings kyi pho brang nas: bde gshegs sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa ltar spyan drangs te skal ldan slob ma rnams la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod:

om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: 'og min mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing : pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas: rje btsun pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i 'khor gyis bskor: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur zhing : sku gsung thugs kyis byin chen phob: 'dir tshogs skal ldan rnal 'byor la: byin rlabs dbang bzhi deng 'dir stsol: om̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī sarba sa ma ya a be sha ya a āḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa brtan par bya ba'i phyir: om̐ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā: slob mas: hoḥ rig 'dzin rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i lha: sku gsum dag pa'i dbyings nas gshegs: mchog gsum rgyal ba brtan par bzhugs: sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su mchi: dam tshig rnam gsum srog ltar bsrung : bslab gsum rnam dag mi btang zhing : bskyed rdzogs sngags gsum la gnas so: de nas bum dbang bskur ba la: so thar bum pa sku yi dbang zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod: hoḥ rigs kun khyab bdag snang mtha'i rnam rol rje: o rgyan rin po che la gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: sku yi dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: bum pa thogs la: hoḥ khyed rang rnams la deng 'dir bla ma rtsa gsum bka' 'dus kyi sku yi dbang bskur ba yin te: bum pa ye shes kyi gzhal yas khang : bum chu rigs 'dus rgyal ba lha tshogs kyi ngo bor dbang bskur ba'i tshe snang stong sprul pa'i sku thob pa'i 'dun pa mdzod: hūm̐: bum pa lhun grub sna tshogs gzhal yas khang : bum chu dam tshig yi dam lha yi dngos: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: bskyed rim snang stong sprul sku'i dbang thob shog: om̐ gu ru ḍāk+ki pad+ma dha ra ha ri ni sa hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: des bum dbang bde ba chen po thob pas deng phyin chad lus lha yi bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang bar byas so:

hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin sku yi bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor: maṇ+ḍal phul: de nas gsung gi dbang zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod: hoḥ rigs kun khyab bdag snang mtha'i rnam rol rje: o rgyan rin po che la gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: gsung gi dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: bhan+dha thogs la: hoḥ deng 'dir khyed rang rnams la bla ma rtsa gsum bka' 'dus kyi gsung gi dbang bskur ba yin te: dam tshig ye shes lnga yi byang chub 'di nyid phyi ltar ma rgyud mkha' 'gro tshogs pa'i pho brang chen po dung khang 'byin 'jug sngags kyi dkyil 'khor: nang ltar rang byung skye med grags stong rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor: rdo rje'i rlung la brten pa'i brda mtshon pa'i rnam pa rtsa brgyad stong sbyar gyi dbang bskur bas: longs sku rig pa'i rtsal snang gi dbang thob pa'i mos 'dun mdzod: hūm̐: bhan+dha bde chen mnyam nyid gzhal yas khang : lnga ldan bdud rtsi snying po 'byin 'jug can: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: grags stong 'gags med sngags kyi dbang thob shog: om̐ gu ru ḍāk+ki pad+ma dha ra ha ri ni sa hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐:

spro bsdu'i dmigs pa 'bog zhing bzlas lung bya: des gsang dbang grags stong chen po thob pas lam snying po sngags bzlas zung 'jug longs spyod rdzogs pa'i 'bras bu thob: bzlas brjod sgrub pa byed du rung ba'i skal ldan du byas so: hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin gsung gi bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor: maṇ+ḍal phul: de nas thugs ky-i dbang zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod: hoḥ rigs kun khyab bdag snang mtha'i rnam rol rje: o rgyan rin po che la gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: thugs kyi dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: me long sin+dhu ra'i tshom bu bcas thogs la: hoḥ khyed rang rnams la bla ma rtsa gsum bka' 'dus kyi thugs kyi dbang bskur ba yin te: dkyil 'khor lha tshom gsal stong don rdzogs kyi ngo bo gzhi ma bcos ka dag gdod ma'i gshis lugs ci ltar ston pa la brten nas chos kyi sku thob pa'i mos pa mdzod: hūm̐: skye med ka dag ngo bo lhun gyis grub: dran rig ma bcos dkyil 'khor gdod nas shar: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: gsal stong 'dzin med thugs kyi dbang thob shog: om̐ gu ru ḍāk+ki pad+ma dha ra ha ri ni sa hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: des thugs shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob: 'bras bu chos kyi sku 'grub: rdzogs chen bla ma a ti bla med bsgom pa la dbang bar byas so: hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs shing : skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin thugs kyi bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor: maṇ+ḍal phul: de nas yon tan kun rdzogs kyi dbang zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod:

hoḥ rigs kun khyab bdag snang mtha'i rnam rol rje: o rgyan rin po che la gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: yon tan dbang bskur dam pa stsal du gsol: gtor ma thogs la: hoḥ deng 'dir khyed rang rnams la rtsa gsum bka' 'dus yon tan gyi dbang bskur ba yin te: gtor ma 'di nyid rmad byung rgyan rdzogs yon tan kun 'byung gi rdzas mchog chen po ste: dbang bskur bas dngos grub 'gugs pa'i dus mchod sogs bsod nams mchod pa'i las byed kun dang : phrin las bzhi yi rten 'brel mthar dbyung zhing : dkyil 'khor phyi nang gsang gsum rgyan rdzogs kyi dbang thob pa'i 'dun pa mdzod: hūm̐: bla med mchog gi mchod pa'i rdzas la brten: 'dod yon rtsa gsum rgyal ba mnyes pa'i rdzas: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: ngo bo mchog thun dngos grub thob par shog: om̐ gu ru ḍāk+ki pad+ma dha ra ha ri ni sa hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: des yon tan mi zad rgyan gyis phyug pa'i rten 'brel la mthar phyin pa'i rdzas dbang ngam chas dbang thob: deng phyin chad bsod nams phun sum tshogs pa'i mchod tshogs brtsam zhing dkyil 'khor lnga'i byed las rung ba dang : 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku thob pa'i skal ldan du byas so: hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs shing : skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin yon tan bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor zhing : maṇ+ḍal phul: de nas phrin las rtsal rdzogs kyi dbang zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod: hoḥ rigs kun khyab bdag snang mtha'i rnam rol rje: o rgyan rin po che la gsol ba 'debs: bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: phrin las dbang mchog dam pa stsal du gsol: sku 'bag gam lha tshom kun 'dus thogs la:

hoḥ deng 'dir khyed rang rnams la rtsa gsum bka' 'dus kyi phrin las dbang bskur ba yin te: sku 'bag lha yi tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa'i lha dbang dang : chas dbang rdzas dbang bcas pa phrin las gcig tu rdzogs pa'i brdar mtshon pa ste: de ltar yongs rdzogs su bskur ba la: zhi ba rdo rje dbyings: drag po dbang drag rol pa ste: phrin las kyi dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa'i mtha' sdud par bya ba'i rim pa rgyab chos smon lam bsam pa lhun grub kyi dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs thob pas rang bzhin thugs rje'i sku ru grol ba'i 'dun pa mdzod: hūm̐: rig 'dzin rtsa gsum bde gshegs rgyal ba'i lha: ye shes tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyis: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: gang 'dul phrin las rab 'byams thob par shog: om̐ gu ru ḍāk+ki pad+ma dha ra ha ri ni sa hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: des phrin las 'gro 'dul ye shes lha tshogs gsal byed rang bzhin thugs rje 'pho 'gyur med pa'i dbang thob pas: deng phyin chad dkyil 'khor bya ba mtha' ru nyams su myong zhing : rtsa gsum bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho yi phrin las sna tshogs la dbang bar byas so: hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: rig 'dzin phrin las bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor: maṇ+ḍal phul: de nas lha dbang bsdus pa ltar na rtsa lha'i gtso bo rnams kyis dbang bskur: chas dang zhi drag bskul ba ni: hūm̐: sku la bkod pa zhi ba'i rgyan mdzes pa: rin chen prog zhu snyan rgyan mgul rgyan dang : dar dpyangs stod g.yogs dpung rgyan ga shal spras: smad dkris phyag gdub zhabs gdub bcas pa gtad: thugs rje'i rang rtsal rgyan gyi dbang thob shog: om̐ sarba rat+na bhi shwo pañtsa li ka ku mu ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐:

de nas drag po'i chas thogs te: hūm̐: thod skam dbu rgyan glang ko zhing lpags dang : rdo rje'i go khrab rus rgyan stag lpags dang : mgo phreng sbrul chun khrag zhag thal chen tshom: me dpung dang ni srung 'khor bcas pa gtad: bdud 'dul dpal gyi cha lugs yongs rdzogs shog: om̐ kro ta kro ta kro ti tsaṇ+ḍa sha ma sha na kan thi ka sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas zhi drag gi phyag mtshan phrin las bzhi gtad la: hūm̐: zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las rnam pa bzhi: dkyil 'khor rang rang sa bon phyag mtshan bcas: de ring skal ldan khyod la sbyin pa yis: rgyan dang sa bon phyag mtshan yongs rdzogs shog: om̐ sarba hri hri hūm̐ kin+tha ka badz+ra tig+na bhan+dha ye sarba hoḥ de nas tshig dbang rin po che ngo sprod rnam gsum bstan pa ni: shel sgong ngam me long thogs la: hoḥ snang zhing stong pa'i chos thams cad rtag dpyad 'dzin gzhig bral bar cir snang bdag med snang stong gi ngo bo de sems zhes bya ba snang tshul tsam yin pas mnyam par zhog cig: de nas rol mo rigs bzhi thogs la: hoḥ de ltar sgra thams cad grags stong brag cha 'byung ba tsha grang 'thab pa'i rang skad ltar thos so cog gi tshig rtog tshogs kyis 'dzin pa ma zhugs par pi waṃ gi gling bu ltar shes par gyis la rang bzhin so ma mnyam par zhog cig: de nas nam mkha' g.ya' dag la sdigs mdzub gtad de: hoḥ dbyings kyi rang bzhin gdod nas dag pa: ngo bo ka nas dag pa: rnam pa shugs las dag pa ste: de nam mkha' la sgro ma btags par phyam gyis gnas pa ltar: bum pa chag pa'i nam mkha' dang nam mkhas khyab pa'i bum nang ltar ris su ma chad phyogs su ma lhung : a 'thas su ma 'byams: had po mdo med ma yin pa: dmigs bya blo las 'das pa: dmigs med kyi rang rtsal las cir yang 'char ba: shar mkhan gdod nas stong pa: stong pa rtsal chen gyi shugs 'chang ba: bzang pos ma sgyur: ngan pas ma bslad pa: gzhon nu kun byed rgyal po zhes sgyu ma bsdus na rkyen gyis mi 'jigs pa:

gzugs med rdzu 'phrul shugs la 'chang ba zhes bya ba: mi bden bzhin du 'gyu ba 'di ni rang shes mngon par mi rtog pa'i rig pa yin te: dgag sgrub lhan pa dang bral ba'i so mar zhog cig: des tshig dbang rin po che'i ngo sprod thob pa yin pas: deng phyin chad a ti bla med theg pa'i yang rtse: bsgom bya'i yul dang sgom byed kyi gnyen por shar grol dus mnyam rtogs pa blo 'das kyi ngo bo la dbang bar byas so: zhes ngo sprad la gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal phul: bkra shis pa'i me tog 'thor zhing : hūm̐: rgya gar yul du sku 'khrungs pa: skye 'chi gnyis spangs 'ja' lus brnyes: bka' 'dus gtso bo zil gnon zhabs: mtsho skyes rdo rje bstan pa'i bdag: khyab bdal klong yangs bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor: maṇ+ḍal phul: de nas dngos grub kyi dga' ston tshogs la rol ba'i rnal 'byor ni: bkra shis brgyad ldan dge ba'i rig mas tshogs btegs la: rdo rje'i glus bskul ba ni: hoḥ gsang ba bla med theg chen lam gyi mchog: bsod nams tshogs bsags ye shes 'bras bu'i dpyid: de ring skal ldan rnams la zhu ba'i phyir: rdo rje rgyal pos bdag la gnang bar stsol: rdo rje slob dpon gyis: hūm̐: rten 'brel rdzas las legs 'ong pa: bsod nams tshogs kyi 'khor lo 'di: ye shes mchog la gzhol ba'i phyir: the tshom spang zhing dwang du blang : dngos grub rtsa ba bla med mchog: rmad byung yon tan kun thob shog: a la la hoḥ zhes pas dngos grub tshogs rol: tshe ril dang tshe chang thogs la: hūm̐: rmad byung bdud rtsi bcud ldan ril bu dang : dam tshig ye shes lnga yi su ra chang : zag med dga' bzhi'i rdzas mchog kun 'byung 'di: 'chi med mchog stsol skal ldan bu la sbyin: om̐ ga ṇa la sarba a mṛ ta pū dza hoḥ de nas rgyas gdab pa ni phyag mtshan kha ṭ+wāṃ dang dar tshon sna lngas brgyan pa thogs te: hūm̐: phyogs bzhi tshe yi rig 'dzin kha ṭ+wāṃ thogs:

mtshams bzhi'i gsang ba'i rig mas mda' dar thogs: g.yon rnams bhan+dha dang ni tshom bu bsnams: dpa' bo dpa' mos bkra shis me tog 'dzin: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur rgya yis gdab: bkra shis dge legs rab gnas 'thor bar bgyis: om̐ bhi dho dhā ra ḍāk+ki nī tshun dha tshun dhi sarba maṅga laṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra puṣ+pe shrī ya a dhiṣ+ṭha na a dhiṣ+ṭhi te swā hā: zhes rgyas gdab: bkra shis rab tu gnas: de nas dam tshig bsgo ba ni: hūm̐: deng phyin chad rigs 'dus rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lhag pa'i lhar 'dzin cing : phyi nang gsang ba'i dam tshig gi gnas rnams la nye bar gnas par bgyi snyam pas 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod: gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal p sa ma ya: zab pa'i mthar thug bde gshegs rtsa ba'i chos: zhal gdams snying gi nā da gdams pa'i bcud: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal bdag gis yi ger bkod: ma 'ongs yang mtha' bskal pa drag spyod tshe: skal ldan rigs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: des kyang chos bdag smon lam can la sprod: 'dzin 'chang spel sgrub rgyud la ra mda' sbron: bka' yi srung ma dregs pa sde lnga dang : dpal gyi lha mo klu rgyal thod pa dkar: gsang sngags gnyan gyi srung mas rtag tu skyongs: dam tshig bstan pa skyong ba'i bya ra mdzod: dpal gyi mchims phur mi nub-i atsha rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos sa khyir lor bsam yas mchims phu nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas zhal bshus so/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // la) ༄༅/ bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: rtsa ba gcig dril gyi lha tshom ye shes drwa ba bzhugs so: rtsa gsum kun 'dus dkyil 'khor lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: de yang rtsa gsum bka' 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor las: smin byed dbang chog 'grigs chags su bkod pa la: thog mar sgrub pa'i las rim sta gon sngon du song nas:

rjes su gnang bar byed pa'i rim pa la: bca' gzhi lag len spyi 'gro ltar las: nyer bsdus mchod pa phyi nang gsang gsum: bum pa gtor ma yi bye brag rigs lnga'i rgyan spyod rdzas bcas: byin 'bebs cha lag gos rgyan dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro'i rgyan cha sogs dang : bar mtshams gcod pa'i ging dkar nag sogs mkho ba'i yo byad rnams: las phran dbang gzhung dang bstun pa'i 'grigs chags zhib par bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi dbang chen ltar bsags: 'di yi dbang gzhung bla ma bde gshegs kun 'dus dang zung du 'brel ba'i go rim ci zhe na: rgyab chos bsam pa lhun 'grub mar grags pa ste: dkyil 'khor rtsa ba'i gzhung thams cad rten 'brel dang smon lam mthar phyin pa'i cha lag: zhal gdams snying gi thig le'i skor las byung ba ste: gzhung 'di nyid la 'khyer sau gsum gyi dbang che phra 'bring gsum las phrin las 'di 'bring po'i lugs su 'dod: des na bca' gzhi 'khyer bde zhing phrin las rang gzhung bslad med byin rlabs nus pa che ba'i yon tan du ma dang ldan pa'o: sa ma ya: de yang dbang sgrub sbrags ma'i cha lag u pa la'i phreng ba ru 'dod pa ni: thog mar sngon du 'gro ba las: na mo: rtsa gsum kun 'dus bde gshegs rgyal ba'i lha: ye shes rol pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: skyabs mchis gsol 'debs byin rlabs thugs dam bskul: phrin las 'gro 'dul dpal du yongs smin shog: gnyis pa: hoḥ khams gsum srid pa'i 'khor lo shing rta'i rgyun: nam yang duḥkha'i srid pa nyer len tshogs: yongs su stongs par bde gshegs 'phrul ba'i mthus: bdag gi 'byor bcus byang chub sems bskyed do: gsum pa: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: om̐ āḥhūm̐: mchod rdzas ma dag pa'i dngos po thams cad sbyang spel bsgyur ba'o: om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ hrīḥ phyi mchod me tog bdug spos mar me dri: zhal zas rol mo sil snyan dbyangs dang bcas:

gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya mchod pa'i sprin: bde gshegs rgyal ba mnyes pa'i rdzas su spel: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wi d+ya shab+da āḥhūm̐: rū pa shab+da gan+dhe rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: nang mchod ni: hūm̐: bhan+dha lcang lo 'khyil ba'i snod yangs su: sman mchog rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar ba'i: dug lnga zhi mdzad ye shes bdud rtsi'i bcud: bla med dkyil 'khor mnyes pa'i rdzas su spel: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ rak+ta byin brlab ni: hūm̐: rā sa 'dar mar babs pa'i rgyun bzang po: kha kha mu kha rā sa'i bcud chags nyid: bum ril snod du rang bzhin mtsho ltar 'khyil: dmar chen rak+ta ye nas bdud rtsir gyur: om̐ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ gtor ma byin brlab ni: hūm̐: zangs lcags la sogs rin chen snod mchog tu: bha ling rgyan rdzogs ro mchog spyod pa'i srid: rtsa gsum lha tshogs mnyes pa'i rdzas chen po: rmad byung gtor ma ye nas bdud rtsir gyur: om̐ ma hā bha ling+ta te dz+wa bha ling+ta bha la bha te gu h+ya sa ma ye hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ dza gad la: hūm̐: dam tshig ye shes bhan+dha ru: zag med bde ba'i bcud g.yo ba: rigs lnga'i sa bon zhu ba'i khur: pañtsa ye shes lnga ru gsal: om̐ sarba ma d+yāṃ dz+nyā na a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ

bum pa byin brlab ni: om̐ bh+rūm̐ paṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pas yi ge yongs su gyur pa las: bum pa mtshan nyid bzhi dang ldan pa: lto ba che zhing lhun rgyas pa: kha g.yer la bkra shis pa'i rdzas rtags mtshan pa: mchur 'dod yon nar ma'i bu ga rab tu 'phyang ba: zhabs bde ba'i bcud chags 'dzag med gzhol zhing mdzes pa: kha rgyan dpag bsam shing dang sgro phod lnga ldan mtshan pa'i tshom bus rnam par spras pa: de yi nang du bh+rūm̐ dang hrīḥ om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes yig 'bru sa bon phyag mtshan yongs su gyur pa las: pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la gu ru bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi cha lugs rdzogs pa: yum gsang ba ye shes 'khril zhing longs sku'i mtshan dpes rab tu brgyan pa'o: de yi phyogs bzhir sgo ma rigs bzhis brdas bskul ba las: om̐ sa ma ya hoḥ om̐ sa ma ya satwaṃ: rā ga ya hoḥ rā ga ya mi: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas yab yum sbyor ba mdzad pa'i thugs dam bskul: dga' chen khyab brdal gis phrin las rtsal du mngon: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes pas rgyal ba rtsa gsum bka' 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros pa wal gyis gsal bar gyur: om̐ gu ru dz+nyā na dhe wa ḍāk+ki nī ye sarba dha ri hoḥ zhes thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul bas slob dpon yab yum las mchod pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams rang bzhin gsal ba'o: slar yang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas la phog: phyogs bcu'i rigs lnga lha yi gtso bo 'od dpag med bcas zhing khams lha rnams kyis dbang bskur khrus bstsal sku gang dri ma dag: chu yi lhag ma yar lud pa las: snang ba mtha' yas kyis dbu brgyan par gyur: om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ dzaḥ a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: zhes lha tshogs de rnams gsal ba dang : bdag mdun gnyis su mched pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer sna tshogs spros pas rgyal ba ye shes kyi thugs dam bskul:

rtsa ba'i sngags phreng 'phros pas gzung thag gi lam du brgyud: bum lha'i zhal du zhugs: thugs kar thim pas sngags phreng rnams 'od zer cha tshang 'khor: gnyis mched pa'i gtso 'khor thams cad mnyam du 'khor: dkyil 'khor phyi nang mu mtha' thams cad yongs su khyab snang srid la phog: skye 'gro spyi dang bye brag thams cad tshe rabs nas bsags pa'i rnam smin thams cad bsregs: lus shel sgong ltar gyur: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje 'bebs mar gyur pas ye shes lnga yi yon tan cig car du rdzogs: slar yang thugs rje'i shugs dang byin rlabs kyi dngos grub thams cad tshur 'dus dkyil 'khor la thim pas gzi brjid 'od du 'bar bar bsgom: om̐ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal sa ma ya dzaḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐: hrīḥm ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrī ya tsit+ta hring hring dzaḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐: bum sgrub sngags ni: om̐ gu ru ḍāk+ki pad+ma dha ra ha ri ni sa hūm̐: yang dril: om̐ gu ru ḍāk+ki ka lak+ṣa hūm̐ hrīḥ zhes pa'i sngags brgya phrag re la dung zhal rdo rje'i kha chod can gyi rdzas rnam bum gyi lha la dbyer med bstim: hūm̐: dam tshig ye shes chen po brtan pa'i phyir: a haṃ rang sgras bskul ba'i snying po sngags: zung 'jug zag med lha yi ngo bor gsal: mchod 'bul bde stong dga' bzhi'i dgyes gyur cig: om̐ a haṃ ku mu ṭa la hoḥ zhes pas bstim: slar yang chu gtsang zhig bzhag: mchod pa kha gso: gtang rag bgyis pa ni: hūm̐: dri med dag pa gtsang ma'i chab: rgyal ba'i sku la byi dor phyir: lha yi khrus gsol ci bzhin 'bul: de bzhin legs gtsang zhabs bsil pa: yan lag brgyad ldan dri med 'bul: sa gzhi srid pa med pa'i khyon: ljan ljin la sogs bral ba'i phyir: de bzhin zhabs bsil legs par 'bul: rgyal ba ye shes lnga ldan phyir: gang gis srid pa 'ching bral ba:

dri spos rang bzhin rgyud ldan kyang : byugs pa dam pa 'bul bar bgyid: de bzhin zhing dang zhing khams su: ji snyed bde bas rab g.yo bas: mchog dang thun mong zhing khams su: rnam par bkod pas yongs su brgyan: me tog bdug spos phye ma phur: mar me'i phreng ba yol bas brgyan: ji snyed zhing rdul brtsegs pa'i khyon: de snyed bdag gis 'bul lags kyis: sngon tshe rgyal ba'i spyi dpal gsol: om̐ sarba ku mu ṭa gan+dhe bha tra sarba me gha la ye shrī hoḥ rigs lnga'i dbyangs bstod ni: hūm̐: chos sku'i rang bzhin mtha' bral ye shes klong : longs sku'i mtshan nyid sna tshogs 'dzin bral po: sprul sku ji snyed 'gro ba'i mgon mchog che: bde gshegs rgyal ba'i lha la bstod par bgyi: sarba pu ru sha ya hoḥ zhes bstod cing bsngags pa gzhung gi las tshogs su sngon du 'gro ba'o: sa ma ya: gzhi snang lam du bkod pa ni: hūm̐: kun gzhi skye med gsal stong ngang : ma 'gags sna tshogs 'phro 'du las: spros 'gyur 'gyed pa'i sa bon gsal: om̐ hūm̐ bh+rūm̐: e snang gsal ba'i gzhal yas khang : ma skyes lhun grub gsal rdzogs su: pho brang gzhal yas gru bzhi pa: rtsig 'dod mda' yab 'od phreng mdzes: chos 'khor za ram rin chen tog: phyi nang dkyil 'khor rgyan bkod tshang : snang stong 'od kyi drwa bar bsgom: hūm̐: dbus su nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan: snang srid zil gnon rgyal po'i chas: g.yas g.yon rigs kyi bde chen gnyis: khor yug rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i lha: tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor ma lus kun: stong gsal 'dzin med wal gyis shar: om̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma dha ra ḍāk+ki sid+dhi hrīḥ de ltar bskyed pa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis 'phro 'dus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥ spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings rang rtsal las: snang mtha'i rnam rol pad+ma 'byung : dbyings las ma g.yos rtsal rdzogs su:

thugs rje'i 'od skur 'dir snang stsol: om̐ gu ru badz+ra dha ra hūm̐ dza dzaḥ bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: chags med skyon bral rigs kyi bdag: pad 'byung rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor lha: nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs: ma skyes bla med dam phyag 'tshal: sgo gsum 'khrul 'dzin sgrib bral nas: dbang bzhis smin grol dngos grub stsol: om̐ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ mchod pa ni: hūm̐: me tog mdzes pa'i phreng ba 'phreng : dri zhim g.yo ba'i bdug spos phyur: snang gsal 'od kyi sgron me gtams: bzang po'i dri chab rab tu bstar: bcud chags ro brgya'i zhal zas mtho: sna tshogs snyan pa'i rol mo'i sgra: reg 'jam yug gos rgyan gyi tshogs: blos blangs dwang bas dgyes bskyed nas: rtsa gsum bka' 'dus lha la 'bul: dgyes pa mchog gis thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: bde gshegs rgyal ba 'dus pa'i gtso: rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas 'od mi 'gyur: bskang ngo mchod do thugs dam bskang : gang 'dul thugs rje'i rol gar ston: rig 'dzin rtsa gsum ngo bo nyid: snang srid zil gnon phrin las lnga: bskang ngo mchod do thugs dam bskang : dbyings kyi dbang phyug tsaṇ+ḍa lī: rdo rje phag mo mkha' 'gro'i gtso: bskang ngo mchod do thugs dam bskang : phrin las rtsal bcus dgra bgegs sgrol: dpal chen dregs pa kun 'dul sku: bskang ngo mchod do thugs dam bskang : sna tshogs sprul sgyur gar dgu 'gyed: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs ma lus kun: bskang ngo mchod do thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: dam tshig chen po'i bhan+dha ru: dgyes pa'i sman phud phyu ru ru: rak+ta rba rlabs gya ma gyu: rmad byung bha ling ye re re: dza gad ngad ldan sbrings se sbreng : ga ṇa tshogs mchod ye re re: dbang po'i me tog spungs se spung : spyan gzigs 'phan 'phyang pu ru ru: rnga sgra dung gling bhi ri ri: ḍā ru cang te'u khro lo lo:

gar mo rgyan mdzes spungs se spung : ging dang dpa' bo sha ra ra: phyi nang dgyes pa'i mchod tshogs 'di: rtsa gsum bka' 'dus lha la 'bul: bla med mchod pas thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: bde gshegs rgyal ba 'dus pa'i gtso: rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas 'od mi 'gyur: bskang ngo mchod do thugs dam bskang : gang 'dul thugs rjes rol gar ston: rig 'dzin rtsa gsum ngo bo nyid: snang srid zil gnon phrin las lnga: bskang ngo mchod do thugs dam bskang : dbyings kyi dbang phyug tsaṇ+ḍa lī: rdo rje phag mo mkha' 'gro'i gtso: bskang ngo mchod do thugs dam bskang : phrin las rtsal bcus dgra bgegs sgrol: dpal chen dregs pa kun 'dul sku: bskang ngo mchod do thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ badz+ra puṣ+pe ?nas shab+da āḥhūm̐: rū pa shab+da gan+dhai rā sa spar+she āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta bha ling+ta gu h+ya sa ma ye swā hā: de nas chos bstod ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ skye 'chi gnyis spangs rdo rje'i go cha can: snang mtha' bde gshegs rigs lnga sangs rgyas stong : grub pa'i bla ma rdor 'chang longs spyod rdzogs: snang srid zil gnon ye shes lnga ru 'chang : rdo rje rnal 'byor zab lam bde chen dbyings: dgra bgegs mthar byed dregs pa kun 'dus rtsal: bde gshegs rtsa ba'i yi dam rigs 'dus lha: gzhan yang phyi nang gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor tshogs: rab 'byams mkhyen rtse dpal zhing lha la bstod: hrīḥ rang bzhin ka dag ye grol chos kyi sku: bya rtsol skye 'gag bral ba'i dkyil 'khor lha: deng 'dir 'pho 'gyur med pa'i ye shes nyid: snang grags sgyu ma'i ngo bo rtsol med kyis: thugs dam mi dmigs bde chen klong nas bskul: bskyed rdzogs gdod ma'i dbyings nas phrin las stsol: rtsa sngags dril sgrub ni: om̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma dha ra ḍāk+ki sid+dhi hrīḥ zhes pas rang nyid rje btsun snang srid zil gnon du gsal ba'i thugs kar hrīḥdamar po'i sngags phreng 'khor bas thugs dam rgyud bskul:
