sngags phreng gcig las gnyis mched kyi rnam pa 'od zer 'phros rtsa ba'i lha rnams la phog: lha so sos skye med rang sgras sngags phreng di ri ri sgrogs par bsam: slar yang 'phros pas 'khor rnams la phog: 'khor rnams kyis kyang bung ba rtsi kha ru myong ba'i sgra ltar che phra grangs med sgrogs pas ye shes kyi rgyud rab tu bskul bar bsam: rjes su 'khor gyi lha rnams gtso bo la thim: gtso bo mdun bskyed bum pa'i bdud rtsi dang dbyer med bsam: bdag bskyed rang nyid pad 'byung snang mtha'i ngo bo mnyam par dar gcig la bzhag: bsnyen pa'i tshad kyang rab 'bru 'bum: 'bring phyed cha: tha ma bdun gsum sgrub pa'i bsnyen tshad bskyal: dbang sgrub skabs bde gshegs kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa dang sbyar ba ci lcogs gnas yul dang bstun: grub pa'-i rtags su nyi zla shar ba dang 'od gsal ba dang nyi zla'i gdan la sdod pa dang : lus la 'od dpung 'ja' lus shar ba dang : ḍāk+ki'i tshogs dpon bgyid pa dang : gangs dkar mthon po la 'dzegs pa dang : ri rab rtse nas lta ba dang : stong gsum dbang du 'du ba dang : me tog tshal du bslebs pa dang : lha mdog bzhin du thu ba dang : gang zhig bud med rgyan mdzes rigs: mang po 'tshogs shing dkar gsum sbyin: brda gar rtse dang rol mo sgrog: skyed mo yid 'ong pad+ma'i tshal: dbang bskur chos 'chad bgyid pa dang : mkha' la lding zhing stobs bskyed pa: ri klung med par bkang ba sogs: mchog dang thun mong rtags tshad 'byung : mchog la bde gsal mi rtog skye: thun mong 'gro ba dbang du 'du: gzhan gyis byams shing longs spyod 'phel: snang ba dge las 'ba' zhig 'char: nad dkon lus kyang gzi mdangs che: phyogs med rnams kyang mthong ba dang : sngar las med pa'i yon tan skye: dga' brod spangs te nan gyis sgrub: sa ma ya: de yang rtsa gsum bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho yi snying po don 'dus thugs sgrub rnam gsum las:

bla ma bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi rgyab chos rje 'bangs ye shes grogs rnams la gdams pa'i gsol 'debs bsam pa lhun 'grub ma'i rtsa ba dang gzhung sdong po'i spyi don kha 'gengs cha lag ste: bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi dbang gzhung mu tig rtsal phreng gi dkyil 'khor gzhung la 'jug pa la: spyi don rnam pa gsum ste: dang po la: stod las byang chub sgrub pa'i zhal gdams don lnga'i sgrub pa: snang mtha' thog ma'i rigs lnga o rgyan bde gshegs sgrub pa dbus phyogs chos sku'i lha tshom: shar du 'byung lnga sgyu mar sbyong ba longs sku dag pa rig 'dzin o rgyan bde chen rgyal po'i lha tshom: lho ru cir snang lam khyer tshogs drug lhug bzhag o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pa'i lha tshom: nub tu 'chi 'pho ltung ba 'byung 'dus 'jigs skrag rang grol gyi mtshams sbyor o rgyan dpa' bo gyad kyi lha tshom: byang du nam zhig tshe yi 'phen pa zad pa'i tshe rig pa chos dbyings su 'pho ba o rgyan rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lha tshom: de ltar zhi ba ye shes dbyings lnga'i lha tshom: dug lnga rang grol gyi zhal gdams don tshan zhi ba chos nyid sku lnga'i le'u'o: sa ma ya: gnyis pa dngos gzhi smad las gang 'dul der ston pa'i rgyu ni: mtsho rgyal dang grogs rnams la gdams pa: sems can 'dod chags las gyur pa'i mu ge: gti mug las gyur pa'i nad rigs: zhe sdang las gyur pa'i dmag 'khrug: nga rgyal las gyur pa'i chom po: phrag dog las gyur pa'i mtha' bzhi ral pa sogs 'byung gsungs: de dag mi 'byung ba'i gdams pa ma hā gu ru'i zhal gdams su gnang bar stsol: ces zhus pas bka' stsal pa: spyir sems can thams cad nyon mongs pa kha yan du spyad pa'i las las grub pa yin te: dug lnga rang grol gyi gdams pa dang gsol 'debs mtshams sbyor gyi sgrub pa 'di ltar dgos so: sa ma ya: de yang dbul phongs pre ta'i gdung ba kun sel ba dbus su o rgyan nor lha dbyer med pad+ma rgyal po'i lha tshom:

shar du dug lnga nad sel o rgyan sman lha'i lha tshom: lho ru pha rol bdud bzhi rgol ba gzhom pa o rgyan rdo rje gur gyi lha tshom: nub tu bdud bzhi 'jigs brgyad zhi ba o rgyan dregs pa zil gnon gyi lha tshom: byang du phung byed dam sri'i dmag tshogs zhi ba o rgyan dregs pa sde brgyad kyi lha tshom: de ltar smad las dgra bgegs bsgral ba dang bdud kyi rgol ba gzhom pa dang dbang sdud zil gnon gyi don tshan phrin las lnga'i le'u'o: sa ma ya: gsum pa phrin las so sor sgrub pa'i rten 'brel phyogs maid du 'char ba gnas dang ri sul 'grims pa: skal ldan las can chos dang 'phrad pa'i lung bstan smon lam gyis rgyud bskul ba'i cha lag zur gsal: thog mar lha klu sde brgyad sogs yul skyong dam tshig can rnams kyi phrin las sgrub pa o rgyan nyi ma 'od zer gyi lha tshom: gnyis pa ting 'dzin gyis zil gyis mnan cing rten 'brel dus las mi g.yel ba o rgyan snang srid zil gnon dpa' bo ging gi lha tshom: gsum pa gnas yul 'grims pa'i bar du gcod pa mngon spyod kyis sgrol ba o rgyan rdo rje gro lod kyi lha tshom: bzhi pa bka' dang bstan pa skyong ba gter srung phrin las sgrub pa'i lha tshom: de ltar cha lag so so'i byed po sku'i rdzu 'phrul cher 'gyed pa don gsum pa'i le'u'o: sa ma ya:

de nas bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi dbang gi sngon 'gro sta gon thams cad rdzogs pa'i rjes su: dngos gzhi gzhung gi lha dbang rnams rdzogs rjes: chas dbang mtshams su thog mar bde chen zhing gi lha dbang bskur ba ni: ༈ nam zhig tshe zad 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe: gnad gcod sdug bsngal drag pos nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan snang ba mtha' yas sprul pa ste: bde ba can gyi zhing du nges par skye: o rgyan? bsam p gtso bo 'od dpag med thogs la: hūm̐: ye shes lus can sangs rgyas 'od mi 'gyur: mnyam bzhag skyil krung bde stong lham mer bzhugs: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: o rgyan snang mtha' dbyer med dbang bskur ro: om̐ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: spyan ras gzigs thogs la: hūm̐: 'jig rten dbang phyug 'gro la spyan gyis gzigs: dbyings phyug dkar mo bde stong zung 'jug 'khril: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: chos dbyings ye shes gsal ba'i don rtogs shog: om̐ lo ki shwa ra hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rdo rje sems dpa' thogs la: hrīḥ zhe sdang rnam dag bcom ldan rdo rje sems: dung mdog snang stong spyan ma sku la 'khril: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: me long ye shes gsal ba'i don rtogs shog: om̐ badz+ra sa twa hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rin chen 'byung ldan thogs la: hrīḥ nga rgyal rnam dag bcom ldan rin chen 'byung : gser mdog bde stong mā kī sku la 'khril: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: mnyam nyid ye shes gsal ba'i don rtogs shog: om̐ rat+na sa twa hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: snang ba mtha' yas thogs la: hrīḥ 'dod chags rnam dag bcom ldan snang mtha' yas: zangs mdog grags stong gos dkar pang du 'khril: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: sor rtog ye shes gsal ba'i don rtogs shog: om̐ pad+ma sa twa hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ

don yod grub pa thogs la: hūm̐: phrag dog rnam dag bcom ldan don yod grub: mthing mdog tshor stong dam tshig sgrol ma 'khril: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: bya grub ye shes gsal ba'i don rtogs shog: om̐ karma sa twa hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sa ma ya: de nas shar phyogs bde chen rgyal po'i tshom bu la: ༈ gzhan yang las dang rkyen gyi dbang gyur te: 'khrul snang dngos por zhen cing sdug bsngal na: yid gnyis? o rgyan bde chen rgyal po'i ngo bo ste: sdug bsngal 'khrul pa rtsad nas gzhig par byed: o rgyan? bsam p bde chen rgyal po thogs la: hūm̐: ka dag ye shes longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku: dmar smug mtsho rgyal dkar mo zung 'jug 'khril: de ring skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: o rgyan bde chen rgyal po'i dbang bskur ro: om̐ ma hā su ṣa rā dza hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin thogs la: hūm̐: rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin 'od lnga'i mdangs: zung 'jug gsang ba'i ye shes sku la 'khril: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: mkha' spyod rig 'dzin go 'phang 'grub par shog: om̐ bi dho bi shwa dha ra hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sar gnas rig 'dzin thogs la: hūm̐: shar du sa la gnas pa'i rig 'dzin sku: dkar gsal chags med nyi zla'i dngos grub 'khril: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: mngon dga'i rig 'dzin go 'phang 'grub par shog: om̐ bi dho ra badz+ra hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: phyag rgya rig 'dzin thogs la: hūm̐: lho ru phyag rgya rig 'dzin chen po'i sku: ser gsal skyon bral mthing 'od 'bar ma 'khril: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: dpal ldan rig 'dzin go 'phang 'grub par shog: om̐ bi bho dha ra rat+na hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: tshe dbang rig 'dzin thogs la: hūm̐: nub tu tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin sku: dmar gsal bde stong rdo rje rnal 'byor 'khril:

de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: pad brtsegs rig 'dzin go 'phang 'grub par shog: om̐ bi dho dha ra pad+ma hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: lhun grub rig 'dzin thogs la: hūm̐: byang du lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin sku: ljang gsal skye med las kyi mkha' 'gro 'khril: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: las rab rig 'dzin go 'phang 'grub par shog: om̐ bi dho dha ra karma hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sa ma ya: de nas lho phyogs su o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pa'i tshom bu ni: ༈ sgyu lus g.yar po zhig pa'i bar do ru: 'khrul snang nying 'khrul sdug bsngal nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pa'i thugs rje yis: 'khrul snang rang sar grol bar the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p dus gsum mkhyen pa'i sku thogs la: hūm̐: thugs rje'i bdag nyid bud+dha he ru kaḥ sku mdog mthing nag lha lcam dmar mo 'khril: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: las rab rig 'dzin go 'phang 'grub par shog: o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pa'i dbang bskur ro: om̐ bud+dha a bhi dz+nyā na hrīḥ.a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rdo rje thod phreng thogs la: hūm̐: sku yi bdag nyid badz+ra thod phreng rtsal: sku mdog dkar po rdo rje'i rig ma 'khril: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: byams pa tshad med ngo bo lhun grub shog: om̐ badz+ra ma li ta hrīḥ.a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rat+na thod phreng thogs la: hūm̐: yon tan bdag nyid rat+na thod phreng rtsal: sku mdog ser mo rig 'dzin rig ma 'khril: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: snying rje tshad med ngo bo lhun grub shog: om̐ rat+na ma li ta hrīḥ.a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: pad+ma thod phreng thogs la: hūm̐: gsung gi bdag nyid pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: sku mdog dmar po pad+ma'i rig ma 'khril: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: dga' ba tshad med ngo bo lhun grub shog: om̐ pad+ma ma li ta hrīḥ

a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: karma thod phreng thogs la: hūm̐: phrin las bdag nyid karma thod phreng rtsal: sku mdog ljang gu las kyi rig ma 'khril: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: btang snyoms tshad med ngo bo lhun grub shog: om̐ karma ma li ta hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sa ma ya: de nas nub phyogs o rgyan dpa' bo brgyad kyi tshom bu ni: ༈ sa chu me rlung 'byung ba'i bar chad kyis: sgyu lus nyen cing 'jig pa'i dus byung tshe: yid gnyis? o rgyan 'byung ba bzhi yi lha mor bcas: 'byung ba rang sar zhi bar the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p mtsho skyes rdo rje'i sku thogs la: hūm̐: mtsho skyes rdo rje skye 'chi gdod nas dag: rgya gar rig 'dzin pan chen cha lugs 'chang : deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu la khyod la: o rgyan dpa' bo gyad kyi dbang bskur ro: om̐ gu ru badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sangs rgyas spyan ma thogs la: hūm̐: shar phyogs lha mo yum chen sangs rgyas spyan: sku mdog dkar mo rdo rje rigs kyi lcam: de ring skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: sa yi khams rnams dgra ru mi sdang shog: om̐ badz+ra ra ti mum̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: mā ma kī thogs la: hūm̐: lho phyogs lha mo yum chen mā ma kī: sku mdog ser mo rin chen rigs kyi lcam: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: chu yi khams rnams dgra ru mi sdang shog: om̐ dz+nyā na ra ti lām̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: gos dkar mo thogs la: hūm̐: nub phyogs lha mo yum chen gos dkar mo: sku mdog dmar mo pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: me yi khams rnams dgra ru mi sdang shog: om̐ rā ga ra ti pām̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: dam tshig sgrol ma thogs la: hūm̐: byang phyogs lha mo yum chen dam tshig sgrol: sku mdog ljang mo karma rigs kyi lcam: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: rlung gi khams rnams dgra ru mi sdang shog:

om̐ pradz+nyā ra ti tām̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sa ma ya: de nas byang phyogs su rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lha tshom ni: ༈ lnga brgya'i tha ma rtsod dus snyigs ma la: sems can thams cad nyon mongs dug lnga rags: nyon mongs 'byol nyog dug lnga rang rgyud spyod: de 'dra'i dus na khyed 'dra'i thugs rjes skyobs: dad ldan mtho ris 'dren pa'i thugs rje can: o rgyan? bsam p rdo rje phag mo thogs la: hūm̐: dus gsum sangs rgyas ma lus bskyed pa'i yum: dbu ma 'khor lo'i sgo 'byed rigs bdag brgyan: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: 'pho ba 'ja' lus mkha' spyod 'grub par shog: om̐ badz+ra yo gi ni ye a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rdo rje mkha' 'gro thogs la: hūm̐: mkha' spyod rdo rje'i rigs kyi ḍāk+ki ma: sku mdog dkar mo zhi ba'i 'od zer ldan: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: ye shes 'pho ba'i chos sgo phyes su gsol: ha badz+ra ḍāk+ki nī a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rin chen mkha' 'gro thogs la: hūm̐: sa spyod rig 'dzin rigs kyi ḍāk+ki ma: sku mdog ser mo rgyas pa'i lang tsho ldan: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: zab lam 'pho ba'i chos sgo phyes su gsol: ri rat+na ḍāk+ki nī a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: pad+ma mkha' 'gro thogs la: hūm̐: bde stong pad+ma rigs kyi ḍāk+ki ma: sku mdog dmar mo dbang gi lang tsho ldan: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: ka dag 'pho ba'i chos sgo phyes su gsol: ni pad+ma ḍāk+ki nī a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: las kyi mkha' 'gro thogs la: hūm̐: tshogs spyod karma las kyi ḍāk+ki ma: sku mdog ljang mo dgyes pa'i lang tsho ldan: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: myur lam 'pho ba'i chos sgo phyes su+u gsol: sa karma ḍāk+ki nī a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de nas dngos gzhi rtsa ba'i smad las drag po'i dkyil 'khor la 'jug pa ni:

phyi mchod rjes su gnang ba'i mgo ru btsud par lha tshom gyi rim pa'o: sa ma ya: de nas nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong de bsdus na dug lnga dug gsum ste: de dag zhi bar byed pa phrin las lha gzhung gi dbang ste: thog mar dbus kyi tshom bu las: ༈ 'byung ba dgrar langs sa bcud nyams pa'i tshe: sems can mu ge'i nad kyis nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan mkha' 'gro nor lha tshogs dang bcas: dbul phongs bkres skoms sel bar the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p pad+ma rgyal po yab yum thogs te: hūm̐: khams gsum dbang sdud 'dod rgu'i dpal yon can: sku mdog dmar snum dbang mo zung 'jug 'khril: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: o rgyan nor lha dbyer med dbang bskur ro: om̐ gu ru pad+ma rā dza ḍāk+ki nī ye a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: man+da ra ba thogs la: hūm̐: tshe la dbang zhing mchog gi rig 'dzin gter: sku mdog dmar mo dbang gi rjes chags can: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: 'chi med rdo rje'i 'ja' lus stsal du gsol: om̐ ā yur ḍāk+ki nī ye a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: mtsho rgyal thogs la: hūm̐: bde chen rig las rdo rje'i brda skad sgrog: zhi 'dzum mdzes pa skye 'gro'i snang ba 'gugs: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: 'dod yon longs spyod gter la dbang sgyur shog: om̐ dz+nyā na ḍāk+ki nī su khaṃ dha ra hrīḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: shar phyogs rdo rje mgyogs ma thogs la: hūm̐: lus 'phags gling la dbang bsgyur pho nya mo: shar phyogs la sogs lha yi dpal 'byor sdud: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: lang tshos skyud pa'i rgyan bzang der stsol cig: om̐ badz+ra ku le a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: lho phyogs rin chen mgyogs ma thogs la: hūm̐: 'dzam bu'i gling la dbang bsgyur pho nya mo: lho phyogs la sogs mi yi mnga' thang sdud: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas:

'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal srid thob par shog: om̐ ku le shaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: nub phyogs pad+ma mgyogs ma thogs la: hūm̐: ba lang spyod la dbang bsgyur pho nya mo: nub phyogs la sogs klu yi longs spyod sdud: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: bang mdzod 'dod rgu 'du bar shog: om̐ ku le hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: byang phyogs karma mgyogs ma thogs la: hūm̐: sgra mi snyan la dbang bsgyur pho nya mo: byang phyogs la sogs gnod sbyin tshe bsod sdud: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: sgra mi snyan gyi tshe dang dpal 'byor stsol: om̐ ku po ti a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sa ma ya: de nas shar phyogs kyi o rgyan sman lha'i tshom bu ni: ༈ sems can sgyu lus 'jig pa'i nad byung tshe: mi bzod sdug bsngal nad kyis nyen pa na: yid gnyis the tshom med? o rgyan sman gyi bla dang dbyer med pas: tshe zad ma yin bar chad nges par sel: o rgyan? bsam p seṅge sgra sgrogs thogs la: hūm̐: dug gsum rtsad gcod bcom ldan seṅge'i sgra: nyon mongs pham mdzad rdo rje phag mo 'khril: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: 'byung bzhi nad kyi bar chad zhi bar shog: om̐ singha ghaṇ+ḍe ye a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rigs bdag sman bla thogs la: hūm̐: baiḍūr mdangs ldan 'chi med bcud 'dzin lha: tshe 'phrang bar gcod rgol ba zhi mdzad phyir: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: dus min 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa skyob par shog: bhai ṣa dz+yai ye a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: shar gyi mgyogs ma thogs la: hūm̐: tshangs pa'i yul nas bcud bsdus mgyogs ma ni: dkar mo nyi zla dbang bsgyur pho nya mo: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: rlung gi nad rnams zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ badz+ra aṅku sha dza a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: lho yi mgyogs ma thogs la: hūm̐: mi yi yul las bcud bsdus mgyogs ma ni: ser mo ri rab dbang bsgyur pho nya mo:

deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: mkhris pa'i nad rnams zhi ba'i dngos grub stsol: om̐ rat+na pā sha hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: nub kyi mgyogs ma thogs la: hūm̐: klu yi yul nas bcud bsdus mgyogs ma ni: dmar mo lang tsho dbang bsgyur pho nya mo: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: bad kan nad rnams zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ pad+ma s+pho ṭa baṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: byang gi mgyogs ma thogs la: hūm̐: steng 'og phyogs bcu'i bcud bsdus mgyogs ma ni: ljang mo srid gsum dbang bsgyur pho nya mo: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: 'dus pa'i nad rnams zhi ba'i dngos grub stsol: om̐ karma ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ.a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sa ma ya: de nas lho phyogs dkyil 'khor tshom bu o rgyan rdo rje gur gyi dbang bskur ba la: ༈ gang zhig gshed ma'i dmag gis mtha' bskor nas: mtshon cha rnon pos 'debs shing nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan rdo rje'i gur dang ldan pa yis: gshed ma bred cing mtshon cha 'thor bar 'gyur: o rgyan? bsam p gtso bo gsang bdag thogs la:

hūm̐: dpal chen gsang bdag rdo rje gtum po'i sku: gnam lcags shugs 'chang spyi bor khyung gis brgyan: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: o rgyan rdo rje'i gur gyi dbang bskur ro: om̐ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rnam rgyal thogs la: hūm̐: shar phyogs gshed ma mthar zhing gzhom pa'i lha: khro bo chen po rnam par rgyal ba yis: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: brtan pa rdo rje'i gur gyi rgyud ldan shog: om̐ badz+ra bī dza ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: mi g.yo ba thogs la: hūm̐: lho phyogs gshed ma mthar zhing gzhom pa'i lha: khro bo chen po mi g.yo mgon po yis: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: sra mkhregs rdo rje'i gur gyi rgyud ldan shog: om̐ kro ta a tsa le a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: stobs po che thogs la: hūm̐: nub phyogs gshed ma mthar zhing gzhom pa'i lha: khro bo chen po dbang phyug stobs chen gyis: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: mi chod rdo rje'i gur gyi rgyud ldan shog: om̐ ma hā bha la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: dbyug sngon thogs la: hūm̐: byang phyogs gshed ma mthar zhing gzhom pa'i lha: khro bo chen po dbyug pa sngon po yis: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: mi shigs rdo rje'i gur gyi rgyud ldan shog: om̐ nī la daṇ+ḍa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sa ma ya: de nas nub phyogs kyi tshom bu o rgyan dregs pa zil gnon gyi dbang bskur ba ni: ༈ lam srang 'jigs pa'i 'phrang la 'grims pa'i tshe: bsad khyer jag pa chom pos nyen pa na: yid gnyis? o rgyan phyag rgya bzhi yi dgongs par ldan: tsau ra mi rgod rngam sems brlag par byed: o rgyan? bsam p dregs pa zil gnon thogs la: hūm̐: dpal chen dregs pa kun 'dul he ru kaḥ sku mdog smug nag srid gsum stobs 'dus sku: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: o rgyan phyag rgya bzhi yi dbang bskur ro:

om̐ artsig nirtsig a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: shar phyogs g.yul las rgyal ba thogs la: hūm̐: shar phyogs lam 'phrang 'jigs pa'i bdud bzhi sgrol: khro bo chen po gshin rje gshed po yis: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: jag rkun chom po tshar gcod phrin las stsol: om̐ sum+bha rā dza a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: gshin rje gshed thogs la: hūm̐: lho phyogs lam 'phrang 'jigs pa'i bdud bzhi sgrol: khro bo chen po gshin rje gshed po yis: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: jag rkun chom po tshar gcod phrin las stsol: oṃ ya mān+ta ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rta mgrin thogs la: hūm̐: nub phyogs lam 'phrang 'jigs pa'i bdud bzhi sgrol: khro bo chen po rta mgrin rgyal po yis: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: jag rkun chom po tshar gcod phrin las stsol: om̐ h+ya ghṛ wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: dbyug pa sngon po thogs la: hūm̐: byang phyogs lam 'phrang 'jigs pa'i bdud bzhi sgrol: khro bo chen po dbyug pa sngon po yis: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: jag rkun chom po tshar gcod phrin las stsol: om̐ daṇ+ḍa dh+wika a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sa ma ya: de nas byang phyogs su dkyil 'khor tshom bu las o rgyan lha srin sde brgyad kyi dbang bskur ba ni: ༈ hor sog 'jigs pa'i dmag gis mtha' bskor nas: chos 'khor gnyan po 'jig la thug pa'i tshe: yid gnyis the tshom med par gsol ba 'debs: o rgyan lha srin sde brgyad 'khor gyis bskor: hor sog dmag dpung bzlog par the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p gtso bo stobs ldan he ru ka thogs la: hūm̐: khrag 'thung nag po stobs ldan he ru kaḥ bdud dpung 'joms mdzad spyi bor bya khyung brgyan: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: o rgyan lha srin gtso bo'i dbang bskur ro: om̐ badz+ra kī li kī la ya e dza bh+yoḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐:

de nas shar phyogs lha yi sde dpon thogs la: hūm̐: shar phyogs sde dpon kun gyi gtso bo ni: lha yi dmag dpon dregs pa dam tshig can: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: shar phyogs dgra bgegs zhi ba'i phrin las stsol: om̐ a rā dza a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: gshin rje thogs la: hūm̐: lho phyogs sde dpon kun gyi gtso bo ni: gshin rje'i dmag dpon dregs pa dam tshig can: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: lho phyogs dgra bgegs zhi ba'i phrin las stsol: om̐ ya rā dza a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: ma mo thogs la: hūm̐: lho phyogs sde dpon kun gyi gtso bo ni: ma mo'i dmag dpon dregs pa dam tshig can: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: nub phyogs dgra bgegs zhi ba'i phrin las stsol: om̐ ma rā dza a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: bdud thogs la: hūm̐: byang phyogs sde dpon kun gyi gtso bo ni: bdud kyi dmag dpon dregs pa dam tshig can: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: byang phyogs dgra bgegs zhi ba'i phrin las stsol: om̐ du rā dza a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rgyal po thogs la: hūm̐: shar lho sde dpon kun gyi gtso bo ni: rgyal po'i dmag dpon dregs pa dam tshig can: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: shar lho'i dgra bgegs zhi ba'i phrin las stsol: om̐ ru rā dza a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: btsan thogs la: hūm̐: lho nub sde dpon kun gyi gtso bo ni: btsan gyi dmag dpon dregs pa dam tshig can: lho nub dgra bgegs zhi ba'i phrin las stsol: om̐ tsa rā dza a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: gnod sbyin thogs la: hūm̐: nub byang sde dpon kun gyi gtso bo ni: gnod sbyin dmag dpon dregs pa dam tshig can: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: nub byang dgra bgegs zhi ba'i phrin las stsol: om̐ sha rā dza a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: klu thogs la: hūm̐: byang shar sde dpon kun gyi gtso bo ni:

klu yi dmag dpon dregs pa dam tshig can: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: byang shar dgra bgegs zhi ba'i phrin las stsol: om̐ nā rā dza a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: gza' thogs la: hūm̐: steng phyogs sde dpon kun gyi gtso bo ni: gza' yi dmag dpon dregs pa dam tshig can: deng 'dir dgra bgegs zhi ba'i phrin las stsol: om̐ rā hu rā dza a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: dam can thogs la: hūm̐: 'og phyogasasde dpon kun gyi gtso bo ni: dam can dmag dpon dregs pa dam tshig can: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: 'og phyogs dgra bgegs zhi ba'i phrin las stsol: om̐ sā dhu rā dza a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: 'di nyid dregs pa'i srog dbang kha sgyur bya na: lha yi dregs pa'i srog dbang thob par shog: a sa ma ya na ra kan: zhes kha bsgyur zhing dam chu sbyin no: sa ma ya: de ltar drag po'i phrin las gzhung gi las tshogs sgrub pa'i dbang gi dngos gzhi rdzogs te: 'di gzhung gi rim pa'o: sa ma ya: de nas phrin las so so'i cha lag gam: sbas yul dang gnas chen bgrod pa'i tshe las tshogs yan lag gi dbang ni: sgrub pa gsum pa'i lha tshom las: thog mar gnas chen gang du bgrod kyang lha 'drer dam bsgrag: bar du sgo dbye rten 'brel rnam bzhi: de yi bar chad bsgral ba drag po gro lod bcas: de dag mthun rkyen chos skyong dgos te: chos skyong ni so so'i bka' gtad spyi gzhung du 'jug pa'o: sa ma ya: thog mar nyi ma 'od zer gyi lha tshom ni: ༈ sbas yul nags khrod dben sa snyogs pa'i tshe: kha char bu yug 'tshubs shing lam 'gags na: yid gnyis? o rgyan gzhi bdag gnyan po'i 'khor gyis bskor: chos mdzad lam sna 'dren par the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p nyi ma 'od zer yab yum thogs la: hūm̐: dmar gsal tsha zer zhags pa'i 'od 'byin pa: khro gnyer gtum mo zung 'jug sku la 'khril: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la:

o rgyan nyi ma 'od zer dbang bskur ro: om̐ sūr+ya rasmis a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rdo rje mkha' 'gro thogs la: hūm̐: rdo rje rigs kyi rnal 'byor mkha' 'gro ma: mda' dar me long lcags kyu'i nam mthongs phye: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: shar phyogs gnas kyi sgo 'byed dngos grub stsol: om̐ badz+ra ḍāk+ki a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rin chen mkha' 'gro thogs la: hūm̐: rin chen rigs kyi rnal 'byor mkha' 'gro ma: mda' dar me long zhags pas nam mthongs phye: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: lho phyogs gnas kyi sgo 'byed dngos grub stsol: om̐ rat+na ḍāk+ki a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: pad+ma mkha' 'gro thogs la: hūm̐: pad+ma rigs kyi rnal 'byor mkha' 'gro ma: mda' dar me long lcags sgrog nam mthongs phye: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: nub phyogs gnas kyi sgo 'byed dngos grub stsol: om̐ pad+ma ḍāk+ki a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: las kyi mkha' 'gro thogs la: hūm̐: las kyi rigs kyi rnal 'byor mkha' 'gro ma: mda' dar me long dril bus nam mthongs phye: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: byang phyogs gnas kyi sgo 'byed dngos grub stsol: om̐ karma ḍāk+ki a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sa ma ya: de nas rin chen gter rgya bkrol ba o rgyan yi dam lha yi tshom bu gro lod kyi dbang bskur ba ni: ༈ las can 'gro ba'i don du gter 'don na: dam tshig zol zog med pa'i dpa' gdeng gis: yid gnyis? o rgyan yi dam lha dang dbyer med pas: pha nor bu yis lon par the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p yi dam gyi sku thogs la: hūm̐: lho phyogs tsan dan nags la spyod par gshegs: dmar nag stag zhon spyi bor thod phreng brgyan: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: o rgyan yi dam lha yi dbang bskur ro: om̐ badz+ra kro ta lo ka sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rdo rje rig ma thogs la:

hūm̐: gsang ba'i yum mchog rdo rje'i rig ma ni: mda' dar bhan+dha bsnams shing gter sgo 'byed: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: lcags kyu'i lde mig zhi ba'i las mdzod cig: om̐ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ.a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: rin chen rig ma thogs la: hūm̐: gsang ba'i yum chen rin chen rig ma ni: mda' dar bhan+dha bsnams shing gter sgo 'byed: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: zhags pa'i lde mig rgyas pa'i las mdzod cig: om̐ rat+na pā sha hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: pad+ma mkha' 'gro thogs la: hūm̐: gsang ba'i yum chen pad+ma'i rig ma ni: mda' dar bhan+dha bsnams shing gter sgo 'byed: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: lcags sgrog lde mig dbang gi las mdzod cig: om̐ pad+ma s+pho ṭa baṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: las kyi mkha' 'gro thogs la: hūm̐: gsang ba'i yum chen las kyi rig ma ni: mda' dar bhan+dha bsnams shing gter sgo 'byed: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: dril bu'i lde mig drag po'i las mdzod cig: oṃ karma ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sa ma ya: de nas spyir ma 'ongs pa'i dus su skal ldan las can gang la la'i rigs rnams sbas yul nags rong dben par snyogs pa'i tshe: o rgyan gzhi bdag srung ma dang : gar ging rig ma bkra shis pa'i rtags mtshan ldan pa'i grogs bgyid par byed pa'i lha yi tshom bu ste: ༈ stag gzig dom dred dug sbrul mche ba can: 'brog chen 'jigs pa'i 'phrang la 'grims pa'i tshe: yid gnyis? o rgyan dpa' bo ging dang srung mar bcas: gdug pa'i sems can skrod par the tshom med: o rgyan? bsam p thog mar o rgyan snang srid zil gnon thogs la: hūm̐: skye 'chi gnyis spangs snang srid zil gyis gnon: rdo rje'i lus la gzhom zhig bral ba'i sku: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: o rgyan dpa' bo ging gi dbang bskur ro:

om̐ badz+ra gu ru om̐ ṭa ya na ra ka ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: man+da ra ba thogs la: hūm̐: mā ra ti kar tshe yi dngos grub brnyes: 'ja' lus nam mkha'i dbang phyug dbang mo yis: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: tshe yi rig 'dzin mchog tu brnyes par shog: om̐ ā yur+dz+nyā na hrīḥ.a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: ye shes mtsho rgyal thogs la: hūm̐: nam mkha'i gos can bde chen mtsho rgyal ma: zab gsang 'khor lo'i dbang mo yid bzhin gter: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: rtag tu gsang sngags rgyun gyis phyug par shog: om̐ dz+nyā na dzi wan mu ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: dpa' bo thogs la: hūm̐: bde chen rgyal po'i ngo bo rnam par sprul: bde chen rig 'dzin dbang bsgyur mkha' la shar: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: dpa' bo rgya mtsho mchog gi dad dpon shog: om̐ tshan+dha ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: mkha' 'gro thogs la: hūm̐: bde chen cha shas mdzes byed yid 'phrog rigs: brda 'gros mkha' la 'gyu ba'i gar stabs can: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: zab lam bde ba'i rtse dga' rol bar shog: om̐ ma hā mu tra la hoḥ.a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: gar ma'i dbang ni: hūm̐: dbyings las ma g.yos mdzes ma'i cha shas rdzogs: bde ba'i rol rtsed dga' ba'i dpal yon can: deng 'dir skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la: lang tsho skyud pa'i rgyan bzang der thob shog: om̐ ḍāk+ki pad+ma mu ṭa hoḥ.a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: ging thogs la: hūm̐: rgod pa'i nyams kyis dpa' ba'i mdangs chags g.yo: dga' ma'i bzhin 'dzin zil bus yid rab phyung : deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: bcu drug khyab bdag 'khor lo'i dga' ston shog: om̐ dha sha ghṛ wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes rigs bzhi thams cad rjes chags rol pa'i dga' ston du bgyid: 'dir las kyi mtha' sdud pa la chos skyaung dge bskul rnams dregs pa sde lnga'i nang du 'jug go:

sa ma ya: 'di nyid bla ma bde gshegs rtsa gsum bka' 'dus kyi cha lag phrin las kyi gzhung yin pa'i phyir: lha bkod me tog tshom bu ma ltar bsgyur la ma nges pa'i phyir phrin las gong du bstan pa'i lha tshom du 'jug 'dod pa dang bye brag mchog gi gzhung ngo : 'di yi bum dbang bsdus pa zur rgyan ye shes drwa ba ltar mos na: rang gzhung 'khyer bde nas blang rgyan bkod 'khor lo'i drwa ba ltar na bum dbang so sor gnas: rtsa ba bde gshegs kun 'dus kyi rim gnyis 'di ltar 'dus pa'i rnam gsum spyi lung ltar ro: zhal gdams man ngag bcu gsum 'dus pa'i le'u bdun ma tshun nas nye bar 'khod pa'o: lung 'di la them yod them med bcas bsam pa lhun 'grub kyis tshang bar mi 'gyur te: sgrub khog le'u brgyad pa'i dbang du gyur pa yin: sgrub khog gsang sngags thugs sgrub man ngag rgya mtsho ltar las: 'di la 'byung lnga rang grol du bstan pa'o: ci'i phyir 'byung lnga rgyu rkyen gyis 'du tshan 'di ka ru grub pa mtsho rgyal gyi 'phrul long shog dril nas gsal lo: des 'di nyid dril sgrub dbang gi le'u spyi chings lha'i 'khrul 'khor: zur rgyan lha gzhung so so ltar ro: rgyud las kṛ yog bar pa rgyan phyag gi gnang ba med rung : lha phyag mngon rdzogs de gsal lo: rgyud kṛ ya ltar la tshom bu bkod tshang dbang po'i don 'grel ltar ro: rgyud u pa rgyan rdzogs rgyan phyag gsal rdzogs kyi don no: rgyud a ti bya bral zhal phyag rgyan them zhes pa don sgyu ma'i snang don la mi 'gal ba'i dbang ste: lo brgyad dang bdun dang don gcig gi dbang la: lha sngags bskyed gsum rdzogs bzhi'i dbang don gcig par 'dod: lung dang mi 'gal khyer so de: bum pa gzhal yas: bum chu lha sku: bum rgyan phyag mtshan: bum pa'i zhabs gzhol rtsig pa: mgul chings lha mo'i mchod sprin: kha g.yer ba ba gam dang bang rim chos tog gi tsakli bcas:

mchu'i nang sgor bdud rtsi 'khyil pa: phyi rol srung ba'i rta mgrin bcas yongs su bkod par bya ba'o: de yi bum dbang ye shes chen po las sbyor ba'i dbang rnams spros pa la spros med du 'jug kyang chog pa yin pas go rim de ltar 'chang bar bya'o: 'di nyid rtsa 'grel dbang gi 'khyer so yin pas rig rtsal gyi rgyan bkod zur nas bgyid do: sa ma ya:

e ma zab pa'i mthar thug ye shes 'khor lo las: bde chen dbang bum man ngag rgya mtsho bzhag: kho mos legs bkod bdud rtsi che: tshig tshogs go bde 'gag tu dril ba 'di nyid: las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: them rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos sa khyi lor bsam yas mchims phu dge'u gong nas gdan drangs shing chu mo glang lor khrom gzigs gsang sngags bdud 'dul gling du shog ser nas zhal bshus so/ gzugs bris su bri ba po sngags lam du rtsi bung gzhol ba po kun dga' blo gros so/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // sha) ༄༅/ bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus las: gsang dbang bde chen 'khor lo zab lam ye shes drwa ba bzhugs so: bde chen gsang ba ye shes ḍāk+kir 'dud: sa ma ya: zab lam rdo rje'i snyan brgyud phreng ba las: tshe gcig 'ja' lus lam la gshegs pa'i phyir: dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho bcud kyi bum bzang las: gzung thag rdo rje lu gu rgyud kyi don: dkyil 'khor lde mig zur bkod pho nya'i rgya: shog dril kun la mi bstan man ngag yin: gsang ba ye shes bzhi sbyoṛ atsha them: de yang zab lam bde ba chen po'i dbang la 'jug par byed pa ni: thog mar dbang gi dkyil 'khor: mdun du mkha' 'gro'i gtor ma zlum po pad 'dab bzhis bskor ba bsham: mchod pa sna tshogs phun sum tshogs par bya: de nas dbang rten gsang ba'i rig ma mtshan dang ldan pa: dung can ma rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rigs: glang chen ma rin chen mkha' 'gro'i rigs: dbyangs can ma pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i rigs: ri dwags ma las kyi mkha' 'gro'i rigs: pad+ma can sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i rigs: 'ga' zhig gis nub phyogs kyang zer: mdor bsdu ba bya rigs rta rigs gnyis: bram ze ma bcas kyi nang nas rigs gang rnyed dkyil 'khor dang mthun pa'i: zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las ci ltar 'grub pa'i rten 'brel dgos rim kha gyu phyogs dang :

phrin las rang gzhung ltar bgyis so: de yang dkyil 'khor gyi rig ma smon lam de dang ldan na: dung can ma dung dkar gyi 'gyu 'gros rnam par ldan zhing : ze'u 'bru ye shes lnga'i rlung 'gyu zhing rlung thun gcig mtshams su lha'i bdud rtsi bskyed: des na nad gdon thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro: glang chen ma glang po'i sna ljags ltar ze'u 'bru lcags kyu'i rnam pas tshogs kyi bdag po'i rlung 'byung : rlung thun re la klu'i bdud rtsi 'bebs: de yi yon tan gyis sgrub pa po la dngos grub thams cad rtsol med du 'byung : dbyangs can ma ni ka la piṅka'i rnal 'byor la: ze'u 'bru zar ma'i me tog rgyas pa lta bu la: lus la dri zhim zhing ngad g.yo ba: 'dar ma nas 'chi med tshe yi rig 'dzin gyi bcud 'bebs pa: rlung 'byin 'jug zag med bde ba'i lang tsho 'bebs pas sgrub pa po tshe ring bar 'gyur: ri dwags ma ni ri dwags kyi rnam 'gyur te ze'u 'bru sbrul lce'i rnam pa can te rlung 'jug re re stobs bskyed nus pa'i me rlung g.yo: rdo rje sbubs su song nas shes rab kyi rtsa kha phye zhing sngags kyi nus pa 'phel bar 'gyur ro: pad+ma can ni bcu drug lcags kyu'i cha shas rdzogs pa rlung thun rer stong nyid bcu drug gi lhan skyes ngo sprod cig car du rdzogs: zag med rgyun gyi rnal 'byor 'phel 'grib med par bstan: zhi rgyas dbang drag las ci bya rung lam du 'gro: lha 'dre'i mthun rkyen rten 'brel gyi snang ba dbang du 'dus pa'o: bya rigs yon tan thams cad bskyed pa'i shes rab kyi rno myur me mched pa ltar 'gyur: rta rigs ma rlung gi gzhi tshugs te gnas lugs kun gzhi 'pho 'gyur med par brten: bram ze mas byang sems rgyud la skye zhing phyogs med rtogs pa mngon shes 'char: lus dbang rtags lha yi yi ge mngon: rigs drug gi rang skad go: 'byung bzhi cha snyoms:

rlung sgrub pas 'ja' lus 'grub: dkyil 'khor gyi lha sgrub pas mchog thun mong gi dngos grub 'byung : rtag tu yid la tshe rabs kyi lha gang yin snang ba la 'char: nyams dang rtogs pa shugs la 'phel: sgrub pa'i rtags 'byong : snying rjes 'gro ba 'dul: dag snang gis zhing khams mjal: tshe gcig la sangs rgyas kyi gsang lam khyad du 'phags: sdig po che las ngan gyi rigs yin kyang lus 'brel thob pas mkha' spyod du 'dren nus pa'i gdeng tshad yod: rgyu mtshan ci zhe na: rgya gar gyi drang srong dang grub pa thob pa'i rdo rje rigs kyi rnal 'byor ma 'gro ba thabs kyis 'dren pa'i ched du sprul pa mi yul du sbas tshul dman pa'i rnam par gzugs bstan pa 'brel 'dogs kyi don no: de'i phyir rang rigs kyi rtsa rigs la yang zhing khams gang yin la dbang ba'i rten 'brel las rigs kyang gang nas chad pas lus kyi rgyu mtshan no: des kyang gang la la zhig dbang po mi yi tshul dang : 'ga' zhig chos pa'i tshul dang : 'ga' zhig rigs ldan gyi tshul te ma nges pa'i cha lugs 'chang ba'o: sa ma ya: rgyu de yi dpe yang : za hor 'bum khang 'gram du rdo rje phag mo lus ngan pa'i cha lugs 'chang nas rgya sgo'i drung du sdod pa kun gyis ngo ma shes pa la: shrī singha nas slob dpon nag po spyod pa la gshegs pa'i lung bstan te: 'di nas shar gyi phyogs rol na: za hor 'bum phrag grong khyer 'gram: lho phyogs bstan pa'i sgo 'gram du: rdo rje phag mo mdze mo'i gzugs: de la 'brel thogs mkha' spyod gnas: 'ja' lus rdo rje'i lam la gshegs: khyod nyid gsang dbang ye shes kyi: gdams pa de la yod kyin longs: the tshom yid gnyis bral bar gyis: de skad lung bzhin gshegs pa la: srang sgo chen po'i khyud zhig la: mdze mo shin tu skyi g.ya' ba: 'khor du de yi bu mo ni: smad 'tshong chang tshong byed pa yi: rnam 'gyur mu stegs yin 'dra ba:

cha lugs tha dad ston par snang : skad cig mthong ma thag tu ni: phyag btsal gus pa'i maṇ+ḍal phul: bu mo rnams kyi smra ba skad: a ma'i mdze 'dres 'bags yong bas: rnal 'byor pa rang bzhud bzhud zer: chang lhag bhan+dha gang tsam drangs: skye med ngang la rang sgra las: om̐ ha ri ni sa baṃ hoḥ zhes pa'i sgra de thos pa dang : bhan+dha'i bdud rtsi la 'ja' shar: phag mo rigs lnga gsal por snang : mchod pa phul nas bde ba myangs: de nas rgyal ba'i lung bstan ltar zhus pas: de 'dra nga ma yin khyod rang grong khyer de nor ba yin yong zer: slar yang the tshom med par thag bcad nas phyag 'tshal bas: khyod nges shes blo brtan zhig yin 'dra: da khyod rang grong khyer la bskor ba bdun bgyis nas: mun rub tsam la 'dir yong mkhan mang po yod pa de la bsdebs shog zer: ci ltar gsungs pa bzhin grong khyer la bskor ba bgyis nas: sngar gyi gnas khang de ma yin pa'i dur khrod chen po zhig gi dbus su thod mkhar smug nag ldems se ba zhig gi nang du sngar gyi mdze mo gnas 'gyur te: rdo rje rnal 'byor ma shin tu gzi brjid che ba: nyi zla'i khri brtsegs pad+ma'i gdan bting : nyi zla'i rgyan gyis spras pa zhig gis phyag g.yas thod pa'i cang te'u dang : g.yon pas bhan+dha bdud rtsis gang ba thogs pa la: 'khor gyi bu mo de rnams rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro mda' dar dang bhan+dha thogs pa: mda' dar dang zung du las bzhi'i phyag mtshan yod pa: gtso mo'i g.yas su stegs kyi kha la mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor bum gsang shes rab ye shes kyi chas yod pa dang : phyi 'khor du lha klu mi yi rigs grangs med pas phyag dang bskor ba byed pa zhig gi gling du 'dug /mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo de yis mdun gyi nam mkha' la gzigs shing ḍā ma ru 'khrol zhing mkha' 'gro'i brda skad sgrogs pa'i tshe/ he ru ka dga' rab dgyes pa rdo rje dngos su byon nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi mkha' ru bzhugs/

rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro'i gtso mos dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pa'i sgras bskul nas phyag mtshan gyis phyag rgya'i phyag bgyis/ mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo de las gnyis mched kyi tshul du dgyes pa rdo rje yab yum gyi ngo bor gyur nas/ mkha' yi dga' bzhi bde ba'i rgyun byang sems kyi rnam pa bum pa'i bcud du gyur te/ zag med ye shes lnga yi ngo bor gyur/ de nas gtso mo de yi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro'i dbang chas rnams kyis dbang bskur/ gtso bo yab yum bdag nyid la thim/ de yi tshe rus pa'i rgyan cha drug gis g.yogs nas dga' bzhi lhan skyes kyi ngo bo sprod gnang*/ mkha' 'gro rigs bzhis las bzhi'i phrin las so so'i rjes su gnang*/ da khyod rus pa'i rgyan drug gi rin chen sgrom bu'i nang du bcug nas dur khrod brgyad kyi bya ba mthar phyin pa'i tshe/ rje 'bangs nyer lnga la dbang bskur ba'i mthar ye shes mtsho rgyal la gtad par gyis/ des kyang rten 'brel rab gnas kyis mtshams sbyor cig: yi ge 'bru 'di yis rgyas btab: da sgrom bu 'dis thum zer nas dar sna lnga yi rgya chings bcas gnang : gsang rgyas thob brgyud pa gang nas blangs shrī singha ma gtogs gzhan la ma bshad gsungs: mthar grong khyer de yi lcags ri phyi ma nas bskor ba lan gsum bgyis pas zhabs sa la mi reg par khru gang btegs par snang ba'i spro ba skyes nas da dung yang gdams ngag zhig lus song ba zhu bsams nas phyin pas: sngar bzhin sprul pa bshigs nas yid mi ches pa zhig byas snang tsa na: sngar gyi sgrom bu de gar yod snyam pas sgal par sing sing zhes dngos su yod par 'dug: des the tshom chod: slar 'di ltar snyan brgyud a mo gha yi las tshogs dgos zhus pas: ci yang gsung ma nyan: snyan brgyud de rgya gar shar gling du med de byang gling du yod pa skad: de yi nang du rdzu 'phrul nyi zla zor 'phen sogs sprul sgyur byed pa'i las tshogs yod par snang :

de bod du ma 'gyur ba skad: slar shrī singha la zhus pas lung bstan pa de de bzhin te: mkha' 'gro de rdo rje phag mo yang zer: rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yang zer: gsang ba ye shes kyang zer: mthing 'od 'bar ma yang zer: go byi dhe ma yang zer: kun dga' mo yang zer: dpal mo yang zer: nyi zla dngos grub kyang zer: las kyi dbang mo yang zer: grub pa'i rgyal mo yang zer: man+da ra ba ye shes mtsho rgyal bcas thams cad ngo bo gcig la rnam pa so sor rgya gar sogs yul gling dang bstun pa'i bye brag go: mdze mo'i cha lugs sman 'tshong 'khor dang bcas pa ni: gsang sngags la log par lta ba skal med rnams la rdo rje theg chen gyi spyod yul du ma gyur pa: lam 'dir mi mos pa rnams kyis rngo ma thogs shing the tshom dang log lta'i dbang gis dngos grub kyi skal ba chad pa'i don gyis de ltar brdzu ba'o: de bas kyang skal med rnams la dur khrod de yi bdag mo yi tshul sha za nag mo'i gzugs: 'khor yang gnas nyul ma gdong can gyi rigs du mas bskor ba'i phyir dngos su dur gyi gcan spyang lag ring dang : dur bya ha ha gh+raṃ gh+raṃ rnams sogs la brdzus te yod pas der bsgrod pa shin du dka' ba'o: des na khyod kyis man ngag snyan brgyud de lan gsum ma zhus na mi gnang : phra men gyi sngags rgod yi ge bcu bzhi ma yi sham bu yin pas bka' rgya dam pa yin: mthar snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus mtha' ru mu stegs phra men mu tri mas gnam lcags kyi thog ser par bur bcug nas bod du kha shas bsleb par 'gyur zhing : de yi gdams bas bod khams phyogs su phyi pa mu stegs pa'i dmag gis 'jig par mi 'gyur ro: 'on kyang cung zad tsam ngang thung pa'i lan: dper na don bzang po gser lta bu gnyer ba la ngang ring po dzam bu'i chu la so nams gzhib pa ltar dgos: 'bras bu bzang po yid bzhin gyi nor bu mtha' yi rgya mtsho'i phyi rol nas len pa la:

snying stobs brtson 'grus pham rgyal bsre nus pa la gru rdzing gi cha lag sgrub pa ltar dgos: snyan grags dang don gnyis kyi skad bzang po nam mkha'i 'brug ltar sgrogs pa la srin po'i yul nas me tog ku sha na len pa ltar dgos: tshe gcig gis sangs rgyas ster ba'i zab lam zhu ba la yid gnyis the tshom gol sa ru ma shor ba: zas dug dang nad mdze: gnas gshin rje'i yul gsum la ya mi nga ba zhig dgos: de ltar bgyis na 'bras bu bzang po gzhan la ngom chog pa yong : zhes gsungs so: gab yig ma rgyud la gsang ba'o: zhes pa de yi 'phrul 'khor gyi gab yig gnyis pa la: sku pad+ma 'byung gnas: gsung nag po pa: thugs ḍā+om+bhi wa: yon tan lo hi pa: phrin las chos skyong zhabs te snang ngor sprul pa'o: dga' rab rdo rje: tai lo pa: shrī singha: nā ro pa: 'jam dpal bshes gnyen: dam pa sangs rgyas: sa ra ha: mi la ras pa bcas phyis 'byung lung bstan pa rin chen snang gi gab yig go: de ltar gsang dbang bde chen 'khor lo rgya gar nas brgyud de: bod du mchims phu sogs la dkyil 'khor gyi dbang mang po bskur ba'i snyan du brgyud pa dang : khra 'brug tu bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'i dbang bskur bas: gsang dbang gi byin 'bebs skabs su bu mo ras sngon gyi ang rag gyon pa: rus pa'i rgyan spras pa zhig dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' nas gar 'cham pa khrom pa rnams kyis mthong bar gyur: rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i dag snang mjal bar man+da ra ba dngos su byon: slob dpon rdo rje 'chang yab yum skur bzhengs te dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor bzhugs nas: ye shes mtsho rgyal: bal 'bangs ka la sid+dhi: bal mo shākya dhe wa: mon mo bkra shis khye'u 'dren bcas pa rigs kyi mkha' 'gro'i skur bzhengs nas dkyil 'khor gsang dbang dngos su thob: de yi tshe snyan brgyud kyi man ngag zhal shes pra khrid bcas pa ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis shog ser logs su bkod nas:

bla ma bka' 'dus: bder 'dus: mkha' 'gro chos bzhi: thugs sgrub rnam lnga: bka' dgongs phur gsum dkyil 'khor cha lag tu gab sbas lde mig skor ro: sa ma ya: de ltar dbang gi bca' gzhi gong ltar la: sta gon sogs bgyis pa ni: thog mar rig ma de la khrus bstsal: gos dkar po bkon: dag gtsang legs par bgyis: lus spos chus byug: de nas rigs lnga dar dpyang brgyan: gos gtsang la mdzes pa ḍāk+ki'i cha lugs rus rgyan sogs kyis legs par spras: gdan gyi steng du 'khod: byin 'bebs bya: mkha' 'gro'i cho ga dang tshogs btang : ha ri ni sas dbang sgrub bya: rig mar rdo rje phag mor dngos su bskyed bstim bya: zhag gsum mam gcig la sgrub pa'i cha rkyen bya: dkyil 'khor la tshom bu phul: mal sa'i mgo de phyogs su gtad la nyal: rmis ltas bzang por ma byung na mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad yin pas phyag dang tshogs 'khor nyams bskang dgos: de ma bgyis pa la dbang mi bskur: las dang ldan pa la dbang sbyin pa ni: bum chus bsang sbyangs bgyis la: om̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ swa bhā wa shud+dho sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ: stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las: mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su pad+ma nyi zla spel ba'i khri steng du: bh+yo dang baṃ las byung ba'i ma gcig rdo rje rnal 'byor ma: sku mdog pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs dang ldan pa: phyag g.yas thod pa'i ḍā ma ru nam mkha' la 'khrol zhing : g.yon pa'i bhan+dha'i nang du 'chi med bdud rtsi dkar dmar gyi bcud kyis gtams pa thugs kar bsnams shing : sku la nyi zla'i rgyan du mas spras shing rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa: dbu la prog zhu dang rigs lnga'i dar dpyang gis brgyan pa: zhabs gar stabs ling tsam du bzhugs pa: mkha' 'gro rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan mda' dar bhan+dha bdud rtsis btams pa bsnams shing : gcer mo rus pa'i rgyan cha drug dang ldan pa bcas gsal ba'o:

bdag mdun gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'phro 'dus mkha' spyod u rgyan dag pa'i zhing khams nas: gsang ba ye shes ḍāk+ki la mkha' spyod kyi rnal 'byor ma sprin ltar gtibs pa lta bus bskor ba spyan drangs te rig mar thim pas: ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro mar mngon sum du gyur pa'i 'dun pa mdzod: hūm̐: ma mi min ye shes mkha' 'gro ma: dbus sangs rgyas rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum: shar rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum: lho rin chen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum: nub pad+ma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum: byang las kyi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum: mtshams 'jig rten rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum: ma gnas 'dir byon la byin gyis rlobs: thugs rje'i sprin phung thibs se thib: byin rlabs char rgyun na ra ra: mos gus 'bras bu chi li li: thabs kyi rgyan cha khro lo lo: shes rab nyams dbyangs kyu ru ru: brda 'gros gar stabs khyugs se khyug: mkha' 'gro'i brda skad di ri ri: mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum dang bcas: gnas 'dir dbang bskur byin chen phob: gsang ba bde chen rig ma 'dir: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dbang bskur cig: grub pa'i gnas mchog dam pa 'di: gzhal yas khang du byin gyis rlobs: dkyil 'khor rdzas la mdangs phyung nas: mos pa'i bu la 'ja' lus stsol: om̐ badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥdzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ om̐ a be sha ya dzaḥdzaḥ

dbang zhu mkhan rnams kyis 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod: om̐ bde gshegs gsang ba'i dbyings phyug yum: dus gsum sangs rgyas bskyed pa'i ma: yum mchog rdo rje rnal 'byor ma: grol lam pho nya'i dngos grub stsol: de nas dam chu sbyin pa ni: hūm̐ baṃḥ dri med pad+ma rak+ta'i bcud: 'di bzung zag med dga' bzhi 'char: dam med rnams kyi snying khrag skem: de bas dam srungs sa ma ya: de nas bum pa thogs te: hūm̐: 'ja' lus rdo rje bum pa'i dbang : skal ldan khyod la bskur ba yis: mkha' 'gro bskyed pa'i dam tshig srungs: dga' ba nyams su myong bar gyis: om̐ badz+ra mu tra dha ra hoḥ bhan+dha thogs te: hūm̐: ye shes rlung ni bhan+dha'i dbang : skal ldan khyod la bskur ba yis: mkha' 'gro sgrub pa'i dam tshig srungs: mchog dga' nyams su myong bar gyis: om̐ an+ḍi ye hoḥ de nas sin+dhu ra yi dkyil 'khor ha ri ni sa bkod pa gnas su bstim: hūm̐ bde chen thig le dkyil 'khor dbang : skal ldan khyod la bskur ba yis: mkha' 'gro'i rdzogs rim dam tshig srungs: lhan skyes nyams su myong bar gyis: om̐ dz+nyā na su kha khaṃ ye swā hā: de nas rigs ma'i phyag g.yon gyi srin mdzub la ye shes lnga'i dar thag btags la: slob ma'i lag tu gtad: hūm̐: zag med 'ja' lus sgrub pa'i grogs: gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro ma: de ring slob bu khyod la gtad: dga' bral chen po nyams su myong : om̐ badz+ra rā ga ya hoḥpad+ma ak+ṣo bh+ya swā hā: des dbang bzhi thob nas grol lam bzhin mngon du gyur: dga' bzhi lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba myong nas: mi rtog pa'i ye shes chen po ngo bo nyid yin par ngos bzung : 'bebs ldog 'dren bkram bzhi yis chos sku 'ja' lus kyi go 'phang 'grub: steng sgo ye shes mngon du gyur nas: 'og sgo bde ba chen po lam du 'gro: steng nas ye shes char rgyun rtag tu phab pa'i bde bas lus kheng :

'og chu rgyun gyi 'grim 'grul bkag nas rdzing gi bcud 'khyil ba'i sgyu lus dpag bsam ljon shing bskyed: rtsa ba ye shes kyi gzhi tshugs: sdong po chos sku'i dpung tshan hrag: yon tan kun ldan gyi yal ga phyogs bcur gyes: snying rje'i lo 'dab phun tshogs su phyug: rig pa shes rab kyi rnam par kha phye: 'bras bu 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku mngon du gyur: snyan brgyud rdo rje'i dbyangs can mchog gi sems dpa' yang dag pa de yi lam du 'jug pa'i tshe: nyams len dang brtson 'grus kyang dgos so: sa ma ya: rtag tu ha ri ni sa'i bla 'khor 'chang : lte bar hūm̐: rtsibs drug la: haḥriḥniḥsaḥbaṃḥmuṃḥ rtsibs mchan la: muḥṭaḥṇiḥdzaḥbaṃḥthunaḥ phyi rol: om̐ baṃ badz+ra hri ṇi pra mo thun pra mo thun pra mo ti ri na le ma sa ma ya thun: om̐ zab ze zo wi ṭa lo khug baṃ thun dzaḥ bdag 'chang ba po la ma sring mkha' 'gro rtag tu 'khor zhing grog dan par gyur cig: om̐ badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma sa ma ya ṇig nal ha phrum ka ka ki ki shag shag su ra si thun thun swā hā: ku ru ko bi ra mañdzu pa shaṃ tri ra tri 'grim 'grim swā hā: zhes bris: de yi phyi rim pad+ma'i phreng bas bskor: rang sngags khri yis rab gnas bya: rdzas ni li khri: rgya mtshal: dngul chu: khab len rdo: 'jol mo'i mtshan ma: bya pho'i sna sder dang snying bcas dzā ti'i phye mas brlan la dar dmar du dril nas 'chang : rigs ldan bcu yi lag brgyud par byas nas rang gis len pa gnad yin: ma rnyed na rigs ldan gnyis bya: rtag tu drod ldan 'chang : sa ma ya: dbang 'di nyid sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi bya ba thams cad la dgongs te: dper na dkyil 'khor gtso bum mtshon pa yin: dbang 'di ma thob na dkyil 'khor gzhung gi nye lam med pa yin te do shin tu gal che'o: sa ma ya: thams cad kyis rig ma'i zhabs pus spyi bor blangs te: phyag thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du me tog re re thogs la:

rjes zlos bya: hoḥ gsang ba bla med lam gyi mchog: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig la: mi 'da' mi rtog srog ltar bzung : rtag tu 'ja' lus bsgrub pa yi: bskyed rdzogs snying po 'dzin la gnas: rdo rje slob dpon gyis: hoḥ skal ldan rnams kyis legs par nyon: zab lam bde ba chen po yi: u dum wā ra'i me tog ltar: yon tan kun ldan rnyed par dka': rgya mtsho'i gling gi nor bu bzhin: ka dag ye shes rang gsal 'di: tsam pa ka yi me tog ltar: dus drug rkyen gyis ya mi nga : 'phags pa'i byin rlabs gter du sbas: 'og sgo dga' bzhi grol lam 'di: sgra gcan 'khor lo'i zom dang 'dra: snang srid dkar dmar dwangs snyigs phye: pho nya'i gnad kyis ngo sprod 'di: rigs lnga'i bde ba skad cig ston: bcu drug dpal mo'i rol rtsed yin: smra brjod kha yi tshig las 'das: rdzogs pa chen po'i sa lam yin: de bas dam tshig 'chang bar bya: mkha' 'gro'i sku yi dam tshig tu: bud med rnams la smad mi bya: skyon du lta dang log bcol spang : mkha' 'gro'i gsung gi dam tshig tu: bud med rnams la sdang mi bya: khong khro gdug sems spang bar bya: mkha' 'gro'i thugs kyi dam tshig tu: bud med rnams la 'tshe ba spang : dkyil 'khor gsum gyis dag snang sbyang : mkha' 'gro'i yon tan dam tshig tu: rdo rje slob dpon gzungs ma dang : rigs rus sras bcas 'dun pas bstod: mkha' 'gro'i phrin las dam tshig tu: rtag tu gsang ba ḍāk+ki brten: bha ga'i dkyil 'khor mchod par bya: mkha' 'gro'i gsang ba'i dam tshig tu: nya stong dus mchod mi bcag cing : tshogs brgya bskang brgyas sgrib sbyong 'bung : rten 'brel dge ba'i gnas chen du: rigs ldan mkha' 'gro thams cad kyis: tshogs 'khor bsham pa'i grogs bgyis nas: rigs 'dus rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor du: phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul bar bgyis: maṇ+ḍal yig brgya ci nus bzla: ma 'ongs rnga yab zhing khams su:

yang yang tshogs pa'i rten 'brel bya: sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams la: rab gnas zhabs brtan legs par phul: 'dzam gling dge ba'i rlung rta dang : sa bcud bsod nams bum gter sba: rjes shes bsngo smon rgyas 'debs bya: sa ma ya: e ma zab pa'i mthar thug las: gsang ba ḍāk+ki'i snyan brgyud ni: dbang bzhi bka' chen chu bo'i rgyud: gling bzhi nas babs rgya mtshor tshogs: bsrubs pa'i bcud kyi dwangs ma bzhin: yang snying lus med mkha' 'gro'i skor: mtsho rgyal bde chen gsang lam 'di: ma 'ongs dus kyi tha ma la: chos kyi bdag po bu la sprod: bka' 'di gnod sbyin gsum gyis skyongs: lam mchog 'di la 'jug pa rnams: mkha' spyod 'ja' lus 'grub nas su: rig 'dzin dgongs pa 'khyaung bar shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: mi nub rgya: gsang rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos sa khyi lor bsam yas mchims phu dge'u gong nas gdan drangs shing*/ lcags mo phag gi lor mdo khams skyed mos tshal/ nang chen rgyal po'i ur 'gos su shog ser nas zhal bshus so/ yi ge pa 'di sngags lam du mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob pa'i kun dga' blo gros kyis bris pas sngags bstan mi nyams shing yun du brtan pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ // sa) chos skyong sde lnga'i bskul gab pa don phyungs kyi sdeb/ khol du phyung ba bka' rgya ma bzhugs pa'i dbu phyogs lags so/ de nas las su bskul ba ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: mi mngon chos dbyings dag pa'i pho brang nas: rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma dgongs su gsol: lhun grub bde chen dbyings kyi pho brang nas: yi dam rgyud sde'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: mkha' dbyings pad+ma 'khyil ba'i pho brang nas: ḍāk+ki gsang ba'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: rngam brjid dur khrod e yi pho brang nas: bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho dgongs su gsol: khrag zhag rba klong 'khrugs pa'i pho brang nas:

chos skyong nor bdag gter srung dgongs su gsol: dgongs shig thams cad bskul lo dbyings nas bzhengs: rig 'dzin bdag la gzi byin mthu stobs stsol: dam nyams dgra la mngon spyod bka' chad phob: deng sang dus ngan snyigs ma lnga brgya'i skabs: bskyed rdzogs chos kyi bstan pa nub la nye: sems can bde skyid skal ba mtha' la thug: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin khas nyen dbang re chung : gsang sngags gnyan po sgrub la 'gras btsal ba'i: ma rungs bdud dang 'byung po kha dar bas: dam can rgya mtsho mngon spyod dus la bab: khyad par rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi: rjes su 'jug pa'i rig 'dzin bdag cag gi: zab mo'i chos dang dben ri gtsug lag khang : grwa 'khor sgar gzhis ka cha dkor nor la: 'tshe zhing g.yul 'gyed dmag 'dren dgra rgol dang : jag chom rku 'phrog bcom dang lam 'phrang bcad: gros ngan mdun sgug rgyab ded ya kha stong : tshad btsug ya bo bzung zhing do bsdo nas: 'tshe zhing bdud kyi gdug rtsub sdang ba rnams: bka' sdod chos skyong dam can ra mdas zlog: nyes can dam nyams dgra bo shor ra re: mthu rtsal las su chos shig srung ma rnams: khrag chang rin chen gser skyems 'di bzhes la: tha tshig dus su ma g.yel phrin las mdzod: de nas ye shes mgon po'i las bskul ni: ho yāḥ mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: bzhengs shig bzhengs shig dpal ldan nag po che: khrag 'thung legs ldan nag po dbyings nas bzhengs: mthu ldan mgon po'i dmag tshogs dgra la drongs: sku che sa gsum gnon pa'i 'gying stabs can: me ltar 'bar ba'i dbu skra dbyings su bskyod: khros pa'i sdang mig snang srid yongs la gzigs: zhal bgrad rngam mche gtsigs pas dgra sha rol: phyag g.yas gri gug lha srin zil gyis gnon: 'og ma'i ral gris dam nyams srog dbugs phral: g.yon pa'i thod khrag sde brgyad klad khrag dkrug: 'og mas tri shul 'dre rgod snying la bsnun:

dur khrod chas ldan dregs pa bsngangs shing brgyal: gyad kyi rol stabs mthil gyis srid gsum gnon: srid pa'i stobs sbyor dmar mo tsaṇ+ḍi 'khyud: gri thod mgul 'khyud gnam sa lto ba sbyor: sku las skyes pa'i me lce ya la la: ba spu'i gseb nas khro chung skar ltar 'khrug: mngon spyod rtsal bcu'i phrin las 'grub pa'i lha: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: khro bo'i dmag tshogs dam nyams dgra la drongs: hoḥ sku yi sprul pa dpal mgon gdong bzhi pa: phyag bzhi g.yas g.yon gri gug thod khrag bsnams: 'og mas beng chen kha ṭ+wāṃ phyar thabs gdeng : myur mgyogs sde brgyad kun gyi dmag dpon mdzad: dri za me lha rnams kyi 'khor dang bcas: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: shar phyogs mgon po'i dmag tshogs dgra la drongs: hoḥ yon tan sprul pa ma ning srog gi bdag: phyag gnyis ru mtshon dang ni tsit+ta gsol: dur khrod chas dang beng bcug ber chen gsol: skye 'gro rtsis la 'debs pa'i dmag dpon mdzad: gshin rje srin po rnams kyi 'khor dang bcas: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: lho phyogs mgon po'i dmag tshogs dgra la drongs: hoḥ gsung gi sprul pa myur mdzad phyag drug pa: g.yas gsum gri gug thod phreng ḍā ru bsnams: g.yon gsum thod khrag rtse gsum zhags pa 'khyugs: snang srid las su bskul ba'i dmag dpon mdzad: klu dbang rlung lha rnams kyi 'khor dang bcas: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: nub phyogs mgon po'i dmag tshogs dgra la drongs: hoḥ phrin las sprul pa dur khrod bram ze'i gzugs: he ru ka pa ḍā ru rkang gling thogs: gnod sbyin dbang ldan rnams kyi 'khor dang bcas: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: byang phyogs mgon po'i dmag tshogs dgra la drongs: hoḥ gnyis med sprul pa las mkhan bya rog gdong : gri thod bsnams shing dpa' ba'i chas dang ldan:

tsaṇ+ḍi yum sbyor gri thod dgyes par stob: tshangs pa sa bdag rnams kyi 'khor dang bcas: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: steng 'og mgon po'i dmag tshogs dgra la drongs: hoḥ las kyi yum bzhi rang mdog gri thod bsnams: kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin mdzad rus pa'i rgyan drug can: sgo ma rigs bzhi'i rang rtags phyag mtshan thogs: 'khor du las byed nyi khri rnams kyis bskor: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: khor yug mgon po'i dmag tshogs dgra la drongs: hoḥ nag po chen po phyag bzhi'i dus la bab: mgon chen sde bzhi yum bcas dus la bab: bya rog gdong dang sgo skyong dus la bab: dpal mgon dam can rgya mtsho'i pho nya ba: dri za rta la bzhon nas rgyal mtshan phyar: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: shar phyogs dgra bgegs thal ba'i rdul du rlog: me lha ra skyes bzhon nas rtse gsum thogs: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: shar lho dgra bgegs thal ba'i rdul du rlog: gshin rje ma he bzhon nas be con thogs: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: lho phyogs dgra bgegs thal ba'i rdul du rlog: srin po ro lang bzhon nas thod dbyug thogs: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: lho nub dgra bgegs thal ba'i rdul du rlog: chu lha sbrul la bzhon nas sbrul zhags thogs: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: nub phyogs dgra bgegs thal ba'i rdul du rlog: rlung lha shwa ba bzhon nas ba dan thogs: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: nub byang dgra bgegs thal ba'i rdul du rlog: gnod sbyin stag la bzhon nas ral gri thogs: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: byang phyogs dgra bgegs thal ba'i rdul du rlog: dbang ldan glang la bzhon nas mda' gzhu thogs: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: byang shar dgra bgegs thal ba'i rdul du rlog: tshangs pa rta la bzhon nas 'khor lo thogs: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la:

steng phyogs dgra bgegs thal ba'i rdul du rlog: sa bdag phag la bzhon nas bum pa thogs: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: 'og phyogs dgra bgegs thal ba'i rdul du rlog: hoḥ dpal ldan ye shes mgon po'i pho nya ba: phyogs skyong bcu yi dmag tshogs dgra la drongs: dgra bo pho rgyud thams cad rtsad nas chod: dgra bo mo rgyud thams cad mngal nas skom: dgra bo'i rigs rgyud thal ba'i rdul du rlog: dgra bo'i sgo nor thams cad phyags mas thob: dgra bo'i yul zhing thams cad rlung la bskur: dgra bo'i pha sde nang tshan nang 'thab thongs: dgra bo'i yul khams thams cad phung du chug: dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad dgra la phob: byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga dgra la phob: rkyen ngan nyi khri chig stong dgra la phob: gnam 'khrugs ri ltar nyil ba dgra la phob: sa 'khrug chu ltar 'brub pa dgra la phob: yul 'khrug 'bras ltar bsigs pa dgra la phob: 'byung 'khrug rlung ltar 'tshub pa dgra la phob: gri 'khrug rno ba'i mtshon cha dgra la phob: srin mo'i sbyor ba'i dug rgod dgra la phob: na tsha 'byung bzhi 'khrugs pa dgra la phob: sdug bsngal sems gdon langs pa dgra la phob: god kha gyod byur thams cad dgra la phob: rmi ltas mtshan ngan thams cad dgra la phob: mi rung bkra mi shis pa dgra la phob: snang srid yongs kyi dmod pa dgra la phob: byad dang dal kha thams cad dgra la phob: pha rol dgra bo'i mi rabs bdun rgyud rnams: bka' yi gtor ma 'di dang mnyam du bzhes: rdul du brlag nas ming yang med par mdzod: oṃ ma hā ka la thun bh+yoḥ ka la ra tri thun bh+yoḥ he ka ra ya e sha tir bh+yoḥ byad ma nṛ tri mā ra ya khang tsakra hu lu hu lu shag bh+yoḥ ru tra tshin+dha tshin+dha bhan+dha bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭḥ he he bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog:

de nas zhing skyong mgon po'i las bskul ni: dzaḥ shar lho rngam brjid bdud yul mun pa'i gling : dur khrod chen po rab 'bar tsā ri ṭa: sha za khrag 'thung gtibs pa'i pho brang nas: bdud mgon seng gdong yab yum skur bzhengs shig: chos skyong nag po'i dmag tshogs dgra la drongs: las su chas nas dgra srog gcod pa'i tshe: seṅge'i nga ro 'brug ltar 'u ru ru: g.yu ral gseb nas seng chung skar ltar 'khrugs: phyag g.yas ru dar nag po lhabs se lhab: g.yon pas dmar chen gtor zor dgra la 'phen: mun rum phod kha nag po lhubs se lhub: stag ral gzig shubs ral gri khra la la: bdud rta nag po 'dur lding khyugs se khyug: g.yon du rngam pa'i nag mo re ma ti: bdud kyi bu mo seṅge'i gdong pa can: dmar mo rtse gsum gtor zor dgra la 'debs: dar dmar ber gsol btsan gyi rta dmar zhon: yab yum mdun du sprel gdong baṃ gnyis 'gyed: rkang pas zor 'phen spyi gtsug sa la 'gro: dug rlangs kham nag bu yug 'tshub ma 'khyil: bdud chas 'dzin tshe lho btsan tshul bzung ba: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bdud kyi dmag tshogs dam nyams dgra la drongs: dzaḥ shar phyogs lha yi dregs pa dmag la chos: rdo rje 'bar bas dung khrab rmog zhu gsol: stag ral gzig shubs ral gri mdung dar thogs: lha rta ngang pa 'dur lding khyugs se khyug: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: lha yi sde dpon dmag tshogs dgra la drongs: dzaḥ lho phyogs btsan gyi dregs pa dmag la chos: 'bar ba khrag 'thung bswe khrab rmog zhu gsol: ber chen mdung dmar zhags pa dgra la 'debs: stag ral gzig shubs ral gri sked la brgyan: rag pa rting dkar 'dur lding khyugs se khyug: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: btsan gyi sde dpon dmag tshogs dgra la drongs: dzaḥ nub phyogs ma mo'i dregs pa dmag la chos: dmar nag ral gcig rtse gsum tsit+ta thogs:

rus pa'i rgyan ldan dur khrod g.yang gzhi gsol: g.yu 'brug mgo dgu 'dur lding khyugs se khyug: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: ma mo sde dpon dmag tshogs dgra la drongs: dzaḥ byang phyogs klu yi dregs pa dmag la chos: mthing nag phod kha g.yu khrab rmog zhu can: yan lag mig brgyan ral gri lcags par thogs: rta nag rting dkar 'dur lding khyugs se khyug: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dge bsnyen sde dpon dmag tshogs dgra la drongs: dzaḥ shar lho bdud kyi dregs pa dmag la chos: nag po lcags khrab rmog zhu dar nag lhub: stag ral gzig shubs dgra satwa ru mtshon bsnams: bdud rta nag po 'dur lding khyugs se khyug: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bdud kyi sde dpon dmag tshogs dgra la drongs: dzaḥ lho nub gza' yi dregs pa dmag la chos: ljang sngon srin gzugs dbu dgu sbrul mjug can: ral gri rgyal mtshan mda' gzhu sbrul zhags thogs: sku lus mig brgyan glog zhags 'od kyis 'gengs: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gza' yi sde dpon dmag tshogs dgra la drongs: dzaḥ nub byang dgra lha'i dregs pa dmag la chos: smug nag rdo rje'i go khrab rmog zhu can: ral gri ru mtshon gnam lcags phur bu bsgril: stag ral gzig shubs btags nas bswo sgra sgrog: mtshal stag dmar po 'dur lding khyugs se khyug: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dgra lha'i sde dpon dmag tshogs dgra la drongs: dzaḥ byang shar dam can dregs pa dmag la chos: dmar smug bswe theb phod kha lhab lhub can: rdo rje dgra snying ru mtshon dmar po thogs: stag ral gzig shubs ral gri 'od ldan brgyan: seṅge mgo sngon 'dur lding khyugs se khyug: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dam can sde dpon dmag tshogs dgra la drongs: dzaḥ zhing skyong mgon po'i dmag tshogs dus la bab: lha yi dal kha thams cad dgra la phob:

btsan gyi shwa kha dmar po dgra la phob: ma mo'i yams nad thams cad dgra la phob: klu yi mdze nad thams cad dgra la phob: bdud kyi zhags pa nag po dgra la phob: gza' yi nag po kha 'tham dgra la phob: dgra lha'i mtshon cha dbal kha dgra la phob: dam can pho lhog glang thabs dgra la phob: dgra bo pho rgyud thams cad gri ru sod: dgra bo mo rgyud thams cad smyo ru chug: dgra bo'i rigs rgyud thams cad 'bogs su chug: dgra bo nyi ma shar nub go ldog thongs: dgra bo 'gro ba'i lam rnams mdun rgyab ldog: dgra bo mgyogs pa'i rta rnams rgyus pa chings: dgra bos phyar ba'i dpung pa ral gris chod: dgra bo skyob pa'i dgra lha go cha shos: dgra bo srung ba'i gur khang 'khor lo gtor: dgra bo mthun pa'i skyes lha yul lha phyes: dgra bo chags pa'i sku mkhar rmang nas shigs: dgra bo'i longs spyod sgo nor rtsad nas bcol: dgra bo 'byung ba 'khrug nas mgo mjug ldog: khyad par 'gras ya rtsod ya 'dzing ya dang : kha 'jam snying rtsub zhe nas sdang zhing smod: do bsdo phod btsug snyad sko bsam ngan 'chang : dmigs pa'i dgra bo byad ma sdig can gyi: bla tshe rnam shes srog dbugs phrol la shog: mngon spyod ma zhan mthu dang rtsal ma zhan: rig 'dzin bdag la 'gras pa'i dgra bo rnams: bka' yi gtor ma 'di dang mnyam du bzhes: oṃ ma hā kā la siṃ ha mu kha thun bh+yoḥ si na ra ma ma tri tsa tri thun bh+yoḥ tri tri dhe wa sha la ya tsa tri nā ga rak+sha bh+yo bh+yoḥ du pra ma ki kaṃ gra hā na dar pa dar pa sā dhu nan dgra la bh+yo bh+yoḥ mā ra ya zlog zlog: de nas drang srong gza' yi las bskul ni: dzaḥ lho nub me rlung 'khrug pa'i gnas kyi mchog: 'byung ba dkar dmar nyi zla cha lang rdeb: dug gi rlangs pa srid pa yongs la khyab: gnam lcags khro chu'i tshwa tshwa si li li: mi bzad skye 'gro bkum pa'i pho brang nas: drang srong gza' mchog yab yum skur bzhengs shig:

chos skyong khra bo'i dmag tshogs dgra la drongs: snang srid srog la khyab pa'i mthu bo che: dud kha mgo dgu bya rog tog gis brgyan: ro stod srin po zhe sdang me ltar 'bar: ro smad klu mo 'dod chags chu ltar khol: sked pa gnyan rgod gti mug mun ltar 'thib: g.yas g.yon dang po ral gri chu srin gdugs: 'og gnyis thog mda' 'phen zhing sbrul zhags 'debs: lte bar zhal gdang skye 'gro zas su za: sku smad sbrul mjug rgya mtsho'i klong du 'khyil: mgo lus thams cad mthong dug dug gis gang : dug rlangs mi bzad phyogs bcu'i gnas su khyab: mthong ba tsam gyis skye 'gro khrag tu skyugs: yum mchog khrag mig nag mo dmar nag ma: khros pa'i zhal gdang nyi zla cha lang rdeb: sku smad sbrul mjug glog dang me lce 'khyug: dbyings kyi dbang bsgyur gza' rgod yab yum gyis: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: khyab 'jug dmag tshogs dam nyams dgra la drongs: dzaḥ gza' rgod zla ba dkar la zhal gsum pa: phyag gnyis shel gyi ral gri gser gzhong 'dzin: gza' rgod lhag pa dung mdog zhal gsum pa: g.yas pas chu gri g.yon pas sbrul zhags 'dzin: gnyis ka chu rlung sgro gshog sbrul mjug can: chu yi las byed byi phag srog la gnas: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dgra bo chu khams lo pa shor ra re: gza' rgod zla ba lhag pa dgra la bh+yoḥ dzaḥ gza' rgod nyi ma dmar po zhal gsum pa: g.yas pas spu gri g.yon pas glog zhags 'dzin: gza' rgod mig dmar dug 'chang zhal gsum pa: g.yas pas satwa re g.yon pas thog rgod 'dzin: gnyis ka me rlung sgro gshog sbrul mjug can: me yi las byed rta sbrul srog la gnas: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dgra bo me khams lo pa shor ra re: gza' rgod nyi ma mig dmar dgra la bh+yoḥ dzaḥ gza' rgod phur bu sngo ljang zhal gsum pa: g.yas pas phur pa g.yon pas rlung zhags 'dzin: gza' rgod sgra gcan dud ljang zhal gsum pa:

g.yas pas 'khor lo g.yon pas skar mda' 'dzin: gnyis ka drag rlung sgro gshog sbrul mjug can: rlung gi las byed stag yos srog la gnas: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dgra bo shing khams lo pa shor ra re: gza' rgod phur bu sgra gcan dgra la bh+yoḥ dzaḥ gza' rgod spen pa ser po zhal gsum pa: g.yas pas ri rab g.yon pas dug par 'dzin: gza' rgod pa sangs ser skya zhal gsum pa: g.yas pas me rlung g.yon pas nad rkyal thogs: gnyis ka sa rlung sgro gshog sbrul mjug can: sa yi las byed khyi 'brug glang lug gi: srog la gnas shing 'byung ba dbang bar byed: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dgra bo sa khams lo pa shor ra re: gza' rgod spen pa pa sangs dgra la bh+yoḥ dzaḥ sbyor ba'i yum mchog klu yi bu mo brgyad: zhal gcig phyag gnyis kha dog yab dang mthun: thams cad phyag na thog ser sgrom bu thogs: spyi bor sbrul gyi gdengs ka gsum dang ldan: mjug ma dug sbrul shugs 'chang grim par 'chang : dgra la gza' nad 'bebs pa'i mthu mo che: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gnod byed sdang sems ldan pa shor ra re: gza' yum klu bdud bu mo dgra la bh+yoḥ dzaḥ drang srong gza' mchog dmag tshogs dus la bab: nyi ma stag gi tshes nas 'dzin pa'i tshe: sgra gcan nag po chu bdud g.yas su bskor: dgra bo pho rgyud thams cad rtsad nas chod: nyi ma sprel gyi tshes nas 'dzin pa'i tshe: sgra gcan nag po me bdud g.yon du bskor: dgra bo mo rgyud thams cad rtsad nas chod: dpyid gsum stag sprel gnyis kyi nyi ma la: byang phyogs dgra la sa gza' kha 'tham thongs: dbyar gsum glang lug gnyis kyi nyi ma la: shar phyogs dgra la me gza' zha ring phob: ston gsum khyi 'brug gnyis kyi nyi ma la: lho phyogs dgra la rlung gza' smyo 'bog phob: dgun gsum phag sbrul gnyis kyi nyi ma la: nub phyogs dgra la skeg 'dar chu gza' phob:

zla ba'i bco lnga gnam stong nyi ma la: dmigs pa'i dgra la stong grib nag po phob: dzaḥ sgra gcan nag po rbad pa'i dus la bab: lo zla pho mo dkar tshes nag tshes la: mngon spyod chen po srog bdag khyed kyi shes: dri za'i yul nas rlung ltar 'gyu ba yi: dam nyams dgra yis lha gsol gang byas kyang : nyi mas smin drug non pa'i dus dang sprod: rlung nas gnod sbyin yul du 'gyu ba'i tshe: dgra bos bag ma gtong len gang byas rnams: zla bas bya sbo non pa'i dus dang sprod: gnod sbyin yul nas me lhar 'gyu ba'i tshe: dgra bos phywa g.yang 'bru bcud gang spel rnams: lag pas chu stod non pa'i dus dang sprod: klu nas dbang ldan yul du 'gyu ba'i tshe: dgra bos ban bon lha bsgoms sngags bzlas rnams: phur bus mgo bo non pa'i dus dang sprod: dbang nas gshin rje'i yul du 'gyu ba'i tshe: dgra bos dur 'debs mo rtsis gang byas kyang : pa ba sangs kyis rgyal non dus dang sprod: gshin rje gnod sbyin yul du 'gyu ba'i tshe: dgra bos rtsed mo rta rgyug gang byas kyang : spen pas mon gru non pa'i dus dang sprod: gnod sbyin dri zar rgyu ba'i dus kyi tshe: dgra bos legs pa'i bya ba gang byas kyang : zin phung zor ba dug 'bebs dus dang sprod: dzaḥ sdang zhing sdug pa'i byad ma sdig can rnams: gnam sa gling bzhi ri rab gar gnas kyang : khyab mjug nag pos dug gi zor kha rgyobs: sgra gcan nag po rlung gi 'khor lo can: ki kang nag pos sde brgyad dmag tshogs sdud: gza' mchog dmag dpon chen po las la bskul: dug gi ser ba nag pos dgra yul khongs: glog gi zhags pa dmar pos dgra bo chum: ngar chen 'brug mos dgra bo klad pa skoms: gnam lcags thog gi dgra bo phye mar thongs: me dug dmar pos dgra bo smyo bar gyis: chu dug nag pos dgra bo 'bog par gyis: sa dug nag pos dgra bo 'thibs par gyis:

rlung dug nag pos dgra bo rings par gyis: steng gza' dkar pos dgra bo lkug par gyis: bar gza' khra bos dgra bo zha bar gyis: sa gza' nag pos dgra bo brgyal bar gyis: dkrugs shig dam nyams dgra bo'i 'byung ba dkrugs: thob cig gza' bdud dug mda' dgra la thob: rgyugs shig ka cha dkor rkun phyi la rgyugs: phyogs nas langs pa'i dmag chen steng du rgyugs: thad nas langs pa'i dgra bo'i steng du rgyugs: rta kha bsigs pa jag pa'i steng du rgyugs: sha chang khur ba rkun ma'i steng du rgyugs: ya kha dmod pa'i shag 'dren steng du rgyugs: 'bu shu byed pa zur za'i steng du rgyugs: yon bdag gzhungs ngan ngo log steng du rgyugs: grwa 'khor dam nyams bka' 'gal steng du rgyugs: dmigs pa'i byad ma dgra bo'i steng du rgyugs: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bh+yo bh+yo de ni dam nyams dgra la bh+yoḥ gza' mchog dug gdong mgo dgu dgra la bh+yoḥ khyab 'jug dug rlangs khol ma dgra la bh+yoḥ ki kang me yi 'khor lo dgra la bh+yoḥ gza' rgod nyi ma zla ba dgra la bh+yoḥ gza' rgod mig dmar lhag pa dgra la bh+yoḥ gza' rgod phur bu pa sangs dgra la bh+yoḥ gza' rgod spen pa biṣ+ṭi dgra la bh+yoḥ stag srin zor ba gdong can dgra la bh+yoḥ 'brog srin chu srin gdong can dgra la bh+yoḥ kong srin ba glang gdong can dgra la bh+yoḥ bam srin dred mong gdong can dgra la bh+yoḥ gza' bdud du ba mjug ring dgra la bh+yoḥ gza' bdud me 'bar stag mgo dgra la bh+yoḥ gza' bdud g.yag mgo rlung 'tshub dgra la bh+yoḥ gza' bdud chu ri sngon mo dgra la bh+yoḥ gza' bdud phung ba zor thogs dgra la bh+yoḥ gza' bdud byi ba kun phung dgra la bh+yoḥ gza' bdud lta ba mig dmar dgra la bh+yoḥ gza' bdud khyab pa lag ring dgra la bh+yoḥ gza' bdud za ba kha che dgra la bh+yoḥ gza' bdud 'gyu ba rkang mang dgra la bh+yoḥ srog bdag khyab 'jug nag po 'khor bcas kyis:

dmigs pa'i dam nyams dgra bo las ngan 'di: bka' yi gtor ma 'di dang mnyam por bzhes: rdul du brlags nas ming yang med par mdzod: oṃ ki kang hrī shag ru rag raṃ nā ge tsit+ta traṃ ma ma yo za 'gram ha rā hu la 'grim gh+rim lhang lhang rgyug rgyug bh+yo bh+yoḥ dgra bo'i srog la bh+yo mā ra ya dgra bo'i snying la bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: de nas btsan rgod kyi las bskul bya ba ni: dzaḥ byang shar gnas mchog ma ru rtse yi yul: phu na zangs ri 'bar ba tshar du bsgrigs: mda' na khrag mtsho lbu ba kya ma kyu: khor yug zangs kyi lcags ri phreng bas bskor: rtsi shing thams cad dmar nag 'tshub cing gzengs: klung gi chu rnams dmar chen khrag tu 'bab: 'byung ba'i sgra rnams ru lu'i rngam skad sgrog: de dbus zangs kyi ri rab 'bar ba'i rtser: mchong lding smug po bswe yi ba gam can: nang rnams thod pa'i sku mkhar ri ltar brtsegs: de 'dra'i pho brang tshangs pas 'gran zla bral: dbus su bzhugs mdzad gnod sbyin mi bo che: btsan rgod bswe yi khrab can dbyings nas bzhengs: chos skyong dmar po'i dmag tshogs dgra la drongs: me 'od gdong can snang srid srog gi bdag: shan pa'i gzugs can glog ltar 'dzam gling bskor: dus mtha' srid pa sdud ltar phrin las 'gyed: 'khor 'das sngangs pa'i mtshon char dgra la 'debs: stong gsum za byed srin po khros 'dra'i zhal: khrag ltar g.yo ba'i spyan rtsa phyogs bcur 'khyil: gangs ri'i dbal ldan mche bas ma mchu mnan: dar dmar rtsi ber steng du bswe khrab gsol: bswe rmog ru dar rgyal mtshan sprin ltar g.yo: phyag g.yas tsan dan beng chen mkha' la phyar: g.yon pas ru mtshon btsan zhags dgra la 'debs: stag ral gzig shubs ral gri 'od ldan brgyan: rag pa rting dkar sa gzhi 'tshubs kyis 'gengs: mtshal lu zangs kyi ze can rol du khrid: me rlung 'khrugs pa'i tshwa tshwa ya la la: bshan pa'i tshul can gnod sbyin 'khor bcas kyis:

sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: btsan rgod dmag tshogs dam nyams dgra la drongs: dzaḥ sku yi sprul pa klu srin bshan pa ni: mthing nag dar thod 'jo ber dgu brtsegs gsol: g.yas pas sbrul zhags g.yon pas shang kha 'bud: bra nag rting dkar sa gzhi 'tshubs kyis 'gengs: bswo sgra sgrogs pa'i stag shar 'khor dang bcas: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: nga yi nor dang ka cha'i phyi la rgyugs: nga yi rdzas dang dpyad cha'i phyi la rgyugs: nga dang 'gras pa'i dam nyams dgra bo yi: bla srog don snying dmar po khyer la shog: gsod byed klu yi bshan pa dus la bab: dzaḥ gsung gi sprul pa brag btsan bshan pa ni: dmar po dar dmar phod dang dar thod bcings: g.yas pas btsan zhags g.yon pas dar 'phen bsgrengs: btsan rta dmar zhur sa gzhi 'tshubs kyis 'gengs: cho 'phrul gtong ba'i zangs sprel 'khor dang bcas: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: nga yi nor dang ka cha'i phyi la rgyugs: nga yi rdzas dang dpyad cha'i phyi la rgyugs: nga dang 'gras pa'i dam nyams dgra bo yi: bla srog don snying dmar po khyer la shog: sgrol byed btsan gyi shan pa'i dus la bab: dzaḥ thugs kyi sprul pa tshangs pa dkar po ni: dar dkar ber dang dar thod rin chen brgyan: g.yas pas zhags dkar g.yon pas sgrom bu 'dzin: rta mchog ngang dkar sa gzhi 'tshubs kyis 'gengs: sprul pa dge slong tshul 'dzin 'khor dang bcas: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: nga yi nor dang ka cha'i phyi la rgyugs: nga yi rdzas dang dpyad cha'i phyi la rgyugs: nga dang 'gras pa'i dam nyams dgra bo yi: bla srog don snying dmar po khyer la shog: za byed lha yi dge bsnyen dus la bab: dzaḥ tshangs pa'i sprul pa srog bdag shel ging ni: skyes bu chen po dar thod tshangs gdugs can: za 'og dmar khra sngo khra'i rtsi ber gsol: g.yas pas ral gri g.yon pas mda' gzhu 'dzin: 'ching byed zhags pa dkar po gru la bkon:

rgyal po'i cha lugs skye 'gro rtsis la 'debs: sham bha la yi chos skyong drag rtsal can: bstan pa srung ba'i dkor bdag 'khor dang bcas: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: nga yi nor dang ka cha'i phyi la rgyugs: nga yi rdzas dang dpyad cha'i phyi la rgyugs: nga dang 'gras pa'i dam nyams dgra bo yi: bla srog don snying dmar po khyer la shog: dge bsnyen myur mgyogs chen po'i dus la bab: dzaḥ yon tan sprul pa gter gyi srung ma ni: dkar mo mdzes ldan le brgan go zu gsol: dbu la 'dod 'byung rin chen prog zhu gsol: g.yas pas mda' dar g.yon pas rin chen 'dzin: bya pho mtshal lu lam lam shugs 'chang 'phyo: byi la gwa pa myur mgyogs 'khor dang bcas: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: nga yi nor dang ka cha'i phyi la rgyugs: nga yi rdzas dang dpyad cha'i phyi la rgyugs: nga dang 'gras pa'i dam nyams dgra bo yi: bla srog don snying dmar po khyer la shog: lcam gcig smin gyi ma mo'i dus la bab: dzaḥ phrin las sprul pa rol pa sde bzhi ni: bshan pa dmar po bswe khrab rmog zhu gsol: g.yas pas btsan zhags g.yon pas ru mtshon bsgrengs: stag ral gzig shubs rno ba'i ral gris brgyan: rag pa rting dkar sa gzhi 'tshubs kyis 'gengs: sprul pa sngags nag tshul 'dzin 'khor dang bcas: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: nga yi nor dang ka cha'i phyi la rgyugs: nga yi rdzas dang dpyad cha'i phyi la rgyugs: nga dang 'gras pa'i dam nyams dgra bo yi: bla srog don snying dmar po khyer la shog: srog bdag hor pa sde bzhi'i dus la bab: dzaḥ gnod sbyin chen po rab 'bar srin po'i gdong : stong khams gling 'dir dbang bsgyur myur mgyogs can: rngam pa'i zhal gdang dgra bo'i sha la zo: gtum pa'i ljags rkyongs dgra bo'i khrag la 'thung : rno ba'i mche gtsigs dgra bo'i rus la mur: 'jigs pa'i gzugs ston dgra bo brgyal bar gyis: phyag g.yas tsan dan beng chen sgo gsum nas:

dkar po lha yi dmag tshogs nyi khri stong : dgra bo pho rgyud mi rabs rtsad nas chod: dmar po btsan gyi dmag tshogs nyi khri stong : dgra bo mo rgyud mi rabs rtsad nas chod: nag po bdud kyi dmag tshogs nyi khri stong : dgra bo'i rigs rgyud mi rabs rtsad nas chod: tsan dan beng gi sgo srung ma mo bzhi: khrag nad dmar yams bdun drug dgra la phob: g.yon pas btsan zhags dmar pos dgra bo chings: ru mtshon dmar po'i dbal kha dgra la phob: gnam lcags thog mda' dgra bo'i snying du ya: phyung rdeg spu gris dgra bo'i mgo lus phrol: klu yi shan pa srog len mthu bo che: bla ma'i sku dgra byed po do nub sgrol: btsan gyi shan pa srin po kha che ba: sangs rgyas bstan dgra byed po do nub sgrol: lha yi tshangs pa shel ging dug mda' can: rig 'dzin bdag gi sgos dgra do nub sgrol: srid pa las kyi ma mo sha za ma: gtsug lag gnas 'dir 'tshe ba do nub sgrol: rol pa chen po gsod byed shan pa bzhi: 'tshe zhing sdang ba'i jag chom do nub sgrol: sprul pa yang sprul las byed nyi khri stong : dmigs pa'i dam nyams dgra bgegs do nub sgrol: dzaḥ btsan gyi dmag dpon sprul pa las la 'gyed: gnod sbyin chen pos cho 'phrul dgra la thongs: rig 'dzin bdag gi chos skyong mthu bo che: slob dpon pad+ma'i bka' nyan drag rtsal can: deng 'dir bskul lo dung dung 'bod lags pas: ma g.yel rin chen gter gyi gnyer kha skyongs: ma g.yel gsang sngags zab chos phyogs bcur spel: ma g.yel sgom grwa 'di yi bstan pa skyongs: ma g.yel gtsug lag 'di yi bya ra gyis: ma g.yel sgrub pa po yi dkor bdag gyis: ma g.yel rnal 'byor bdag gi phrin las sgrubs: ma g.yel nga yi sgar gzhis grwa 'khor srungs: ma g.yel nga yi nor gyi rjes su rgyugs: ma g.yel nga yi rdzas kyi rjes su rgyugs: ma g.yel nga yi ka cha'i rjes su rgyugs:
